name: (un)Holy Tattoo (Tattoo)
entries: The tattooed symbol of your faith is recognized by the gods.
{@b Benefit}:

items: Increase either your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20
You are considered to alwasy in possession of holy symbol as a focus for casting divine spells.
Gain an additional use of Channeling Divinity; When using Turn (Unholy/Faithless/Tide) range expanded to 60ft.
Gain advantage on Presuasion with ability checks against people of that faith; and disadvantage to several others (Opposite aligned faiths).

entries: {@b Note}: Simply having a tattoo of a deity's symbol does not make it usable as a holy symbol–the character must also take this feat as an act of infusing the power of their deity into the symbol.

name: 1st-Level Spellcasting
entries: You uncover magical abilities, and gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two 1st-level spells of your choice from any spell list, and gain two 1st-level spell slots. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the ability score you chose to increase with this feat.

entries: You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, your spellcasting ability increases by 1, up to a maximum of 20, you learn two more 1st-level spells of your choice from any spell list, and you gain two more 1st-level spell slots.

name: 2nd-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 2nd-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain two 2nd-level spell slots. Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat. You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, you learn two more 2nd-level spells of your choice from any spell list and gain one more 2nd-level spell slot.

name: 3rd-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 3rd-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain two 3rd-level spell slots. Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat. You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, you learn two more 3rd-level spells of your choice from any spell list and gain one more 3rd-level spell slot.

name: 4th-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 4th-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain two 4th-level spell slots. Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat. You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, you learn two more 4th-level spells of your choice from any spell list and gain one more 4th-level spell slot.

name: 5th-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 5th-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain two 5th-level spell slots. Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat. You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, you learn two more 5th-level spells of your choice from any spell list and gain one more 5th-level spell slots.

name: 6th-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 6th-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain one 6th-level spell slot.  Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat. You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, you learn one more 6th-level spell of your choice from any spell list and gain one more 6th-level spell slot.

name: 7th-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 7th-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain one 7th-level spell slot. Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting feat|Adventurer}. You can select this feat one more time. If you do so, you learn one more 7th-level spell of your choice from any spell list and gain one more 7th-level spell slot.

name: 8th-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 8th-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain one 8th-level spell slot.  Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat.

name: 9th-Level Spellcasting
entries: You learn one 9th-level spell of your choice from any spell list, and gain one 9th-level spell slot. Your spellcasting ability is the same as the one you chose when you took the {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer} feat.

name: A Friend Indeed
entries: You may use your Sacred Weapon Channel Divinity on a friendly creature's weapon within 15 feet of you. As a Dog, you may ignore the restriction on holding a weapon.

name: A Loxodon Never Forgets
entries: You have an elephant's memory. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Intelligence checks you make to remember paths you've already walked down and roads you've already taken.
Whenever you attack a creature for the first time after it dealt damage to you, you may add {@dice 1d4} to the attack roll.

name: A Tabaxi Always Lands on its Feet
entries: Your agility is truly feline. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you fall, as long as you are not incapacitated, you may make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. If you succeed, you land on your feet, and the falling damage you take is reduced by two times your level.
Standing up from prone only costs 5 feet of movement, instead of half your movement speed.

name: Aberrant Spawn
entries: You were somehow mutated or created by an aberration, such as a god-aboleth, and you suffer from strange deformities as a result. Due to these changes, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Aberrant Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition on yourself and against any effect that would read your thoughts.

entries.name: Psychic Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: At least one of your limbs is muscular, rubbery, and pliant, akin to a tentacle that you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. Additionally, when you use the Grapple or Shove option of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine the save DC. When you deal damage with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you deal Bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.

name: Aberrant Spawn
entries: You were somehow mutated or created by an aberration, such as an aboleth, and you suffer from strange deformities as a result. Due to these changes, you have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Aberrant Mind
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself and against any effect that would sense your emotions or read your thoughts.

entries.name: Psychic Resistance
entries: You have resistance to psychic damage.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries: At least one of your limbs is muscular, rubbery, and pliant, acting as a tentacle that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

name: Abnormal Arbor
entries: You have adapted to the world far better than you expected. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can now use your Shapechanger trait to turn into a plant of Medium or larger size. When you are transformed into a Large or larger plant, your reach extends by 5 feet, your speed becomes 0 and you can't benefit from any bonus to your speed.
If you spend a long rest turned into a plant, you do not need to eat or drink for the next day.

When you use your Shapechanger trait to turn into a creature, you can choose for it to gain more plant-like look. Additionally, you can cast {@spell barkskin} without expending a spell slot targeting yourself. Once you cast the spell this way, you can't cast it again with this trait until you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it. You can cast it without requiring components.

name: Acclimated
entries: More accustomed to life above ground, your tender eyes have overcome their sensitivities. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, or {@skill Perception}.
You ignore the effects of your Sunlight Sensitivity trait.

name: Acclimated
entries: More accustomed to life above ground, your tender eyes have overcome their sensitivities. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, or {@skill Perception}.
You ignore the effects of your Sunlight Sensitivity trait.

name: Ace Pilot
entries: You have logged thousands of hours at a starship's helm, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|DarkMatter} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.
When you are in the Pilot role and you take Evasive Maneuvers, you can move 1,000 feet in any direction.
No matter how difficult the conditions, if you are forced to make a crash landing, you can guide the ship to the ground softly enough to ensure that no one aboard dies in the crash.

name: Ace Pilot
entries: You have logged thousands of hours at a starship's helm, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Expert Pilot
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Piloting|DarkMatter24} skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

entries.name: Hard Turn
entries: When you take the Evasive Maneuvers action, you can move the ship 1,000 feet in any direction.

entries.name: Ramming Maneuver
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls you make with ship Melee weapons as a part of the {@variantrule Pilot|DarkMatter24} Crew Role.

entries.name: Ship Feats
entries: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

entries.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
entries: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.

items: You gain proficiency in {@skill Religion}.
Pick a {@5etools deity|deities.html}. You acquire an amulet or emblem that proves your faith. Faithful of the same deity have no doubt you are one of them.
You can make a {@skill Religion} check in place of any other {@dice d20} roll. You can use this ability a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).

name: Acolyte of Faith
entries: Choose a class: {@class cleric} or {@class druid}. You learn a cantrip of your choice from the class's spell list. Your spellcasting ability for the chosen cantrip is your choice of Wisdom or Intelligence. You can take this option multiple times, but must choose a new class each time.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Acolyte of Faith
entries: Choose a class: {@class cleric} or {@class druid}. You learn a cantrip of your choice from the class's spell list. Your spellcasting ability for the chosen cantrip is your choice of Wisdom or Intelligence. You can take this option multiple times, but must choose a new class each time.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Acolyte: Arcana
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Spell Recreation
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to memorize the spell, using your Channel Divinity. Until you use this Channel Divinity option again or finish a short or long rest, you can cast the spell once without expending a spell slot. The spell must be of 1st level.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Protection from the Arcane
entries: When you are forced to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you can use your reaction to roll the save at advantage, using your Channel Divinity. Additionally, if the effect allows you to make a saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Devotion
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.caption: Domain Spells
rows: {@spell command}, {@spell protection from evil and good}
{@spell freedom of movement}, {@spell guardian of faith}

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to imbue one weapon that you are holding with positive energy, using your Channel Divinity. For 1 minute, you add your spellcasting modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (with a minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. If the weapon is not already magical, it becomes magical for the duration.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
entries: As a bonus action, you can use your Channel Divinity to issue a challenge that compels other creatures to do battle with you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. This effect ends on the creature if you are incapacitated or die or if the creature is more than 30 feet away from you.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Eldritch
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Awakened Mind
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel divinity to touch the minds of other creatures. For one minute, you can communicate telepathically with all creatures you can see within 30 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Eldritch Madness
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with an attack roll, you can use can use your Channel Divinity as a reaction to force them to reroll the attack. You must use the new roll. If the creature rolls a 1 on the new roll, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or become insane for 1 minute. While insane, the creature can't take actions, can't understand what other creatures say, can't read, and speak only in gibberish. A {@spell greater restoration} spell cast on it ends this effect early.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Fiend
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Dark One's Own Luck
entries: When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your Channel Divinity to add a d6 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Fiendish Resilience
entries: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain 10 temporary hit points. Choose one damage type from acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. While you have these temporary hit points, you have resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Forge
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Blessing of the Forge
entries: As a bonus action, you can use your Channel Divinity to imbue magic into a weapon. Until the end of your next short or long rest or until you die, attacks made with that weapon count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Embers
entries: When you roll fire damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Grave
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you, cursing it until the end of your next turn. The next time you or an ally of yours hits the cursed creature with an attack, the creature has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage, and then the curse ends.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Sentinel at Death's Door
entries: As a reaction when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you suffers a critical hit, you can turn that hit into a normal hit, using your Channel Divinity. Any effects triggered by a critical hit are canceled.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Knowledge
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with the chosen skill or tool.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to choose one creature that you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature succeeds on the saving throw, you can't use this feature on it again until you finish a long rest.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Life
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to present your holy symbol and evoke healing energy that can restores 10 hit points. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those hit points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Supreme Healing
entries: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell, you can use your Channel Divinity to instead use the highest number possible for each die.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Light
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.caption: Domain Spells
rows: {@spell guardian of faith}, {@spell wall of fire}

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to present your holy symbol, and any magical darkness within 30 feet of you is dispelled. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes radiant damage equal to 2d6 on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has total cover from you is not affected.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Warding Flare
entries: When a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you attacks you or a creature other than you, you can use your Channel Divinity as a reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, causing light to flare before the attacker before it hits or misses. An attacker that can't be blinded is immune to this feature.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Nature
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to cause spectral vines to spring up and reach for a creature within 10 feet of you that you can see. The creature must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or be restrained. While restrained by the vines, the creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it frees itself and the vines vanish.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to present your holy symbol and invoke the name of your deity. Each beast or plant creature that can see you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is charmed by you for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While it is charmed by you, it is friendly to you and other creatures you designate.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Oathbreaker
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to target one undead creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey your commands for the next 24 hours, or until you uses this Channel Divinity option again. An undead whose challenge rating is equal to or greater than 2 is immune to this effect.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to channel the darkest emotions and focuses them into a burst of magical menace. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw if it can see you. On a failed save, the target is frightened of you for 1 minute. If a creature frightened by this effect ends its turn more than 30 feet away from you, it can attempt another Wisdom saving throw to end the effect on it.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Peace
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to augment your presence with divine power. As a bonus action, you grant yourself a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for the next 10 minutes.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to rebuke those who use violence. Immediately after an attacker within 30 feet of you deals damage with an attack against a creature other than you, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Tempest
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
entries: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Whirling Wind
entries: As a bonus action, you can use your Channel Divinity to fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Trickery
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Beguiling Presence
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to cause each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a target is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 feet of you.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Undying
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Among the Dead
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to mask your life force. For 1 minute, you are invisible to undead creatures.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Blessing of the Undying
entries: When you fail a death saving throw, you can use your Channel Divinity to reroll it. You must use the new roll.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: Vengeance
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
entries: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to present your holy symbol and speak a prayer of denunciation. Choose one creature within 60 feet of you that you can see. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw, unless it is immune to being frightened.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
entries: As a bonus action, you can use your Channel Divinity to utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 10 feet of you. You gain advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acolyte: War
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to use one of the channel divinity options from the chosen domain once per short or long rest. You choose which ability at the time you take this feat.

You learn the first level domain spells from the chosen domain, and can cast them either by using spell slots or by expending uses of your Channel Divinity. You must expend a number of uses equal to the level of the spell you are casting. Your spellcasting DC ability for your spells is the same as your ability for your channel divinities.
You gain the ability to use holy symbols as your spellcasting focus.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to exude a terrifying presence. As an action, you force each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes frightened of you for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
entries: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to the roll, using your Channel Divinity. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

You can select this feat a second time at 3rd level, a third time at 5th level, a fourth time at 7th level, and a fifth time at 9th level. Each time you do so, you gain another use of Channel Divinity and can select either the same domain or a a different domain.  If you select the same domain, you gain access to the domain spells of one level higher.

name: Acrobat
entries: You become more nimble, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Acrobatics} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

As a bonus action, you can make a DC 15 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. If you succeed, you can move through the space of any creature that isn't of a size smaller than yours until the end of the turn.

name: Action Hero
entries: {@i 12th-Level Feat. Repeatable: No.}

entries.name: Catch Jaws
entries: If a creature hits you with an attack that uses its mouth (i.e. a bite or maw attack), you can use your reaction to reduce any incoming damage by {@dice 1d10} + your level.

entries.name: Heroic Moment
entries: The first time you fail an Athletics check each day, you may choose to succeed it instead.

activation.condition: When you take damage from a bite or maw attack
First failed Athletics check each day

name: Action Surge
entries: You gain the ability to push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action. Once you use this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. You can select this feat a second time after 17th level. When you do so, you gain another use of this ability.

name: Actor
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Actor Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Actor Feat:}

name: Actor
entries: Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) and Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person.

You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check contested by your Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.

name: Adamant Bastion
entries: Your adamantine plates thicken and cover even more of your body, overlapping in interlocking sections to cover all your structural weak points. Though this gives you increased protection, the plating becomes impossible to remove. You gain the following traits:

items: Your model type becomes Adamantine Construction if it was not already, and you then lose the Remodeling racial trait, making your model type permanent.
Any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
You reduce all damage you take from attacks by 1.

name: Adamantine Chitin
entries: Your shell has become as strong as adamant, capable of withstanding even the mightiest of attacks. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
You gain +1 bonus to AC.
When you suffer a critical hit, you can use your reaction to turn that attack into a normal hit. You can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Adamantine Clan
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adamantine Skin
entries: While you aren't wearing any armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

entries.name: Adamantine Bones
entries: Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you becomes a normal hit.

name: Adaptive Colouration
entries: You are able to shift your colouration, a rare ability possessed by few of your kin, granting you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Stealth checks made to avoid being seen.

Choose one colour from your Koi Dragon Colour trait when you select this feat. When you use your Slumbering Dragon or Heartening Breath trait, you can choose to empower ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws associated with either your primary colouration or the one you chose with this feat.

name: Additional Forms
entries: You can shapeshift into unfamiliar objects more often. Instead of being able to use your Mimic {@variantrule Object|XPHB} feat only once between short rests, you can now use it any number of times.

name: Additional Wildshapes
entries: Choose a creature type: {@filter Bird Wyverns|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|search=Wyvern|tag=bird}, {@filter Brute Wyverns|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|search=Wyvern|tag=brute}, {@filter Fanged Wyverns|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|search=Wyvern|tag=fanged}, {@filter Flying Wyverns|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|search=Wyvern|tag=flying}, {@filter Leviathans|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|search=leviathan}, {@filter Neopterons & Temnoceran|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|tag=neopteron;temnoceran}, {@filter Piscine Wyverns|bestiary|source=MHMM|challenge rating=[&0;&6]|search=wyvern|tag=piscine}.

You can use your Wild Shape to transform into a creature from the type you chose (you ignore the fact that the creature isn't a beast, but must abide by the other wildshape limitations for your level). Additionally when you wildshape into one of these creatures, you cannot use their legendary resistances (if it has any), any recharge ability can only be used once per wildshape, and you cannot use any action or ability that can only be used a limited number of times a day/rest.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different creature type.
{@b Creator's Note}

The Additional Wildshape feat is still in the testing phases. Allowing the recharge ability to be used once, keeps the creatures CR more accurate to its calculated CR. This might be removed after some testing, but for the time being it should be ok, but your DM may use their own discretion to limit use of recharge abilities.

name: Adhesive Adaptation
entries: The natural adhesive you secrete becomes stickier. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on skill checks made to grapple other creatures.

When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can attempt to douse it in your adhesive. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw with a DC equal to 10 + your proficiency bonus. On a failed save, that creature has disadvantage on dexterity saving throws for 1 minute. A creature that succeeds on this save is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

name: Adhesive Climb
entries: You can use the adhesive on your pseudopods to climb any surface with ease. You gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to half your Walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. In addition, you can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

name: Adhesive Grappler
entries: You can use every part of your body to grapple your foes, and when you grapple a creature, you cover them in adhesive, slowing them down for a short time after they escape. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike using your pseudopods (or your pseudopod blade, if you have the Mimic Blade feat), you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

After a creature you have successfully {@condition grappled} is no longer {@condition grappled} (usually because you ended the grapple or the creature Escaped), the creature's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

name: Administrative Mind
entries: As a bonus action on their turn, the character can grant a number of willing creatures they can see within 60 ft. up to their Intelligence Modifier (minimum of 1) they can see advantage on one attack roll or ability check of their choice before the end of their next turn. This must be declared before the roll is made. This ability can be used once per long rest.

name: Admiral
entries: You can command more than one ship at once, provided that the ships under your command have an available Captain role, working communications, and crews which consent to your command by majority. Each ship for which you are the captain takes their turns on the same round of combat. You can choose which order the ships act in. Additionally, on your turn, you can use your action to take an action provided for you by the Captain role for each ship under your command.
You can command a number of ships equal to your proficiency bonus, up to a maximum of your Charisma modifier (minimum 2).

name: Adroit Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and the steps in crafting have become second nature to you. You gain the following benefits:

items: The time it takes to create an item using your proficient skills or tools is halved.
If you fail to successfully craft the item and would lose the components, you retain the components instead.

name: Adroit Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and the steps in crafting have become second nature to you. You gain the following benefits:

items: The time it takes to create an item using your proficient skills or tools is halved.
If you fail to successfully craft the item and would lose the components, you retain the components instead.

name: Adroit Crafter

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency in a skill or tool

entries: You've trained in crafting items using a skill or tool that you're proficient with, and the steps in crafting have become second nature to you. You gain the following benefits:

items: The time it takes to create an item using your proficient skills or tools is halved.
If you fail to successfully craft the item and would lose the components, you retain the components instead.

name: Advanced Carpentry
entries: Your knowledge of wooden structures is widely applicable throughout your adventures. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item carpenter's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
You can temporarily fortify a door or window using your action. The DC needed to open it increases by 5, but the fortification falls apart after 1 minute.

With 1 minute of work and raw materials, you can create a wooden barrier no more than 10 feet in any dimension. The barrier has AC 10 and HP 25, is immune to poison and psychic damage, and is vulnerable to fire damage. The barrier collapses 8 hours after being assembled.

name: Advanced Communications*
entries: Your time in this new world has helped to develop your ability to communicate with the primates of this world who lack your telepathic abilities. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in two languages of your choice.

As an action, you can link your telepathic mind to that of another willing lesser being. As long as the being you link with can speak a language, you will be able to communicate telepathically back and forth, so long as your connection is not severed by a mind shield.

name: Advanced Gunner
entries: You have trained to master the use of advanced firearms, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with advanced firearms.

name: Advanced Weapon Arts

prerequisite.other: Proficiency with simple and martial weapons

entries: Your proficiency with both simple and martial weapons allows you utilize their unique features to a greater extent than others when you use them to attack. When you use the attack action, you may replace any attack with any Weapon Art assigned to that weapon. You may use multiple Weapon Arts per turn, but may not use the same one twice in one turn. You may use Weapon Arts a number of times equal to twice your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a short or long rest. This feature doubles the uses of the Weapon Arts feature.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency (FS)
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with {@filter Advanced weapons|items|type=advanced weapon}, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Advanced Weapon Proficiency (G)
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Proficiency
entries: You have proficiency with {@filter Advanced weapons|items|type=advanced weapon}, and your training allows you to use the mastery properties of those weapons.

name: Adventurous Chef

prerequisite.other: Replaces the {@feat Chef|TCE} feat found in Tasha's Cauldron of Everything

entries: Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with cook's utensils if you don't already have it.

You can utilise creature parts for food by cooking with ingredient dice. With cook's utensils, a dagger, or a weapon that deals slashing damage in hand, you can begin the process of harvesting ingredient dice from the remains of a creature within 5 feet of you, so long as it died within the last 24 hours and is one of the following types of creature: aberrations, beasts, dragons, elementals, fiends, fey, giants, humanoids, monstrosities, oozes, or plants. The process takes 1 minute per creature, at the end of which you gain an ingredient die equal to the size of its Hit Dice. In addition, at the end of a long rest you gain two ingredient dice, which are d4s.

You can stock a maximum of 2 ingredient dice (these ingredient dice do not count towards any maximum limit on stock you have from another source). If you exceed your maximum when you gain a new ingredient die, you must discard stocked dice until you no longer exceed it.

At the end of a short or long rest, you can expend these ingredient dice to prepare special food for a creature within 30 feet of you, granting it temporary hit points equal to the number rolled on the ingredient die. These temporary hit points can be added to any granted by another feature of yours that expends ingredient dice.

Any creature that eats your food made using ingredient dice and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points during a short rest regains extra hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of 1).

name: Aereni Expertise
entries: Growing up in Aerenal, you spent decades developing your talent with one particular skill. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Expertise
entries: You gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with the skill you selected for this feat.

name: Aereni Half-Life
entries: You've undergone rituals that bind you to Irian and the Undying Court. Many who undergo this process have a desiccated appearance, similar to a mummy; it's up to you to decide whether you are affected in this way. Regardless of your appearance, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deathless
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage and Radiant damage.

entries.name: Radiant Focus
entries: If you cast a spell that deals Necrotic damage, you can choose to have it inflict Radiant damage instead.

name: Aereni Halflife
entries: You've undergone rituals that bind you to Irian and the Undying Court. Many who undergo this process have a desiccated appearance, similar to a mummy; it's up to you whether you are affected in this way. Regardless of your appearance, you gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and you have advantage on death saving throws.
If you cast a spell that deals necrotic damage, you can choose to have it inflict radiant damage instead.

name: Aerial Expert
entries: Years of practice or an innate talent have made you adept at gliding. You gain the following benefits:

items: You no longer need to move at least 10 feet to perform long and high jumps. You may choose whether the jump uses your Strength or Dexterity score for determining height or distance, and you double the distance you would normally leap in either case.
You may take the {@action Dash} action while gliding to fly an additional distance up to your movement speed.
You may change direction freely while gliding, and may gain up to 10 feet of altitude once before you finish your descent.

name: Aeromancer
entries: You specialize in the magic of the air, commanding howling wind and thunderous storm. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@variantrule spell prowess|TEB} with {@book aeromancy spells|TEB|2|Aeromancy Spells}.
The spells {@spell control winds|XGE},* {@spell gust|XGE},* {@spell silence}, and {@spell whirlwind|XGE}* are added to the spell list of your spellcasting class.

When you cast an aeromancy spell, you choose one creature within 5 feet of you. That creature cannot make opportunity attacks against you this turn. Also, if the spell pushes or pulls any creature, it moves that creature 5 extra feet.

When you cast an aeromancy spell of 1st level or higher, if you have a flying speed, you may choose to increase it by 15 feet for that turn. If you don't, you gain a flying speed of 15 feet for that turn, and if you are still aloft at the end of the turn, you fall unless you are held aloft by other means.

name: Affluent
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heirloom
entries: You gain an Uncommon magic item of the GM's choice, passed down through generations of your family. A {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG} or {@item Cloak of Protection|XDMG} is recommended.

entries.name: Stipend
entries: You gain 100 CR and gain another 100 CR whenever you gain a character level thereafter.

name: Against the Unseen
entries: Elves can perceive creatures that dwell in the wraith-world, be they spirits or ghosts, even when they are normally {@condition invisible} to the eyes of the living and appear only as a chilling whisper of voices. You have learnt to strengthen your heart against such terrors.

items: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws, and you cannot be {@condition frightened} by Undead creatures.

name: Agent of the Tower
entries: As a fully-inducted Agent of the Tower, you are familiar with the organization's cryptic ciphers, secret codes, and arcane symbols, and are trained in their clandestine, magical arts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You are branded with an {@condition invisible} tattoo, visible only under the effects of the spell detect magic, which is used to identify you as an Agent to your fellow Tower members.
You learn the {@spell prestidigitation} cantrip. If you already know prestidigitation, you can instead learn any other wizard cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

When you cast a spell, you can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to disguise the spell's casting. The DC equals 12 + the spell's level. On a successful check, you can cast the spell without its verbal or somatic components (your choice).

You can use your action to magically muffle your movement and hasten your step. For the next minute, creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks to hear you move, and your movement speed increases by 5 feet. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you take a long rest.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a Dexterity ability check or Dexterity saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new result, even if it is a 1.

You may use your Dexterity score instead of your Strength score when calculating your long jump distance, and your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier when calculating your high jump distance.

name: Agile Leader
entries: Each unit you control has +2 to Defense.

name: Agility
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge} action, you can immediately move 5 feet in any direction without provoking opportunity attacks, in addition to your normal movement.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Agility
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge} action, you can immediately move 5 feet in any direction without provoking opportunity attacks, in addition to your normal movement.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Air Step

prerequisite.other: {@feat Spellbook|Adventurer} (School of Conjuration or Evocation), 6th Level

entries: You can use a bonus action to create arcane panels of force in the shape of stairs or walkways that float in the air. These panels provide no cover, but can be walked across. At the end of your turn, the panels disappear and you fall if nothing else is holding you aloft. You can create arcane panels no smaller than 5 ft by 5 ft squares, and their total area cannot exceed 100 times your spellcasting modifier.

name: Akimbo Master
entries: You master the art of wielding two ranged weapons at once. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can draw or holster two sidearms when you would normally be able to draw or holster only one.

If you are wielding two ranged weapons with the {@itemProperty LD||loading} property, you can ignore the {@itemProperty LD||loading} property for those weapons, and do not need a free hand to reload them.
You can wield two one-handed ranged weapons at once, even if they do not have the {@itemProperty L||light} property.

name: Alacrity
entries: You move at supernatural speeds. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Burst of Speed
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain an additional action. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only) or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Fast
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls.

name: Alchemical Evolution

prerequisite.other: You must have taken the Materialistic feat at least twice

entries: You have accumulated enough physical and alchemical mass that you have begun to evolve into the next stage of {@race kilnkin|UltimateAdventurer}. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your size becomes Large.

Choose one of your subraces. The ability scores associated with that subrace increases by 2, to a maximum of 22. The ability score associated with each of your other subraces increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you use your Exceeding Mortal Limits trait, the maximum your ability scores can be increased to becomes 24.

name: Alchemist
entries: You have studied the secrets of alchemy and are an expert in its practice, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item alchemist's supplies|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
As an action, you can identify one potion within 5 feet of you, as if you had tasted it. You must see the liquid for this benefit to work.

Over the course of any short rest, you can temporarily improve the potency of one potion of healing of any rarity. To use this benefit, you must have {@item alchemist's supplies|phb} with you, and the potion must be within reach. If the potion is drunk no more than 1 hour after the short rest ends, the creature drinking the potion can forgo the potion's die roll and regains the maximum number of hit points that the potion can restore.

name: Alchemist
entries: You have studied the secrets of alchemy and are an expert in its practice, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
As an action, you can identify one potion within 5 feet of you, as if you had tasted it. You must see the liquid for this benefit to work.

Over the course of any short rest or long rest, you can temporarily improve the potency of one potion of healing of any rarity. To use this benefit, you must have alchemist's supplies with you, and the potion must be within reach. If the potion is drunk before your next short or long rest, the creature drinking the potion can forgo the potion's die roll and regains the maximum number of hit points that the potion can restore.

name: Alchemist
entries: You are an expert with {@item Alchemist's Supplies|phb}.
As an action, you can identify one potion within 5 feet of you, as if you had tasted it. You must see the liquid for this benefit to work.

Over the course of any short rest, you can temporarily improve the potency of one {@item acid (vial)|phb|acid} or {@item alchemist's fire (flask)|phb|alchemist's fire}. To use this benefit, you must have alchemist's supplies with you. If it's content is used no more than 1 hour after the short rest ends, the creature using it can forgo the damage roll and deal the maximum number of damage that the item can do.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Alert
entries: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and you cant be surprised while you are conscious.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Alert
entries: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and you cant be surprised while you are conscious.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Alert
entries: Gain the first two available Tiers of the Alert feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Alert Feat:}

name: Alert
entries: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative.
You can't be surprised while you are conscious.
Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

name: Alien Psychology
entries: Your aberrant origin opens up possibilities of improving your mind, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain advantage on saving throws to avoid being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

You have advantage on checks and saving throws to resist both magical and nonmagical effects that detect your thoughts, emotions or compel you to tell truth. Additionally, you can present false thoughts, emotions, or lies as if you are being truthful by making a Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check contested by the creature's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

You can use your action to sense presence of shapechangers and creatures whose true form is different from their apparent form (such as ones under the effects of disguise self) within 60 feet of you. You know their number, direction and distance from you, but don't know their true form or identity. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.
You do not need to sleep, and magic cannot put you into sleep. You can spend 8 hours of light activity and still gain the benefit of long rest.
You have advantage on saving throws to avoid falling unconscious.

name: Alluring
entries: You have mastered the otherworldly powers of your voice, gaining the following benefits:

items: As an action you can attempt to charm one or more humanoids that can hear you by singing an unearthly song. A creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus, with advantage if you are currently fighting it, or it becomes {@condition charmed} by you for one hour or until one of your allies harms it. It will know it has been charmed when the effect ends. You can use this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). You may expend multiple uses in a single action to affect an additional creature for each use beyond the first. You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

You become proficient in singing as if your voice were a musical instrument and can sing underwater. While you are singing, humanoids, giants, and beasts with intelligence 7 or less that can hear you are {@condition charmed} by you. If you or your companions do anything harmful to an affected creature, it becomes immune to your song for 24 hours.

name: Alpha of the Pack
entries: Your howling fury establishes you as master of the hunt. Whilst raging, your allies have advantage against a single target that you are engaged with.

name: Altered
entries: You have been changed through magic, science, or a volatile blend of the two. You have a blatant physical augmentation of your choice from the options below. The augmentation is obvious—such as with stitches, grafts of other creature's body parts, or implants—unless disguised.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You have gills or mucus membranes that allow you to breathe water, and you have webbed extremities that grant you a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: You have scales, plates, or thick hide that grants you an AC of 13 + your Dexterity or Constitution modifier (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: You have claws, fangs, horns, or some other natural weapon that you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} that deal {@damage 1d8} damage on a hit. The damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing as appropriate to the form.

entries.name: Night Vision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, its range increases by 30 feet.

name: Alu'Tel'Quessir Training
entries: You have received advanced training that heightens your senses and quickens your reflexes, reserved for only the most elite Alu'Tel'Quessir warriors. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
You gain {@sense blindsight} out to 5 feet. While you are submerged in water, your blindsight increases to 30 feet.

name: Alu'Tel'Quessir Training
entries: You have received advanced training that heightens your senses and quickens your reflexes, reserved for only the most elite Alu'Tel'Quessir warriors. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
You gain {@sense blindsight} out to 5 feet. While you are submerged in water, your {@sense blindsight} increases to 30 feet.
Lose the -3 to off-hand attacks.  For clarification, Polearm Master's attack now works as written and does not take a -3 penalty.
Gain the ability to attack with one additional off-hand attack as a bonus action.

name: Ambusher
entries: When you hit a creature from which you are hidden with a weapon attack, you can roll your weapon damage twice and take the higher result.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Ambusher
entries: When you hit a creature from which you are hidden with a weapon attack, you can roll your weapon damage twice and take the higher result.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: An Eye for Trouble
entries: When you find a trap or secret door while investigating you learn the following additional details about the trap or door:

items: Approximately how long ago the trap was set or door was last used.
Likely requirements for resetting the trap or resealing the door behind you.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: An Eye for Trouble
entries: When you find a trap or secret door while investigating you learn the following additional details about the trap or door:

items: Approximately how long ago the trap was set or door was last used.
Likely requirements for resetting the trap or resealing the door behind you.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

entries.name: Borrowed Masteries
entries.entry: Learn 3 masteries and choose a damage type for each. You can use these masteries on any weapon attack that makes an attack roll. When you do, for that attack you can change the weapon's damage type to the type that was chosen for that mastery and you gain tolerance to that damage type until the end of your next turn

entries.name: Repeatable
entries.entry: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Ancient Knowledge
entries: You are specially studious and pick up new skills with ease. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
You gain one skill proficiency of your choice, one tool proficiency of your choice, and fluency in one language of your choice.

Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it. The skill you choose must be one that isn't already benefiting from a feature, such as {@feat Expertise}, that doubles your proficiency bonus.

name: Android
entries: You are an escaped android—likely a Version 13—that is functionally a perfect replica of a human being, except that wires and blinking lights lie hidden underneath your skin. It is even possible you aren't aware of your construct origins, owing to faulty programming, willing suppression of memory, or intentional tampering with your construct core. You have the following benefits:

items: You are immune to nonmagical diseases.
You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, but you can ingest food and drink if you wish.

Instead of sleeping, you enter an inactive state for 4 hours each day. You don't dream in this state; you are fully aware of your surroundings and notice approaching enemies and other events as normal. You can still be placed into a torpor by sleep-inducing magic.

You have the ability to speak the native code-language of machines. You can use this language to interact with arcane terminals and ship computers from range and to communicate with constructs, even if you don't share a language.

name: Android
entries: You are an escaped android—likely a Version 13—that is functionally a perfect replica of a human being, except that wires and blinking lights lie hidden underneath your skin. It is even possible you aren't aware of your construct origins, owing to faulty programming, willing suppression of memory, or intentional tampering with your construct core. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Construct Anatomy
entries: You don't need food, drink, or air. You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

entries.name: Machine Code
entries: You know {@language Machine Code|DarkMatter24}, the native code-language of machines. Due to this language, you know the {@spell Technomancy|DarkMatter24} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you install the graft).

entries.name: Technical Expertise
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of {@skill Data|DarkMatter24}, {@skill Piloting|DarkMatter24}, or {@skill Technology|DarkMatter24}.

name: Angelic Protection
entries: The innate resistance to magic that angels possess extends to you. You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

name: Animal Handler
entries: You master the techniques needed to train and handle animals. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You can use a bonus action on your turn to command one friendly beast within 60 feet of you that can hear you and that isn't currently following the command of someone else. You decide now what action the beast will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you issue a general command that lasts for 1 minute, such as to guard a particular area.

name: Animal Partner

prerequisite.other: {@feat Complex Training|TalentTrees} or {@feat One with the Rider|TalentTrees} or {@feat Bolster Animal|TalentTrees}

entries: You can give a trained animal commands as a bonus action. Additionally, you can select one beast that you have trained to be your partner. The chosen beast increases its hit point maximum by twice your proficiency bonus while it remains your partner. You can only select one animal to be your partner at a time.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Animal Partner

prerequisite.other: {@feat Complex Training|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat One with the Rider|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Bolster Animal|TalentTreesMod}

entries: You can give a trained animal commands as a bonus action. Additionally, you can select one beast that you have trained to be your partner. The chosen beast increases its hit point maximum by twice your proficiency bonus while it remains your partner. You can only select one animal to be your partner at a time.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Animalistic Mutation
entries: You gain animal like characteristics. Choose two of the following:

items.name: Claws
entries: Your unarmed strikes deal {@dice 1d6} slashing damage.

items.name: Carapace
entries: You gain a natural armour of 12 + you Dexterity modifier.

items.name: Reflexes
entries: You may add your Proficiency Bonus to your initiative rolls.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

name: Animorph
