entries: When you gain this feat, choose one CR 1/4 or lower beast that doesn't have a swimming or flying speed. You may transform into the chosen creature as an action, all rules of the druid's wildshape transformation apply to this one except that it lasts for 1 hour.
If the chosen creature has a CR of 1/8 or higher, once you have transformed this way, you may not do so again until you finish a long rest.
If the creature has a CR of 0, you may transform into it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, after which you may not do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Ankle Cutter
entries: When making a Sneak Attack, if any of the Sneak Attack dice roll their maximum face value, your target's speed is reduced to 0 until they pass a Constitution Saving Throw at the end of one of their turns. The DC for this is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier.

name: Apanhar Objetos
entries: O personagem consegue apanhar projéteis atirados contra ele em pleno ar, como flechas, virotes, lanças e outros projéteis e armas de arremesso.

{@b Beneficio:} Quando usar o talento Desviar Objetos, o personagem será capaz de apanhar a arma (ou projétil) em vez de apenas desviá-la. As armas de arremesso, como lanças e machados, podem ser imediatamente arremessadas contra o atacante original (mesmo que não seja o turno do personagem) ou mantidas para utilização posterior. É necessário ter pelo menos uma mão livre (sem estar segurando nada) para usar esse talento.

name: Apex Predator
entries: When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark} on a target, choose up to three willing creatures within 30 feet. They each gain a {@damage 1d4} damage bonus to attacks against the same target for the duration of the effect. (One creature will also benefit from {@feat Lead the Hunt|Dungeons&Doggies}).

name: Apex Predator
entries: You are a true lord of the forest, hunted by none and challenged by few. You gain the following benefits:

items: Beasts must make a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) when they target you with an attack or harmful effect. On a failure, they are cowed by your superior predatory nature and must choose a new target or lose the attack.

In your elf form, you can use your bite as a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Dexterity modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.
In both forms, you strike with deadly accuracy, and your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

name: Apparent Competence
entries: When attempting to don armor or wield weapons with which you are not proficient, you can attempt to appear proficient, ignoring disadvantage on your attacks and other pentalties due to wearing unfamiliar armor and adding your proficiency bonus to your attacks with the unfamiliar weapons. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and you regain the use of this ability after you complete a short or long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Apparent Competence
entries: When attempting to don armor or wield weapons with which you are not proficient, you can attempt to appear proficient, ignoring disadvantage on your attacks and other penalties due to wearing unfamiliar armor and adding your proficiency bonus to your attacks with the unfamiliar weapons. This effect lasts for 10 minutes and you regain the use of this ability after you complete a short or long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Apprentice
entries: Choose a class: {@class bard}, {@class cleric}, {@class druid}, {@class sorcerer}, {@class warlock}, or {@class wizard}. You learn a cantrip of your choice from that class's spell list. Your spellcasting ability for the chosen cantrip is the same as that of the chosen class.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Apprentice
entries: Choose a class: {@class artificer|TCE}, {@class bard}, {@class cleric}, {@class druid}, {@class sorcerer}, {@class warlock}, or {@class wizard}. You learn a cantrip of your choice from that class's spell list. Your spellcasting ability for the chosen cantrip is the same as that of the chosen class.
When you take this option, if you already have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, you can choose to progress again on this tree instead learning any cantrip.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Aquanaut
entries: Your world is nearly one continuous ocean, with nary an island in sight. Consequently, you have aquatic features, like gills, webbed fingers and toes, and fishlike scales, that grant you the following benefits.

entries.name: Aquatic
entries: You can breathe underwater.

entries.name: Finned
entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Marine Speech
entries: You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity that has a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB}. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

name: Aquanaut
entries: One of your parents is a merfolk, or you are distantly descended from the Elemental Plane of Water; consequently, you have aquatic features like gills, webbed fingers and toes, and fishlike scales, which grant you the following racial traits:

entries.name: Aquatic
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Finned
entries: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

name: Aquatic
entries: Your world is nearly one continuous ocean, with nary an island in sight. Consequently, you have aquatic features, like gills, webbed fingers and toes, and fishlike scales, which grant you the following benefits:

items: You can breathe water as well as air.
You have a swimming speed equal to your movement speed.

name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: You are able to live underwater. This may be a natural feature of your character if you're playing a Malenti or an Elf from Valraea, or it could be the result of arcane transmutation or a divine blessing. Whatever the origin of this gift, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe underwater. If you possess the Limited Amphibiousness trait in addition to this feat, this eliminates your dependence on water.

entries.name: Athletic Build
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Natural Swimmer
entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Aquatic Heritage
entries: You manifest more of the magical power of your heritage. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell detect magic} spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot.
You have resistance to cold damage.

name: Arachne
entries: Much like drow, humans can be corrupted by the magic of the drow goddess, becoming arachne—humans with eight eyes and coarse, black hair. Sometimes these humans are the offspring of driders or drow priestesses, while other times they bear the marks of a ritual sacrifice gone terribly awry.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 120 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Spider Magic
entries: You know the {@spell poison spray} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell bane} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell spider climb} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell bane} or spider climb with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

name: Arcane Ammunitionist*
entries: You have developed the magical ability of conjuring ammunition and returning weapons you throw, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to ranged attack rolls.

You can conjure a piece of mundane ammunition (such as {@item arrow|yastah|arrows} for bows, {@item crossbow bolt|yastah|bolts} for crossbows, or {@item sling bullet|yastah|stones} for slings) as part of an attack with a ranged weapon. The conjured ammunition disappears after 1 round.
Immediately after you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon, you can cause the weapon to teleport into your hand.
You ignore the loading quality of crossbows with which you are proficient.
You also ignore the reload of firearms that use {@item bullet|yastah|basic bullets} and {@item slug|yastah|slugs}. {@color NO OTHER ROUNDS WILL WORK|e40707}

name: Arcane Beast Shape

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast a cantrip or spell, {@feat Beast Shape|Adventurer}, 18th Level

entries: You gain the ability to cast many of your spells in any shape you assume using Beast Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

name: Arcane Cannoneer
entries: Your experience casting spells from a starship's {@variantrule Gunner|DarkMatter24|Arcane Cannon} grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Mega Cantrip
entries: When you use the {@variantrule Gunner|DarkMatter24|Arcane Cannon} action to magnify a cantrip that deals damage to Mega scale, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the damage roll.

entries.name: Over-Cast
entries: When you cast a Mega spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can give one target of the spell {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saves against the spell. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ship Feats
entries: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

entries.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
entries: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.

name: Arcane Charger
entries: When you use your action to Dash, you can cast a cantrip with a range of touch by using your bonus action. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line and hit with your cantrip, you can either add a +5 bonus to the spell's damage roll or push the target 10 feet away from you.

name: Arcane Conduit

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast at least one spell

entries: You have developed a synaptic link between yourself and your companion, working in tandem to achieve arcane mastery. You gain the following benefit:

On your turn, as a bonus action you can create a link between yourself and a bonded companion within 100 feet. Until the end of your next turn, the next spell you would cast is cast by your companion instead. Use your companion's location to determine range and visibility of targets. Your companion automatically provides all verbal, somatic and material components without a gold cost. If the spell uses an attack roll, spell saving throw, or similar requirement, it uses your modifiers.

name: Arcane Conduit

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast at least one spell

entries: You have developed a synaptic link between yourself and your companion, working in tandem to achieve arcane mastery. You gain the following benefit:

On your turn, as a bonus action you can create a link between yourself and a bonded companion within 100 feet. Until the end of your next turn, the next spell you would cast is cast by your companion instead. Use your companion's location to determine range and visibility of targets. Your companion automatically provides all verbal, somatic and material components without a gold cost. If the spell uses an attack roll, spell saving throw, or similar requirement, it uses your modifiers.

items: Your Scoridra siblings have started to understand each other's casting capabilities and movements while focusing upon spellcasting. Arcane Cooperation negates Arcane Sibling Rivalry's negative effect of having all attacks made on you until the start of your next turn to have Advantage to hit.
Gain proficiency with Appraisal, {@skill Arcana}, and {@skill History}.
You learn the Arcane language.
You can cast spells through spell scrolls as if they were on your spell list. If they are not, the spellcasting modifier is Intelligence; otherwise, it's your designated spellcasting attribute.
Once per long rest, when you see another creature casting a spell, you can use your reaction to give the target(s) a +2 to their saving throws if they are within 60 feet of you.

name: Arcane Enchanter
entries: {@i 12th-Level Feat. Repeatable: No.}

entries.name: Enchant
entries: As an action, you can select an item you can see and touch, and enchant it. You may only have a single item enchanted at any given point, and when you use this action, any previous enchants you have made end. The item gains one of the following enchantments based on its type:

items: {@bold Weapon:} For the next minute that weapon deals {@damage 1d6} additional damage of any damage type that your spells can deal. At level 16, you may add your proficiency bonus to this additional damage.

{@bold Armour:} For the next minute that armour provides the wearer with resistance to one damage type that your spells can deal. At level 16, you may select two damage types that this armour provides resistance to.

{@bold Wondrous:} For the next minute, that item provides the bearer advantage on saving throws and checks to prevent or end a condition of your choice. At level 16, you may select two conditions that this item provides advantage for.

name: Arcane Fist
entries: While you have your {@spell mage hand} out, you gain the ability to use your {@spell mage hand} to make a special ranged spell attack with a range of 30 feet which requires verbal and somatic components and uses your spellcasting ability from {@spell mage hand} for the attack roll. This attack deals 1 bludgeoning damage. If you have the {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} feat or another way of increasing your unarmed strike damage, this attack deals damage equal to your unarmed strike. You do not add your spellcasting modifier to the damage of this attack. When you use this attack, your {@spell mage hand} moves next to the target of the attack.

You can also use your {@spell mage hand} to attempt to grapple or shove creatures within 30 feet of you. When you do so, you use your spellcasting ability score for the check instead of your Strength.
If you have the {@feat Spellcasting Style|Adventurer} feat, this special attack can benefit from the Destructive, Elementalist, and Repelling styles.

If you have a second {@spell mage hand} summoned from the {@feat Spellcasting Style|Adventurer}: Dualcast, when you take the Attack action on your turn and use this special attack as part of it, you can make an additional attack with this special attack.
If you have the {@feat Extra Attack|Adventurer} feat, this special attack can be used for any of the attacks you make as part of the Attack action.

If you have the {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} feat, when you take the Attack action on your turn and use this special attack as part of it, you can make the special attack once as a bonus action, or spend 1 ki point to make the special attack twice as a bonus action.
If you have the {@feat Mage Hand Legerdemain|Adventurer} feat, attacking with your {@spell mage hand} while hidden does not give away your location.

name: Arcane Focus*
entries: During a short rest you can perform a 1 hour long ritual to attune your weapon to arcane energy. Doing so will grant the following benefits:

items: You use your melee weapon to channel your arcane energy.
Apply any magic bonus from the weapon to any spell attack rolls you make.
You can perform touch spells through your melee weapon.

name: Arcane Furnace
entries: You may convert calories into heightened magical ability.

items: By burning the value of 1 day's consumed meals you may increase the DC of your spell a single spell.
Once per long rest, you may spend a spellslot to convert that into a meal equivalent.
The spell caster when in a cold enviroment, can effectively burn a meal equivalent to offset the effect of the cold (per period).
When casting a spell with costly material component you may instead choose to burn one meal for every 10gp worth of material components, (as an object interaction) once per day.

name: Arcane Preparation

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation; Spellcasting feature from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard class

entries: Instead of preparing spells normally, you fix each spell slot precisely in your mind, in the manner of wizards long past. When you would prepare spells when you finish a long rest, you record which spell you will use with each of your spell slots, picking from among the spells you could cast using it. These spell slots can't be expended for any purpose other than casting their assigned spells, but can be recovered and used to cast any spell. Additionally, you gain a bonus spell slot of each level for which you have spell slots, to which you do not assign a particular spell and can cast normally.

For example, a 3rd level wizard has four 1st-level spell slots and two 2nd-level spell slots. Using this feat, the wizard must assign each spell slot to a spell; for example, three 1st-level {@spell magic missile|PHB|magic missiles}, one 1st-level {@spell sleep}, one 2nd-level {@spell scorching ray}, and one 2nd-level {@spell mirror image}. The wizard also has one bonus 1st-level spell slot and one bonus 2nd-level spell slot, through which they can cast any spell they have recorded in their spellbook.

name: Arcane Prescience
entries: As part of your reaction, you can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check to discern the identity of a spell you see being cast. The DC for the check = 10 + the spell's level. If the check succeeds, you or one ally of your choosing have advantage on the saving throw against that casting of the spell. After identifying the spell, you can move up to 10 feet or half your speed, whichever is less.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). You regain expended uses after you finish a short or long rest.

items: Whenever you roll damage for a spell, you can reroll a number of damage equal to your spellcasting modifier. You must keep the new results.
Whenever you learn a new spell, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 20 you can learn an additional spell that meets the same requirements as the spell that triggered the roll.

name: Arcane Recovery
entries: You have learned to regain some of your magical energy. When you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level of 2, and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, the combined level of recovered slots increases by 2.

name: Arcane Ward
entries: When you finish a long rest, you can create a magical ward on yourself that lasts until you finish your next a long rest. The ward starts with hit points equal to five times your spellcasting ability modifier which you choose for {@feat 1st-Level Spellcasting|Adventurer}. If your Arcane Ward is dispelled or disabled in some other way, you must finish a long rest until you can cast it again.

Whenever you take damage, the ward takes the damage instead. If this damage reduces the ward to 0 hit points, you take any remaining damage. While the ward has 0 hit points, it canâ€™t absorb damage, but its magic remains. Whenever you expend a spell slot to cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, the ward gains a number of hit points equal to twice the level of the expended spell slot.

name: Arcanine Scrounger
entries: You can temporarily learn others' spells as you scrounge for knowledge. Choose a willing creature and spend 15 minutes with them discussing the intricacies of their spellcasting. You may learn a spell that the creature knows as if you have it prepared, but it does not count against the number of spells you can prepare. You can cast this spell until then end of your next long rest.

name: Arcanist
entries: You study the arcane arts, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You learn the {@spell prestidigitation} and {@spell detect magic} spells. You can cast detect magic once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

name: Archangel*
entries: Daijizaten's warmth is still ever present in your heart, and his peaceful motives spread to your mind even if bloodshed is in your nature. You gain the Following Benefits:

items: Once per day, you can escape harm by creating a burst of blinding light. As an action, you cause yourself to glow violently, making every hostile creature within 30 ft of you roll a CON save against your CHA modifier or become {@condition blinded} until the end of their next turn. Immediately after using this effect, you and any ally within 10 ft of you can {@action dash} as a Bonus Action for 3 rounds.

name: Archery
entries: Once when you would miss a ranged weapon attack roll you can add two to your attack roll. You regain this ability at the start of your next turn.

name: Archery Champion*
entries: You triumphed in countless contests of archery and have learned to use your bow to its fullest, granting the following benefits:

items: When you make a ranged attack with the weapon against targets who have disadvantage on Dexterity checks or Dexterity saving throws, add your Strength modifier to the attack roll.

You have learned to use your bow in acrobatic maneuvers. You can add your proficiency bonus for Acrobatics checks made while carrying a shortbow or longbow. If you are already proficient in Acrobatics, you can instead add double your proficiency bonus.

You can attempt to intercept an opponent's ranged weapon attack with one of your own. When a creature that you can see makes a ranged weapon attack against another creature that you can see, you can use your reaction to make a ranged attack with your weapon against the opponent's projectile. The projectile's AC is equal to the opponent's attack roll plus 5. On a hit, the opponent's attack misses. (Boulders hurled by giants or siege engines, and similar projectiles, are unaffected)

name: Archon

prerequisite.other: Member of the S.S. Saint Vincent

entries: You are a shining beacon of law and order, bringing justice and peace to those of the Frontier. You gain the following benefits:

items: You are granted a badge of rank, designating you as an Archon of the S.S. St. Vincent. You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks to convince those who recognize this badge of your benevolence, and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks against raiders, pirates, and other lawbreakers.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can place yourself between harm and one of your allies within 5 feet of you. Until the beginning of your next turn, you have a -2 penalty to AC and your ally gains a +2 bonus to AC.
You gain a +1 bonus to one saving throw of your choice.

name: Arena Champion
entries: Whether you adopt the dirty fighting of the pits or the flashy spectacle of the arena, your combat style takes on the performative aspects of a gladiator. You gain the following benefits:

items: As an action you may make a melee weapon attack using {@skill Acrobatics} (Dexterity), {@skill Athletics} (Strength), or {@skill Performance} (Charisma). If this attack hits treat it as a critical hit. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Armor Bond
entries: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one shield or suit  of armor. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a short rest. The shield or suit of armor must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the shield or suit of armor and forge the bond.

Once you have bonded a shield or piece of armor to yourself, you can shunt it into an extradimensional space as an action. Afterwards, you can summon that shield or piece of armor as a reaction to being hit by an attack, donning it instantly if you are unarmored. Its armor class is included against the triggering attack. You can only have one bonded shield or suit of armor. If you attempt to create a new bond, it replaces the current one.

name: Armor Training
entries: You gain proficiency with armor or improve your existing armor proficiencies. You can take this talent multiple times. You gain proficiency with light armor. If you already have proficiency in light armor, you also gain proficiency in medium armor and shields. If you already have proficiency in medium armor, you also gain proficiency in heavy armor. When you take this option, if you already have proficiency with the armor you desire, you can choose to progress again on this tree instead of gaining any armor proficiencies.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Armor Training
entries: You gain proficiency with armor or improve your existing armor proficiencies. You can take this talent multiple times. You gain proficiency with light armor. If you already have proficiency in light armor, you also gain proficiency in medium armor and shields. If you already have proficiency in medium armor, you also gain proficiency in heavy armor. When you take this option, if you already have proficiency with the armor you desire, you can choose to progress again on this tree instead of gaining any armor proficiencies.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

items: As a bonus action, you can attach or detach a {@item shield|PHB} to your {@item heavy bowgun|AGMH}.
While the shield is attached, you gain a +2 bonus to your AC, your movement speed is halved, and being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you attack a creature with your heavy bowgun, and they are within the weapon's normal range, you can choose to use Strength instead of Dexterity for its attack and damage bonuses.

name: Armorer
entries: You are trained in the upkeep and construction of weapons and armor. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with {@item leatherworker's} and {@item smith's tools}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.

You can spend an hour repairing a piece of equipment damaged by rust, ooze, or similar degrading effects. Each hour spent repairing an item removes one instance of its cumulative penalty. You must have smith's tools, as well as access to a sufficient heat source and materials to use this benefit.

You are able to refine armor in a variety of ways. Over 12 hours, you can modify one piece of nonmagical armor to either remove its disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, or to give it resistance to either acid or cold damage. You must have {@item smith's tools or leatherworker's tools}, as appropiate to the type of armor, as well as access to a sufficient heat source and materials worth the base cost of the armor, which are consumed, to use this benefit. You can't apply multiple modifications to a single suit of armor with this feature.

name: Arms Booster
entries: You can channel the power of your spells into an ally's weapon. By touching a weapon and expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher as an action, the weapon becomes temporarily magical for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell slot expended. The weapon counts as magical and gains a +1 bonus to damage rolls but gains no bonus to attack rolls. This effect ends when the duration expires, when you lose your concentration, or when you cast a spell that requires your concentration. You must complete a short or long rest before you can use arcane infusion again.

name: Arquearia Montada

otherSummary.entry: Proficiência em {@skill Animal Handling} e {@feat Mounted Combatant}

entries: O personagem é capaz de usar armas de ataque à distância enquanto está cavalgando.
{@b Beneficio:} A penalidade que seu personagem sofre quando utiliza uma arma de ataque à distância é eliminada: em vez de Desvantagem quando a montaria está correndo.

name: Art of Disappearing
entries: Hobbits are said to have little or no magic about them, but the way they can choose to disappear quickly and quietly can be described by others only as supernatural. You have learnt to choose exactly the right moment to turn away from the attention of others, sometimes unconsciously anticipating the need to disappear.

items: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check you make.
You can try to hide even when you are only lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding.

name: Artifactor
entries: You are one of DD&D's renowned Artifactors, tasked with acquiring valuable magic items, be it through shrewd negotiation or daring expedition. You gain the following benefits:

items: You are adept at identifying the properties of magic items. After examining an object for one minute, you can determine the object's exact market value; as well, if it is a magic item, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any.
You can attune to four magic items, instead of three.
You have advantage on all Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made to barter, buy and sell goods and services.

You learn {@filter two infusions|optionalfeatures|feature type=ai} of your choice from among those available to the {@class Artificer|TCE} class that do not have a level requirement or gold cost. If an infusion you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the infusion's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier. If an infusion would improve at a certain level in Artificer, it does not improve for you unless you are an Artificer of that level.
You can use one of these infusions at a time. If you already have infusions, then you increase the amount of infusions you can use at a time by one.

name: Artificer Initiate.
entries: You have the makings of a Artificer in you!

items: Choose 2 Infusions with an infusion cost of 1; and whose schemas spells you already know. You gain 2 infusion points to use per long rest.
You gain proficiency in the Tinkerer's Tools or Arcane (your choice).
If you already have proficiency in both, gain expertise in one.

name: Artillerist
entries: Your experience behind massive shipbound weapons grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Ship Weapon Mastery
entries: You can use the mastery property of two kinds of ship weapons of your choice, provided you have proficiency with them.
Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can change the kinds of weapons to other eligible kinds.

entries.name: Expanded Critical
entries: Your attack rolls with ship weapons can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

entries.name: Ship Feats
entries: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

entries.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
entries: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.

name: Artisan
entries: You are a creative, learning a variety of artistic crafts. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with two artisan's tools of your choice. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

name: Artisan Rage

prerequisite.other: {@feat Rage|Adventurer}, Proficiency with one set of artisan's tools

entries: You have learned how to harness your rage for your craft, and how to harness your craft for combat. You become proficient in using your artisan's tools in combat. They deal 1d6 damage, of a type that is reasonable for the tool.
While raging, you have advantage on checks made with artisan's tools. Your rage doesn't end as long as you're working with your artisan tools.

name: Ashbound Initiate
entries: You have learned a certain number of the secrets and techniques of the Ashbound druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ashbound Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Arcane Enmity
entries: When a creature you can see casts a spell, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Ashbound Spells
entries: The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Ashbound Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Assassinate
entries: You are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, when you hit a creature that is surprised, you can deal maximum damage with your {@feat Sneak Attack|Adventurer}.

name: Assistance
entries: You learn to instruct, guide, or inspire others through logical commands, advice or anecdotes, or stirring words or music. To do so, you use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one assistance die, a d6.

Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 before deciding to use the assistance die, but must decide before the DM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the assistance die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one assistance die at a time.
During a short rest, you can spend 1 assistance die to heal any friendly creatures within 60 feet by the amount rolled.
You have two assistance dice. You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Assistance Dog
entries: You are gifted at guiding others. You can nominate a creature within 5 feet of you as a bonus action. Whilst in this range, it benefits from your Keen Senses trait as if it possessed the trait itself.

name: Astrogations Inc.: Starguide
entries: As a starguide for Astrogations Inc., you receive flashes of prescience to help you navigate the Galactic Frontier, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Momentary Prescience
entries: When you roll the {@dice d20} for a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can flip the {@dice d20} over and use the number on the bottom. Note that for a balanced {@dice d20}, the top and bottom numbers add up to 21. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Navigator's Discount
entries: You receive a 50 percent discount on Star Charts you purchase from Astrogations Inc.

entries.name: Faction Feats
entries: Veteran adventurers are likely to make enemies across the 'Verse, but if they're lucky, they might forge some alliances too. The greatest of these alliances are likely to be with factions, which provide work, services, and connections to spacers everywhere. Factions in Dark Matter are detailed in Chapter 1: The 'Verse.

Of course, such allies don't come free. Factions generally also require work and commitment from their members, which might come in the form of small tasks, important favors for higher ranking members, or even regular obligations for the organization. For their efforts, adventurers gain specific and useful skills from their factions, as represented by Faction feats.

entries.name: Gaining a Faction Feat
entries: The GM can award you a Faction feat for joining a faction or completing a quest for one. If allegiance to a faction is important to your backstory, the GM can also replace the feat granted by your background with an appropriate Faction feat.

name: At Their Heels
entries: You are skilled in dogging your opponent no matter what. When a target provokes an opportunity attack from you, if you hit then you may also move up to half your movement speed towards your foe.

name: Ataque Atordoante
entries: O personagem sabe atingir oponentes em áreas vulneráveis.

{@b Beneficio:} O jogador precisa declarar que seu personagem está usando esse talento antes de realizar a jogada de ataque (logo, um fracasso na jogada desperdiçará a tentativa). Um oponente atingido por um ataque desarmado atordoante deve realizar um Saving Throw de Constituição (CD 10 + modificador de Sab), além de sofrer o dano normalmente. Caso fracasse, o alvo ficará atordoado durante 1 rodada completa (até o final da próxima ação do personagem). Um personagem atordoado perde qualquer bônus de Destreza na CA e bônus do seu escudo na CA. É possível desferir um ataque atordoante somente uma vez por rodada a cada descanso curto. Os constructos, limos, plantas, mortos-vivos, criaturas incorpóreas e criaturas imunes a sucessos decisivos não podem ser atordoadas.

name: Ataque com Escudo Aprimorado
entries: O personagem pode atacar com um escudo sem perder seu bônus na Classe de Armadura.
{@b Beneficio:} Quando seu personagem atacar com um escudo, ele ainda considera o bônus do equipamento na CA.
{@b Normal:} Sem este talento, os personagens que atacam com um escudo perdem o bônus que ele concede na CA até a próxima ação.

name: Ataque Poderoso
entries: O personagem é capaz de realizar ataques corporais excepcionalmente poderosos.

{@b Beneficio:} Durante a ação de seu personagem, mas antes de realizar as jogadas de ataque, é possível subtrair um valor de todas as jogadas de ataque e adicioná-lo a todas as jogadas de dano. As alterações no ataque e no dano continuam válidas até seu próximo turno, inclusive para ataques de oportunidade.

name: Atavist
entries: By embracing your unique heritage and deepening the bond between you and your Quori spirit, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you communicate telepathically with a creature using your Mind Link trait, you can simultaneously communicate with any number of creatures up to your proficiency bonus. As a bonus action, when you're speaking telepathically to one or more creatures, you can give those creatures the ability to speak telepathically to each other until the start of your next turn. To use this ability, the creatures must be within 60 feet of you and be able to see you.

You can call to your Quori spirit for guidance in all things. If you miss with an attack roll, or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier. You choose when you make the roll, provided you aren't {@condition incapacitated}. Once you use this ability, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Athlete
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Climb Speed
items.entry: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed

items.name: Hop Up
items.entry: When you are Prone, getting up only spends 5ft of movement

items.name: Jumping
items.entry: Once at any time you can add 5 times your proficiency bonus to your jump distance until the start of your next turn. You regain this ability on a short or long rest.

name: Athlete
entries: You can accomplish mythical feats of athletic prowess. You gain the following benefits:

items: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Athletic Movement. Gain your choice of a climbing speed or swimming speed equal to your movement speed.
Gain the Athletic Feat special ability (below).

entries.name: Athletic Feat
entries: You can perform an outrageous athletic feat. You can do any of the following during your turn:

items: Jump a distance equal to your movement speed.
Lift twice your normal lifting capacity until the end of your turn.
Move at normal speed while carrying or dragging another creature until the end of your turn.
Make a free Strength or Dexterity saving throw or ability check against an ongoing effect or spell effecting you that would normally take an action or only occur at the end of your turn
Take the {@action Dash} action as a bonus action.

entries: Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest. You can use the feature again before completing a rest by taking a level of exhaustion.

name: Athlete
entries: You can accomplish mythical feats of athletic prowess.

items: After moving at least 20 feet in a direction, your next melee weapon attack deals an additional 1d8 damage. This damage increases by 1d8 for each additional 20 feet moved, up to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Flowing Strikes
entries: As an action, you can move up to 15 feet. Each time you move into range of a new creature, you can make one melee weapon attack against the creature. This can only hit a creature once per turn, and each time you move you can only attack once (even if moving into reach of multiple new creatures). You can make a maximum number of attacks this way equal to your proficiency bonus.

If you are wielding two weapons with the Light property, you can use your bonus action to make one additional attack in this way.Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Athlete
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Athlete Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Athlete Feat:}

name: Athlete
entries: You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:

items: When you are {@condition prone}, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.
Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement.
You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

When the Scoridra makes a bite attack, all three siblings attack the same target at once. On a successful bite attack, you may spend a reaction to deal 3d6 piercing damage instead of than 1d6. You may use Attack As One again after a long rest.
You gain {@sense tremorsense} of 60 feet. (tremorsense doesn't not substitute sight for the purposes that require you to see a creature).

items.name: Walls Have Ears
entries: Using your action, you touch your ear on an adjacent wall. You feel the vibration of each creature talking in a 150 feet radius that is within 10 feet of a wall. The walls must have a physical path connecting them. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency bonus per long rest.

name: Augmented Force

prerequisite.other: The ability to manifest at least one power

entries: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: fire, force, or psychic. Powers you manifest ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type, and they treat immunity to damage of this type as resistance instead.
Additionally, when you roll damage for a power you manifest that deals damage of the chosen type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

name: Aura
entries: You exude an aura around you that has noticeable affect on your allies while you are conscious. Your aura has range of 10 feet, affecting any friendly creatures in range. Choose one of the following auras. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different aura.

entries.name: Aura of Might
entries: Both you and all allies in your aura add your Strength modifier to Strength saving throws. Additionally, all allies in your aura can add your Strength modifier to Strength (Athletics) checks.

entries.name: Aura of Quickness
entries: Both you and all allies in your aura add your Dexterity modifier to Dexterity saving throws. Additionally, you and all allies in your aura gain a 5 foot bonus to movement speed.

entries.name: Aura of Fortitude
entries: Both you and all allies in your aura add your Constitution modifier to Constitution saving throws. Additionally, you and all allies in your aura reduce damage from spells by a number equal to your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Aura of Understanding
entries: Both you and all allies in your aura add your Intelligence modifier to Intelligence saving throws. Additionally, you and all allies in your aura can communicate telepathically with each other, and can understand each other even if you don't share a language.

entries.name: Aura of Discipline
entries: Both you and all allies in your aura add your Wisdom modifier to Wisdom saving throws. Additionally, you and all allies in your aura can't be {@condition charmed}.

entries.name: Aura of Courage
entries: Both you and all allies in your aura add your Charisma modifier to Charimsa saving throws. Additionally, you and all allies in your aura can't be {@condition frightened}.

name: Aura Imbuement
entries: You can use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of weapons. When you use Charisma in this way, add your Proficiency Bonus to the weapon's base damage.

name: Auric Heritage
entries: You manifest more of the magical power of your heritage. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell detect magic} spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot.
{@homebrew Don't let me tell you how to write homebrew but I think this feat is missing a third benefit like the other two genasi feats?}
You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Propel
items.entry: As a bonus action you can double your Fly, Glide or Hover speed until the end of your next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

items.name: Crash Landing
items.entry: Once as a reaction before you take damage from falling you can reduce the damage by a number of d6s equal to half your level. You regain this ability after a short rest.

items.name: Repeatable
items.entry: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Aware
entries: Other creatures dont gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being hidden from you.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Aware
entries: Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being hidden from you.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Axe Expert
entries: You wield an axe like a force of nature, maximizing and embodying its relentless and unstoppable power. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Axe Rush
entries: While wielding a handaxe, battleaxe, or greataxe, you can use a bonus action to move up to 5 feet and add {@damage 1d6} to your next attack and damage roll with an axe.

name: Axe Fighter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Axe Flurry
entries: Once on each of your turns, if you hit a creature with a {@item Handaxe|XPHB}, you can make an extra attack with a {@item Handaxe|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Precise Topple
entries: When you hit a creature with a {@item Battleaxe|XPHB}, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the Constitution saving throw to avoid having the {@condition Prone} condition caused by the {@itemMastery Topple} property of the {@item Battleaxe|XPHB}.

entries.name: Unending Cleave
entries: The number of additional creatures you can attack using the {@itemMastery Cleave} property of a {@item Greataxe|XPHB} increases by a number equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded down).

name: Axe Juggle
entries: The {@item light hammer|PHB|light hammers} and {@item handaxe|PHB|handaxes} that you wield gain the finesse property while you wield them.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Axe Juggle
entries: The {@item light hammer|PHB|light hammers} and {@item handaxe|PHB|handaxes} that you wield gain the finesse property while you wield them.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Axe Thrower
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Returning Throw
entries: When you make a ranged weapon attack with a {@item Handaxe|XPHB} and miss on your attack roll, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on the same turn to catch the weapon as it whirls back to you.

name: Axeshield
entries: You know how to defend yourself with a battleaxe. You gain the following benefits:

items: When wielding a battleaxe with two hands, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC.

name: Back-Alley Pitcher
entries: Quick and accurate, you have developed an excellent throwing arm. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your improvised weapons with the light property also gain the thrown (range 30/90) property.

Once per round, when you hit a creature with a ranged attack with a melee weapon with the thrown property, you have advantage on your next weapon attack against the creature before the end of your next turn and it has disadvantage on its next melee attack against you before the end of its next turn.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Back-Alley Pitcher
entries: Quick and accurate, you have developed an excellent throwing arm. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your improvised weapons with the light property also gain the thrown (range 30/90) property.

Once per round, when you hit a creature with a ranged attack with a melee weapon with the thrown property, you have advantage on your next weapon attack against the creature before the end of your next turn and it has disadvantage on its next melee attack against you before the end of its next turn.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Bandit Cunning
entries: Your time as a bandit has granted you a sense for danger, and made you skilled at sizing up opponents. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you are asked to make a saving throw, you may spend your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier as an additional bonus to the saving throw. You cannot use this ability again until you have completed a long rest.

During combat, you can use your action to make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against any creature you have seen fight. As long as you succeed against a DC of 10 + their challenge rating, you can learn one useful fact of your choice about the target's combat abilities. Choose from:
one damage resistance or immunity
one condition immunity
one special ability possessed by the creature that either does damage, or prevents damage
one option under their attack, legendary, or reaction actions
one special sense they possess

activation.condition: When you are asked to make a saving throw

name: Banshee Wail
entries: As an action on your turn, you can emit an unearthly wail that rattles the souls of your opponents. Each creature within 20 feet of you that is not an undead or construct must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma or Wisdom modifier (your choice). A creature that fails this saving throw takes psychic damage equal to {@dice 2d10} + your total character level, or half this amount on a success.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you have finished a short or long rest.

items: Also, in addition to other bonuses provided by your College, a creature who uses your Bardic Inspiration die to make a successful roll may, as a bonus action, pass the Bardic Inspiration die to an ally within 30 feet.The recipient must use the inspiration die on their next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. The die is not passed again.
You gain proficiency with {@item brewer's supplies|phb}, if you are already proficient with them, double your proficiency bonus for all ability checks you make with them instead.

With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can prepare a number of strong drinks in small bottles equal to your proficiency bonus. These drinks last indefinitely, but their effects described below last only for 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a bonus action to drink one of those drinks, if they do they gain {@dice 1d6} temporary hitpoints. Creatures have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed} or {@condition Frightened} while they have temporary hitpoints from this feat.

name: Baruk Khazâd!
entries: The {@language Khuzdul|TLotRR|secret tongue of the Dwarves} is guarded as a treasure of the past, yet their battle-cry is well-known and feared by their foes.

items: You can use a bonus action on your turn to force each hostile creature that can hear and see you within 30 feet of you to make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your choice of your Strength or Charisma modifier). On a failed check, the creature becomes {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. {@action Attack} rolls against creatures {@condition frightened} in this way have advantage. Once you use this virtue, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Bashing
entries: You can use a shield as a d6 bludgeoning weapon with the guard property. If you have training with the shield then you're proficient in it as a weapon. This does not allow you to draw or stow the shield when you would normally draw or stow a weapon. Gain a weapon mastery from any class that can be used with this weapon.

name: Bashing Daze
entries: As an action, you can make a special attack with any weapon that deals bludgeoning damage to daze a creature. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus. If it fails, it takes your normal weapon damage and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Bashing Daze
entries: As an action, you can make a special attack with any weapon that deals bludgeoning damage to daze a creature. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus. If it fails, it takes your normal weapon damage and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Batter
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action and attack with only a {@item glaive|PHB}, {@item halberd|PHB}, {@item pike|PHB}, {@item spear|PHB}, or {@item quarterstaff|PHB} you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon; this attack uses the same ability modifier as the main attack. The weapon's damage die for this attack is a {@dice d4}, and the attack deals bludgeoning damage. A {@item quarterstaff|PHB} or {@item spear|PHB} must be held in both hands to gain this benefit.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Batter
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action and attack with only a {@item glaive|PHB}, {@item halberd|PHB}, {@item pike|PHB}, {@item trident|PHB}, {@item spear|PHB}, or {@item quarterstaff|PHB} you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon; this attack uses the same ability modifier as the main attack. The weapon's damage die for this attack is a {@dice d4}, and the attack deals bludgeoning damage. A {@item quarterstaff|PHB}, {@item trident|PHB} or {@item spear|PHB} must be held in both hands to gain this benefit.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Battle Adept
entries: Intensive training and combat experience have allowed you to master special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain one battle die, which is a d6. This die is added to any battle dice you have from another source. A battle die is expended when you use it. You regain all of your expended battle dice when you finish a short or long rest, or when you roll initiative.

You learn {@filter two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the Captain class or those available to the Grey Watchman subclass of the warden class.|optionalfeatures|feature type=mv:gw} You use your battle dice to fuel these maneuvers. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

name: Battle Cry
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thunderous Cry
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to release a frightening battle cry. Roll a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check. One creature of your choice that can hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to your Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check result or have the {@condition Frightened} condition for {@dice 1d4} rounds. The target can make a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once you've used this ability, you can't use it again until you've completed a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

At higher levels, you can target an additional number of creatures with this ability. At 9th level, you can target two creatures. At 15th level, you can target three creatures, and the range of this ability increases to 60 feet.

name: Battle Spells
entries: You learn two cantrips from any classes' spell lists. Both of these spells must deal damage and at least one of them must require an attack roll. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is your choice of Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Battle Spells
entries: You learn two cantrips from any classes' spell lists. Both of these spells must deal damage and at least one of them must require an attack roll. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is your choice of Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Battlecaster
entries: You are skilled at casting spells with a weapon in hand.

items: You can use a weapon that you're proficient with as a spellcasting focus.
When wielding a magical weapon that you're proficient with and that provides a bonus to hit and damage, you can also add that weapon's bonus to damage rolls for spells you cast.
You gain proficiency with a simple or martial weapon of your choice.

name: Battleframe Dragoon
entries: As a full-fledged Battleframe Pilot, known as a Dragoon, your combat prowess grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Kaiju Slayer
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll you make against a Mega creature.

entries.name: Relentless Retaliation
entries: When you are the {@variantrule Pilot|DarkMatter24} of a Battleframe that is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}, you can drop to 1 {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24|Mega Hit Point} instead. You can immediately make one melee attack with a frame weapon as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: One Hundred to Oni
entries: After one hundred recorded kills, you earn the rank of Oni. Record whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. When you reach 100, you gain the Faction feat {@feat Lakshay: Oni|DarkMatter24}.

entries.name: Ship Feats
entries: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

entries.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
entries: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.

name: Battlemage
entries: You have mastered techniques of fighting and wielding magic at close range, gaining the following benefits:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to {@action Cast a Spell|phb|cast a cantrip} against that creature.
You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you who are concentrating on a spell.

name: Battlemage*
entries: You've learned to empower your spells, drawing every bit of power you can from the Weave. You gain the following benefits:

items: Before you make a spell attack roll for a cantrip, you can choose to take a -5 penalty on the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 damage to the spell's damage.

Before you cast a spell that requires a saving throw to avoid damage, you can choose to lower the spell's saving throw DC by an amount up to your proficiency bonus. If a target fails the saving throw to avoid damage, they receive an additional 1 point of damage per damage dice of the spell for every 2 that the DC is lowered by.

name: Battlemind

prerequisite.other: The ability to manifest at least one power

entries: Your experience in manifesting powers during combat grants you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status concentration} on your active powers when you take damage.

When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to {@action Manifest a Power|TalPsi|manifest a power} that targets the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The power must have a manifestation time of 1 action and must target only that creature.
Whenever you gain strain, that stress triggers a protective buffer that grants you {@dice 1d4} temporary hit points.

name: Bayashi
entries: You have become an expert of mischievous illusion, continuing the ancestral line of legendary tanuki.

items: When you cast {@spell phantasmal force} with your Tanuki Magic racial ability, you can instead drum on your belly as the somatic component of the spell, to create an illusion known as bayashi. When casting {@spell phantasmal force} in this way, the illusion you create has no visual appearance; instead, you create the sound of ghostly drumming at a location of your choice within 60 feet. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the locationg of the illusion up ot 20 feet..

name: Bearer of Ill Omen
entries: You gain the ability to transform your familiar into a howling creature of darkness to harass your foes. As a bonus action, you can magically transform your familiar into a bearer of ill omen to target one creature you can see within 120 feet of you. Your familiar undergoes the following changes while in this form:

items: Your familiar counts as a monstrosity, not a beast.
It can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The hound takes 5 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
At the start of its turn, your familiar automatically knows its target's location. If the target was hidden, it is no longer hidden from you or your familiar.
On its turn, your familiar can move only toward its target by the most direct route, and it can use its action only to attack its target.

entries: Your familiar can make opportunity attacks, but only against its target. Additionally, while your familiar is within 5 feet of the target, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against any spell you cast. The your familiar disappears as normal if it is reduced to 0 hit points. After 1 minute or if its target is reduced to 0 hit points, your familiar disappears into a pocket dimension and is unable to be summoned until you finish a long rest.

name: Beast Shape
entries: You gain the ability to use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this ability twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest. You can transform into beasts of CR 1/4. The creatures cannot have a flying or swimming speed. You can stay in a beast shape for thirty minutes. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this ability. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall {@condition unconscious}, drop to 0 hit points, or die. While you are transformed, the following rules apply:

items: Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the creatures, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus instead of yours. If the creature has any legendary or lair actions, you can't use them.

When you transform, you assume the creatures's hit points. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. However, if you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked {@condition unconscious}.

You can't cast spells, and your ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of your new form. If your new form is capable of casting spells, you are unable to cast any of them. Transforming doesn't break your concentration on a spell you've already cast, however, or prevent you from taking actions that are part of a spell.

You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them if the new form is physically capable of doing so. However, you can't use any of your special senses, such as darkvision, unless your new form also has that sense.
If your new form has legendary actions or legendary resistances, you cannot use them.

You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground in your space, merges into your new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal, but the DM decides whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change size or shape to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge with it. Equipment that merges with the form has no effect until you leave the form.

name: Beast Shape Mastery
entries: You gain mastery over a specific beast shape and can transform into it with little effort. Choose one of your {@feat Improved Beast Shape|Adventurer} forms. You gain the ability to transform into that form without expending a use of your Beast Shape. If you want to transform into another beast shape, you must expend a use of Beast Shape as normal.

name: Beast Tamer
entries: You have a great ability to communicate with, and command, beasts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling} skill, if you don't already have it.

If you succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check on a beast, the subject of your check serves you for one hour. The beast can perform simple tasks, such as carry messages, guard doorways, or serve as a mount.

name: Beast Tamer
entries: You have a great ability to communicate with, and command, beasts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling} skill, if you don't already have it.

If you succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check on a beast, the subject of your check serves you for one hour. The beast can perform simple tasks, such as carry messages, guard doorways, or serve as a mount.

name: Beast Whisperer
entries: Embracing your animal nature, you learn to speak with all manner of beasts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can speak with beasts as if constantly under the effect of the {@spell speak with animals} spell. Effects that dispel or suppress magic have no effect on this ability.

name: Beast Whisperer
entries: You may cast the spell {@spell Speak with Animals} at will without using a spell slot or material components. Additionally, you learn the {@spell Animal Friendship} spell, and may cast it once without expending a spell slot or material components. Once you have done so, you may not do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Beast Whisperer
entries: Embracing your animal nature, you learn to speak with all manner of beasts. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase an ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can speak with beasts as if constantly under the effect of the speak with animals spell. Effects that dispel or suppress magic have no effect on this ability.

name: Beast-Craft
entries: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, beasts can give you information about nearby locations and creatures, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day. You might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favour for you, at the Loremaster's discretion, such as delivering a letter, or a verbal message to someone who can also speak with beasts.

In addition, as an action you can spend a craft slot and choose a beast that you can see within 30 feet of you. It must be able to see and hear you. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check, contested by the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If you win the contest, the beast is {@condition charmed} by you for 24 hours or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. If you obtain a magical success and the target is a beast with a challenge rating of 1/8 or lower, you can make the beast permanently {@condition charmed} by you, until you dismiss it, harm it, or make another beast permanently charmed by you. A beast automatically wins the contest if its Intelligence score is 4 or higher. When you reach 5th level, you can affect one additional beast, or two additional beasts at 9th level.

name: Beastly Forms
entries: With enough training, your ability to change form has improved so well that you can now take forms of beasts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can now use your Shapechanger trait to turn into a beast that you have seen of basic shape different from yours. While you are transformed into a beast, your AC is replaced by the beast's AC, you lose your ability to speak and your equipment melds into your new form. Other than that, your statistics do not change.

If the creature you are transformed into has a swimming or climbing speed, you gain that speed. If it has a swimming or climbing speed that's higher than your movement speed, you only gain that speed equal to your movement speed.
While you are transformed into a creature that can breathe air and water, you can breathe air and water.

While you are transformed into a creature with horns, claws or other natural weapons, you have natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to {@dice 1d6} + your Strength modifier.

name: Beastman
entries: With a short tail, coarse fur covering your face, and long teeth and claws, you appear more like a ferocious beast than a man. You might resemble any type of beast, but always gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

You possess sharp claws, which are natural weapons that you can use to make unarmed strikes. On a hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to {@dice 1d4} + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

name: Beastman
entries: With a short tail, coarse fur covering your face, and long teeth and claws, you appear more like a ferocious beast than a man. Perhaps your parentage includes a werecreature or an intelligent beast, granting you the following racial traits:

entries.name: Claws
entries: You have sharp claws that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to smell.

name: Beastperson
entries: The 'Verse is rife with wolf-people, horse-people, and other beastfolk, ranging from those with passing bestial features—such as a cat's ears and tail—to those that are indistinguishable from a lycanthrope. You may resemble any type of beast, but always gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Animalistic Reflexes
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws if you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.

entries.name: Claws
entries: You have sharp claws that you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. When you deal damage with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can deal Slashing damage equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.

name: Beguiling Wordsmith
entries: Your time among the charming and eloquent members of the Silk Purse has taught you the art of persuasive communication. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Profiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill, and you become fluent in one language of your choice.

entries.name: Hyptontic Words
entries: Your words are hypnotic, dancing with promises of elegance and wealth. Over the course of 1 minute interacting with a non-hostile creature, you can attempt to charm them. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be {@condition charmed} by you for 1 hour. Creatures easily tempted by promises of status and wealth (at the GM's discretion) have disadvantage on this saving throw. If a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it becomes immune to this effect from you, recognising your attempt to influence it.

name: Behaviourist
entries: {@i 4th-Level Feat. Repeatable: No.}

entries.name: Animal Behaviour Expert
entries: You have expertise in Animal Handling checks.

entries.name: Bespoke Saddles
entries: Creatures you tame gain +1 to their AC, hit rolls, and damage.

name: Bend Luck
entries: You gain the ability to twist fate using your {@feat Wild Magic|Adventurer}. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

name: Benign Transposition
entries: You can use your action to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Alternatively, you can choose a space within range that is occupied by a Small or Medium creature. If that creature is willing, you both teleport, swapping places.
Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest or you cast a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.

name: Benthic Servant
entries: You are adapted to life in labyrinthine seafloor caves. You require no extra movement to squeeze through tight spaces, have resistance to cold damage, and are immune to the effects of extreme pressure. While partially or entirely submerged, you have {@sense blindsight} with a range of 60 feet, except for points in that area outside that body of water.

name: Better under Pressure

prerequisite.other: The ability to manifest at least one power and gain strain

entries: You are able to turn the strain of body, mind, and soul into bursts of focused energy, tracked as pressure points. Whenever you gain strain, you also gain 1 pressure point for each strain you gain this way. Thereafter, whenever you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can spend up to 3 pressure points and add 1 to the roll for each point spent. You can wait until after you roll the {@dice d20} before deciding to spend pressure points. You lose all your pressure points when you finish a long rest.

name: Beyond the Grave*
entries: Death could not hold you, and neither can mortality. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the ability to sew your wounds back together. Once per day, as a Bonus Action, you can heal yourself with ethereal energy. Regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your CON modifier.
You gain the ability to see into the Ethereal plane up to your normal sight range.
Whenever you spend a certain amount of gold within a settlement, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: 1000+ Gold
entries: The trader starts to remember you, is willing to share beneficial (but not secret) information, recommend you to other traders or reserve products or services for you.

items.name: 5000+ Gold
