entries: Your name starts to become known amongst traders in that settlement. You start getting discounts or custom orders.

items.name: 10000+ Gold
entries: You have become a known wealthy individual. People are eager to be in your good side and are more keen on doing favors for you. Your opinion on social or economical matters is weighted heavily (unless you have a bad reputation for other reasons).

items.name: 25000+ Gold
entries: Traders will consider loaning gold to you and it's quite easy for you to purchase valuable real estate in the settlement. People are more than happy to work for you or be employed by you.

items.name: 100000+ Gold
entries: If there is opportunity for new leadership in the settlement, you are the most favorable candidate for every trader and simple citizen.

name: Bird of Prey
entries: As an Owlin you've inherited some of the core traits that make Owls excellent hunters, especially so in the dead of night, honing your incredible sense to your advantage. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill
Dim light does not impose disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight
You gain advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or hearing.

name: Bite of the Blue Burn

otherSummary.entry: {@subclassFeature The Spellscarred|Sorcerer|PHB|The Spellscarred|TSSO|1|} feature

entries: Your spellscarred jaw can extend, giving you a terrible bite that curses the target.

items: You gain a special melee attack called {@b {@i Bite of the Blue Burn}}, it can be substituted for a normal weapon attack much like grappling or shoving.
When you make this attack, you use Strength and are considered proficient with this attack, the damage deals {@damage 1d4} plus Strength.

If you hit with this attack, the creature is grappled and the target loses resistance to one damage type of your choice. The grapple can end without action, and the curse ends immediately as the grapple does.
This effect counts as a curse against the target, and can be removed with spells such as {@spell Remove Curse|PHB}.

name: Black Powder Expert
entries: Thanks to extensive practice with firearms, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack made with a black powder weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.
Once per turn when you roll the maximum result of a damage die of an attack made with a black powder weapon, you can roll another die of the same type and add both dice to the damage dealt.

name: Black Powder Expert
entries: Thanks to extensive practice with firearms, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack made with a black powder weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.
Once per turn when you roll the maximum result of a damage die for an attack made with a black powder weapon, you can roll an additional die of the same type and add it to the damage dealt.

name: Blackpowder Expert
entries: You are well-versed in the use of Blackpowder weapons and wield them with deadly efficiency. You gain the following benefits:

items: You ignore the loading property of Blackpowder weapons with which you are proficient.
Whenever a hostile creature moves within 10 feet of you, and you did not move on your last turn, you can use a reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against that creature.

name: Blackpowder Pistol Expert
entries: You have become practiced with the use of {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24|Blackpowder Pistols}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with a {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24}.

entries.name: Quick Load
entries: You ignore {@itemProperty LD|XPHB|Loading} of the {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24}.

entries.name: Trick Shot
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you moves, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a ranged attack with a {@item Blackpowder Pistol|GrimHollowPG24} against that creature.

name: Blacksmith
entries: You have studied the secrets of Blacksmithing and are an expert in its practice, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with smith's tools. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.

As an action, you can identify the material and craftsmanship of one weapon or piece of armor learning it's value, damage and properties. You are not able to identify enchantments or magitech applied to weapons this way.

Over the course of any short rest, you can repair a weapon or piece of armor, removing a single −1 penalty to damage rolls or AC. To use this benefit, you must have smith's tools with you and the weapon or armor must be within reach.

name: Blacksmith
entries: You are an expert with {@item Smith's Tools|phb}.

Your smithing experience lets you identify weak points in a target's armor. When you roll a 20 on a weapon attack against a target that is wearing armor, it suffers a -2 penalty to AC until the start of your next turn. This ability can't reduce a creature's AC multiple times simultaneously.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Blade Barrier

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency with {@item twinblades|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}

entries: Your expertise with twinblades allows you to turn your defensive flourish into an offensive strike. When you use the Whirl special bonus action with a twinblade, you gain the following features:

items: You can make one additional melee attack with the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack, and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a d4.
Until the start of your next turn, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter your reach or make a melee attack against you while within your reach.

entries.name: Blaster Roulette
entries: If you roll the same number of two damage dice for a blaster, you deal bonus damage equal to that number. You can only add this bonus damage once per turn.

entries.name: Ignore Cooldown
entries: You ignore the {@itemProperty DM-C|DarkMatter24|Cooldown} property of weapons.

entries.name: Run and Gun
entries: When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action, you can make a ranged attack using a blaster as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

name: Blaster Master
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Blaster Roulette
entries: If you roll the same number of two damage dice for a weapon with the {@itemProperty GC:VSS-F|ValdaGunslinger|Firearm} property, you deal bonus damage equal to that number. You can only add this bonus damage once per turn.

items.name: Ignore Cooldown
entries: You ignore the {@itemProperty GC:VSS-C|ValdaGunslingerExtras|Cooldown} property of weapons.

items.name: Run and Gun
entries: When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action, you can make a ranged attack using a weapon as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

name: Blaster Master
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Blaster Roulette
entries: If you roll the same number of two damage dice for a weapon with the {@itemProperty GC:VSS-F|ValdaGunslinger|Firearm} property, you deal bonus damage equal to that number. You can only add this bonus damage once per turn.

items.name: Ignore Cooldown
entries: You ignore the {@itemProperty GC:VSS-C|ValdaSpire24Extras|Cooldown} property of weapons.

items.name: Run and Gun
entries: When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action, you can make a ranged attack using a weapon as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

name: Blaster Roulette
entries: Whenever you roll damage with a blaster that has 2 damage dice and roll the same number on both of them, you can add that number to the damage roll.

name: Blend into Shadows
entries: You are at home in the darkness. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are within an area of darkness, if you remain still and silent for 1 minute, you can become {@condition invisible}. This invisibility ends if you are no longer in an area of darkness, take any action, or move faster than 5 feet on a turn

name: Blessed by the Dragon Gods
entries: Most half dragons only possess a draconic tail and lower body, along with several scales on their upper bodies. However, there are also those who are blessed by the dragon gods (usually Bahamut or Tiamat) and are granted draconic wings. These blessings seem to be given at random, as even the most devout followers of Bahamut will find it unlikely that they would be blessed with them. However, half silver dragons who live in high altitudes seem to gain them more often than not. Those who are granted this blessing will often start with smaller or weaker wings, which need time to properly grow in size or strength.

Some half dragons are blessed by the dragon gods and may choose the {@feat Draconic Heritage (Half Dragon)|LEGDRAG} feat (page 21). This grants them the Wings trait of the Wayfarer dragonborn subrace, granting them the ability to glide and even fly at a higher level.

name: Blessing of Angrboda and Bergelmir
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thunderous Strike
entries: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can choose to deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage. You can use your Thunderous Strike a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Prophetic Vision
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, you can choose one Divination spell with a casting time of 1 action (from any spell list) of a level you can cast that is no more than half your character level and cast it without expending a spell slot. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability stat. Once you use this feat to cast the spell, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of Baldur
entries: You gain the following benefit.

entries.name: Protective Aegis
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, when you or an ally within 10 feet of you takes damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce that damage by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

entries.name: Radiant Aura
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you emit a bright golden light in a 10-foot-radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for another 10 feet. You may extinguish this light with another {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sunlance
entries: You know the {@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB} cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Blessing of Boreas
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Aegis
entries: If you take Cold damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give yourself {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage until the end of your next turn. You can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Winter Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} cantrip. Choose either the {@spell Armor of Agathys|XPHB} or {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Bragi
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Love of the Vanir
entries: You gain {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} with the {@skill Persuasion} skill if you don't already have it, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks.

name: Blessing of Eir
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vitality Points
entries: You have a number of Vitality Points equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and can spend the points on the benefits below. You regain your expended Vitality Points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vitality Surge
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and spend 1 Vitality Point to recover {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If you are dying, you can spend 1 Vitality Point to {@variantrule Stable|XPHB|stabilize} (no action required).

entries.name: Channel Vitality
entries: You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and spend 1 Vitality Point to cause a creature you touch to regain {@dice 1d4} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of Freyr and Freyja
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Wild Knowledge
entries: You have proficiency in either the {@skill Animal Handling} or {@skill Nature} skill.

entries.name: Green Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} and {@spell Thorn Whip|XPHB} cantrips. Choose either the {@spell Entangle|XPHB} or {@spell Hail of Thorns|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Heimdall
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Awareness of the Guardian
entries: You have {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB} in the Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) skill. If you already have {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in that skill. In addition, when you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can decide to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. You can do this a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Herald's Horn
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@item Horn|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vigilance
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you can reroll the check but must use the new result. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

name: Blessing of Hel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Forestall the End
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

entries.name: Resurgence
entries: If you become {@variantrule Stable|XPHB} following a third successful {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}, or if you are stabilized by another creature, you immediately recover {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: The Bell Tolls
entries: You know the {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB} and {@spell Toll the Dead|XPHB} cantrips. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Jormungandr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Poison Resilience
entries: If you take Poison damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give yourself {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage until the end of your next turn. You can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Serpent Kinship
entries: You always have the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} and {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you cast these spells without a spell slot, you may only target snakes and serpents. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Serpent's Tongue
entries: You know the {@language Draconic} language.

name: Blessing of Loki
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Expert Liar
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Deception} skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it instead.

entries.name: Trickster Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} and {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} cantrips. Choose either the {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} or {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Njord
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Call Sea Serpent
entries: You can cast {@spell Find Steed|XPHB} without expending a spell slot. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Njord's Protection
entries: You can breathe water as well as air, and automatically succeed on saves against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} while submerged in water. You also have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of Sif
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gift of Dexterity
entries: When you make a Dexterity check, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to a Dexterity check, you may add it an additional time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sif's Prowess
entries: You know the {@spell True Strike|XPHB} cantrip. Choose either the {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} or {@spell Longstrider|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Skadi
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hunter's Eye
entries: When you use the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make a ranged weapon attack, you can choose to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll. Once you use this feature you must finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Snowpace
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet when you move on ice or snow, and you never treat those types of terrain as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

name: Blessing of the Colossus
entries: You have received a boon of incredible power from a giant or kaiju, allowing you to increase your size. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Invoke Colossus Power
entries: As an action, you can invoke the power of a colossus to grow immensely. Your size becomes Large, if there is room and you aren't already larger, and your equipment increases in size to match. Your reach increases by 5 feet, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and your weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d4} damage on a hit. These changes last for 1 minute, or until you fall {@condition unconscious}. Once you use this action, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Blessing of the Pale Lady
entries: Your people have been granted power by the moon, and through deep meditation you have unlocked even greater lunar boons. You gain the following benefits:

items: You no longer need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep by any means. To gain the benefits of a long rest, you can spend 4 hours doing light activity, such as praying to the moon or keeping watch.

At sunset, you may gain a number of temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1 hit point). If the moon is full, you roll a d10 instead. You lose any remaining temporary hit points when the sun rises.

name: Blessing of the Pale Lady
entries: Your people have been granted power by the moon, and through deep meditation you have unlocked even greater lunar boons. You gain the following benefits.

items: You no longer need to sleep and can't be forced to sleep by any means. To gain the benefits of a long rest, you can spend all 8 hours doing light activity, such as praying to the moon or keeping watch.

At sunset, you may gain a number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1 hit point). If the moon is full, you roll a {@dice d10} instead. You lose any remaining temporary hit points when the sun rises.

name: Blessing of the Snow Queen
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Frozen Edge
entries: You know the {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB} Spell. You can cast it without using a spell slot a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Shield of the North Wind
entries: If you fail a saving throw against a spell or effect that deals Cold damage, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this feature you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

name: Blessing of Thor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gift of Strength
entries: When you make a Strength check, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the roll. If you already add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to a Strength check, you may add it an additional time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Storm Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Shocking Grasp|XPHB} or {@spell Thunderclap|XPHB} cantrip (choose when you select this feat). You also always have the {@spell Thunderous Smite|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Tyr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bravery
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened} condition.

entries.name: Justicar
entries: As a {@action Magic} action, you can touch a creature and compel it to tell the truth. The creature must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't speak a deliberate lie for 1 minute. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this save. An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.
You can use this feature at will, but when you use it on a creature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it on that creature again.

name: Blessing of Volund
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Crafter's Knack
entries: You gain proficiency with an {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB|Artisan's Tool} of your choice. If you already have proficiency with that tool, you instead have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks with it.

entries.name: Forge Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell Elementalism|XPHB} and {@spell Mending|XPHB} cantrips. Choose either the {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} or {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blessing of Wotan
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lore Bound
entries: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion}. If you already have proficiency with the chosen skill, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

entries.name: Secret Wisdom
entries: You know the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} cantrip. Choose a level 1 spell from any school of magic. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast the spell without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat).

name: Blind Spot
entries: You evolved some psionic capabilities, seldom seen in Warrior. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Charisma or Wisdom score by 1, up to maximum of 20.

As an action, you can choose a creature within 30 feet of you to make an Intelligence saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the creature perceives you as if you were invisible for 1 minute. Should the creature have special senses which allows it to see invisible creatures, such as blindsight, you still appear invisible to it. If the creature takes damage from you, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. You have to finish a short or long rest before you can use this feature again.

Additionally, you can use an action to sweep your wings dramatically, giving off a thick cloud of particulate. Each creature within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against a DC of 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus, or become {@condition blinded} until the end of your next turn. You can then move up to twice your speed, as if you used the {@action dash|phb|dash action}. Once you use this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

name: Blindsense
entries: If you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or {@condition invisible} creature within 10 feet of you.

items: You gain an advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

During a short or long rest, you can attune yourself to your senses, as if attuning to a magic item. You gain blindsight in a radius of 30 feet until you complete a short or long rest that you do not spend attuning yourself in this way. You lose this benefit while you are deafened.

name: Blitz
entries: When you use your action to {@action Attack}, if you moved 15 feet or more in a straight line before hitting a target with a {@item spear|PHB}, {@item trident|PHB}, or {@item lance|PHB}, you deal an additional {@dice 1d4} piercing damage to the target.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Blitz
entries: When you use your action to {@action Attack}, if you moved 15 feet or more in a straight line before hitting a target with a {@item spear|PHB}, {@item trident|PHB}, or {@item lance|PHB}, you deal an additional {@dice 1d4} piercing damage to the target.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Blitzwarrior
entries: When you roll damage for a blaster with the Scatter property, you can reroll one of the damage dice, and must use the new roll. Additionally, being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

name: Blocker
entries: When an entire siegeball team charges to the other end of the arena, a quick victory for one side or the other is assured. The safer strategy (and the one most often employed) is to designate one or two player as blockers, who hang back by the tower or by mid-field to ensure that an errant ball doesn't fly past the team's defenses. Blockers need to be steadfast and powerful, capable of knocking a ball to the other side of the field when need be, and gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Block|SIEGESOURCEBOOK|optional text} action as a bonus action on your turn.
You take half damage from siegeballs that hit you.

In a pinch, you can dive in the way of a shot. When an ally within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack or fails a Dexterity saving throw, or when a siegeball is about to hit your tower, you can use your reaction to dive in front of the shot. You move adjacent to your ally or tower and take the damage instead of the original target. If you jumped more than 5 feet to intercept the effect, you fall {@condition prone|PHB}. You can use this ability once in each siegeball game, but can use it as often as you wish outside of siegeball games.

name: Blood Feats - Blood of the Beast
entries: Your blood is empowered with a ferocity for battle and a thirst for violence. As a bonus action on your turn you may expend a hit dice and deal slashing damage to yourself equal to the maximum value of that hit dice to release the violent power of your blood, and gain the following effects:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects
If a creature within 5 ft of you takes any action other than the disengage action, you may use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against them
You gain an additional number of reactions each round equal to half your proficiency bonus. These reactions can only be used to make opportunity attacks.

entries: This release lasts for 1 minute or until you are knocked unconscious. At the beginning of each of your turns while this release is in effect, you expend an additional hit dice, and take slashing damage equal to the maximum value of the hit dice expended. As a bonus action on your turn, you may attempt a wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to 12 + your constitution modifier. On a success, the release ends early.
Damage you take as part of this feature cannot be reduced in any way.

name: Blood Feats - Blood of the Heretic

prerequisite.other: Constitution 16, Ability to cast at least one spell

entries: Weather by natural affinity, or heretical study, you have mastered the forbidden rites of blood magic. When you cast a spell, you may use a bonus action to expend a hit dice, and gain one of the following effects:

entries.name: Scarlet Binding
entries: By consuming one ounce of a creature's blood and dealing slashing damage to yourself equal to the spell's level + the maximum value of the hit dice spent, you may target that creature from any distance, even if you do not have line of sight.

entries.name: Blood Channel
entries: When casting a spell which requires concentration, you may choose to ignore the concentration requirement of the spell and instead take slashing damage equal to the spell's level each round that the spell remains in effect. To willingly end the spell before for the end of its duration, you must succeed on a constitution saving throw against your own spell save DC.

entries.name: Sanguine Empowerment
entries: You deal slashing damage to yourself equal to the spell's level + the maximum value of the hit dice spent to empower your casting, adding your constitution modifier to your spell attack modifier or spell save DC.
Damage you take as part of this feature cannot be reduced in any way.

name: Blood Hound
entries: Your keen senses are heightened beyond that of most people. Whether these senses were heightened through training, through the loss of other senses, or they simply matured as you did, you gain the following benefits:

items: While conscious, whenever a creature that is small or larger moves, within 10 feet of you, you immediately become aware of its presence.
Your attack rolls do not have disadvantage against {@condition invisible} creatures that you are aware of.
You have advantage on Wisdom (perception) and Wisdom (survival) checks that rely on sound or smell.

name: Blood Hound
entries: Your senses are heightened beyond those of most folk. Whether these senses were strengthened through training or the loss of other senses, or they simply matured as you did, you are a master of finding those whom you seek. You  gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Motion Sensor
entries: Whenever a creature that is Small or larger moves within 10 feet of you while you do not have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, you immediately become aware of its presence.

entries.name: No Hiding
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sound or smell.

name: Blood Magic

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast a spell or {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} or {@feat Metamagic|Adventurer}

entries: You gain the ability to harness your own blood as a source of magic energy by storing it in a blood vial. As a bonus action on your turn, you can spend any number of hit dice to fill your blood vial. Roll the dice, add your Constitution modifier for each hit dice spent this way. Your vial gains a number of hit points equal the total. While your blood vial has more than 0 hit points, you can use it as your spellcasting focus. Your blood vial loses all unused hit points at the end of your next long rest.

When you cast a spell with your vial on your person, you can expend a number of hit points from your vial in order to cast the spell without expending spell slots. A 1st-Level spell costs 5 hit points, a 2nd-Level costs 10 hit points, a 3rd-Level costs 15 hit points, a 4th-Level costs 20 hit points, and a 5th-Level costs 25 hit points. Additionally, if a spell requires a material component that lists a cost, you can instead expend a number of hit points from your blood vial equal to the cost of the component in gold (minimum of 1 hit point).

If you have the {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} feat, you can also use hit points from your vial in place of ki points. 1 ki point costs 5 hit points. If you have the {@feat Metamagic|Adventurer} feat, you can also use hit points from your vial in place of sorcery points. 1 sorcery point costs 2 hit points.

name: Blood of the Berserker
entries: You inherited a touch of the ferocity of a berserker ancestor. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Berserker Fury
entries: When you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to enter a frenzied state. While in this fury, your melee weapon attacks deal extra damage equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you don't have the {@condition Unconscious} condition when you are reduced to 0 HP (though you still make {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saves} as normal).

Your Berserker Fury lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required), or if you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Bloodhound
entries: You are a master of tracking. You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks on rolls related to tracking a target using scent.

name: Bloodied Resilience
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bloodied Reaction
entries: While you're {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and take any damage, you can spend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and reduce the damage you take by the amount rolled. You can only spend one {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} at a time in this way, each time you are damaged.

entries.name: Bloodied Saves
entries: If you succeed on a Strength or Constitution saving throw that would normally cause you to take half damage, you take no damage instead.

name: Bloodline Brand
entries: A sorcerer who knows her bloodline qualifies to be inked with an elaborate representation of the bloodline from which she came.
{@b Benefit}:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

This depiction allows the sorcerer to access her bloodline powers one level earlier than normal. Thus, a tattooed draconic bloodline sorcerer with bloodline brand depicting a dragon gains Elemental Affinity, at 5th level.
Gains an additonal Sorcerer Cantrip appropriate to your bloodline.

name: Bloodsucker*
entries: You need to feed. This need consumes you. It will drive you. It will control you... at least until you're no longer hungry. You gain the following benefits:

items: You become proficient in Athletics. If you are already proficient in Athletics, you gain expertise.
You can now use Siphon Kiss as a Bonus Action.

name: Bloodthirsty
entries: Whenever you become Bloodied, you gain Bloodthirsty for 5 rounds, granting the following abilities:

items: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you may spend 1 Hit Die to deal additional damage to that creature equal to the roll + your Constitution modifier.
When taking damage from a creature's melee attack, you may make a free melee attack against that creature. You can use this trait up to 3 times per round.

When damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you can make a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 + the damage taken). On a success, you instead drop to 1 hit point. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Bloody Resolve
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inner Fire
entries: Pain bolsters your resolve. When you take damage, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws until the end of your next turn. While you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, the bonus to saves increases to +2, and you also gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

name: Blowdart Mastery
entries: You have mastered the careful application of blowguns and darts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls you make with blowguns and darts.
Your ranged attacks with blowguns use a d4 for damage.
When you are hidden from a creature and attack it with a blowgun or dart, making the attack doesn't reveal your position.
You ignore the loading property of blowguns.

name: Body Guard
entries: You master grappling and leverage to pin and fling your foes.

items: When you use a reaction on a Fighting Style to defend an allied creature, you can swap positions with that ally after the attack completes.

entries.name: Heroic Intervention
entries: As a reaction, when an allied creature within range of your movement speed takes damage, you can move to them and into their space. They move to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet, or the closest unoccupied space if there are no unoccupied spaces within 5 feet. You and the target creature have resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature to successfully throw a creature or object, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Body Linguist

prerequisite.other: Proficiency with both the Insight and Perception skills

entries: You can interpret the intentions of others by reading their posture and mannerisms, granting you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks when trying to determine a creature's attitude as either friendly, indifferent, or hostile if you can see it.

You can use a bonus action to unerringly convey a message silently using only physical gestures to other creatures that can see you. This message must be a simple concept, emotion, or one-word command.

name: Body of Werk

prerequisite.other: {@race Kobblek|HippocampersCompleteCookbook} bearing the body part of another race associated with a feat you wish to use

entries: Your body is a biological tapestry, and with time and practice you are able to unlock the best of its potential. Choose one feat with a prerequisite of a race. You must possess a body part of the prerequisite race through either your Anatomical Heirloom feature or your Graftwerk feature. While you retain the appropriate body part, you ignore the prerequisite of the chosen feat and gain its benefits. A feat that enhances a specific biological feature requires you to have a body part that includes that specific biological feature (such as lungs that generate a breath weapon for the Dragon Fear feat)
Detaching the matching body part using your Uncouple Appendage feature, if you are capable of doing so, does not count as losing the prequisite for the chosen feat.

You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a body part that has not yet been matched with a feat through this method. You can gain the benefits of each feat chosen through this method only once.

name: Bodyguard

otherSummary.entrySummary: Fighting style that uses your reaction to defend an allied creature

entries: Your reflexes and techniques safeguard your allies. You gain the following benefits:

items: Ability Score Increase. Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Leaping Saves. You can move up to 5 feet before using your reaction to protect an ally with a Fighting Style or Feat. Alternatively, when you use a reaction on a Fighting Style to defend an allied creature while you are already adjacent to them, you can swap positions with that ally after the attack completes as long as your movement speed isn't zero. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Gain the Heroic Intervention special reaction (below).

entries.name: Heroic Intervention
entries: As a reaction, when an allied creature within range of your movement speed would take damage, you can move to them and into their space. If the damage came from an attack, you become the target of the attack.

They move to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet, or the closest unoccupied space if there are no unoccupied spaces within 5 feet (potentially moving them out of an area of effect, but moving yourself into it).
You and the target creature have resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Bodyguard*
entries: Your extensive of being a bodyguard has trained you to constantly be on guard, and reflexively act when your charge is in danger.

items: You gain proficiency in perception, or if you already had proficiency gain +3 to your passive perception.
Choose one creature to be your charge before a mission starts, cannot be someone who has this feat.
When ever your charge is within 30ft of you they gain +1 to saving throws.
When you are within 5ft of your charge they gain +2 to AC.
If any creature within your melee range attempts an attack on your charge you may use your reaction to attempt to stop the attack. You must make an attack of your own equal or higher to their roll

name: Boisterous Roar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mighty Yell
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a target, you let out a boisterous roar. You and allies within 5 feet of you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage until the end of your next turn, and enemies within 5 feet of you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to all damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Bolster Animal
entries: Animals grow strong after time under your tender care. Whenever you spend an hour or more training with a friendly beast, which can be done during a short or long rest, you can have it gain an amount of temporary hit points equal to 3 times your proficiency bonus plus your Wisdom modifier. Once you use this feature on a creature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Bolster Animal
entries: Animals grow strong after time under your tender care. Whenever you spend an hour or more training with a friendly beast, which can be done during a short or long rest, you can have it gain an amount of temporary hit points equal to 3 times your proficiency bonus plus your Wisdom modifier. Once you use this feature on a creature, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Bolstering Heart
entries: With the right encouragement great potential can be unlocked. You gain the following benefits:

items: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to use the {@action Help} action. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

When a creature succeeds a check or roll that you helped with and both results would succeed the check, the creature has advantage on the the next check or roll of the same type it makes before the end of its next turn as if you helped it (if you helped a creature with an attack roll, it would have advantage on the next attack roll it makes).
You are proficient with improvised thrown weapons.
You gain proficiency with {@item tinker's tools|PHB}. If you are already proficient with the tool, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
You can detonate {@filter barrel bombs|items|source=AGMH|search=barrel-bomb} planted by you, as a bonus action, from up to 60 feet away with the snap of your fingers.

name: Bomb Thrower
entries: A bomb for the purposes of this feat is a handheld object that deals damage by exploding or chemically affecting a target, such as an {@item Acid (vial)|PHB|acid flask}, {@item Alchemist's Fire (flask)|PHB|alchemist's fire}, {@item Holy Water (flask)|PHB|holy water}, {@item Fragmentation Grenade|DMG|grenades}, and so forth.
You gain the following benefits:

items: You add your proficiency bonus to hit with any thrown weapon, including an improvised thrown weapon.

When you hit with a bomb, you can make a second attack roll against another target within range and within 5 feet of the original target. If you hit the second target, you deal damage equal to your Dexterity modifier (if any) of the same type as the bomb to the secondary target.
If a creature has to make a saving throw against a bomb thrown by you, the DC is equal to 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus.

name: Bond of Arcana
entries: Your creature has been learning from you more than you had ever thought possible and can aid you in casting magic.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.

entries.name: Broadened Mind
entries: Your creature grants you the ability to have one additional spell known every time you take this feat. (If your class does not have this feature then it grants you one additional 1st level spell slot.)

entries.name: Joined Casting
entries: You can ask your creature to aid you in one of the following ways when casting a spell;

items: {@b Targeted}: You gain advantage on any spell that requires a spell attack roll
{@b Enhanced}: Saving throws from your spells are at disadvantage for the target
{@b Longevity}: The duration of your spells is doubled

entries: It must be within 5 ft. of you as you are casting the spell and use the same amount of actions as you do.
Your creature requires a short rest before they can aid your spell casting again. Every time you take this feat your creature can aid you one additional time.

name: Bond of Arcana
entries: Your creature has been learning from you more than you had ever thought possible and can aid you in casting magic.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature has either its Intelligence or Wisdom increased by 1, (the score may not exceed 20 or 2 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)).

entries.name: Broadened Mind
entries: Your creature grants you the ability to have one additional spell known every time you take this feat. (If your class does not have this feature then it grants you one additional 1st level spell slot.)

entries.name: Joined Casting
entries: You can ask your creature to aid you in one of the following ways when casting a spell (this takes your creatures's action during their turn.);

items: {@b Targeted}: You gain advantage on any spell that requires a spell attack roll.
{@b Enhanced}: Saving throws from your spells are at disadvantage for the target.
{@b Concentration}: Concentration checks are made with advantage, if you fall unconcious the familiar takes over concentration of the spell.

entries: It must be within 5 ft. of you or a target as you are casting the spell and use the same amount of actions as you do.
Your creature requires a short rest before they can aid your spell casting again. Every time you take this feat your creature can aid you one additional time.

name: Bond of Learning
entries: You have taught your creature to do the things that you can do.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.

entries.name: Skilled
entries: You can teach your creature a couple of skills that you are proficient in. It gains half your proficiency bonus in these skills (rounding up).
You can choose two skills every time you take this feat. If you choose a skill that your creature already knows, you can increase the proficiency bonus to the same level as yours.
Your creature can use the {@i help} action to aid you with skills it is proficient with, giving you advantage on the relevant roll.

entries.name: Arcane knowledge
entries: You can teach your creature one first level spell (or cantrip) that you know every time this feat is taken. This spell has to have a range of self.
If the spell requires a component you need to give (or craft) your creature a focus to wear. It cannot cast the spell if it loses the focus.
Your creature has one spell slot for every time you take this feat. The spell slot recovers as the same rate as your own.

entries.name: Class Feat
entries: If you have no arcane ability yourself, you can teach your creature any feature you have learned as the first level of your class.
It can only use this feature as per a first level character.
If you choose this feat more than once, you can choose to level up an existing class feature or teach your creature a new one at first level.

name: Bond of Learning
entries: You have taught your creature to do the things that you can do.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature has one of its attributes increased by 1, (the score may not exceed 20 or 2 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)).

entries.name: Skilled
entries: You can choose two skills every time you take this feat. If you choose a skill that your creature already knows, you can increase the proficiency bonus to the same level as yours.
Your creature can use the {@i help} action to aid you with skills it is proficient with, giving you advantage on the relevant roll.

name: Bond of Spirit
entries: Your creature has a stronger spirit bond that it can use to restore you and keep you alive.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.

entries.name: Healing
entries: Your creature can restore hit points to your character equal to 1D4 + your proficiency bonus at the time of taking this feat.
Taking this feat multiple times gives it an additional 1D4 each time.
To bestow this healing your creature must be able to touch you. It can only use this feat once per long rest.

entries.name: Shared Soul
entries: If you ever lose three death saves, your soul becomes bonded to your creature. This holds you in a stabilised condition until you are healed.
While you are not in your body any damage it takes must be healed before you can return to it. If your body receives your maximum HP in damage then your soul has nothing to return to.
The same bonding works for your creature: Its soul becomes bonded to you if it ever dies.

name: Bond of Spirit
entries: Your creature has a stronger spirit bond that it can use to restore you and keep you alive.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently and 1 point of Constitution (the score may not exceed 20 or 4 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)).

entries.name: Shared Soul
entries: If you ever lose three death saves, your soul becomes bonded to your creature. While its still alive, it holds you in a stabilised condition which allows for a {@spell revivify} up to 1 hour per caster level.
The same bonding works for your creature: Its soul becomes bonded to you if it ever dies.

You share an empathic bound, and while within a mile of each other are aware of either's emotional state and pains/joys - this grants adavntage for saves against effects that would alter emotional states (Fear; Tasha's Hideous Laughter or the like).

name: Bond of the Guardian
entries: You have taught your creature to be an excellent guard and protector.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains +2 its AC
Your creature has either its Intelligence or Wisdom increased by 1, (the score may not exceed 20 or 2 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)).

entries.name: Alert
items: Your creature gains proficiency in {@skill perception} and may use your proficiency bonus. If the creature is already proficency in perception, its gains expertise.
Your creature cannot be surprised while its is concious.

name: Bond of the Hunter
entries: You have trained to further enhance your creature's natural instincts to hunt.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.

entries.name: Heightened perception
entries: Any perception checks made by your creature gain a +5.

entries.name: No escape
entries: Delivered You can introduce your creature to a friendly entity for it to imprint on. If this entity is on the same plane of existence then your creature can find its way to this entity. You can only assign your creature to track a number of targets equal to your level when you take this feat: Every entity tagged for tracking or delivery counts as a target.

If you assign your creature a quarry to track, they will never lose it. Your creature only has to make a perception check to pick up the trail again if the quarry teleports. If your creature ever crosses the path of a quarry they have been assigned to in the past, they will pick up the trail again.

entries.name: Shrouded
entries: Any attempt that a quarry has to detect your creature tracking it is at a disadvantage.

entries.name: Delivered
entries: You can introduce your creature to a friendly entity for it to imprint on. If this entity is on the same plane of existence then your creature can find its way to this entity.
You can only assign your creature to track a number of targets equal to your level when you take this feat: Every entity tagged for tracking or delivery counts as a target.

name: Bond of the Hunter
entries: You have trained to further enhance your creature's natural instincts to hunt.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature has its Wisdom increased by 1, (the score may not exceed 20 or 2 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)).
Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.

entries.name: Skilled
entries: Your creature gains proficiency in {@skill investigation} and {@skill survival} and may use your proficiency.
Any survival checks made by your creature gain a +5.
Your creature gains +5 to its initative.

entries.name: Tracking
entries: You can introduce your creature to a friendly entity for it to learn. If you assign your creature a quarry to track, if the quarry teleports or escapes and your creature ever crosses the path of a quarry they have been assigned to in the past, the DMs should roll to pick up the trail again.
Any attempt that a quarry has to detect your creature tracking it is at a disadvantage.

name: Bond of the Wildblood
entries: You can call upon the aid of such creatures as would lend it to you. Once per short rest you can issue a howling cry which nearby creatures will respond to. The DM will determine the exact creature that responds as is suitable for the environment you are in and this ability may not work if no living creatures are present.

A group of creatures will appear within five minutes of being called if able. {@dice 1d3} {@filter creatures of the Beast subtype|bestiary|type=beast} will appear. The CR of the summoned creatures is equal to your Wild Shape form Max CR. Summoned creatures will aid you and fight for you as a friendly non player character might. They will remain until your next short rest.

name: Bond of Tooth & Claw
entries: You have trained with your creature to enhance its fighting abilities. If it couldn't attack, it now can.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by one level in dice damage (d4 > d6 > d8 > d10 > d12).

entries.name: Battle tactics
entries: If you and your creature are fighting the same foe, you both gain advantage to your attacks.
If this feat is taken for a second time, you can send your creature to use battle tactics with another party member.

entries.name: Practiced Manoeuvre
entries: If you successfully damage a foe that your creature is within combat range of, it can use a Bonus Action of its own to automatically hit that target for critical damage (as if they had rolled a natural 20).
This manoeuvre can be performed on the same foe once per combat. A new manoeuvre is learned each time this feat is taken.

name: Bond of Tooth & Claw
entries: You have trained with your creature to enhance its fighting abilities. If it couldn't attack, it now can.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by one level in dice damage (d4 > d6 > d8 > d10 > d12).

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: While either you or your creature are facing the same creature or within 5 ft. of an enemy the other is targeting, both you and your companion have advantage on your attack rolls.

entries.name: Practiced Manoeuvre
entries: If you successfully damage a foe that your creature is within combat range of, it can use a reaction to attack that creature.
This manoeuvre can be performed only once per short or long rest.

name: Bond of True Sight
entries: You have taught your creature to find hidden things and see through deception.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.

entries.name: Seek
entries: Your creature gains the skills of investigation and perception at your proficiency level when you choose this feat.
Any time that these skills are used to look for pocketed items, secret compartments, magically disguised things or hidden doors your creature gains an additional +5 on the rolls.

entries.name: Sniff out lies
entries: If your creature is with you during social encounters, you gain advantage on rolls to see through any deception.
If this feat is taken a 2nd time, your creature can detect invisible things. On a 3rd time of taking this feat, your creature can tell if any creature has changed shape or is in disguise.

name: Bond of True Sight
entries: You have taught your creature to find hidden things and see through deception.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently. All attacks increase by 1 point.
Your creature has either its Intelligence or Wisdom increased by 1, (the score may not exceed 20 or 4 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)).

entries.name: Skilled
entries: Your creature gains proficiency in {@skill investigation} and {@skill perception} and may use your proficiency.
Any time that these skills are used to look for pocketed items, secret compartments, magically disguised things or hidden doors your creature gains an additional +5 on the rolls.

entries.name: Sniff out lies
entries: If your creature is with you during social encounters, you gain advantage on rolls to see through any deception.

name: Bonded Companion

prerequisite.other: a pet, animal companion, familiar or steed

entries: You have spent your time bonding with and training your creature to enhance their abilities. Your connection with them becomes so strong that you feel their pain and they feel yours.
After bonding with a companion you can use future feats to bond further with them as listed below. These additional feats can be taken multiple times.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently and gets a +1 to all attacks.

entries.name: Shared pain
entries: You can divert half the damage you take in one blow to your creature. You can also take half the damage your creature gets hit with in one blow on yourself.
You can use your hit dice to heal your creature during a short rest in the same way that you would heal yourself and you gain an additional hit dice back during a long rest.
You can {@i share the pain} as many times as your characters level between long rests. You must both be on the same plane of existence to {@i share the pain}.

entries.name: Comforting presence
entries: You always know the direction your creature is and their distance from you as long as they are on the same plane of existence. They also know where to find you.
You can feel their life force no matter where they are and tell when they get injured. They can also tell when you get injured.
Unless given instructions otherwise they will try to come to your aid any time you take an injury. No matter their instructions they will stand over you and defend you when you reach 0HP.

name: Bonded Companion

prerequisite.other: a pet, animal companion, familiar or steed

entries: You have spent your time bonding with and training your creature to enhance their abilities.
After bonding with a companion you can use future feats to bond further with them as listed below. These additional feats can be taken multiple times.

entries.name: Level up
entries: Your creature gains an additional hit dice in HP permanently and gets a +1 to all attacks.

entries.name: Comforting presence
entries: You always know the direction your creature is and their distance from you as long as they are on the same plane of existence. They also know where to find you.
You can feel their life force no matter where they are and tell when they get injured.
If struck with either the {@condition frigthened} or {@condition charmed} conditions, if their action or innaction puts you in obvious peril, your creature as a reaction gets to roll again to save.

name: Bonded Feature
entries: Your
When you gain a feat that increases an ability score, your bonded animal gains 1 point in that same ability.
Your creature gains 1 point in an atrribute of your choice and may choose one {@filter Evolutionary Enhancement|optionalfeature|type=EA}.
{@i Your creature cannot increase its ability score through this feat may not exceed 20 or 4 more than the familiar/companion template's maximum (whichever is greater)}

name: Bone Shield

prerequisite.other: {@feat Spellbook|Adventurer} (School of Necromancy) or {@feat Acolyte: Grave|Adventurer}, 6th Level

entries: As a reaction to being targeted by an attack from a creature you can see, you can chooses one undead creature under your control within 5 feet of you to swap places. The undead becomes the target of the attack instead.

name: Bone'ead
entries: You are one of the rare Man-Ogres who, despite their primitive mind-set, exhibit a rare glimmer of intelligence. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two maneuvers from the Battle Master archetype in the fighter class: {@optfeature Commander's Strike} and {@optfeature Pushing Attack}. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

You gain two superiority dice, which are {@dice d6}s (these dice are added to any superiority dice you have from another source). These dice are used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Boomerang Expert
entries: You have mastered the versatile boomerang and are capable of performing extraordinary feats with the weapon. You gain the following benefits:

items: The damage die for the boomerang is now a {@dice d8} for you.
Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls made with a boomerang.
You automatically catch the boomerang after throwing it without needing to use your reaction.

name: Boon of Ashura
entries: Be it through gift, theft, or serendipitous chance of wild magic, you have come to possess a fragment of the power of Ashura, the mighty three-headed demon god of passion and fury. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take one additional reaction in a round, but you can only take one reaction on a turn. You can take an additional reaction in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Boon of Generations
entries: You have become the embodiment of the ancient vampires of your bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Deep Feeding
entries: Whenever you roll a Feed Die for your {@classFeature Feed|Kindred|BoundByBlood|1} feature, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Potent Blood
entries: Your Blood Point maximum increases by 5.

name: Boon of Magic Resistance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heroic Resistance
entries: If you fail a saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Boon of Perfect Flight
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Flying
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet and can hover.

entries.name: Graceful Fall
entries: If you fall more than 5 feet, your rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until you land.

name: Boon of Shadowsteel Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Strange Bedfellows
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Friendless|GrimHollowPG24|Friendless Transformation Flaw}.

name: Boon of the Archlich
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vessel of Vitality
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, if your {@optfeature Soul Vessel|GrimHollowPG24} is not charged, it gains a soul and becomes charged.

name: Boon of the Ascended Vampire
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inured to Sunlight
entries: You are no longer affected by sunlight.

name: Boon of the Earthly Tether
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Persistent Haunter
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Fraying Reality|GrimHollowPG24|Fraying Reality Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Specter Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=spec:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Fey
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fey Bulwark
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Weakened Constitution|GrimHollowPG24|Weakened Constitution Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Fey Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=f:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

entries.name: Free Agent
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Pull of the Netherworld|GrimHollowPG24|Pull of the Netherworld Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Fiend Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=fi:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elder Horror
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stabilizing Form
entries: When you roll a 25 or lower on the {@table Unstable Form|GrimHollowPG24|Unstable Form table}, you can choose to roll again. You must use the new result. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Aberrant Horror Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=ah:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Elemental Temperance
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Controlled Chaos
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Primordial Chaos|GrimHollowPG24|Primordial Chaos Transformation Flaw}.

name: Boon of the High Seraph
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Absolution
entries: You are no longer affected by the {@optfeature Seraph Corruption|GrimHollowPG24|Seraph Corruption Transformation Flaw}.

entries.name: Divergent Growth
entries: Choose any {@filter Seraph Transformation Boon|optionalfeatures|source=grimhollowpg24|feature type=ser:tb|miscellaneous=} that you don't already have but meet the prerequisites for. You gain that Boon.

name: Boon of the Jorōgumo
entries: The Jorōgumo is a shapeshifting, arachnoid yokai that lives among Humanoids, seducing and devouring its victims. You possess a fragment of its frightening power, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in your choice of either the Deception or Persuasion skills.
You can cast the {@spell disguise self} spell a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. In addition, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.
You ignore difficult terrain caused by webbing.

name: Boon of the Komainu
entries: The stone-skinned komainu sit vigilantly at shrines across the realm, guarding that which is sacred from pillage and plunder. You have come to possess a fragment of these lion-dog yokais' power, granting you the following benefits:

entries.name: Radiant Mane
entries: As an action, you can ignite a glowing mane of radiant energy around your neck, which lasts until you dismiss it as a bonus action or you fall {@condition unconscious}. While your mane is ignited, you shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, and a creature you are grappling takes {@damage 2d4} radiant damage at the start of its turn.

entries.name: Stone Body
entries: As a bonus action, you can harden your body to stone. Until the start of your next turn, gain a +2 bonus to AC while you aren't wearing heavy armour, have advantage on Constitution saving throws, and have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Boon of the Nue
entries: The nue is a fierce, chimeric hunter, rumoured to be the first yokai. Its power is chaotic, and a spark of that chaos resides in you. Your connection to the nue grants you the following benefits:

entries.name: Chaotic Power
entries: At the start of your turn, you can roll a d6. If the result on the die is even, you gain a bonus to the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw you make before the end of this turn equal to the result. If the result is odd, you take poison damage equal to the result, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Fleeting Flight
entries: As a bonus action, you can grant yourself a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn. You fall if you end your turn in the air with nothing holding you aloft. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Boon of the Ōmukade
entries: The omukade is a dragon hunter—a colossal centipede yokai with a resilient carapace and resistance to the elements. Your connection to the omukade grants you the following benefits:

entries.name: Elemental Carapace
entries: Choose one damage type from among acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, and thunder when you select this feat. You gain resistance to that damage type and, when you take damage of that type, you can use a reaction to become empowered. When you do, the first damage roll you make within the next minute deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage of that type. This damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}). You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Boon of the Wanyūdō
entries: Frenzied, fanatical, and blisteringly fast, the Wanyūdō is a fiendish yokai that takes the form of a large, flaming wheel. Your connection to it grants you the following benefits:

items: Your speed increases by 10 feet.
When you are {@condition prone}, standing up costs you only 5 feet of movement.

If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line towards a creature and are within reach of it, you can immediately use a bonus action to attempt a charging slam against that creature. Make a Strength (Athletics) check, contested by the target's Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (target's choice). Whoever loses the contest falls {@condition prone}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Boon of the Wilds
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Apex Predator
entries: When you enter your Hybrid Form, you gain 25 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. At the end of each of your turns while in Hybrid Form, if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. While you are in your Hybrid Form and have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

name: Botanist
entries: You have studied the secrets of botany and are an expert in its craft and application, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@item Herbalism Kit|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.

As an action, you can identify one plant within 5 feet of you, as if you had tasted it. You must see the plant for this benefit to work. You learn what kind of plant it is, and what types of properties it has, such as if it is used for medical purposes or is edible.

name: Bouncy
entries: You learned to capitalize on your flexible form and tap into your ooze ancestry to shrug off blows and impacts.

items: When jumping you can use your Constitution score in place of your Strength score to determine how far and high you can jump.
When you take the {@action Dodge} action you become resistant to bludgeoning damage until the beginning of your next turn.

When you take bludgeoning damage, you can use a reaction to gain resistance to bludgeoning damage until the end of your next turn. If you use this feature to gain resistance to bludgeoning damage caused by falling, you do not fall prone after landing. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Bouncy
entries: You learned to capitalize on your flexible form and tap into your ooze ancestry to shrug off blows and impacts.

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When jumping you can use your Constitution score in place of your Strength score to determine how far and high you can jump and you increase both by 10 feet.
When you take the {@action dodge} action you become resistant to bludgeoning damage until the beginning of your next turn.

When you take bludgeoning damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to bludgeoning damage until the end of your next turn. If you use this feature to gain resistance to bludgeoning damage caused by falling, you do not fall prone after landing. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses after finishing a long rest.

name: Boundless Reserves
entries: You have learned to harness your inner vitality to replenish your {@classFeature Ki|Monk||2}. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you start your turn and have no {@classFeature Ki|Monk||2} points remaining, you can use a reaction to spend one Hit Die. Roll the die and add your Constitution modifier to it. You regain expended {@classFeature Ki|Monk||2} points equal to up to half the total (minimum of 1). You can never have more {@classFeature Ki|Monk||2} points than the maximum for your level. Hit Dice spent using this feat can't be used to regain hit points during a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short rest}. You regain spent Hit Dice as normal.

name: Bountiful Luck*
