entries: You are an expert with {@item Cook's Utensils|phb}.

As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided you have ingredients and {@item cook's utensils|phb} on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 + your proficiency bonus. At the end of the short rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points regains an extra {@dice 1d8} hit points.

With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus. These special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a bonus action to eat one of those treats to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Chef
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Chef Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Chef Feat:}

items.name: Chosen Chemicals
items.entry: Choose Poison damage or Acid damage.

items.name: Adjust for Species
items.entry: Once at any time you can pick a creature type. Until the start of your next turn, damage you deal of the chosen type to creatures of the type you picked ignores resistance and immunity. Additionally, if any of the damage dice roll their highest value add an additional damage die. It is the same damage type and die type. Additional dice can be added in this way no more than a number of times equal to twice the ability modifier increased by this feat to each instance of damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses on a long rest.

name: Chief Engineer
entries: You are a brilliant engineer, knowledgeable of every system on board your ship, and capable of fixing just about anything. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Technology|DarkMatter} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.
When you deactivate the ship's shield to direct its power elsewhere, you can invest its power in both the engines and a weapon, or in two weapons of your choice.
You have advantage on checks you make to repair systems. When you repair a system or weapon, it regains 5 mega hit points, instead of 1.

Additionally, when you repair the ship as a downtime activity, the ship regains mega hit points equal to three times your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier for each day you spend performing repairs.

name: Chief Engineer
entries: You are a brilliant engineer, knowledgeable of every system on board your ship, and capable of fixing just about anything. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Technology Expert
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Technology|DarkMatter24} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you have {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

entries.name: Advanced Repairs
entries: When you take the Emergency Repairs action, you can choose to make a DC 20 check instead of a DC 15 one. On a success, the ship regains an additional 10 {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}.

entries.name: Ship Firewall
entries: While you are in the {@variantrule Engineer|DarkMatter24} role, the {@variantrule Pilot|DarkMatter24} has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws they make on behalf of the ship.

entries.name: Ship Feats
entries: Life on a starship is arduous, and those without proper training can find themselves completely unprepared to face the challenges posed by deep space. Even a simple run-in with a spaceshark or a pack of var'zuul grubs can spell disaster for the uninitiated. Ship feats each correspond to a Crew Role aboard a starship and represent training and expertise in that role. Ship roles are detailed in the Ships chapter.

entries.name: Gaining a Ship Feat
entries: The GM can grant you a Ship feat to solidify your chosen role aboard the ship or to award you for excellence in a particular role.

name: Child

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: You are an adolescent, someone who has absolutely no place in the dangerous adventuring life. Perhaps you are destined to change the world and your destiny will not wait for maturity, or perhaps you have thrown your lot in with an adventuring party who has promised to keep you safe from harm. Somehow, you are at the precipice of adventure, and have the following traits:

items: Your size is Small, even if your race is normally Medium.
You have two fewer skill proficiencies than other characters of the same class.
Your Strength and Constitution scores have a maximum of 16, instead of 20.
You gain proficiency in two saving throws of your choice.

name: Child of Yastah*

choose.entry: Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: Yastah is your world. It always has been, and it always will be as long as you have a say in the matter. Through your studies of Luna and Soual, and of the first empire of Ereborn, you learn that you were made to be adaptable, and so you shall be. You gain the Following Benefits:

items: You become proficient in two new skills, or gain expertise in one skill you already have proficiency in.

Once per day, you can calm a situation by invoking your dominance. When it seems combat is about to begin, if no stikes have yet been made by you or your allies, you can use a bonus action to intimidate your enemy to stand down peacefully. You will have advantage on this Intimidation, and all hostiles will have disadvantage on their Will saves. Any hostile who fails their Will save will be too afraid to fight you or your party unless they are provoked by further violence.

name: Chitinous Reinforcement
entries: You've learned to reinforce all of your forms with thicker chitin. While you are not wearing armor and using no shield, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC. This bonus isn't cumulative with {@item bracers of defense|XDMG}

name: Choke-Hold
entries: You can use your action to try to pin a creature {@condition grappled} by you. To do so, make another {@action grapple} check. If you succeed, your speed becomes 0 and the creature you are grappling becomes {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Choke-Hold
entries: You can use your action to try to pin a creature {@condition grappled} by you. To do so, make another {@action grapple} check. If you succeed, your speed becomes 0 and the creature you are grappling becomes {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Chosen by Fate
entries: The Norns have chosen you for greater things. As a result, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Heroic Resurgence
entries: If you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} and the die roll fails, your use of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} isn't expended (though you can't use it again for the same {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}).

entries.name: Heroic Windfall
entries: Whenever you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}, you regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the die roll. If you are already at your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum} when you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}, you instead gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the die roll. If you use {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}, and you roll higher on the die than is necessary to restore you to your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum}, you gain any excess as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

name: Chosen Chaplain

prerequisite.other: Member of the Temple of the Chosen

entries: While all who worship the Chosen strive to live their best amongst the stars, only a select number walk the path of the chaplain. As a chaplain, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Religion} skill.
You can cast the spell worldseek once without expending spell slots or spell components. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

As an action, you can pray to the Chosen for guidance while aboard a ship. Choose one creature in a role aboard your ship. The next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw that creature makes as a part of their role has advantage on that roll.

name: Chosen Enemy
entries: Choose a type of chosen foe when you take this feat: aberrations, beasts, celestials, constructs, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, giants, monstrosities, oozes, plants, or undead. Alternatively, you can select two races of humanoid (such as gnolls and orcs) as your chosen foe.
When you make an attack roll against a creature of that type, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to your attack roll.

You can take this feat multiple times, but you must choose a different creature type each time you take it. Also, when you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can switch the type of creature you chose with this feat to a different one.

name: Chosen of Magic
entries: Your faith grants you great insight into magic, giving you a special privilege with it as if magic itself favors you.

items: When someone attempts to dispel or {@spell counterspell} your magic, if they are required to make a roll for it succeed, the DC is increased by your spell casting modifier.
When you make a saving throw against a spell or other magical effect, you can gain advantage on the roll. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

When you expend a spell slot, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 20, you regain a spell slot of a level lower than expended spell slot, up to a maximum level equal to your proficiency bonus, and a minimum level of 1. You can regain a total number of spell slot levels equal to your proficiency bonus this way until you cannot regain further spell slots until you complete a long rest.

name: Chronomancy Initiate
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Moment to Think|ValdaSpire24} cantrip.

entries.name: Expanded Spell List
entries: Spells with the [Chronomancy] tag are added to your spell list.
The spells {@spell Haste|XPHB}, {@spell Slow|XPHB}, and {@spell Time Stop|XPHB} have the [Chronomancy] tag.

entries.name: Prepared Spells
entries: Choose a number of spells with the [Chronomancy] tag equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell with the [Chronomancy] tag.

name: Chronomancy Initiate
entries: Having unraveled the secrets of time magic, chronomancy, you have learned to pull seconds apart, reorder them, and reap minutes as a reward. You gain the following benefits:

items: All spells with the chronomancy tag are added to your class's spell list, if they are a level for which your class gets spell slots. Use your spellcasting ability for these spells.
You learn the {@spell moment to think|VSS} cantrip, which doesn't count against your total number of cantrips known.

You learn four spells of your choice that you cast with the chronomancy tag. If you prepare spells, these spells are always prepared for you and don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you are a wizard, they are added to your spellbook instantly at no cost. If you learn spells, these spells do not count against your total number of spells known. When you gain a level in your spellcasting class, you can replace one of these spells with another spell with the chronomancy tag for which you have spell slots.

name: Church of the Sun Above: Adherent
entries: For pledging yourself and potentially your soul to the Sun Above, you have become an adherent of the faith, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Dogma
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Religion|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Solar Judgement
entries: When you deal damage to a creature with a weapon, spell, or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can cause the target to take an extra {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Faction Feats
entries: Veteran adventurers are likely to make enemies across the 'Verse, but if they're lucky, they might forge some alliances too. The greatest of these alliances are likely to be with factions, which provide work, services, and connections to spacers everywhere. Factions in Dark Matter are detailed in Chapter 1: The 'Verse.

Of course, such allies don't come free. Factions generally also require work and commitment from their members, which might come in the form of small tasks, important favors for higher ranking members, or even regular obligations for the organization. For their efforts, adventurers gain specific and useful skills from their factions, as represented by Faction feats.

entries.name: Gaining a Faction Feat
entries: The GM can award you a Faction feat for joining a faction or completing a quest for one. If allegiance to a faction is important to your backstory, the GM can also replace the feat granted by your background with an appropriate Faction feat.

name: Cindersoul
entries: You have uncovered the aggressive magics of elemental fire inside yourself, granting you the following benefits:

items: On your turn, you can transform your lower body into a column of smoke and embers, casting the {@spell jump} spell on yourself, without expending a spell slot or material components.

Once you reach 5th level, you can cast hellish rebuke as a 3rd-level spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Cindersoul
entries: You have uncovered the aggressive magics of elemental fire inside yourself, granting you the following benefits:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal {@dice 1d4} fire damage to the creature.

Once you reach 5th level, you can cast {@spell flame blade} as a 3rd-level spell, requiring no spell slot or components, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Circle Magic
entries: You have received training in the Circle Magic Tradition enabling you to absorb the magical might of a group of spellcasters working together. You gain access to {@b Circle Magic Casting}

items: The eastern reaches of Faerûn have a long history of using Circle Magic. Currently both the Red Wizards of Thay and the Wychlaren of Rashemen are known for using this technique to unleash incredible feats of magical power.

Using Circle Magic, spellcasters work together to augment a single circle member with power derived from all the individuals in the group. That recipient can then use the magical power they have been given to increase their own spellcasting until all the stored magical energies have been used.

{@b Requirements.} To cast a spell using Circle Magic, three or more spellcasters are required. One of these spellcasters must possess the Circle Magic feat. The leader of the circle, usually the most powerful or experienced caster, stands within a circle formed by the other casters, who are no more than 10 feet from each other. Up to five casters can aid the leader, though stories exist of powerful Red Wizards employing twice that number.

{@b Storing Magical Energy.} For 1 hour, each spellcaster in the circle concentrates on transferring their magical energies to the leader. At the start of this hour, each participant expends one spell slot of their choice. Spellcasters are subject to normal concentration checks during this hour. Should any caster be interrupted and fail their concentration check during this hour, that caster's spell slot is lost. The leader of the circle receives a pool of magical energy at the end of this hour equal to the total level of spell slots expended by the circle.

For example, a circle consisting of one leader and three assistants spends 1 hour developing their pool. The assistants expend the following spell slots: 2 1st-level spell slots, 1 2nd-level spell slot, and 1 3rd-level spell slot. The leader adds 1 1st-level spell slot. This results in the circle leader receiving a final pool of Circle Magic energy totaling (2) 1st, (1) 2nd and (1) 3rd level spell slot.
{@b Spending Spell Pool Energy.} The leader of the circle may use their pool of magical energy in the following ways:
{@u Increased Spell Slot.} The leader may spend any number of spell slots from the circle spell pool and add it to a spell being cast.
{@u Apply a Meta Magic Feat.} The leader may spend spell slots to apply meta-magic option as per a sorcerer to a spell they cast. The following meta magic options are available:
{@i Increased Spell Slot.} The leader may spend any number of spell slots from the circle spell pool and add it to a spell being cast.

Example. If the leader cast a 1st level spell using their they could augment it with any number of spell slots that are available in their spell pool. If they spent a 3rd level spell slot from their circle spell pool, the spell would be effectively cast as if by a 4th level spell slot (1st level personal slot + 3rd level circle pool slot).
{@i Meta Magic.} Circle leaders may apply a selection of sorcerer meta magic options to a spell they cast as follows:
Empowered Spell: Costs 1 spell slot regardless of level.
Extended Spell: Costs 1 spell slot regardless of level.
Heightened Spell: 3 spell slots regardless of level.
{@b Duration.} The leader of the circle may hold the pool of magic energy received for up to 24 hours. Any unused magical energy in the pool dissipates after 24 hours and is forever lost.

name: Circle of Duplication

otherSummary.entry: or ritual caster class feature

entries: When you serve as the focal point for a Thayan circle cast spell, you may attempt to manifest your spell's effect twice when the ritual completes. If you do, the spell's base DC is half of its normal value, determined after all adjustments from your ritual are compiled in. You choose new targets for the duplicated spell.

name: Circle of Hunger

otherSummary.entry: or ritual caster class feature

entries: When you serve as the focal point for a Thayan circle cast spell, you may attempt to siphon additional energy from each caster other than yourself participating in the ritual. This decision is made at the end of each minute that you spend casting your ritual, and once made each caster other than yourself automatically loses their highest-level unused spell slot unless they succeed on a Constitution saving throw. The DC for this saving throw is:

entries.name: DC
entries.text: 8 + your spellcasting modifier + your proficiency bonus + the number of rounds in this ritual that you've used this ability

entries: A spellcaster that fails this saving throw and has no spell slots remaining falls {@condition unconscious} and is no longer able to participate in the current circle casting effort. Any spell slots lost by the circle casting participants may be used by you in your ritual's final effect, and the original caster regains spell slots lost in this manner when they complete a long rest.

name: Circle Spellcaster
entries: You have learned to create a circular flow of magic between yourself and an allied spellcaster to bolster your spells. You gain the following benefits.

items: You can spend 2 hours (including during a long rest) creating a mystical bond with another spellcaster. Both of you must spend this time in meditation, and you must remain within 10 feet of each other. Once the bond is formed, you can work together to bolster one another's magic. When one of you casts a spell that requires {@status concentration}, the other can use their reaction to help maintain the spell. If the caster must make a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status concentration} on the spell, both of you make the saving throw. If either of you succeeds, {@status concentration} is unbroken. If both saving throws fail, you both lose {@status concentration} on any spells you are currently maintaining and you both take {@damage 2d6} psychic damage from the strain. You can maintain this bond with only one spellcaster at a time. If you create a new bond, the previous bond breaks. Otherwise, it lasts until the end of your next long rest.

name: Circle Spellcaster
entries: You have learned to create a circular flow of magic between yourself and an allied spellcaster to bolster your spells. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can spend 2 hours (which can be during a long rest) creating a mystical bond with another spellcaster. Both of you must spend this time in meditation, and you must remain within 10 feet of each other. The bond goes into effect when the meditation is over (or when you finish your long rest). Once the bond is formed, the two of you can bolster one another's magic. When one of you must make a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, the other can use his or her reaction to help maintain the effect. Both of you make the saving throw. If either save is successful, the caster maintains concentration. If both saves are failed, both of you lose concentration on any spells you are maintaining and each of you takes {@damage 2d6} psychic damage from the strain. You can maintain this bond with only one spellcaster at a time. If you create a new bond, the previous one breaks. Otherwise, the bond lasts until you finish your next long rest.

name: Clairvoyant Warrior
entries: You have a mystical connection to the ebb and flow of combat and can anticipate and even influence the actions of nearby combatants.

You learn one {@filter 1st-level spell of your choice from the divination school of magic|spells|level=1|school=D|cast time=action;bonus}. The spell must have a casting time of 1 reaction or 1 bonus action. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma to be your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can cast the spell a number of times equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1). You regain expended castings after finishing a long rest.
This feat can be taken more than once. Choose a different spell each time the feat is taken.

entries.name: Class Skill Features
entries: You gain two Class Skill Features of your choice, provided you meet the requirements of the Skill Feat. You can choose the skill feats from the following classes: {@filter Artificer|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:A}, {@filter Barbarian|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:B}, {@filter Fighter|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:B}, {@filter Monk|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:M}, {@filter Paladin|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:P}, {@filter Ranger|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:Ra}, {@filter Rogue|optionalfeatures|feature type=SF:Ro}.

name: Classical Artist
entries: Your great intellect has allowed you to master what many would consider the fine arts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with both {@item mason's tools|PHB} and {@item painter's supplies|PHB}. Whenever you make an ability check with either tool, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.
You can use mason's tools or painter's supplies and the appropriate materials to create a work of fine art worth 50 gp for each 8-hour workday you spend working on it.
You have advantage on checks to assess the value of art.

name: Classical Artist
entries: Your great intellect has allowed you to master what many would consider the fine arts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with both {@item mason's tools|phb} and {@item painter's supplies|phb}, and you can add double your proficiency bonus to any check you make with these tool proficiencies.
You can use {@item mason's tools|phb} or {@item painter's supplies|phb} and the appropriate materials to create a work of fine art worth 50 gp for each 8-hour workday you spend working on it.
You have advantage on checks to evaluate the value of art.

name: Cleansing Touch
entries: You gain the ability to use your action to expend one dice from your {@feat Lay on Hands|Adventurer} pool to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch.

items: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee weapon (Not an unarmed attack of any kind), you can immediately make an attack against another creature within reach with the same weapon. Before making the extra attack make a new attack roll.

name: Cleaving Attacks
entries: Your attacks carry weight and devastate the battlefield, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you make a melee weapon attack using Strength against a creature, if there are other targets within 5 feet of you and it, you can cleave them with the same attack. You target other creatures within reach and, if the original attack roll can hit them, apply damage equal to your Strength modifier.

name: Clever Action
entries: You can make an extra object interaction on each of your turns.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Clever Action
entries: You can make an extra object interaction on each of your turns.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Clever Disguise
entries: You're adept at keeping your true nature hidden and have even embraced more of your fey heritage than others. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@item disguise kit|phb} if you didn't already have it.

You can use your change form feature to instead turn into a {@creature fox|KitsuneFF}. Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the fox, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the fox. If the fox has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the fox's bonus instead of yours. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying isn't transformed and you can't wear any armor unless it is made to fit your fox form. You have disadvantage when using equipment meant for humanoids and cannot cast spells that require material components while in this form.

name: Clinging Breath

prerequisite.other: Breath Weapon (Dragonborn, Dragon, Half Dragon, or Kobold (Dragonwrought) with the Kobold Breath feat)

entries: The elemental energies of your racial breath weapon cling to your foes, slowly consuming them whole.

items: The DC of your racial breath weapon increases by 1.

A creature that fails its saving throw against your racial breath weapon (provided it deals damage) must make a saving throw at the start of each of its turns afterwards, with the same saving throw type and DC as that of your breath weapon, taking damage equal to 1d6 times half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) of the same type on a failed save, and ending this effect on a successful one. This effect does not stack on the same creature.

name: Cloak of Shadows
entries: You are adept at supernaturally masking your presence. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enshrouded
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) check on the current turn.

entries.name: Unseen Passage
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

You can use this {@action Magic|XPHB} action a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Clockwork Servant
entries: You learn to use your skill to create a clockwork servant. With 8 hours of work and the expenditure of 100 gp worth of metal components, you can create a clockwork servant. You can only have one clockwork servant at a time. Your servant can take the form of any beast of CR 1/2. The servant uses that beast's game statistics, but it can look however you like, as long as its form is appropriate for its statistics. It has the following modifications:

items: It is a construct instead of a beast.
It is immune to psychic and poison damage and the poisoned and charmed conditions.
It gains darkvision with a range of 60 feet if it doesn't have it already.
It understands the languages you can speak when you create it, but it can't speak.
It is unaffected by healing magic. If is targeted by the mending spell, it can spend hit dice and instead use the highest number possible for each die.

entries: Your servant acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn.

You can infuse a spell into your servant through use of the Infused Magic feat. As an action, your servant can activate the spell, even if it has an Intelligence score of less than 6. Your servant be infused with only one spell at a time.
If your servant is destroyed, you can spend 8 hours of work and 100 gp worth of metal components in order to repair the servant. You can only have one clockwork servant at a time.

You can select this feat a second time after 7th level, a third time after 11th level, a fourth time after 15th level, and a fifth time after 19th level. The CR of beasts you can craft your servant into increases to CR 1 after the second time, CR 2 after the third time, CR 3 the fourth time, and CR 4 the fifth time.

name: Close Combat Artillerist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Point Blank
entries: When you hit a creature that is within 5 feet of you with a ranged attack, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

items: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls, excluding spells.

name: Close-Quarters Shooter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls, and you have advantage if you attack a {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of you with a ranged weapon attack.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Close-Quarters Shooter
entries: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls, and you have advantage if you attack a {@condition prone} creature within 5 feet of you with a ranged weapon attack.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Cloud Hopper
entries: Your exposure to the great wind spirit has changed you. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you move on your turn, you can choose to conjure tiny clouds below your feet, allowing you to move into unoccupied spaces in the air. You can move a number of feet in this way equal to 5 × your proficiency bonus before the clouds stop appearing. Ending this movement while in the air causes you to fall as normal.

You learn the {@spell Fog Cloud} and {@spell Gust of Wind} spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).

name: Clout
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Strong Influence
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception}, {@skill Intimidation}, and {@skill Persuasion}) checks when interacting with Vikings, professional warriors, and other martial folk. When using the {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB} feat, you also add your Strength modifier to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you grant.

name: Clown
entries: From the world Circus Maximus, clowns are humans with pale skin, red noses, and a penchant for mischief. Others might find your appearance delightful or frightening, but it's the only one you've ever known. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Natural Entertainer
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Pratfall
entries: When you roll a 5 or lower on the {@dice d20} roll for a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vicious Shenanigans
entries: You learn the {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When a creature fails its saving throw against this spell and rolls a 5 or lower on the {@dice D20} for its saving throw, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Club Master
entries: You gain proficiency with greatclubs, if you weren't proficient with them already.
Additionally, clubs you wield deal {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage and greatclubs you wield deal {@dice 1d10} instead of {@dice 1d8} bludgeoning damage.

Finally, whenever you score a critical hit on a creature with a club or greatclub, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier), or have its speed reduced to 0 and be unable to make reactions until the end of its next turn.

name: Coalition War Training
entries: For joining the Coalition, you have received marksman training to make the most out of the standard-issue carbine, which confers the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the repeater and the standard carbine.
When you make an attack with a carbine you are holding in two hands and you don't fire it automatically, its damage increases to {@dice 2d8}.
Using a system of silent hand signals, you can communicate tactical information, such as how many enemies are in sight, where your allies should move, and when to attack.

name: Cobbler
entries: You have mastered the humble art of making and repairing footwear. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item cobbler's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.

As part of a short rest, you can alter up to six pairs of shoes to leave behind the tracks of a differently sized person or animal. Checks made to identify these tracks as fakes have disadvantage. This alteration lasts for 8 hours or until the shoes are altered again.

Any creature that wears shoes you have worked on has advantage on saving throws against and take half damage (rounded down) from items and effects that specifically target their feet, such as the {@spell grease} spell or a spread {@item Caltrops (bag of 20)|phb|bag of caltrops}. Such creatures also ignore difficult terrain caused by nonmagical ice, mud, sand, or snow.

name: Cobbler
entries: You are an expert with {@item Cobbler's Tools|phb}.

As part of a short rest, you can alter up to six pairs of shoes to leave behind the tracks of a differently sized person or animal. Checks made to identify these tracks as fakes have disadvantage. This alteration lasts for 8 hours or until the shoes are altered again.

Any creature that wears shoes you have worked on has advantage on saving throws against and take half damage (rounded down) from items and effects that specifically target their feet, such as the {@spell grease} spell or a spread {@item Caltrops (bag of 20)|phb|bag of caltrops}. Such creatures also ignore difficult terrain caused by nonmagical ice, mud, sand, or snow.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Coin Shot
entries: You spit out and fire coins or other small objects you stored within your container-shaped body (or elsewhere if your body is shaped like a different object). You can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to make a ranged attack against a target you can see within 60 feet of you. Your bonus to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|XPHB} is equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} + your dexterity modifier.

The damage dealt by your coin shot attack is normally bludgeoning damage, but the GM might determine you deal piercing damage if you spit out something sufficiently spiky. Your coin shot attack deals {@damage 2d6} damage.

name: Cold Plunge Training
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Water Training
entries: While in water, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} and on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks to swim.

entries.name: Arctic Dive
entries: On a turn when you dive from land into water, your movement in the water is at your normal {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} rather than half {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

name: Cold Refusal
entries: Your crystal carapace is coated in frigid ice. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
You gain resistance to fire damage.
Cold, fire and nonmagical slashing damage you take is reduce by 3.

At the end of a long rest, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes cold damage equal to 5 x your proficiency bonus.

name: Cold Water Warrior
entries: You have become accustomed to spending time in cold, treacherous waters. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Against the Current
entries: You automatically succeed on Strength checks to move through rough water.

entries.name: Cold Water Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of immersion in frigid water for a number of hours equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Swimming Leap
entries: You can make {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB} and {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB} while swimming. If you swim at least 10 feet before a jump, you are considered to have a running start.

entries.name: Water Combatant
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} if you begin combat at least partially submerged in a body of water.

name: Colossus
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use an action to automatically break out of nonmagical restraints and {@condition grappled|grapples}.
You have advantage on checks to break magical restraints.
You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity, the weight you can push, drag, or lift, and your size while grappling creatures.
When you successfully {@action shove} a creature, you can deal the target bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier (minimum of 1 damage).

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Colossus
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use an action to automatically break out of nonmagical restraints and {@condition grappled|grapples}.
You have advantage on checks to break magical restraints.
You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity, the weight you can push, drag, or lift, and your size while grappling creatures.
When you successfully {@action shove} a creature, you can deal the target bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier (minimum of 1 damage).

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Colossus Breaker
entries: When you hit a Large or larger creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d6 damage for each size category it is above Medium—for example, a Huge creature would take an additional 2d6 damage. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

items: You can attempt to {@action shove} a creature who is 2 sizes larger than you or smaller.
When you successfully {@action shove} a creature, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier (minimum 0) and you may push them an additional 5 feet away from you.
When you make a Strength check to break restraints, damage an object, or win a contest of Strength, you gain advantage on that roll.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls (only applicable for spells).
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage.

name: Combat Flight Training
entries: You have trained to overcome the limits of flight to make better use of it while in combat.

items: You can now fly while wearing any type of armor you're proficient with, and at half speed with armor you're not proficient with.

When you trigger an opportunity attack by moving out of range of an enemy you may use your reaction to cause disadvantage on the attack roll. You may do this a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once) until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Combat Flyting
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Taunt
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn, you can demean and bait an opponent within 30 feet of you that can hear and understand you. The target must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the target takes a -1 penalty to attack rolls against you. You can use another {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your subsequent turns to impart another -1 penalty; these effects stack to a maximum equal to your Charisma modifier. The target is allowed a save against each of these uses.

This effect ends if you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition, you fail to use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} each round to maintain it, or if the target moves more than 30 feet away from you. Otherwise, it continues for a maximum number of rounds equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.
A creature that succeeds on the saving throw has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to your Taunts for 24 hours.

name: Combat Knots
entries: When you ensnare a creature with a {@item net|PHB}, the DC required to escape is increased by your proficiency modifier.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Combat Knots
entries: When you ensnare a creature with a {@item net|PHB}, the DC required to escape is increased by your proficiency modifier.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Combat Medic
entries: You have experiance as a medic for those in constant danger. You gain the following benefits.

items: You gain proficiency in the Medicine skill.  If you are already proficient in Medicine, you gain Expertise in the skill as well.
You can tell the approximate remaining Hit points (to the closest 10%) of a creature when you make a Wisdom (Medicine) check by visually examining them as a bonus action.

When making a Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize an unconscious creature as an action, you may take disadvantage on the skill check to also heal the creature 1d4 hit points and end their unconscious condition.

name: Combat Medic
entries: While touching a creature, you can use your action to make a Medicine check. The creature is stabilized, gains 1 HP (if you have a Healer's Kit, the HP equals 1d10), and temporary HP equal to your Medicine check (up to a maximum of 20). If the result is higher than 20, you also regain a spell slot equal to half your proficiency modifier (rounded down). You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Combat Superiority
entries: You learn one additional maneuver of your choice from among those available to the Battle Master archetype in the fighter class. You gain one superiority dice, and your superiority dice turn from d6s to d8s. You can select this feat a second time after 10th level and a third time at 18th level. Each time you do so your superiority dice become one step larger (such as from d8s to d10s).

name: Combat Support
entries: You learn to inspire others in battle. A creature that has a assistance die from you can roll that die and add the number rolled to a weapon damage roll it just made. Alternatively, when an attack roll is made against the creature, it can use its reaction to roll the assistance die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses.

name: Combination Caster
entries: You are a master of casting powerful spells one after the other. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Choose a 1st-level spell that has a casting time of 1 bonus action and add it to one of your classes' spell lists. This spell is considered known and prepared for you, but doesn't count against your spells known or prepared.

When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that has a casting time of 1 bonus action, you can use your action this turn to cast a spell of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action, expending a spell slot as normal. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Combo Striker
entries: You are practised in the art of collaborative combat and combination strikes, granting you the following benefits:

items: You can collaborate in a combo attack*, even if you have already collaborated in one since your last long rest. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

When you initiate a combo attack, one willing creature of your choice that you can see can collaborate in that combo without preventing them from collaborating in another combo attack before they finish a long rest. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Comforting Companion
entries: You are a soothing presence. When you share an entire short or long with up to six creatures you choose within 30 feet of you, each regains hit points equal to your level.

name: Communications Officer
entries: The character gains proficiency in the {@skill Persuasion} skill. If the character already has proficiency, add double the proficiency bonus to checks with it, and the character also has advantage on {@skill Persuasion} checks made to influence members of the Silver Company. Additionally, when interacting with members of organisations foreign to Kathkach, you can gain an audience with a leader or person of authority within the organisation once per day.

name: Company Boat
entries: The character is given a boat by the Company, that is equivalent to a {@vehicle keelboat|GoS}. The {@vehicle keelboat|GoS} is docked at the Company docks and will be maintained (but not repaired) by the Company so long as it remains there free of charge. If the boat is sunk or destroyed, the Company will issue a replacement within {@dice 3d6} days.

name: Company First Aider
entries: The character can add an additional {@dice 1d6} points worth of healing to any healing spell or effect that restores hit points. The character can make use of this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency modifier, and regain all expended uses at the end of a long rest.

name: Company Lodgings
entries: The character is gifted a more enhanced lodging for personal use. The house is located in the Merchant District and features three rooms, each made up of 20 by 20ft spaces, 15ft high. These rooms contain a sleeping area, a kitchen, and a living area. A long rest taken in this space grant the character an additional number of temporary hit points equal to {@dice ceil(@details.level/2)|half their character level, rounded up}. The living spaces can be customised using furniture and items at the owner's discretion.

name: Company Magic Specialist

spell.entry: The capacity to cast spells of 1st level or higher

entries: If the character has the capacity to cast spells of 1st level or higher, the character can cast a level 1 spell from any spell list as an innate spell that can be cast once per long rest. The spellcasting ability for this spell is either Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, as chosen by the character.

name: Company Militant Specialist
entries: The character can for 1 minute add +1 to any attack roll made with any weapon. The character can use this ability once per long rest.

name: Company Mount
entries: The character is given a mount by the Company, either a {@creature camel|MM}, {@item donkey|PHB} or {@creature mule|MM}, {@creature draft horse|MM}, {@creature riding horse|MM}, {@creature mastiff|MM}, or {@creature pony|MM} and uses the stat blocks for that creature in the monster manual. The mount is taken care of by the Company and can be left at the Silver Company Headquarters (or equivalent), and so long as the mount is stabled there will be fed and sheltered. If the mount is killed, the Company will issue a replacement within {@dice 1d4} days.

name: Company Wetworker
entries: A number of times equal to the character's proficiency bonus, the character can add +5 to an ability check aimed at opening a lock or otherwise breaking into an area. This bonus must be declared before the roll is made. Uses of this ability are regained after a long rest.

name: Complex Training
entries: When you attempt to train an animal, you can attempt to train it to follow more complex commands. Choose a complex command (such as "fetch a healing potion from my bag," "watch for intruders," or "follow the scent on this rag") and make a DC 15 Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check. If you succeed, the beast learns to follow the command as it would a simple command. Additionally, you can now train animals of {@filter CR 1/4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/4]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Complex Training
entries: When you attempt to train an animal, you can attempt to train it to follow more complex commands. Choose a complex command (such as "fetch a healing potion from my bag," "watch for intruders," or "follow the scent on this rag") and make a DC 15 Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check. If you succeed, the beast learns to follow the command as it would a simple command. Additionally, you can now train animals of {@filter CR 1/4 or lower|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/4]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Composite Resilency
entries: You have honed your stone, metal, and wood construction into efficient harmony, improving your overall resilience. You gain the following benefits while your model type is Composite Plating:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC.
Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to your level.
Whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, you may reroll any results of 1, taking the new roll.

You automatically stabilize when brought to 0 hit points. You do not need to make death saving throws on your turn when at 0 hit points, but you may still be killed if damage forces you to automatically fail three death saving throws.

name: Conductive Hydromancer
entries: You have learned techniques to direct lightning spells through bodies of water, gaining the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell create or destroy water|PHB} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot or providing material components. You regain the ability to cast this spell in this way when you finish a long rest.
When you cast a spell using hydromancy, you can treat any bodies of water that are less than 10 feet apart at any point as a single body of water.
When you cast a spell that deals lightning damage, it gains the hydromancy tag with a hydromancy radius of 30 feet.

Once per turn when you deal lightning damage to a creature with a spell cast using hydromancy, you can cause it to take an additional {@damage 1d8} lightning damage, or {@damage 1d12} lightning damage if the creature is submerged in water.

name: Conductive Hydromancer
entries: You have learned techniques to direct lightning spells through bodies of water, gaining the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell create or destroy water|PHB} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot or providing material components. You regain the ability to cast this spell in this way when you finish a long rest.
When you cast a spell using hydromancy, you can treat any bodies of water that are less than 10 feet apart at any point as a single body of water.
When you cast a spell that deals lightning damage, it gains the hydromancy tag with a hydromancy radius of 30 feet.

Once per turn when you deal lightning damage to a creature with a spell cast using hydromancy, you can cause it to take an additional {@damage 1d8} lightning damage, or {@damage 1d12} lightning damage if the creature is submerged in water.

name: Confidence
entries: Overcoming difficulties has reinforced your spirit and renewed your faith in a brighter future.

items: You gain proficiency in saving throws using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).

name: Configuration Upgrade
entries: When you use your Reconfigurable Ability Score Increase trait, you can increase a single ability score by 3, or increase 3 different ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20.

items: The character can, when ordering wines or beverages, order a second bottle or jar free of charge (up to 1gp) once per day. In addition, when consuming a wine worth over 5 silver pieces, they gain a bonus to their {@skill Performance} and {@skill History} ability checks equal to their constitution modifier for the next hour.

name: Connoisseur of Lies
entries: You collect lies that you hear and know their weaknesses and what they reveal about the personality and disposition of the liar. If you determine that a creature is lying, you have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks against the creature for 1 minute as long as you can see the creature's mouth and eyes.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Connoisseur of Lies
entries: You collect lies that you hear and know their weaknesses and what they reveal about the personality and disposition of the liar. If you determine that a creature is lying, you have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks against the creature for 1 minute as long as you can see the creature's mouth and eyes.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Conserved Spellcasting
entries: When you cast a spell using a higher level spell slot, you can regain a spell slot of level equal to the difference between the spell slot used and spell's level. Using this ability ignores the spell's Casting at Higher Level feature.

name: Conviction of Justice
entries: Your faith is a stalwart bastion of righteous purpose, few can stand before you when evil rises your ire. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the spell {@spell divine favor} which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. When you are under the effect of {@spell divine favor}, your movement speed is increased by 5 feet. You regain the ability to cast this spell in this way when you finish a long rest.

As an action, you can focus your righteous fervor, infusing a weapon you are holding with your divine purpose. For 1 minute, when you make a damage roll for that weapon, you reroll any 1 on the die (continuing to reroll it until it is no longer a 1 if necessary). If you have another feature that allows you to reroll a 1 on the damage die (such as the {@optfeature Great Weapon Fighting} Fighting Style), you can instead maximize the die. Once you use this action, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

name: Convincing Inquisitor
entries: You know how to spot a liar, and you can get people to see your way, whether through charm, reasonable arguments, or force of will. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Charming Presence
entries: When you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action, you don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on checks to influence {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creatures, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks to influence {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} creatures.

entries.name: Multiple Paths
entries: You can use any ability modifier when you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action to make an {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} or  {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} check.

entries.name: Zealous Insight
entries: When you succeed on a {@action Search|XPHB} action's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to detect lies or evasive answers, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls involving combat against that creature for 1 hour.

name: Convincing Thoughts
entries: Your supernatural powers of persuasion are uncannily hidden from your victim's mind. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Charming Smile
entries: You can cast the {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Rationalize
entries: When spells or effects that cause the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition end, the target doesn't know it was {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you.

name: Cornered Combatant
entries: You've gained an almost animalistic wrath when you're pushed to your limits. In tough circumstances, your adrenaline bolsters your strength so you can live to see another day.

items: Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have a +1 to damage rolls made while you have less than half of your maximum hit points.

name: Cornered Combatant
entries: You've gained an almost animalistic wrath when you're pushed to your limits. In tough circumstances, your adrenaline bolsters your strength so you can live to see another day.

items: Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have a +1 to damage rolls made while you have less than half of your maximum hit points.

name: Corrosive Adhesive
entries: As a bonus action, you can transform the adhesive that coats your body into corrosive acid. Your adhesive remains in this form for 1 minute, until you fall {@condition unconscious}, or until you use a bonus action to return your adhesive to normal. While covered in corrosive adhesive, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have immunity to acid damage.
When you hit a target with an unarmed strike using your pseudopods (or your pseudopod blade, if you have the Mimic Blade feat), you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} acid damage.
When a creature within 5 feet of you touches you or hits you with a melee attack, that creature takes {@damage 2d6} acid damage.

entries: Once you have used this ability, you must finish a long rest before you can do so again.

name: Corrosive Grasp
entries: Your most powerful attacks spatter corrosive adhesive on your foes, {@condition burning|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} them with acid. When you score a critical hit with an Unarmed

Strike using your pseudopod (or your pseudopod blade, if you have the Mimic Blade feat), the target takes an extra {@damage 2d4} acid damage immediately and {@damage 2d4} acid damage at the end of its next turn

name: Cosmos Touched
entries: Your exposure to the cosmos has changed you, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell alter self} spell and one {@filter 1st-level abjuration or transmutation spell|spells|source=|level=1|school=a;t} of your choice. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these feat's spells, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the ability score increased by this feat.

name: Cosmos Touched
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cosmos Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Abjuration or Transmutation school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Alter Self|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Counterabjuration

prerequisite.other: {@spell dispel magic} spell or {@spell counterspell} spell, 6th Level

entries: When you cast an abjuration spell that requires you to make an ability check as a part of casting that spell (as in {@spell counterspell} and {@spell dispel magic}), you add your proficiency bonus to that ability check. Additionally, you gain an additional reaction that can only be used to attempt to identify a spell being cast.

name: Counterstriker
entries: You gain the following beneifits:

items.name: Patient
items.entry: You can set two triggers when you hold your action or bonus action.

items.name: Counter Damage
items.entry: If you reduce damage using an instaneous reaction, reduce by twice as much.

name: Courier
entries: Gain a swim speed and a climb speed equal to your movement speed. Increase your movement speed by 5 ft.

name: Coven Witch

prerequisite.other: You must be a member of a witches coven

entries: You have become an official member of a witches coven.
You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two random common and uncommon potion recipes from your coven.

You learn two 1st-level spells of your choice. The 1st-level spells must be from the divination, conjuration, or transmutation school of magic. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Craft
entries: You gain a craft slot and a craft of your choice from the Scholar's Crafts list (see {@book Crafts|TLotRR|2|Crafts}).

name: Craft Elf Magic
entries: You add a set of industrious magics to your toolbox. You learn one artificer cantrip of your choice. You also learn the {@spell unseen servant|PHB} and {@spell heat metal|PHB} spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Craft Homunculus

prerequisite.other: Must be able to use an arcane spellcasting focus and cast 2nd level spells.

entries: You gain the ability to invest a construct with a portion of your soul, binding it to you as a homunculus. You must spend 4 workweeks of downtime and 500 gold to construct one. Choose a construct creature no larger than Medium and that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower (see the Homunculus section of The Korranberg Chronicle: Threat Dispatch starting on page 45 for constructs particularly suitable for this purpose). After it is complete, you imbue it with a portion of your soul. Your homunculus shares your alignment.

It accompanies you on your adventures and faithfully fights alongside you. Add your proficiency bonus to the homunculus's AC, attack rolls, and damage rolls, as well as to any saving throws and skills it is proficient in. The creature has a total number of hit dice equal to your level minus 3, or it's normal total, whichever is higher. For every hit die it has, its hit point maximum increases accordingly. Each level you gain after taking this feat, your homunculi gains an additional hit die and increases its hit points accordingly.

For every 4 hit die the homunculus has, its ability scores improve. Your homunculus can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or it can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, your homunculus can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature unless its description specifies otherwise. Your homunculus can't gain feats unless otherwise noted.

Your homunculus obeys your commands as best it can. It rolls for initiative like any other creature, but you determine its actions, decisions, attitudes, and so on. If you are incapacitated, your companion acts on its own.

Your homunculus remains active as long as it is within 100 feet of you. It becomes unconscious and inert if you ever move further away. If your homunculus is destroyed, a piece of your soul is lost and you suffer a–4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Every time you complete a long rest, this penalty lessens by 1. Once you no longer have this penalty, you can craft a new homunculus by spending another 4 workweeks of downtime and 500 gold.

You cannot have more than one homunculus active at a time. Should you begin crafting a new homunculus, the old one collapses into wasted raw materials after you finish one day of progress toward crafting the new one (and you suffer the penalty above, since the old homunculus is destroyed).

name: Crafter
entries: You are adept at crafting things and bargaining with merchants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Tool Proficiency
items.entry: You gain proficiency in an Artisan's Tool of your choice.

items.name: Slapdash
items.entry: When you make or help with a crafting check you can divide the time spent modifier by 2 rounded up. Subtract the time spent modifier from the DC of the check instead of adding it to your own check. If you do, you cannot do so again until after a short rest.

items.name: Recycle
items.entry: When you fail a crafting check there is a 10% chance that your materials are not negatively affected.

name: Crafter
entries: Gain the first two available Tiers of the Crafter feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Crafter Feat:}

name: Creative
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Innovation
entries: Whenever you roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for an ability check, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Double Inspiration
entries: You can have two instances of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} at one time. You can use only one {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} per roll.

name: Creative Threat
entries: You specialize in specific and sometimes unusual methods of Intimidation, using your proficiencies in other skills to amplify the effectiveness of your threats.

When you use a skill such as {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Religion}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Stealth}, or {@skill Deception} to enhance an {@skill Intimidation} check you make, you can choose to use your bonus for that skill in place of your {@skill Intimidation} bonus.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Creative Threat
entries: You specialize in specific and sometimes unusual methods of Intimidation, using your proficiencies in other skills to amplify the effectiveness of your threats.

When you use a skill such as {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Religion}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Stealth}, or {@skill Deception} to enhance an {@skill Intimidation} check you make, you can choose to use your bonus for that skill in place of your {@skill Intimidation} bonus.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Crescent Moons Style

entries.name: Repeatable:
entries: No
You wield cutting wheels with the grace and inevitability of the moons. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use a cutting wheel to make a melee weapon attack, its damage die changes from a {@damage d6} to a {@damage d8}.
You may draw a cutting wheel as part of making a ranged weapon attack.
When you use a cutting wheel to make a ranged weapon attack, its short range increases to 60 feet, and its long range increases to 120 feet.

Any cutting wheel you've made a ranged attack with, whether it is magical or not, returns to you at the end of your turn, regardless of whether you hit or miss, and you can catch it automatically (provided you have a hand free).

name: Cricket Legs*
entries: Your sturdy legs have only improved since coming to the surface, and people like to hear your take on things. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Acrobatics, if you were already proficient your proficiency becomes Expertise.
Your Persuasive Voice is enough for you to gain Advantage on any Persuasion check.

name: Crimson Ritualist
entries: Your study of blood magic and life force has borne fruit, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Blood Lash
entries: You learn the {@spell Blood Bolt|CrookedMoon24} cantrip. Your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Bottled Life
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can perform a 1-minute ritual to transfer some of your life essence into a vessel for later use. Expend a number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and bleed into a vial of water or other liquid. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, a creature can drink the vial to roll the {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} you expended. The creature regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total rolled plus its Constitution modifier. The vial remains potent until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Critter Friend
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with a beast, you can communicate simple ideas with the animal and understand its responses.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Critter Friend
entries: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with a beast, you can communicate simple ideas with the animal and understand its responses.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Crocodile Wrangler
entries: {@i 8th-Level Feat. Repeatable: No.}

entries.name: Bush Wrangler
entries: You gain +1 to your Constitution or Strength score.

entries.name: "What a beauty!"
entries: You have advantage on Animal Handling checks and advantage on checks to grapple beasts.

entries.name: "Crikey!"
entries: Any Large, Medium, or Small beast you are grappling cannot select you as a target for its attacks.

name: Crossbow Expert (Alternate)
entries: You have trained extensively with crossbows and wield them more efficiently than most. You gain the benefits below when using a hand crossbow, light crossbow, or heavy crossbow:

entries.name: Focused
entries: Being within 5 feet of a Hostile creature does not impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attacks.

entries.name: Quick Load
entries: You ignore the restrictions from the Loading property of all crossbows, and you can load ammunition into a crossbow even when you do not have a free hand.

entries.name: Quick Shot
entries: When you take the Attack action and make an attack with a one-handed melee weapon, you can use a bonus action on that turn to make one attack with a hand crossbow.

name: Crossbow Expert
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Ignore Loading
items.entry: You ignore the Loading property.

items.name: Firing in Melee
items.entry: Being within reach of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your Attack Rolls with crossbows, arbelests or hand crossbows.

items.name: Recoil
items.entry: Whenever you make an attack with a crossbow, arbelests or hand crossbow you are pushed 5ft in the opposite direction of the attack.

name: Crossbow Expert
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Crossbow Expert Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Crossbow Expert Feat:}

name: Crossbow Expert
entries: Thanks to extensive practice with the crossbow, you gain the following benefits:

items: You ignore the loading quality of crossbows with which you are proficient.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the {@action Attack} action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a {@item Crossbow, Hand|yastah|hand crossbow} you are holding.

name: Crossbow Focus
entries: Your focused training with crossbows provides you with the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with all types of crossbows.
If you are a small size creature, you can use a heavy crossbow without disadvantage due to your size.
You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with a crossbow.

name: Cruel
entries: The challenges and struggles you've faced throughout your life have left you ruthless in combat, relishing in the pain you inflict.

items: You have a number of cruelty points equal to your proficiency modifier. Once per turn, whenever you deal damage to a creature with an attack, you can spend one cruelty point to deal an additional {@dice 1d6} damage of the attack damage type to that creature.
You can also spend one cruelty point when you score a critical hit against a creature to regain {@dice 1d6} hit points.
While making a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check that involves inflicting pain, you can spend one cruelty point to gain advantage on the roll.
You regain your expended cruelty points when you finish a long rest.

name: Cruel
entries: The challenges and struggles you've faced throughout your life have led you to delight in inflicting pain and anguish upon others. You gain a number of cruelty dice equal to your proficiency bonus. Your cruelty dice are {@dice d6|d6s}. You can roll only one cruelty die per turn, and a cruelty die is spent when you roll it.
You can roll a cruelty die under any of the following circumstances, with the indicated result:

items: When you deal damage to a creature, spend one cruelty die to deal extra damage to the creature equal to the roll.
When you score a critical hit, spend one cruelty die to gain temporary hit points equal to the roll.
When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, spend one cruelty die and add the roll to your check.

entries: You regain all spent cruelty dice when you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.

name: Crusher
entries: You've learned how to crush the bones of foes you grapple, gaining the following benefits:

items: Your unarmed strike uses a {@damage d4} for damage.

You can use your action to force a creature {@condition grappled} by you to make a Strength saving throw. The saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. On a failed save, you deal bludgeoning damage to the creature equal to twice the damage dealt by your unarmed strike.

name: Crusher
entries: When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature are made with advantage until the start of your next turn.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Crusher
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Crusher Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Crusher Feat:}

name: Crushing Grip
entries: The power of your grapple is able to crush the bones of your enemies with ease. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Wisdom score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.

While reared up, you can {@condition grapple} a creature while both of your hands are occupied, using your body to coil around the creature. When you are grappling a creature in this way and get down to your normal size, you let go of the creature and it is no longer {@condition grappled} by you.
On the start of each of their turns, a creature {@condition grappled} by you takes {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage.

name: Crystal Telepathy
entries: You have learned to connect with other minds as easily as you connect ( or once connected) with the Mother Crystai by tapping into your nature as either a being of mind or a being of celestial light. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You don't need to share a language with a creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language. If you have telepathy from another source, the range is doubled, and the target can also respond to you telepathically.

name: Crystal Touched*
entries: The crystal's touch upon your life has made it more difficult for the gods' agents to influence you. You gain the Following Benefits:

items: Since there are still very few Elysians on the surface, surface dwelling creatures have a hard time reading your non-verbal clues. Gain advantage on any Deception checks against any non-Elysian creatures.

Once per day when a divine caster (Clerics/Paladins/Warlocks) cast a spell targeting you, you gain advantage on the save vs their spell or +5 to your AC vs their spell. You also have resistance to any damage taken from the spell.

name: Cult Initiate
entries: Your cult instructs you in eldritch rites, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Two Cantrips
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Warlock spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose the ability when you select this feat).

entries.name: Level 1 Spell
entries: Choose a level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Spell Change
