When you cast {@spell flash|WrathOfTheKaiju} or {@spell wind drake|WrathOfTheKaiju} with this feat, you can expend additional Rampage Points; the level of the spell increases by 1 for each additional point you expend in the casting (maximum 9th-level spell).

name: Gift of the Lion Turtle
entries: Some lion turtles, such as yourself, are blessed with unusual command over their telepathic abilities. Your mastery of this power grants you the following benefits:

items: You can cast the {@spell detect thoughts} and {@spell suggestion} spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast {@spell detect thoughts} or {@spell suggestion} with this feat, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this feat (choose when you select this feat).

name: Gift of the Spider Queen
entries: You have the blessing of the Spider Queen upon you. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain {@sense tremorsense|MM} out to a range of 60 feet.
You can see through magical darkness.

You can cast the {@spell spider climb} spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have.

name: Gilded Skin
entries: The ore that coats your veins is as beautiful as it is tough. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your skin hardens into a gleaming defense. While you aren't wearing armor, you can calculate your AC as 13 + your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

While you aren't wearing armor, you can use your Constitution modifier, instead of Charisma, for ability checks using the Deception, Performance, and Persuasion skills. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

name: Gladiator
entries: Fighting for an audience is your forte, and you maximize the use of more exotic weapons to show off your prowess. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in Performance.

You gain proficiency with nets, and when you use the Attack action and attack with a net, you can use a bonus action to attack with a one-handed weapon you are holding. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your attack rolls with a net, and the escape DC for your nets increases by your proficiency bonus.
You gain proficiency with tridents, and you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a trident.

name: Glassblower
entries: You are an expert in all things glass-related. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item glassblower's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
Identifying the weak point in a glass object only requires a bonus action.

As part of a long rest, you can use glassblower's tools to create or reconstruct a glass object that is no more than 3 feet in any dimension. If you are missing a glass shard needed to reconstruct the object, you can melt down and reshape glass that you already have to create a replacement.

name: Glassblower
entries: You are an expert with {@item Glassblower's Tools|phb}.
Identifying the weak point in a glass object only requires a bonus action.

As part of a long rest, you can use glassblower's tools to create or reconstruct a glass object that is no more than 3 feet in any dimension. If you are missing a glass shard needed to reconstruct the object, you can melt down and reshape glass that you already have to create a replacement.

As part of a long rest, you can create a glass version of simple melee weapon, provided you have enough glass, glassblower's tools, and other supplies on hand. If a 1 is rolled on an attack roll with a glass weapon, it shatters and can no longer be used.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Gleam of Wrath
entries: Your folk have seen many defeats, and many fruitless victories in their wars against the Shadow. The deadly rage that your kindred harbour for the Enemy infuses your weapons with a gleam of chill flame.

items: As a bonus action, you can make a melee weapon that you are wielding emit dim light in a radius equal to its reach until the start of your next turn. The light is sunlight. While the weapon gleams, it also deals radiant damage instead of its normal type.
When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it as extra radiant damage.

name: Glide
entries: You have learned to use magic to glide rather than walk. Lazy, but looks really cool.
You can cast the cantrip {@spell Self Levitation|9F}.

name: Glider Membrane
entries: As a reaction you may use a charge of your shifting armor when you do so:

items: You gain a glider that allows you to reduce your fall speed to 50ft per round
You do not take fall damage
You move 2ft forward per foot you fall to a maximum of 100ft per turn.  Moving in this way does not provoke opportunity attacks

entries: All these effects end when you land.

name: Glima
entries: Glima is the name for a style of unarmed fighting in the North similar to wrestling. When you hit with an unarmed attack against a creature within 5 feet of you, if that creature is one size larger than you or smaller, you can choose to force that creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, the target creature has the {@condition Prone} condition.

name: Glimmering Magic
entries: You aquire a knowledge of the magic of the mystical Flittermarsh, granted through the Archfey patron of your tribe.

items: You learn the {@spell faerie fire|phb} spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot.

You also learn {@spell phantasmal force|phb} and {@spell blink|phb}, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast those two spells in this way when you finish a long rest.
Charisma is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Glued Grip
entries: Like all adventuring mimics, you've altered your natural adhesive to allow you to move about more easily, but even so you've learned to use it selectively while in contact with the ground or when holding an object in your pseudopods. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Strength saving throws against effects that would push or pull you, knock you {@condition prone}, or force an object out of your grip.

name: Golden Child*
entries: You can feel yourself growing closer to decay, but it only makes you more powerful. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Persuasion. If you are already proficient, you gain expertise.
Your Feeding die increases so that it now does 1d6 + CON modifier damage and healing.

name: Golem Upgrade
entries: You have chosen to embrace your golem heritage and redefine yourself as a construct. You can't gain this feat if you have the Vitality Upgrade feat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase two of your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution scores by 1, to a maximum of 20. Decrease your Charisma score by 1.
When you have Adamantine Plating or Juggernaut Plating installed, your AC is 18.
You can't be {@condition poisoned} and magic can't put you to sleep.
You can add your proficiency bonus to any saving throw you make against a spell.

name: Gorgon's Charm
entries: You have learned to use the fear and fascination others feel for your cursed beauty to influence them to your advantage. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion} skill.

When you use your Petrifying Gaze, you can attempt to {@condition charmed||charm} the target instead of attempting to {@condition petrified||petrify} it. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw in place of the normal saving throw. On a failed save, the target is {@condition charmed} by you instead of being {@condition restrained}.

name: Got the Knack of It
entries: You understand magic items like you understand that one stubborn mule:

items: When  you attune to a magic item, you knack it and gain proficiency with that item.
You can only have one knacked item at a time, but can change your knack when you attune to a different item.

name: Gourmand
entries: You have mastered a variety of special recipes, allowing you to prepare exotic dishes with useful effects. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item cook's utensils|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
As an action, you can inspect a drink or plate of food within 5 feet of you and determine whether it is {@condition poisoned}, provided that you can see and smell it.

During a long rest, you can prepare and serve a meal that helps you and your allies recover from the rigors of adventuring, provided you have suitable food, {@item cook's utensils|phb}, and other supplies on hand. The meal serves up to six people, and each person who eats it regains two additional Hit Dice at the end of the long rest. In addition, those who partake of the meal have advantage on Constitution saving throws against disease for the next 24 hours.

name: Grabbing Bite
entries: You have a strong and powerful mouth and neck. When you succeed in hitting a creature of your size or smaller with your Bite attack you may also declare it is {@condition grappled}. You may use this ability against a creature larger than you, but if you do, your move becomes 0 while grappling and you will move along with the grappled creature.

name: Grace of Charity

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Charity, carrying within you the grace of selfless giving and boundless generosity. This manifestation allows you to share your vitality with others, transform excess healing into aid, and restore those around you with increasing efficiency.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Charity
entries: You embody compassion and selfless giving, allowing you to recognize the needs of others and respond with care. You have Advantage on Medicine checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Raphael
entries: Your connection to Raphael grants you an instinctive understanding of healing and the restoration of life. You have Resistance to Force damage.

entries.name: Give Your Love
entries: Your compassion allows you to turn what you have into a gift for others, giving freely without seeking anything in return.

At the start of your turn, you can expend one Hit Die to regain Hit Points equal to the result of the Hit Die plus your primary ability modifier. This does not require an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Give Your Love manifests as an aura of generosity called Aura of Benevolence, extending 10 feet from you.

At the start of their turn, friendly creatures within the aura can expend one Hit Die to regain Hit Points equal to the result of the Hit Die plus your primary ability modifier. This does not require an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: At the start of your turn, you can choose one friendly creature within your Aura of Benevolence to regain Hit Points equal to your level. This does not require an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Benevolence expands to 30 feet.
When healing granted by your Grace restores a creature to its maximum Hit Points, any excess healing can be transferred to another friendly creature within your Aura of Benevolence.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: When you or a friendly creature expends a Hit Die through your Give Your Love to regain Hit Points, the Hit Die is not expended.
Additionally, whenever a Hit Die used through your Give Your Love rolls below half of its maximum value, the result is treated as half of its maximum value instead.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Benevolence expands to 60 feet.
Additionally, the benefits of your Aura persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: At the start of your turn, you can choose a number of friendly creatures within your Aura of Benevolence up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Each chosen creature regains Hit Points equal to your level plus the target's level.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: All healing and recovery provided by you, including healing and recovery granted by Aura of Benevolence, use the maximum result for any dice involved.
Additionally, healing and recovery provided by you cannot be reduced, prevented, or otherwise suppressed by any effect.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: Your Aura of Benevolence expands to 120 feet.
Additionally, at the start of your turn, every friendly creature within your Aura of Benevolence receives the benefits of your Level 13 healing.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Grace Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grace of Chastity

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Chastity, carrying within you the grace of purity, self-control, and an unwavering will. Your presence cleanses harmful influences, protects the minds and bodies of those around you, and allows you to resist forces that seek to corrupt, weaken, or control you.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Chastity
entries: Your pure will allows you to perceive influences that seek to deceive, corrupt, or manipulate you. You have Advantage on Perception checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Gabriel
entries: Your connection to Gabriel grants you resistance against the overwhelming force of the heavenly thunder and the power to remain steadfast against seductive or manipulative voices. You have Resistance to Thunder damage.

entries.name: Keep Your Will
entries: Your unwavering will allows you to cast away harmful influences and preserve your purity even in the presence of corruption.

At the start of your turn, you can remove one harmful effect affecting yourself. The effect can be one disease, curse, condition, or other negative effect currently affecting you. If multiple valid effects are present, the effect removed is determined randomly.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Keep Your Will manifests as an aura of purity called Aura of Purity, extending 10 feet from you.

At the start of their turn, friendly creatures within your Aura of Purity can benefit from your Keep Your Will, allowing one disease, curse, condition, or other negative effect affecting them to be removed. If multiple valid effects are present, the effect removed is determined randomly.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: If there is no harmful effect to remove when Keep Your Will activates, the affected creature instead receives a protective blessing that lasts for 1 round.
The next time the creature would take damage while this blessing lasts, the damage is half and the blessing ends.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Purity expands to 30 feet.
Additionally, when Keep Your Will removes a harmful effect, you can choose which disease, curse, condition, or other negative effect is removed instead of determining it randomly.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: When a friendly creature within your Aura of Purity is about to take damage or is about to be affected by a disease, curse, condition, or other negative effect, you can use your Reaction to protect them.
The creature receives a protective blessing that lasts for 1 round. The next time the creature would take damage while this blessing lasts, the damage is prevented and the blessing ends.
Additionally, you can immediately remove one disease, curse, condition, or other negative effect affecting that creature.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Purity expands to 60 feet.
Additionally, the benefits of your Aura persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: The number of harmful effects that can be removed by Keep Your Will at the start of a turn increases to a number equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Additionally, when you use your Reaction through Keep Your Will, you can remove a number of diseases, curses, conditions, or other negative effects from the protected creature equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: The first time a friendly creature within your Aura of Purity would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it is reduced to 1 Hit Point instead and receives a protective blessing that lasts for 1 round.
The next time the creature would take damage while this blessing lasts, the damage is prevented and the blessing ends.
This benefit can affect each creature only once per Day.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: Your Aura of Purity expands to 120 feet.
Additionally, at the start of your turn, all diseases, curses, Conditions, and other negative effects affecting you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Purity are immediately removed.
If there is no harmful effect to remove when Keep Your Will activates, the affected creature instead receives a protective blessing that lasts for 1 round.
The next time the creature would take damage while this blessing lasts, the damage is prevented and the blessing ends.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Grace Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grace of Diligence

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Diligence, carrying within you the grace of perseverance, devotion, and unwavering effort. Your faith is not passive, but a force born from constant action. The longer you continue to strive, the greater your power becomes.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Diligence
entries: Your unwavering diligence allows you to remain focused even when your efforts do not immediately succeed. You have Advantage on Investigation checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Raguel
entries: Your connection to Raguel grants you the strength to endure the trials that stand before you. You have Resistance to Lightning damage.

entries.name: Push Your Faith
entries: Your faith grows through constant action. Whenever you make an Attack Roll or force an enemy to make a Saving Throw, you gain 1 Faith for each individual Attack Roll made or each creature forced to make a Saving Throw.
For example, an Attack made with Extra Attack grants 1 Faith for each Attack Roll, while a spell such as Fireball that forces 3 creatures to make Saving Throws grants 3 Faith.

Your Faith is shared among you and all friendly creatures benefiting from Push Your Faith. If no creature benefiting from Push Your Faith makes an Attack Roll or forces an enemy to make a Saving Throw for 1 full round, all accumulated Faith is lost and all effects granted by Faith end.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Push Your Faith manifests as an aura of shared devotion called Aura of Faith, extending 10 feet from you.
Friendly creatures within the aura gain the benefits of Push Your Faith and contribute to the shared Faith pool.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: When the shared Faith reaches 7 points, attacks made by you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith have Advantage.

Additionally, when you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Faith forces an enemy to make a Saving Throw against an ability or spell that deals damage, that Saving Throw is made with Disadvantage.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Faith expands to 30 feet.
Additionally, you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith can change the damage type of an attack, spell, or ability to another damage type available to that attack, spell, or ability.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: When the shared Faith reaches 17 points, damage dealt by you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith ignores Resistance.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Faith expands to 60 feet.
Additionally, the benefits of your Aura persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: When the shared Faith reaches 37 points, attacks made by you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith are automatically Critical Hits.
Additionally, creatures automatically fail Saving Throws against your and your friendly creatures' abilities that deal damage.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: When the shared Faith reaches 57 points, all damage dice rolled by you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith are treated as having rolled their maximum values.
Additionally, damage dealt by you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith ignores Immunity.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: Your Aura of Faith expands to 120 feet.

When the shared Faith reaches 77 points, you and friendly creatures within your Aura of Faith gain 1 additional Action, 1 additional Bonus Action, and 1 additional Reaction when they begin their turns.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Faith reaches its complete manifestation. Your Faith and all effects granted by Push Your Faith cannot be reduced, removed, suppressed, countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grace of Gratitude

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Gratitude, carrying within you the grace of thankfulness, appreciation, and the sacred act of returning the blessings you receive. Your soul transforms every gift bestowed upon you into a greater blessing, allowing the grace of others to flourish and be shared with those around you.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Gratitude
entries: Your grateful spirit allows you to express the blessings you receive through art, presence, and heartfelt expression. You have Advantage on Performance checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Zadkiel
entries: Your connection to Zadkiel grants your soul the serenity to endure the cold and preserve the blessings entrusted to you. You have Resistance to Cold damage.

entries.name: Share Your Grace
entries: The blessings bestowed upon you by others become greater within your soul. Whenever another creature grants you Healing or Temporary Hit Points, the amount you receive is increased by half, rounded up, to a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Share Your Grace manifests as an aura of shared blessings called Aura of Appreciation, extending 10 feet from you.
Friendly creatures within the aura gain the benefits of Share Your Grace.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Appreciation has Advantage granted by another creature, you roll three dice instead of two and use the highest result.

Additionally, whenever another creature grants you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Appreciation dice from an ability or beneficial effect, the number of dice granted is increased by half, rounded up, to a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Appreciation expands to 30 feet.
Additionally, the duration of abilities and beneficial effects granted by other creatures to you or friendly creatures within the aura is doubled.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: Healing, Temporary Hit Points, and dice granted to you or friendly creatures within your Aura of Appreciation by another creature are doubled.
Additionally, dice granted to you or friendly creatures within your Aura of Appreciation by another creature receive one additional die of the same type.
This replaces the increases granted by Share Your Grace at 1st and 5th level; these benefits do not stack.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Appreciation expands to 60 feet.
Additionally, the benefits of your Aura persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: The first time each round that you receive an ability, beneficial effect, Healing, or Temporary Hit Points from another creature, you can choose one friendly creature within your Aura of Appreciation. That creature receives the same result.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Appreciation grants another creature an ability, beneficial effect, Healing, or Temporary Hit Points, the creature granting the effect also receives the same benefit.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: Your Aura of Appreciation expands to 120 feet.

The first time each round that you receive an ability, beneficial effect, Healing, or Temporary Hit Points from another creature, that creature can share the same result with every friendly creature within your Aura of Appreciation.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Grace Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, suppressed, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grace of Humility

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Humility, carrying within you the grace and selflessness of the Heavenly Host. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, a calming presence, and the ability to accept even the greatest burden without allowing it to define your worth.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Humility
entries: You embody humility, free from the arrogance that blinds the heart. You see others without the distortion of pride, allowing you to perceive their true intentions. You have Advantage on Insight checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Michael
entries: Your spirit does not seek to place itself above others. You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

entries.name: Know Your Worth
entries: Your sense of self does not depend on the approval, fear, or influence of others.

If affected by the Charmed or Frightened conditions, you suffer none of the negative effects of those Conditions, and other creatures gain none of the benefits those Conditions would normally grant against you.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Know Your Worth manifests as a quiet and reassuring aura called Aura of Assurance, extending 10 feet from you.
You and friendly creatures within the aura gain the benefits of Know Your Worth.
If creatures benefiting from Aura of Assurance, Their Speed cannot be reduced.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: If you or friendly creatures in Aura gain the Grappled Prone or poisoned condition, they suffer none of the negative effects of those Conditions, and other creatures gain none of the benefits those Conditions would normally grant against them.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Assurance expands to 30 feet.

If you or friendly creatures in Aura gain the Blinded, Deafened, or Diseased condition, they suffer none of the negative effects of those Conditions, and other creatures gain none of the benefits those Conditions would normally grant against them.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: If you or friendly creatures in Aura gain the Incapacitated, Restrained, or Petrified condition, they suffer none of the negative effects of those Conditions, and other creatures gain none of the benefits those Conditions would normally grant against them.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Assurance expands to 60 feet.
The benefits of Aura of Assurance persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: If you or friendly creatures in Aura gain the Stunned, Paralyzed, or Unconscious condition, they suffer none of the negative effects of those Conditions, and other creatures gain none of the benefits those Conditions would normally grant against them, this benefit does not apply to Unconscious caused by their Hit Points being reduced to 0.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: If you or friendly creatures in Aura of Assurance gain any Condition or Exhaustion, they suffer none of the negative effects of those Conditions or Exhaustion, and other creatures gain none of the benefits those Conditions would normally grant against them.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: you or friendly creatures in Aura cannot die solely as a result of having 0 Hit Points.
A creature can still die if its body is completely destroyed or an effect explicitly destroys its body.
Additionally, Aura of Assurance expands to 120 feet.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Grace Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grace of Patience

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Patience, carrying within you the grace of endurance, steadfastness, and unwavering hope. This manifestation allows you to withstand adversity, protect yourself and others through perseverance, and turn suffering into the strength to endure.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Patience
entries: Your patience allows you to remain calm and understanding even in the presence of creatures that are difficult to approach. You have Advantage on Animal Handling checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Remiel
entries: Your connection to Remiel grants you the endurance to withstand even the fiercest flames. You have Resistance to Fire damage.

entries.name: Hold Your Hope
entries: You gain a bonus to AC equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Hold Your Hope manifests as an aura of perseverance called Aura of Hope, extending 10 feet from you.
Friendly creatures within the aura gain the benefits of Hold Your Hope.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: At the end of your turn, if you are within your Aura of Hope, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half the Hit Points you have lost, plus your primary ability modifier. You gain at least 1 Temporary Hit Point.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Hope expands to 30 feet.

Additionally, when you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Hope gains Temporary Hit Points while already having Temporary Hit Points, the existing Temporary Hit Points are converted into Hit Points before the new Temporary Hit Points are gained.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: You and friendly creatures within your Aura of Hope gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Hope expands to 60 feet.
Additionally, the benefits of your Aura persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: The Temporary Hit Points granted by your Grace at the end of your turn are equal to the number of Hit Points you have lost, plus your primary ability modifier.

Additionally, when you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Hope has maximum Hit Points, any remaining Temporary Hit Points can be combined with the new Temporary Hit Points granted by your Grace to form a new pool of Temporary Hit Points.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: While you or friendly creatures have Temporary Hit Points, you cannot be subjected to a Critical Hit.
Additionally, if an instance of damage you take exceeds your remaining Temporary Hit Points, the excess damage does not reduce your Hit Points.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: The first time you or friendly creature within your Aura of Hope becomes Bloodied, it immediately gains Temporary Hit Points equal to its maximum Hit Points.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Grace Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grace of Temperance

prerequisite.other: You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat

entries: You embody the essence of Temperance, carrying within you the grace of self-control, restraint, and spiritual fortitude. Your soul learns from every hardship, adapting to the forces that seek to overwhelm it until even the greatest dangers can no longer break your resolve.
You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Blessed Soul
entries: You gain the Celestial Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

entries.name: Heavenly Faith
entries: Your connection to the Heavenly Host grants you a deep understanding of divine teachings, celestial beings, sacred rites, and the nature of faith. You have Advantage on Religion checks.

entries.name: Manifestation of Temperance
entries: Your mastery over yourself allows you to maintain perfect control of your body, balance, and movements. You have Advantage on Acrobatics checks.

entries.name: Avatar of Uriel
entries: Your connection to Uriel grants your soul the strength to endure forces that seek to erode and consume it. You have Resistance to Acid damage.

entries.name: Guard Your Soul
entries: Your disciplined soul instinctively protects you from harm. Whenever you take damage, you can reduce that damage by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times per round equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

entries.name: Level 3
entries: Your Guard Your Soul manifests as an aura of spiritual protection called Aura of Equilibrium, extending 10 feet from you.
Friendly creatures within the aura gain the benefits of Guard Your Soul.

entries.name: Level 5
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Equilibrium take damage of a damage type, you gain Resistance to that damage type for 1 minute.

entries.name: Level 7
entries: Your Aura of Equilibrium expands to 30 feet.
Additionally, the amount of damage reduced by Guard Your Soul increases by your primary ability modifier.

entries.name: Level 9
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Equilibrium recover from a Condition, Disease, or Curse, you gain Immunity to that specific Condition, Disease, or Curse for 1 minute.

entries.name: Level 11
entries: Your Aura of Equilibrium expands to 60 feet.
Additionally, the benefits of your Aura persist for 1 round after a creature leaves the aura.

entries.name: Level 13
entries: The first time each round that you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Equilibrium takes damage, that damage is reduced by half.

entries.name: Level 15
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Equilibrium takes damage, the damage is divided equally among you and all friendly creatures within the aura.

entries.name: Level 17
entries: Your Aura of Equilibrium expands to 120 feet.
Whenever you or a friendly creature within your Aura of Equilibrium take damage of a damage type, you gain Immunity to that damage type for 1 minute.

entries.name: Level 19
entries: Your Grace Feat cannot be countered, interrupted, suppressed, or otherwise prevented by any spell, feature, ability, or other effect.

name: Grafted Motor Functions
entries: You have adapted to regular use of your extra limb. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your Bonegraft feature allows for an additional arm with no penalty. For example, if your Dexterity modifier was reduced for every arm after your third, it's now reduced for every arm after your fourth.

entries: Choose one of the following:

items: You can take the Use an Object action as a bonus action.
You gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.
If two or more of your arms are wielding weaponry, you can benefit from a shield.
You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must either choose a different benefit from the list above or increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

name: Grafter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Extra Slots
entries: You have two Arm graft slots and two Internal graft slots. You can install a graft in each of them.

entries.name: Machine Precision
entries: When you miss with a weapon that is installed as a graft, such as an {@item Arm Cannon|DarkMatter24} or {@item Embedded Weapon|DarkMatter24}, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add it to the roll, potentially turning the miss into a hit. You can use this benefit only once per turn, you can use it a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Painless Attachment
entries: You don't lose {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} for the first installation of a graft in a particular body slot.

entries.name: Quick Installation
entries: You can take the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to install a Construct graft on your body.

name: Graftling Avoidance
entries: Through constant vigil you have become better at sensing danger. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain the Marrowsense ability. If you already have the ability, you may use it twice between short rests.

{@bold Marrowsense.} You have a nose for bone. As a bonus action, until the end of your next turn, you can use this ability to detect the location and creature type of unexposed bone within 30 feet and exposed bone within 60 feet. {@italic This ability can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, 3 feet of wood, or 7 feet of dirt. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.}

name: Graftling Discharge
entries: You have evolved to use your noxious digestive fluid as a defense mechanism. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use your action to expel a spray of acid in a 5 by 30 ft. line. Each creature must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier). A creature takes 2d6 acid damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level. Once you use your discharge, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
You have resistance to acid damage.

name: Grand Breed
entries: Your legs grow stronger from hard training and extended use. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.
The damage die for your hooves increases to a {@damage d6}, and your hooves count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

name: Grand Breed
entries: Your legs grow stronger from hard training and extended use. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.
When you take the {@action Dash} action on your turn, creature's can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
The damage die for your hooves increases to a {@dice d6}, and your hooves count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

name: Grappler
entries: You master grappling and leverage to pin and fling your foes. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Quick Grabs.} When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one unarmed strike or attempt to {@action Grapple} as a bonus action.
Gain the {@b Martial Toss} special attack (below).

entries.name: Martial Toss
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack)}

When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to attempt to hurl a creature of your size or smaller. The target must make a Strength saving throw. An object or creature you are grappling automatically fails. If you successfully lift them, you can throw them 20 feet. The range is increased by 10 feet for each size smaller than you the target is.

The creature's movement ends early if it collides with another creature or obstacle. The thrown creature and anything it collides with takes {@damage 2d6} + your Strength modifier, and the thrown creature falls prone. The number of d6 increases by one when your proficiency bonus increases (with the total number of d6 equaling your proficiency bonus).
A creature can choose to fail their save against this ability. You can throw a willing creature more carefully, dealing no damage to them unless they collide with something during their flight.
Once you use this feature to successfully throw a creature or object, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Grappler
entries: You master grappling and leverage to pin and fling your foes.

items: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

entries.name: Martial Toss
entries: As an action, you attempt to lift a creature or object your size or smaller within reach. The target must make a Strength saving throw. An object or creature you are grappling automatically fails. If you successfully lift them, you can move 5 feet in direction and throw them an additional 15 feet in the direction moved as part of the same action.

The creature's movement ends early if it collides with another creature or obstacle. The thrown creature and anything it collides with takes 2d8 + your Strength modifier and falls prone, unless it collides with something larger than it, in which case only the thrown creature falls prone. The number of d8 increases by one when your proficiency bonus increases (with the total number of d8 equaling your proficiency bonus).
After throwing the object or creature, you can make one weapon attack or grapple as a bonus action before the end of your turn.
Once you use this feature to successfully throw a creature or object, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Grappler
entries: You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

You can use {@homebrew one of your attacks from the {@action Attack} action|your action} to try to pin a creature {@condition grappled} by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, {@homebrew the creature is {@condition restrained} and your speed becomes 0|you and the creature are both {@condition restrained}} until the grapple ends.

name: Grappler
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Grappler Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Grappler Feat:}

name: Grappler
entries: You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

Pin: You can use your action to try to pin a creature {@condition grappled} by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.

Opportunity grapple: You can use a reaction when someone attacks you with a light or finesse weapon and you have one free hand to make a grapple check at disadvantage. If you succeed, you grapple the target and manage to avoid all damage from the attack that you reacted to, otherwise, the attack you reacted to becomes a critical hit.

Body-Shield: When you have a creature restrained you can use half your movement to instead reposition them around you rather then dragging them in one direction. by doing so you can make them give you cover from oncoming ranged attacks from that direction. 1/2 cover if they are the same size as you or 3/4 cover if they are a size bigger then you or more.

name: Grave Keeper
entries: Studying funeral rites and tending the dead's rest has made you a conduit between the worlds of the living and the dead. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Divine Channel
entries: You gain one use of the Channel Divinity feature from the Cleric class, and you can create the Turn Undead effect with it. If you already have Channel Divinity, you add this use to the feature from one class of your choice. Your save DC for this benefit is 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Last Rites
entries: You can enact a 10-minute ritual to prepare the corpse of a Medium or smaller creature, expending at least 10 GP worth of incense, oils, linen wraps, or similar trappings. The prepared corpse can't become Undead.

name: Gravitational Spell Adept
entries: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the {@book gravitational spell list|TTAtPoG|7}.
In addition, choose 2 1st-level spells from the {@book gravitational spell list|TTAtPoG|7}.

You can cast one of the chosen spells once, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast either in this way again. The level at which it is cast is equal to your level divided by 6 (rounded up).
Your spellcasting ability for these spells is either Charisma, Wisdom, or Intelligence (your choice).

name: Grax's Guy

reprintedAs.uid: Grax's Guys for Cheap: Grax's Guy|DarkMatter24

prerequisite.other: Member of Grax's Guys for Cheap

entries: Grax's Guys are known for being tough, adaptable, and able to get the job done; you're no different. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with one weapon or tool of your choice.
You can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

name: Grax's Guys for Cheap: Grax's Guy
entries: Grax's Guys are known for being tough and dependable. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Plucky
entries: When you roll a 1 the {@dice d20} for a saving throw, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. You can't use this {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} to reroll the triggering save.

entries.name: Work Experience
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill and one tool of your choice. You also learn one language of your choice.

entries.name: Faction Feats
entries: Veteran adventurers are likely to make enemies across the 'Verse, but if they're lucky, they might forge some alliances too. The greatest of these alliances are likely to be with factions, which provide work, services, and connections to spacers everywhere. Factions in Dark Matter are detailed in Chapter 1: The 'Verse.

Of course, such allies don't come free. Factions generally also require work and commitment from their members, which might come in the form of small tasks, important favors for higher ranking members, or even regular obligations for the organization. For their efforts, adventurers gain specific and useful skills from their factions, as represented by Faction feats.

entries.name: Gaining a Faction Feat
entries: The GM can award you a Faction feat for joining a faction or completing a quest for one. If allegiance to a faction is important to your backstory, the GM can also replace the feat granted by your background with an appropriate Faction feat.

name: Great Beast Killer
entries: You may replace a melee attack with an attempt to climb onto a creature at least one size category larger than you. To do so you expend half your movement and make a acrobatics or athletics check (your  choice) DC 12 + 2 times the number of size categories the creature is larger than you.

items: While you are atop a creature in this way you have advantage on attack rolls with one handed and versital weapons.

The creature may as an action attempt to shake you off you must make a DC 15 + the creatures strength modifier otherwise you are thrown a number of feet equal to 5 times the creatures strength modifier of the creature (minimum of 5 feet) in a lateral direction of the DM's choice.
If you land a critical hit while atop the creature in this way the creature is knocked prone and is incapacitated until the end of it's next turn.
Once you have climbed atop a creature using this feature you may not do so again until innovative is rolled again

name: Great Cleave
entries: When you attack with a {@item longsword|PHB}, {@item battleaxe|PHB}, {@item greatsword|PHB} or {@item greataxe|PHB}, which is being wielded in two hands, you may choose to target two adjacent creatures within 5 feet of you with a single attack. This attack uses the same attack and damage roll for both targets and if you hit both targets, you choose how much of the damage to apply to each.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Great Cleave
entries: When you attack with a {@item longsword|PHB}, {@item battleaxe|PHB}, {@item greatsword|PHB} or {@item greataxe|PHB}, which is being wielded in two hands, you may choose to target two adjacent creatures within 5 feet of you with a special melee attack. This attack uses the same attack and damage roll for both targets and if you hit both targets, you choose how much of the damage to apply to each.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Great Sage
entries: Your mind is fully attuned with your magic, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Deep Concentration
items.entry: Before you take damage you can choose to add your proficiency bonus to a saving throw to maintain concentration that you make as a result of that damage. If you do and fail, you cannot use this again until you finish a short rest.

items.name: Vast Memory
items.entry: Learn a number of level 1+ spells equal to your proficiency bonus. They must be spells you can already learn from your spellcasting features. You can replace one of the spells with a different one whenever you level up.

name: Great Weapon Adept
entries: You've mastered the art of using a weapon's weight to your advantage by using its momentum to strengthen your attacks. You gain the following benefits:

items: Once on each of your turns when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can immediately make one melee weapon attack (no action required).

Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a −5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage. You cannot do so if the attack is made with the opposite end of your weapon.

entries: {@note {@b Design Note:} This optional feat replaces {@feat Great Weapon Master|PHB|the feat with a similar name}, balancing player options introduced in Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt.}

name: Great Weapon Master (Alternate)
entries: You have honed your skills with massive weapons to overwhelm your foes. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Forceful Strikes
entries: Whenever you hit a creature equal to your size or smaller with a Heavy melee weapon attack you can knock it back 5 feet away from you in a line along the ground, so long as the space it would be forced into is unoccupied.

entries.name: Ruthless Warrior
entries: If you reduce a creature to 0 hit points or score a critical hit with a Heavy melee weapon, you can make an attack with that Heavy weapon as your bonus action on that same turn.

name: Great Weapon Master
entries: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits while wielding a heavy weapon:

items: When you miss an attack with the weapon without having disadvantage on the attack roll, you can use your reaction to repeat the attack against the same target using the momentum of your previous swing.

When you hit with an opportunity attack using the weapon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked {@condition prone}. The save succeeds automatically if the target is more than one size larger than you.
On your turn, when you score a critical hit with the weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee attack with the weapon as a bonus action.

name: Great Weapon Master
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Great Weapon Master Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Great Weapon Master Feat:}

name: Great Weapon Master
entries: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits:

items: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

name: Greater (un)Holy Tattoo

prerequisite.other: Tattoo, {@feat Improved (Un)Holy Tattoo|INK}, Divine Caster, Level 12

entries: Your tattooed holy symbol is a font of divine power.
{@b Benefit}:

items: Caster's Spell and Ability Save DC for Paladin/Cleric DC increases by an additional +1 (+2 Total)
Using a tattoo grants a +3 AC and +2 to saves until the beginning of your next turn, as you flare with a holy vigor. You also gain 8hp (Does not stack)
Gain 1 additional uses of divine smite.
Spells gain +1 per die (ie. +1 per day of healing; +1 per die of damage)

name: Greater Blessing of Baldur
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Divine Resilience
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one damage type of your choice. This {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Boreas
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold-Forged
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage. Additionally, you can summon a shield of cold to block fire-based effects. As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, when you would take Fire damage, you can gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Greater Blessing of Freyr and Freyja
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Healing Magic
entries: You always have the {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without using a spell slot a number of times per day equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability you chose when you took the Blessing of Freyr and Freyja feat. When you cast the spell on a Beast or Plant creature, the amount healed is doubled.

name: Greater Blessing of Jormungandr
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Serpent's Aspect
entries: You can channel the fear inspired by serpents and dragons. You can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to force a number of creatures of your choice equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} within 30 feet of you that can see you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a target has the {@condition Frightened} condition for 1 minute. Such a creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Loki
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lord of Lies
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) checks.

entries.name: Mask Magic
entries: You always have the {@spell Alter Self|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the one you chose when you took the Blessing of Loki feat.

name: Greater Blessing of Sif
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Sif's Arrow
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can channel the power of the god Sif for 1 minute. During that time, when you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you deal extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can deal this extra damage no more than once on each of your turns. You can channel Sif's power in this way a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Thor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Storm Strike
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can channel the power of the god Thor for 1 minute. During that time, when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal extra damage of the weapon's type equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can deal this extra damage no more than once on each of your turns. You can channel Thor's power in this way a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Blessing of Wotan
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lore Master
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} when rolling checks for the skill you selected for your Lore Bound trait from the Blessing of Wotan feat.

entries.name: Magical Foresight
entries: You always have the {@spell Augury|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without expending a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability you chose when you took the Blessing of Wotan feat.

name: Greater Companion
entries: You learn the {@spell find familiar} spell, and may cast it once without using a spell slot or material components, after which you must finish a long rest to do so again.
When you cast this spell this way, it has the following modifications:

items: The summoned creature can be any beast with a CR of 1/4 or lower;
As a bonus action on your turn, you may command the summoned creature to take the {@action Attack} action.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} and {@spell Animal Messenger|XPHB} spells but only as Rituals. You can cast the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saving throws for 1 minute.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} or as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you are hit by an attack roll, you can expend 1 Blood Point to double your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and gain a +3 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast the {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} and {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spells. You can cast either spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Constitution saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. You can't use this feat if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
While entirely in {@spell Darkness|XPHB}, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition to any creature that relies on {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} to see you in that {@spell Darkness|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to empower your strikes for 1 minute. When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} Force damage. In addition, you deal double damage to objects and structures.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.

You expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Fear|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}, and creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against the spell.

name: Greater Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: Your talents with the vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline have improved. You gain the following benefits.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to deal an extra {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage to a target you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} for 1 minute.

name: Greater Dragonmark
entries: Your dragonmark has grown in size and power. This enhances your existing dragonmark, and the benefits are based on the mark that you already possess. A greater dragonmark provides the following benefits:

items: The die type of your dragonmarked Intuition Die increases by one (for example, from a {@dice d4} to a {@dice d6}).
Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. The abilities available to you are based on your mark, as shown on the Greater Dragonmark Benefits table.

You learn a set of spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot or using a material component. The list of spells, the spellcasting ability for them, and the type of rest you must complete to regain the use of these spells are shown on the Greater Dragonmark Benefits table.

entries.caption: Greater Dragonmark Benefits
rows: {@race half-orc (mark of finding)|ERLW|Find}{@race human (mark of finding)|ERLW|ing}
{@spell Knock}, {@spell Glyph of Warding}, {@spell Leomund's Secret Chest}*
footnotes: *To cast {@spell Leomund's secret chest} using this feat and the {@race dwarf (mark of warding)|ERLW|Mark of Warding}, you must have a {@item Siberys dragonshard|ERLW} with a value of at least 100 gp. While you have this dragonshard in hand, it serves as the spell's focus, and you can use it to summon and dismiss the chest.

name: Greater Familiar*
entries: Your familiar can be any medium, small or tiny beast with a CR of 1 or lower.
You can use your reaction to cast the spells Shield or Absorb Elements when your familiar is attacked if you already know these spells.

name: Greater Favored Enemy
entries: Chose one creature type that you selected from the {@feat Favored Enemy|Adventurer} feat. Your bonus to damage rolls against creatures of the chosen type increases to +4. Additionally, you have advantage on saving throws against the spells and abilities used by creatures of the chosen type. If you have the {@feat Improved Beast Shape|Adventurer} ability, you also gain the ability to transform into creatures of the chosen type, following all other restrictions of {@feat Improved Beast Shape|Adventurer}.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different favored enemy type.

name: Greater Magical Bond
entries: Adventurers who spend enough time with their familiars as companions find certain loopholes in the find familiar spell's function, allowing their companion even greater strength.

items: Your familiar can take the attack action on its turn.
You can dismiss or summon your familiar as a bonus action.

name: Greater Magical Bond
entries: Adventurers who spend enough time with their familiars as companions find certain loopholes in the find familiar spell's function, allowing their companion even greater strength.

items: Your familiar can take the attack action on its turn.
You can dismiss or summon your familiar as a bonus action.

name: Greater Mark of Handling
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Wild Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Handling|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Handling
entries: While you are mounted, immediately after you hit a target within 5 feet of your mount with a melee attack roll, your mount can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} or take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action to make one attack only (your choice).

entries.name: Subdue Animal
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you exert command over one Beast or Monstrosity you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Mark of Healing
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Medical Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Healing|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Healing
entries: You can now use the Healing Touch benefit of your {@feat Mark of Healing|BakerKanon} feat to cast {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} without using a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Additionally, when you cast {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and roll dice to determine the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a roll as a 3.

name: Greater Mark of Hospitality
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Ever Hospitable benefit of your {@feat Mark of Hospitality|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Hospitality
entries: When you cast {@spell Purify Food and Drink|XPHB}, you can modify the spell so that instead of its normal effect, each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you is refreshed. Each affected creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level is reduced by 1, and the creature gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this feat). Once you modify the spell with this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Mark of Making
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Artisan's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Making|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Making
entries: When you use the Spellsmith benefit of your {@feat Mark of Making|BakerKanon} feat to cast {@spell Magic Weapon|XPHB} without a spell slot, you cast the spell as its level 3 version.

name: Greater Mark of Passage
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Intuitive Motion benefit of your {@feat Mark of Passage|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Passage
entries: When you use the Magical Passage benefit of your {@feat Mark of Passage|BakerKanon} feat to cast {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} without a spell slot, you can also choose up to two willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself before you teleport. Each target can then take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to also teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Greater Mark of Scribing
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Gifted Scribe benefit of your {@feat Mark of Scribing|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Inspired Scribing
entries: When you cast {@spell Comprehend Languages|XPHB}, you can modify the spell to encompass up to three willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Each chosen creature also gains the benefits of the spell for the duration. In addition, for the duration of the spell, you and the chosen creatures can communicate telepathically with each other while within 1 mile of each other. Once you modify the spell with this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Greater Mark of Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Sentinel's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Sentinel|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Sentinel
entries: When you use the Vigilant Guardian benefit of your {@feat Mark of Sentinel|BakerKanon} feat, you can also make one attack with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} as part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

name: Greater Mark of Shadow
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Cunning Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Shadow|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Shadow
entries: When you use the Shape Shadows benefit of your {@feat Mark of Shadow|BakerKanon} feat to cast {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} without a spell slot, you cast the spell as its level 3 version.

name: Greater Mark of Warding
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improved Intuition
entries: When you use the Warder's Intuition benefit of your {@feat Mark of Warding|BakerKanon} feat, you can roll {@dice 1d6} instead of {@dice 1d4}.

entries.name: Improved Warding
entries: When a creature makes an attack roll against you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on that roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Green Skin
entries: Your people metabolize by basking in the sunlight, aided by your tough, photosynthetic skin, which grants you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned} and have resistance to poison damage.
While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 12 + your Dexterity modifier.

name: Green-Skin
entries: Your people metabolize by basking in the sunlight, aided by your tough, photosynthetic skin, which grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: Your skin acts as a tough natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 13 plus your Dexterity modifier. You can use a {@item Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

entries.name: Photosynthetic Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Poison Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage.

name: Greensinger Initiate
entries: You have learned a certain number of secrets and techniques of the Greensinger druidic order. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Greensinger's Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Performance|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Fey Dancer
entries: Whenever you cause a creature to gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, you can join them in dance and revelry. If you do so, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entries.name: Fey Affinity
entries: Your spells and magical abilities that affect Humanoids also affect Fey.

entries.name: Greensinger Spells
entries: The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Greensinger Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Greenskin
entries: Your people metabolize by basking in the sunlight. Aided by your tough, photosynthetic skin, you gain the following racial traits:

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: Your skin acts as a tough natural armor. When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 12 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

entries.name: Photosynthetic Resilience
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition poisoned} condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

name: Grendel
entries: The children of goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears with humans are known as grendels. Despite their varied heritage, grendels don't quite resemble either of their parents, with green or orange-tanned skin, coarse hair, and three knuckles on each finger.

entries.name: Size
entries: Unlike other humans, you are Medium or Small, depending on your heritage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

entries.name: Grendel Ambition
entries: On your first turn in combat, you can add your proficiency bonus to your attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

name: Grim Harvest

prerequisite.other: {@feat Spellbook|Adventurer} (School of Necromancy) or {@feat Acolyte: Grave|Adventurer}, 2nd Level

entries: You gain the ability to reap life energy from creatures you kill with your spells. Once per turn when you kill one or more creatures with a spell of 1st level or higher, you regain hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times its level if the spell belongs to the School of Necromancy. You don't gain this benefit for killing constructs or undead.

name: Grit of the Earth
entries: You exemplify the natural hardiness of Earth Ponies

items: You take no ill effects from one level of exhaustion
Choose one damage type from Slashing, piercing or bludgeoning. You now resist damage from that type.
You can reroll a saving throw after you roll but before the results are called. Once you use this feature you must finish a long rest before you can do it again.
