You have advantage on saving throws made to resist or remove Fear and Madness effects.
While you are at or below half of your hit point maximum, you add half of your proficiency bonus to any saving throws you are not already proficient in.

name: Grizzled
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Overcome
entries: Whenever you make a saving throw against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you gain a bonus to the saving throw equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Survive
entries: You require half as much food and water to survive, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to forage for food and water.

entries.name: Withstand
entries: Immediately after you take damage that causes you to be {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. You can't gain this benefit again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Grizzled
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Overcome
entries: Whenever you make a saving throw against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you gain a bonus to the saving throw equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Survive
entries: You require half as much food and water to survive, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to forage for food and water.

entries.name: Withstand
entries: Whenever you become {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

name: Grotesque tattoo

prerequisite.other: Tattoo, may NOT have {@feat Sexy Tattoo|INK}

entries: Your tattoos are especially frightening and intimidating.
{@b Benefit}:

items: Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20
You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it
Gain advantage to Intimidation checks when the tatto is clearly visibile.

entries: {@b Note}: A character cannot have the Sexy Tattoo feat if they have the Grotesque Tattoo feat.

name: Group Combatant
entries: You've honed your fighting skills and are just as comfortable fighting a group of enemies as you are facing a combatant one on one. You gain the following benefits:

items: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1.
Creatures don't gain advantage on attacks made against you using the optional flanking rules.
After you provoke an opportunity attack on your turn, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Growth Spurt
entries: One day you awaken to find yourself much larger than you were before. Gain the following benefits:

items: You grow to Large size, losing the Powerful Build feature if you have it.
You can use Large weapons, but when you do you cannot use the Extra Attack class feature.
You gain a natural weapon that deals 1d8 damage of a type appropriate to your race. If you already have a natural weapon, its damage increases to 1d8.

name: Grue
entries: One of your parents was a creature of darkness, such as a shadow or a native to the Plane of Shadow. Grues such as yourself have blackened skin and cast a shadow in all directions, even when directly in light. In shadows, you are nearly {@condition invisible}. You have the following racial traits:

items: You have {@sense darkvision}, the ability to see in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can reattempt your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to hide. On a success, you silently reposition yourself, and the creature does not notice you. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Grue
entries: One of your parents was a creature of darkness, such as a shadow or a native to the Plane of Shadow. Grues such as yourself have blackened skin and cast a shadow in all directions, even when directly in light. In shadows, you are nearly {@condition invisible}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Covert
entries: When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check, you can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to quickly conceal yourself. If your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) roll beats the creature's Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check, you silently reposition yourself and the creature doesn't notice you. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Swirl of Shadows
entries: When you reach character level 5, you can cloak yourself in perfect darkness. You can cast the {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} spell on yourself without a spell slot while you are entirely within {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. The spell ends early if you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition or you end your turn in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Grue
entries: One of your parents was a creature of darkness, such as a shadow or a native of the Plane of Shadow. Grues, such as yourself, have blackened skin and cast a shadow in all directions, even when directly in light. In shadows, you are nearly {@condition invisible}. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Covert
entries: When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can reattempt your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check to hide. On a success, you silently reposition yourself and the creature doesn't notice you.
Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Grung Tied
entries: Through a combination of herbal tonics and ritual magic, your grung physiology evolves, and you are considered one caste level higher amongst other grungs. You gain the following benefits:

items: You ignore the effects of your Water Dependency trait. Instead, you count as one size larger when determining how much water you must consume in a day.

As an action, you can make a chirring noise to which other grungs are immune. Each creature within 10 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Guard Dog
entries: You are gifted at reacting to attacks on your companions. If an ally is hit by an attack within five feet of you, you may use your reaction to make an attack against the attacker.

items.name: Impenetrable
items.entry: When you use a reaction granted by a shield you can regain your expended reaction. If you do, you cannot do so again until the start of your next turn. It must be a reaction you haven't used this turn and you cannot use it again this turn.

items.name: Swap
items.entry: When you would normally draw or stow a weapon, you can instead swap (stow then draw) one shield you're holding with another shield on your person.

name: Guardian
entries: Your body developed a seemingly spontaneous mutation, likely brought upon your body's genetic alterations. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain an additional Animal Enhancement of your choice. Alternatively, you may instead choose one of the following spells: {@spell barkskin}, {@spell protection from poison}, {@spell speak with animals}, or {@spell spider climb}. You may cast the chosen spell on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Guardian of the Seas*
entries: Bael wishes he was as good at swimming as you are, but he's dead after siding with Martyn. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are swimming, you can use your bonus action to take the dash action.
You get the ability to cast {@spell Wall of Water|yastah} once per day when you reach 5th level.

name: Guide the Pack
entries: Once per long rest, when you reduce a target to 0 hit points, you grant up to three creatures within 30 feet of you advantage on their next attack.

name: Guided Fury (War Domain)

otherSummary.entry: Cleric (War Domain)

entries: 6th-level cleric feature, requires the War divine domain. Your War Priest feature no longer has a limited amount of uses, and you can now also use it when you use your action to cast a spell. Those affected by your Guided Strike and War God's Blessing features also gain a +10 bonus to one of the damage rolls of the attack.

name: Guiding Paw Strike
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike, you may spend one ki point to give one creature within 30 feet of you advantage on its next attack against the target or resistance to the next source of damage caused by the target.

name: Guild Cypher

otherSummary.entry: Runic Lore feature

entries: Those with a facility with runic invocation are often brought into the company of either a druid circle or thieves' guild. As one of these individuals, you gain the following benefits:

items: You learn your choice of either {@language Druidic} or {@language Thieves' Cant}, and add a rune from the {@filter chosen language|optionalfeatures|feature type=r:du;r:tc} to your runic lexicon.

name: Gun Fu Artist
entries: You have studied the art of close-quarters combat and gunfights, gaining the following benefits:

items: When you hold firearms in your hands, they are melee weapons that deal {@dice 1d6} bludgeoning damage. If the firearm has the light property, it also has the finesse property.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you engage in two-weapon fighting with either light melee weapons or light firearms, you can use a bonus action to make two attacks with a light weapon instead of one.
You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

name: Gun-Mage Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with Ranged Martial weapons.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Finger Guns|ValdaGunslinger} cantrip.

entries.name: Expanded Spell List
entries: Spells with the [Firearm] tag are added to your spell list.

entries.name: Spells Prepared
entries: Choose a number of spells equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} from among those with the [Firearm] tag. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell with the [Firearm] tag.

name: Gun-Mage Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency with Ranged Martial weapons.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Finger Guns|ValdaGunslinger} cantrip.

entries.name: Expanded Spell List
entries: The following spells are added to your spell list: {@spell Antiballistics Field|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Ballistic Smite|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Conjure Cannonball|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Conjure Cover|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Jam Weapon|ValdaGunslinger}, {@spell Jethro's Instant Reload|ValdaGunslinger}, and {@spell Perforating Shot|ValdaGunslinger}.

entries.name: Spells Prepared
entries: Choose a number of spells equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} from among those in the Expanded Spell List benefit. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of these spells with a different spell from the Expanded Spell List.

name: Gun-Mage Adept
entries: You've learned how to meld subtle arcana with the brute force of a firearm, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with four {@filter simple or martial firearms|items|category=basic|type=Firearm} of your choice. You can use these firearms as spellcasting focuses.
All spells with the renaissance tag are added to your class's spell list, if they are a level for which your class gets spell slots. Use your spellcasting ability for these spells.
You learn either the {@spell concealed shot|VSS} or {@spell finger guns|VSS} cantrip, your choice, which doesn't count against your total number of cantrips known.

You learn four spells of your choice that you cast with the renaissance tag. If you prepare spells, these spells are always prepared for you and don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you are a wizard, they are added to your spellbook instantly at no cost. If you learn spells, these spells do not count against your total number of spells known. When you gain a level in your spellcasting class, you can replace one of these spells with another spell with the renaissance tag for which you have spell slots.

name: Gunlance Mastery
entries: You have unlocked the secrets of the {@item gunlance|AGMH}. While you are attuned to a gunlance, its {@optfeature wyvernfire|AGMH} now recharges on a short or long rest. Additionally, it uses a new type of shell. Choose one of the following shells below that you now use in place of your original {@optfeature shells|AGMH}:

items.name: Long Range Shells
entries: Your shell's attack range is now 150/600 feet.

items.name: Wide Range Shells
entries: When you hit a creature with your shell attack, you also deal your damage against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

items.name: Short Range Shells
entries: The attack range of your shells is reduced by half, but you can add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage.

name: Gunner
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Gunner Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Gunner Feat:}

name: Gunslinger

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency with at least one firearm

entries: Thanks to extensive practice with firearms, you gain the following benefits:

items: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with firearms.
Once per turn, when you attack with a firearm you can reload it as a free action.

name: Gunslinger
entries: You have trained to wield a gun in each hand, gaining the following benefits:

items: You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one handed firearms you are wielding aren't light.
You can make a single ranged weapon attack with a one-handed firearm when you use your action to take the Dash action.
Reloading no longer requires a free hand, and if a firearm can be reloaded with a bonus action, you can reload a firearm you are holding once on your turn (no action required.)
You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

name: Hacker
entries: With a few keystrokes, you can make just about any system sing the right tune. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Data|DarkMatter} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You can attempt to hack devices without an interface, even when you don't have an interface rig. If you do have an interface rig, you can attempt to hack a device as an action, rather than over the course of one minute.
Devices never lock after your attempts to hack them.

name: Hacker
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Black Hat
entries: You are always treated as having an {@item Interface Rig|DarkMatter24}. Furthermore, devices never lock after your attempts to hack them.

entries.name: Data Expert
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Data|DarkMatter24} skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in it.

entries.name: Quick Hack
entries: You can attempt to hack a device as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, rather than over the course of one minute.

entries.name: Ranged Hack
entries: You can make {@variantrule Hacking|DarkMatter24} attempts on {@variantrule Magical Technology|DarkMatter24} you can see within 60 feet of yourself.

name: Hacker
entries: You have worked with several hacking programs and devices, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@item hacking tools|MH}.
When you use your action to to {@action operating a device|MH|operate an electronic device}, you can make an additional action to {@action operating a device|MH|operate the device} for free.

name: Hakuryū River Conduit
entries: You have studied the thrumming magic of the Hakuryū river, a coiling roil of magic that flows through the Hakuryū Valley. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: River Magic
entries: You learn the {@spell ice moon|WrathOfTheKaiju} spell, and you can cast it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have. The ability score you increase with this feat is your spellcasting ability when you cast {@spell ice moon|WrathOfTheKaiju} using this feat.

entries.name: Animate Water
entries: Over the course of 10 minutes, you can animate an area of water within 10 feet of you that fits within a 5-foot cube, turning it into a quasi-sentient creature. It uses the {@creature giant crab}, {@creature pony}, or {@creature mule} stat block (your choice), except it is an Elemental, not a Beast, and it can move across water as though it were solid ground. The creature obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you), and it disintegrates back into water after a number of hours equal to your proficiency bonus, if it falls to 0 hit points, or if you dismiss it as an action. Once you create a creature with this feat, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Half-Hand Casting
entries: You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Half-Hand Casting
entries: You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Halfling Combat Expert
entries: Whether you were born a halfling or not, you are trained in their military methods and have mastered the use of slings in combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you end your turn without moving, before your next turn when a creature within 30 feet of you moves, you can use your reaction to make a ranged weapon attack with a sling against that creature.
Once per turn when you make a ranged weapon attack without disadvantage using a sling, you can make an additional ranged weapon attack with a sling against a different creature.
The first time you score a critical hit with a sling against a creature on a turn, that creature has disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks it makes until the start of your next turn.

name: Halfling Combat Expert
entries: Whether you were born a halfling or not, you are trained in their military methods and have mastered the use of slings in combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: If you end your turn without moving, before your next turn when a creature within 30 feet of you moves, you can use your reaction to make a ranged weapon attack with a sling against that creature.
Once per turn when you make a ranged weapon attack without disadvantage using a sling, you can make an additional ranged weapon attack with a sling against a different creature.
The first time you score a critical hit with a sling against a creature on a turn, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

name: Hammer Fanner
entries: You ignore the loading property of ranged weapons.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Hammer Fanner
entries: You ignore the loading property of ranged weapons.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Hammer Rocketeer
entries: Your expertise in heavy weapons, particularly the impressively impactful rocket hammer, grants you the following benefits:

items: You deal an additional {@damage 2d4}, instead of {@damage 1d4}, bludgeoning damage when you engage the thrusters on your rocket hammer's attack.

By engaging your rocket hammer's thruster and performing an uppercut, you can propel yourself high into the air. If you perform a long jump or a high jump as an action while holding a rocket hammer, you can double your jump distance or jump height, respectively.

Once per turn, when you have advantage on an attack roll using a {@item maul|PHB}, {@item rocket hammer|DarkMatter}, {@item warhammer|PHB}, or {@item wrenchinator|DarkMatter}, you can push the target 10 feet away from you on a hit. You don't need advantage on this attack if the target is one size category smaller than you or smaller.

name: Hanabi Tinkerer
entries: Under the tutelage of the College of Hanabi, or through study of a treatise on their technique, you have developed the knowledge to infuse objects with simple magic. You gain the following benefits:
You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill and with one tool of your choice.

entries.name: Infuse Object
entries: At the end of a long rest, you can infuse one Tiny or Small nonmagical object you touch with magic. That object becomes magical and gains one of the following effects of your choice:

items.name: Light.
items.entry: As a bonus action, a creature holding the object can cause it to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light is coloured as you like when you infuse the object. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. A creature holding the object can use a bonus action to quench the light.

items.name: Sound.
items.entry: As an action while you are within 30 feet of the object, you can cause it to emit a sound, ranging in volume from a whisper to a scream. It can't replicate words, but it can replicate a scream of pain, a dragon's roar, incoherent murmuring, the shattering of glass, birdsong, or other noises. The sounds can last for up to six seconds, and they can be continuous, or you can make discrete sounds at different times over that time.

items.name: Boom.
items.entry: As an action while you are within 60 feet of the object, you can cause it to explode, destroying the object in the process. Each creature within 5 feet of the object must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + twice your proficiency bonus) taking {@damage 2d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When you infuse the item, you can choose for the explosion to be silent, or emit a tremendous boom that can be heard up to 500 feet away.

entries: The object you infuse with magic remains magical until it is destroyed, or until you use this feat to infuse an item again.

name: Hanamori Physiology
entries: Your hyperactive hanamori physiology causes your body to adapt to changes in the environment instantly, granting you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid exhaustion brought about by the environment, such as extreme heat or cold.

When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to that damage type, including against the triggering damage, until the end of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Hand-Craft
entries: This craft is not meant to cover the whole range of abilities of smiths, wrights, and other artisans, but reflects a talent for making things with superior skill and cunning. During a Fellowship Phase, you can spend a craft slot and choose a non-magical item in your possession. You must be proficient with the tools related to the item you choose, and you might also need access to special materials or locations, such as a forge. If a feature lets you add double your proficiency bonus with a tool, you can select two item related to that tool instead of one. Then, choose one of the following options for each item:

items: If it's a suit of armour or a shield, it is upgraded with a reward (see {@book Chapter 4|TLotRR|3|Rewards List}). When you reach 5th level, a creature also gains a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wearing or holding it.

If it's a weapon, it is upgraded with a reward. If you can obtain a magical success with the tools used, the weapon can also become magical. When you reach 5th level, a creature also gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

If it's any other item, choose a skill somehow related to the item, for example {@skill Stealth} if the item is a cloak, or {@skill Athletics} if the item is a pair of boots. A creature holding or wearing the item gains a Blessing die (see {@book Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Marvellous Artefacts and Wondrous Items}) on ability checks using that skill. If you can obtain a magical success with the tools used, the item can instead become a Marvellous Artefact with a blessing affecting the chosen skill (see {@book Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Marvellous Artefacts and Wondrous Items}).

entries: Each of the above options can only be chosen once for each item, and you cannot regain a craft slot expended in this way until the next Fellowship Phase, when you can withdraw the bonuses granted by that slot and regain the slot, if you wish.

name: Handspring Expert
entries: When you are {@condition prone}, standing up uses only 10 feet of your movement.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Handstring Expert
entries: When you are {@condition prone}, standing up uses only 10 feet of your movement.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Haniwa Soulbinding
entries: Your innate creation magic is potent enough that you can pour more of your essence into your clay companion. When you create a companion, it can use one of the following stat blocks instead of one listed in the Clay Companion trait: {@creature black bear}, {@creature giant goat}, {@creature giant octopus}, or {@creature warhorse}.
Once you reach 5th level, you can create Clay Companions that use the {@creature dire wolf}, {@creature giant spider}, and {@creature giant toad} stat blocks.

name: Harbinger of Death
entries: You have been touched by the magic of death itself, whether by ancient lineage or eldritch accident, and the Raven Queen's power flows through you like blood. Instead of growing mad, your mind has become accustomed to the dark beyond death. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your darkvision has a range of 120 feet, instead of 60.
You have resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
You have advantage on saving throws made to resist curses or to resist having your mind read, and you can't be aged magically.
You learn both the {@spell spare the dying} and {@spell toll the dead|XGE} cantrips, and can cast them at-will. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

name: Hard to Kill
entries: As a Roach you've survived through most of the hardships the world could throw at you, becoming even harder to kill. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
When you succeed on three death saving throws, you regain 1 hit point and become conscious. You also gain the benefits of the Dodge action until the start of your next turn.

When you fail a death saving throw, you can choose to reroll the saving throw. You must use the new roll. You must use the new roll. Once you use this feature you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Hardened Shell
entries: Your shell is tougher. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are using your Shell Defense racial feature, melee attacks made against you don't have advantage because you are {@condition prone}, and you have resistance to all damage types except Force, Poison, Psychic, Radiant and Necrotic damage while you remain within your shell.

name: Hardened Shell
entries: Your shell is not just used for protection, but as a weapon as well. You gain the following benefits:

items: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line on your turn, you can use your bonus action to immediately enter your shell. You slide on the ground for a number of feet equal to the remainder of your movement. Any creature in your path must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes bludgeoning damage and falls {@condition prone}. The bludgeoning damage is equal to a number of {@dice d6}s equal to your proficiency bonus. If you hit one or more creatures on your turn, you stop moving at the end of your turn. Otherwise, you continue moving until you emerge from your shell or the ground brings you to a stop. Once you hit at least one creature using this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Hardened Skin
entries: Your skin is dense and difficult to damage. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: Select Bludgeoning or Slashing damage. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage.

name: Hardiness
entries: Your determination and stamina have improved through hardship and toil.

items: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to your level when you gain this virtue. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional hit point.

name: Hardy
entries: You have grown tougher, gaining the following benefits:

items: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to half your level rounded up when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 1 Hit Point.

name: Hardy Physique
entries: You have hardened your physical body to absorb hits rather then dodge them. You can use your Constitution, in place of Dexterity, when calculating your Armor Class in armor.
You also have advantage on saving throws to avoid being moved against your will, {@condition Grappled}, or knocked {@condition Prone}.

name: Harmonious Balance Sentinel

entries.name: Repeatable:
entries: No
You know the secret arts of wielding the zulaat. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls you make with a zulaat.
When you wield a zulaat, at the start of your turn, you can choose for it to have both the Reach and Double properties, instead of only one or the other.
When you use a zulaat, its damage die is always 2d4, no matter what properties it currently has.
You cannot be surprised as long as you are conscious.
You may use your Wisdom modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier when rolling for Initiative.

name: Harpoon Expert
entries: You are resourceful and skilled when it comes the use of harpoons, gaining the following benefits:

entries.name: Throwing Arm
entries: The normal range of your thrown weapons is doubled.

entries.name: Harpoon
entries: As an action, you can use 30 feet of rope to turn any javelin, spear, or trident into a harpoon. When you throw that harpoon at a target 30 feet or less from you, you can pull it back to your hand as a bonus action. If the attack hit the target and the target is no more than one size larger than you, when you pull the harpoon back to you, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw against a DC of 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus. On failure, you drag the target up to 20 feet toward you.

name: Harrier

prerequisite.other: {@footnote {@i The Shadow Traveler} shadow fey|the shadow fey are described in the {@i Midgard Heroes Handbook} by Kobold Press, which is currently not converted for 5eTools.} trait or the ability to cast the {@spell misty step} spell

entries: You have learned to maximize the strategic impact of your {@spell misty step}. You appear in a flash and, while your foe is disoriented, attack with deadly precision. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use your {@footnote {@i The Shadow Traveler}|the shadow fey are described in the {@i Midgard Heroes Handbook} by Kobold Press, which is currently not converted for 5eTools.} trait or cast {@spell misty step}, you have advantage on the next attack you make before the end of your turn.

name: Hashalaq Atavist

prerequisite.other: have taken no other atavist feat.

entries: Hashalaq quori loyal to the Darkness that Dreams wield empathy and desire like a poisoned dagger. Morally repulsed by this behavior, your spirit was instrumental in finding other quori dissatisfied with the Dreaming Dark and masking the flight of the kalashtar spirits from Dal Quor. Representative lineages include Khad, Tash, and Shana. You can nearly hear one of these spirits whispering to you, increasing your empathic talents. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Instill Confidence
entries: Your hashalaq has granted you the ability to empathically connect with your allies and fill them with confidence and security. You may cast the {@spell bless} spell, using no components. Wisdom or Intelligence (your choice) is your spellcasting ability for this spell. Once you cast the spell using this feat, you must finish a long rest before you may do so again.

items.name: Empathic Projection
entries: As an action, you project calming emotions and friendship toward one humanoid you can see within 120 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you until the end of your next turn. The DC to resist this is equal to 8 + your proficiency modifier + your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier (your choice). You may use this ability at will.
When using a ranged weapon ({@color NOT THROWN|e40707}), you gain the following benefits:

items: When you critically hit an enemy add another damage Dice to the damage roll

You weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. If they already do, then your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20. If they already do, then your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 17-20.

items.name: Hazardous Distraction
items.entry: As a reaction immediately before a creature you can see within a distance equal to a third of your movement speed is affected by a harmful area of effect you can move up to a third of your movement speed straight towards them. If you end your movement in the area of effect, you can make an opportunity attack with a melee weapon against them.

items.name: Avoid Hazard
items.entry: When you take the dodge action you can gain immunity to a damage type of your choice until the end of your next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

name: Healer
entries: As an action, you can spend one use of a {@item healer's kit|PHB} to tend to a creature and restore {@dice 1d6 + 4} hit points to it, plus additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this talent again until it finishes a short or long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Healer
entries: As an action, you can spend one use of a {@item healer's kit|PHB} to tend to a creature and restore {@dice 1d6 + 4} hit points to it, plus additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this talent again until it finishes a short or long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Healer
entries: Gain the first two available Tiers of the Healer feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Healer Feat:}

name: Healer
entries: You are an able physician, allowing you to mend wounds quickly and get your allies back in the fight. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use a {@item healer's kit|phb} to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point.

As an action, you can spend one use of a {@item healer's kit|yastah} to tend to a creature and restore {@dice 1d6 + 4} hit points to it, plus additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this feat again until it finishes a short or long rest.

name: Healer's Bag
entries: You have learned to stock and use your medical supplies more effectively. The {@item healer's kit|PHB} that you use are considered to have twice as many charges as normal while you use them.
In addition, when you use a {@item healer's kit|PHB} to stabilize a dying creature, it wakes up in {@dice 1d4} rounds instead of {@dice 1d4} hours.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Healer's Bag
entries: You have learned to stock and use your medical supplies more effectively. The {@item healer's kit|PHB} that you use are considered to have twice as many charges as normal while you use them.
In addition, when you use a {@item healer's kit|PHB} to stabilize a dying creature, it wakes up in {@dice 1d4} rounds instead of {@dice 1d4} hours.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Healthy
entries: You have, for whatever reason, maintained a physically healthy lifestyle. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hit Die Use
entries: The first time you would spend a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} after completing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you gain the benefit of spending the Hit Die but do not spend it.

entries.name: Saving Throw Proficiency
entries: Choose one ability in which you lack saving throw proficiency. You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

items: Whenever you roll a 1 on a Constitution ability check or Constitution saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new result, even if it is a 1.
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws you make against poison or disease.

entries.name: Feint
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack you attempt to throw it off balance and weaken its strikes. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw with DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity ability modifier. On a failure, any damage the creature deals is reduced by your proficiency bonus and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. You may use feint a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Use of feint is recovered when you complete a long rest.

entries.name: True North
entries: As a bonus action you enter a state of intense focus. Until the start of your next turn, you make all melee weapon attack rolls with advantage. Once you use True North in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Addle
entries: As a bonus action, you attempt to cloud the mind of a creature you can see within 30ft. of you. The creature must make a wisdom saving throw with DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your spellcasting ability modifier. On a failure, any damage the creature deals is reduced by your proficiency bonus and have disadvantage on saving throws against your spells until the start of your next turn. You may use addle a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Use of Addle is recovered when you complete a long rest.

entries.name: Surecast
entries: When you are hit by an attack, as a reaction you can choose to pass on any concentration check and saving throws against effects that forcibly move you until the start of your next turn. Once you use surecast in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Blunt Shot
entries: When a creature you can see within 30ft. of you begins to cast a spell, as a reaction you may make a ranged weapon attack against that target. If you hit, the creature must make a concentration saving throw with a DC equal to 8 + your Dexterity ability modifier + your profciency bonus. On a failure, the spell fails and has no effect. On a failure, the spell fails and has no effect. This attack deals damage as normal whether it makes the save or not. You may use blunt shot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Use of blunt shot is recovered when you complete a long rest.

entries.name: Maiming Shot
entries: When you land a ranged weapon attack against a target you may choose to use maiming shot. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 8 + your proficiency + your Dexterity modifier. On a failure, the creature's speed is reduced to 0 feet until the start of your next turn. This attack deals damage as normal whether it makes the save or not. You may use maiming shot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Use of maiming is recovered when you complete a long rest.

entries.name: Rescue
entries: As an action, you cause a willing creature you can see within 60 ft. of you is instantly teleported to a location within 5ft of you. Once you use Rescue in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Swiftcast
entries: You hasten the casting of a spell. You may cast a spell with a casting time of an action as a bonus action. Once you use Swiftcast in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Interject
entries: When a creature you can see casts a spell within 5ft. of you, as a reaction may make a weapon attack against the creature. If you hit, the creature must make a concentration saving throw with a DC equal to 8 + your Strength or Dexterity ability modifier + your profciency bonus. On a failure, the spell fails and has no effect. This attack deals damage as normal whether it makes the save or not. You may use interject a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Use of interject is recovered when you complete a long rest.

entries.name: Reprisal
entries: As a bonus action, you omit a dominating aura in a 10ft. radius centered on you. Enemy creatures that deal damage in the affected area have their damage reduced by a number equal to your proficiency bonus until the end of your next turn. You may use reprisal a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Use of reprisal is recovered when you complete a long rest.

name: Heart of Treachery

prerequisite.other: {@feat Ventriloquist|TalentTrees} or {@feat Apparent Competence|TalentTrees} or {@feat Liar's Liar|TalentTrees}

entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} and any spells that would determine if you are telling the truth or compel you to do so. These spells do not alert the caster when they fail on you.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Heart of Treachery

prerequisite.other: {@feat Ventriloquist|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Apparent Competence|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Liar's Liar|TalentTreesMod}

entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} and any spells that would determine if you are telling the truth or compel you to do so. These spells do not alert the caster when they fail on you.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Heavily Armored
entries: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Damage Reduction
items.entry: While you're wearing Heavy Armor, reduce any damage dealt to you by weapon attacks by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical weapons is reduced by your proficiency bonus.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical weapons is reduced by your proficiency bonus.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Heavy Armor Master
entries: You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical weapons is reduced by 3.

name: Heavy Carapace
entries: Your carapace hardens and grows more dense, granting you the following benefits:

items: Your weight doubles.

When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.
You have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws made against effects that would push you or knock you {@condition prone}.
Your pincers gain the heavy property, and you can deal bludgeoning or slashing damage (your choice) equal to {@damage 1d8} + your Strength modifier when you hit with them.

name: Heavy Carapace
entries: Your carapace hardens and grows more dense, granting you the following benefits:

items: Your weight doubles.

When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.
You have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws made against effects that would push you or knock you {@condition prone}.
Your pincers gain the heavy property, and you can deal bludgeoning or slashing damage (your choice) equal to {@damage 1d8} + your Strength modifier when you hit with them.

name: Heavy Glider
entries: You were either born with great strength, or trained hard to allow yourself to glide under circumstances most would find impossible. You gain the following benefits:

items: You may glide while holding a heavy weapon and wearing heavy armor as long as you aren't encumbered.

You may choose to land your glide in a space occupied by a hostile creature that is Large or smaller. If you do so, you may roll an opposed Strength check against the creature. On a success, you push them 10 feet away and knock them {@condition prone} with the force of your impact. On a failure you land in the nearest un-occupied space.

name: Heavy Gunner
entries: Your experience behind massive shipbound weapons grants you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with two blasters of your choice.
Your weapon attacks with ship weapons score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. Additionally, on a critical hit, you can choose which system to deactivate, instead of selecting it randomly.
Whenever you roll damage with a ship weapon, if you roll the highest number possible on two or more damage dice, you can roll one additional damage die and add it to the roll.

name: Heavy Gunner
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Strong Attacks
entries: You can use Strength, rather than Dexterity, for attack and damage rolls using Ranged weapons with the {@itemProperty H|XPHB|Heavy} or {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: Immediately after you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with a Ranged weapon, you can give the target the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Hedgecraft

prerequisite.other: Proficiency in two of the following skills or proficiency in one of these skills and with an {@item herbalism kit|PHB}: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Survival}

entries: You have extensively studied the magic found in rare plants, and you have unlocked the secrets to invoking the ceremonial and cultivated worts of {@variantrule hedge magic|ToH} (see the Magic and Spells chapter). You gain the following benefits:

items: You are skilled at locating and identifying magic plants. You have advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks to search for and identify magic plants.

When you fail to harvest a magic plant (see {@variantrule Hedge Magic|ToH} in the Magic and Spells chapter), you can try a second time before the magic plant is destroyed. You have disadvantage on this second attempt, which destroys the plant on a failure.

You have learned how to expertly care for magic plants, and you gain two magic plants of your choice. Each plant is in a small pot, pouch, or some other portable container that you carry with you on your travels. At the end of every 7 days, roll a {@damage d4} for each magic plant that you own. The number rolled determines how many uses of that plant you have for the next 7 days. Each plant then steadily regrows, providing more uses after 7 days have passed. While caring for a plant requires work, it is considered part of your routine when you take a {@quickref resting|phb|2|0|long rest} and requires no further skill checks. You can keep and care for a number of magic plants equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus at a time.

name: Heedful
entries: Your skill in {@skill Investigation} makes you take in information with ease. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have a +5 bonus to your passive Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) score.
If given 1 minute to consult your copious mental notes, you gain advantage on your next Intelligence check. Once you do so, you must complete a short or long rest before you do so again.
It takes you half as long to train a skill, language, or tool proficiency during downtime. The gp costs remain the same.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Heedful
entries: Your skill in {@skill Investigation} makes you take in information with ease. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have a +5 bonus to your passive Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) score.
If given 1 minute to consult your copious mental notes, you gain advantage on your next Intelligence check. Once you do so, you must complete a short or long rest before you do so again.
It takes you half as long to train a skill, language, or tool proficiency during downtime. The gp costs remain the same.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Heightened Aspect (Beasthide)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: While shifting, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from weapons that aren't silvered is reduced by 3.

name: Heightened Aspect (Cliffwalk)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: Your climb speed during your shift increases by an additional 20 feet.
While shifting, if you are barefooted, you can climb even on upside down surfaces, and may hang securely from any surface you are climbing so your hands are free.

name: Heightened Aspect (Dreamsight)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: Once during your shift, you may innately cast either {@spell see invisibility} or {@spell misty step}, using no components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for either spell. Once you cast one of these spells in this way, you many not cast either with this ability until your shift ends and you shift again.

name: Heightened Aspect (Longtooth)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: The piercing damage you deal with unarmed strikes made with your fangs increases to {@dice 1d8} + your Strength modifier.

If you hit with your fangs, you may attempt to grab the target of the attack as a bonus action. While maintaining a grapple with your fangs, unarmed strikes with your fangs automatically hit the grappled opponent. Make an attack roll to determine if your hit is a critical hit, but on any result lower than a natural 20 (including a natural 1) you still hit.

name: Heightened Aspect (Razorclaw)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: During your shift, if you hit a target with an unarmed strike using a claw with your Attack action and also hit the same target with an unarmed strike using a claw with your bonus action, you may make one additional unarmed strike using a claw against the same target as part of the same bonus action.

name: Heightened Aspect (Swiftstride)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: While shifting, when you take the Dash action, after moving at least 30 feet in a straight line you may make one melee weapon attack as part of the same action or bonus action used to Dash.
While shifting, you when you use the Dash action, all opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

name: Heightened Aspect (Swiftwing)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

While shifting, at the start of your turn, you may choose to forfeit your movement to freefall 60 feet straight downward. If you do and you do not collide with a surface during the first 30 feet of your freefall at the start of your turn, you may use your arms and hands for any purpose during any action and/or bonus action you take after you have fallen 30 feet, and then your turn ends. At the end of your turn you fall the remaining 30 feet.

If you are still in midair at the end of this freefall and have not collided with a surface, you are no longer falling and may resume flying on your next turn. Otherwise you take falling damage as normal.

name: Heightened Aspect (Truedive)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: Your swim speed during your shift increases by an additional 20 feet.
While shifting, you have advantage on the first attack roll you make in a turn against a target that does not have a swim speed.

name: Heightened Aspect (Wildhunt)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: Once during your shift, you may innately cast either {@spell locate animals or plants} or {@spell pass without trace}, using no components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for either spell. Once you cast one of these spells in this way, you many not cast either with this ability until your shift ends and you shift again.

name: Heightened Aspect (Winterhide)
entries: Your shifter aspect has grown more pronounced than others of your kind, granting you increased benefits when you shift. You gain the benefits below associated with your shifter subrace.

If you have the Extra Shifter Aspect feat, you gain the benefits associated with only one of your subraces. However, when eligible you may take this feat a second time to gain the below benefits associated with your other shifter subrace:

items: While shifting, you are immune to cold damage and you gain a +1 bonus to AC. If you shift as a reaction to taking cold damage and this bonus would increase your AC above the result of the attack roll, the attack misses you.

name: Heightened Senses
entries: Your vampiric senses are stronger and more precise than ever before. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Preternatural Perception
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB} and {@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Sense the Unseen
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet. In addition, you can cast the {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Heir of Arnor
entries: The days of your folk have darkened, and not many of you remain; but ever the memory of the Kings is passed from generation to generation. An artefact going back to the days of Lost Arnor has been in your family's possession for unbroken generations. Now you have been deemed worthy to become its keeper.

items: With the help of the Loremaster, use the {@book rules in Chapter 7|TLotRR|6|Marvellous Artefacts and Wondrous Items} from {@i The Lord of the Rings Roleplaying} to create either a Wondrous Item, or a Famous Weapon possessing a single enchanted reward. The item is generally of Númenórean craftsmanship, but might even be of Elven or Dwarven make. If it is a Famous Weapon, it can be upgraded with up to two non-enchanted rewards, as if it was a normal item.

name: Hell's Envoy
entries: Your familiar can take the form of an imp. When you or your familiar reduce a hostile creature within 30 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier.

name: Helpful Insights
entries: You always seem to have helpful advice for any situation. You gain the benefits below:

items: You can take the {@action Help} action as a bonus action.
If you use a Help action to give advantage on an ability check with a skill or tool you are proficient in, the target can treat a result of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.

name: Helpful Insights
entries: You always seem to have helpful advice for any situation, no matter how obscure. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use a bonus action to take the {@action Help} action.
When you use the {@action Help} action to give a target advantage on an ability check that you are proficient in, they gain a bonus to their roll equal to your Intelligence modifier.

name: Helping Hand
entries: You use minor cantrip magic to help you improve your skill with tools and kits.
You can add your {@i spell proficiency} to skill checks that involve using {@i kits} or {@i tools}. This counts as a concentration cantrip while the skill is being performed. ({@i some examples}...)
{@b Artisan's tools}: you float tools and materials, make sure things are precise, tidy your work as you go and occasionally create, shape or join things that would be impossible to do by hand.
{@b Cooking kit}: you mix multiple pots at once and keep things at temperature while occasionally adding flavour or creating spices from nothing.

{@b Disguise kit}: you subtly change skin and hair colour, make the join between prosthetic and real unnoticeable and slightly alter the pitch of your voice with magic - it's not a magical disguise or illusion; just a helping hand.

{@b Forgery kit}: you can fill a page with text magically rather than with a quill and ink, use magic to erase one name so that another can take its place, age parchment and form impressions in wax without a seal.
{@b Gaming set}: you can use magic to mark cards, change the colour of gaming pieces and turn the tables to your advantage (Using this will give opponents advantage in seeing through any cheating)
{@b Herbalism kit}: you can use magic to harvest herbs without damaging them while preserving and extract various natural resources.
{@b Musical instrument}: you can use magic to add background effects, reverb, echo and play notes normally out with the range of your instrument.
{@b Poisoner's kit}: you can use magic to safely handle nasty things and measure out precise quantities.
{@b Thieves' tools}: you can hold multiple picks without hands, raise unseen latches and reach beyond your fingers. You can spread cantrips and attach tripwires to surfaces using magic.

name: Helping Hand
entries: You are always there to give your allies a hand. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.

{@b Boosting Shoves.} When a willing allied creature moves out of your reach, you can use your reaction to give them a boost, shoving them 5 feet. This occurs before any opportunity attack their movement might provoke, and may prevent them from taking an opportunity attack.

{@b Get Down.} When an allied creature is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw while within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to shove them 5 feet, potentially out of the effect. If the effect is targeted, you can instead interpose yourself, giving them advantage on saving throw, but forcing you to save against the same effect.

name: Hemomancer
entries: You can sacrifice your essence to cast blood magic spells in place of expending a spell slot. To do so, sacrifice 5 hit points per level of the spell. These hit points sacrificed can count towards the hit point cost of the blood Material component of the spell.

You can cast a total number of spell levels in this manner equal to your character level, but casting a spell of 6th level or higher this way drains your vitality in a more profound way unless it has the blood magic tag, causing you to gain levels of exhaustion equal to the number of levels over 5th the spell is (1 level for a 6th level spell, 2 for a 7th level spell, etc).
You cannot cast spells this way over 5th level while you have any levels of exhaustion. You regain all levels of usage of this rite when you complete a long rest.

name: Hemomancer
entries: You can sacrifice your essence to cast spells with the "(blood magic)" tag in place of expending a spell slot. To do so, sacrifice 5 hit points per level of the spell. These hit points sacrificed can count towards the hit point cost of the blood Material component of the spell.

You can cast a total number of spell levels in this manner equal to your character level, but casting a spell of 6th level or higher this way drains your vitality in a more profound way, causing you to gain levels of exhaustion equal to the number of levels over 5th the spell is (1 level for a 6th-level spell, 2 for a 7th-level spell, etc.).
You cannot cast spells over 5th level this way while you have any levels of exhaustion. The total number of spell levels you can cast in this manner resets when you take a long rest.

name: Herbalist
entries: You excel at the identification and use of herbs and other natural substances for medicinal purposes. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item herbalism kit|phb|herbalism kits}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
Creating {@item antitoxin|phb|Antitoxin (vial)} takes half as much time and requires half as many raw materials.

As part of a short rest, you can use your herbalism kit to administer an herbal remedy that helps a creature recover from their ailments. The creature gains advantage on saving throws against poison and disease for the next hour.

name: Herbalist
entries: You have studied the craft of herbalism, mastering the art of gathering and cultivating alchemical reagents, along with a few other tricks of the trade.

items: You gain proficiency with the herbalism kit. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.

Over the course of ten minutes, you can expend one use of a healer's kit to rub your trademark salve into one creature's wounds, speeding up their natural healing process. At the end of that ten minutes, the creature may expend a single hit die, gaining hit points from this as if having just completed a short rest. A creature may benefit from this feature only once per long rest.
When you roll a natural 20 on an herbalism check in downtime, you gain one extra success than you normally would.

name: Herbalist
entries: You are adept at harnessing the useful properties of herbs and other plants. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with herbalism kits. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
As an action, you can inspect a plant within 5 feet of you and determine whether it is edible or poisonous, provided that you can see and smell it.

You can apply herbal remedies to help yourself or your allies recover from maladies. Over the course of a short rest, you can remove one poison or disease from a friendly creature within reach. You must have an herbalism kit and either a component pouch or access to local herbs to use this benefit.

name: Herbalist
entries: You are an expert with {@item Herbalism Kit|phb|Herbalism Kits}.
Creating {@item antitoxin|phb|Antitoxin (vial)} takes half as much time and requires half as many raw materials.

As part of a short rest, you can use your herbalism kit to administer an herbal remedy that helps a creature recover from their ailments. The creature gains advantage on saving throws against poison and disease for the next hour.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Herbalist Initiate
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item herbalism kit|PHB|herbalism kits}, and learn how to use them to produce {@item healing poultice|TMR|healing poultices}.

You may spend 1 hour a day searching a natural area for helpful herbs and fungi; this can count as part of a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}. Roll a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check against the DC corresponding to your environment.

On a success, you find enough herbs to produce a number of {@item healing poultice|TMR|healing poultices} equal to half your Wisdom modifier (rounded up). You must have an {@item herbalism kit|PHB} to produce these items, which must be done at the end of your search time as part of the same hour. On a failure, you produce no {@item healing poultice|TMR|healing poultices}, and cannot attempt to produce more until you complete a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.

If you have the {@classFeature Natural Healer|Martial Ranger|TMR|2|TMR} feature from the {@homebrew martial} ranger class, you instead can produce one additional {@item healing poultice|TMR} when you use that feature.
If you are a {@homebrew martial} ranger, your additional {@item healing poultice|TMR} healing scales with your {@homebrew martial} ranger level as normal.

name: Heroic Appetite
entries: Your stomach's capacity is truly astounding and gains the ability to hold far more than it should.

items: You may eat up to a twice as many meals per day as you would otherwise be allowed.
Magical foods that can be consumed only twice per day count as one meal, and may be consumed multiple times in a day
You may choose to delay the effect of Consumable items (Until your next short/long rest), and may activate it by a bonus action.

name: Heroic Rush
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Triumphant Boost
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. These benefits last until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Victorious Inspiration
entries: When you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with an attack, you can choose one ally within 30 feet of you to receive {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. The ally must use this {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} before the end of their next turn or it is wasted. You can use this feature twice, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Hewn for Battle
entries: You have reshaped your stone body to be a more effective and devastating weapon of war. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thickened Hide
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can choose the thickness of your natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} becomes your choice of either 14 plus your Dexterity modifier, or 18. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

entries.name: Spellcarving
entries: Your hide can be enchanted or infused as if it were nonmagical armor.

entries.name: Claws
entries: You have shaped your hands into fearsome claws. Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. If you hit with them, you deal Slashing damage equal to {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength modifier in place of the normal Bludgeoning damage of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

name: Hexer
entries: You have practiced the art of inflicting grievous curses, granting you the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You learn the hinder spell and another 1st-level Enchantment spell of your choice from any spell list. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

When a spell you cast that has a duration of 1 minute or longer imposes a saving throw on a creature, you can choose for that creature to make the save with disadvantage. Once you use this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

name: Hexer
entries: You learn {@filter two hexes|optionalfeatures|feature type=Hex} of your choice from among those available to the witch class, and gain the {@classFeature Cackle|Witch|VSS} feature from the witch class. Use your Charisma when determining the attack rolls and saving throws of these hexes.

name: Hidden Action
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks against creatures that you are hidden from.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Hidden Action
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks against creatures that you are hidden from.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Hierophant

prerequisite.other: from the Druid or Ranger spell list

entries: You have strengthened your connection to the beasts of the natural world. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in either the {@skill Nature} or {@skill Survival} skill.

You learn the {@spell speak with animals} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. Once you do, you can't do so again until you complete a short or long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

You gain one use of the {@classFeature Wild Shape|Druid||2} feature available to the druid class and can use it to shift into {@filter any beast you have seen before with a CR rating 1/8 or below, including those with a swim or fly speed|bestiary|challenge rating=[&0;&1/8]|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}. Once you do, you can't do so again until you complete a short or long rest. If you have the {@classFeature Wild Shape|Druid||2} feature from another source, you gain an additional use with the benefits and restrictions of that feature instead.

name: High Destiny
entries: Stories tell that those who belong to the race of Dale are destined for greatness, a fact proven true by your King and his story. Do you share the same destiny of those of the line of Girion?

items: You have advantage on death saving throws.
Whenever you become stable, you also regain 1 hit point.

name: High Horn Magic
entries: As a unicorn, you have more access to spells and other scholarly magic than any other pony. You learn one 1st level spell that has a casting time of one action from the Wizard, Bard or Warlock spell list that you can now cast at will. In addition, you learn one third level or lower spell from the Wizard, Bard or Warlock spell list that you can now cast without a spell slot, but you must finish a long rest to cast again. Use either Intelligence or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for these spells.

items: When you make a high jump, you leap into the air a number of feet equal to 6 + twice your Strength modifier if you move at least 10 feet on foot immediately before the jump.
When you make a Strength (Athletics) check to climb, you are considered proficient in Athletics and add your twice your proficiency bonus instead of your normal proficiency bonus.
You gain resistance to falling damage.

name: Highborn Dorw
entries: You have learned how to tap into the advanced magical abilities available to you through your drow noble heritage. You gain the following benefits:

items: Choose a 1st level spell from the wizard or warlock spell list. You can cast the chosen 1stlevel spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spell is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you can use a bonus action to become {@condition invisible} until the start of your next turn. This invisibility ends early if you speak, use a reaction, or take damage.

name: Hinder
entries: You learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your assistance dice and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can't hear you or if it's immune to being charmed.

name: Historian
entries: Your study of history rewards you with the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill History} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

When you take the {@action Help} action to aid another creature's ability check, you can make a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill History}) check. On a success, that creature's check gains a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus, as you share pertinent advice and historical examples. To receive this bonus, the creature must be able to understand what you're saying.

name: Historiomancer
entries: You are a member of the Chroniclers, or have studied alongside them in the art of historiomancy, granting you the following benefits:
You gain proficiency in the History skill.

entries.name: Historical Divination
entries: Over the course of 10 minutes without moving, you can focus on the area within 30 feet of yourself, as if concentrating on a spell.
