entries: You learn to maneuver more effectively, even while wearing light armor. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wearing light armor and not wielding a shield, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
While you aren't wearing medium or heavy armor, your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
Light armor being worn no longer counts towards your carry capacity.

While wearing light armor, you can use your reaction to reduce damage dealt to you as the result of a Dexterity saving throw equal to your Dexterity modifier plus your proficiency bonus to a minimum of 1.

name: Light as a Feather
entries: While wearing no armor or only light armor, when an enemy hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to prepare yourself to disengage. Until the end of your next turn, your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from that creature.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Light as a Feather
entries: While wearing no armor or only light armor, when an enemy hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to prepare yourself to disengage. Until the end of your next turn, your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from that creature.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Light Foot
entries: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you aren't wearing heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC.
Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action, you can forgo one of your attacks to move up to half your speed.
Nonmagical {@quickref difficult terrain||3} costs you no extra movement.
You can move through a hostile creature's space, regardless of its size.
On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can move up to half your speed as a reaction.

Before you make a melee attack with a light weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to gain a bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you do not add your Dexterity modifier to the weapon's damage. In order to gains this benefit, you must add your Dexterity modifier to your weapon damage.
When you gain this feat, choose either radiant or necrotic.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

name: Light/Shadow Specialist*
entries: You specialize in casting spells of a specific type.

items: You are able to emulate other damaging spells using your preferred element, but you are unable to deal any other type of spell damage.
When you gain this feat, choose radiant or necrotic.
Damaging spells of any damage type listed that you cast deal damage of the chosen type instead of their normal damage.
Radiant: changes acid, cold, thunder, Necrotic.
Necrotic: changes fire, lightning, thunder, Radiant.
When you hit a creature that is immune to damage of the chosen type, it takes damage as if it had resistance rather than immunity.

name: Lighthearted
entries: Few things can shake your mood, and your respites are particularly restful. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

If you spend one ore more Hit Dice to regain hit points during a short rest, you regain an additional {@dice 1d6} hit points for each Hit Die you spend. If you consume alcohol during your rest, you roll an additional {@dice 1d8} hit points (instead of a {@dice d6}).

name: Lightly Armored
entries: You have trained to master the use of light armor, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with light armor.

name: Lightning Caster

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast at least one cantrip

entries: Your rapid-fire style of casting cantrips allows you to weave magic with uncanny speed, granting you the following benefit:

items: Whenever you cast a cantrip that can only target a single enemy, you can use your bonus action to target two enemies within 5 feet of one another instead.

name: Lightning Caster
entries: Your rapid-fire style of casting cantrips allows you to weave magic with uncanny speed. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dual Target
entries: When you cast a cantrip with a casting time of an action that targets a single creature, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to target a second creature within the cantrip's range.

entries.name: Immediate Response
entries: When you cast a spell as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, that spell doesn't expend a spell slot. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Lightning Leaper
entries: You master the art of moving like lightning... literally. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Bonus.} Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Intelligence ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Lightning Dodge.} When you succeed a dexterity saving throw, you can teleport up to 5 feet
You gain the {@b Lightning Leap} special attack (below).

entries.name: Lightning Leap
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack, Supernatural)}

When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one attack by turning into lightning, leaping (as lightning) to a creature or empty space within 10 feet. If you target a creature, you can target a chain of creatures within 10 feet of the previous target, targeting a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus. Each creature you target makes a Dexterity saving, taking {@damage 2d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful save. You then teleport to an empty spot of your choice adjacent to the last target of the chain. The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} and the range (initial and jump distance) increases by 5 feet whenever your proficiency bonus increases.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Lightning Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Thor's Fury
entries: Your lightning spells are laced with extra power. Whenever you deal Lightning damage to a creature with a spell of at least 1st level, you can choose one of the following additional effects.

items: The creature has the {@condition Stunned} condition until the end of your next turn, if it failed its save against the spell.

The creature takes half of the Lightning damage it initially took again at the beginning of its next turn. It can make a saving throw against your spell saving throw DC to negate this additional damage.

The creature gains {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Lightning damage for 1 minute. It can make a Constitution saving throw (equal to your spell saving throw DC) to end this effect at the end of each of its turns.

entries: You can use Thor's Fury a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Lightning Rod
entries: You learn to store lightning energy within your body. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Bonus.} Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Lightning Draw.} When a creature within 10 feet of you takes lightning damage, as a reaction you can redirect that damage to yourself.
You gain the {@b Lightning Burst} special attack (below).

entries.name: Lightning Burst
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack, Supernatural)}

When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one attack by unleashing lightning that blasts all targets of your choice within 10 feet of you. Each target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On failure, they take {@damage 2d6} lightning damage. On success they take half as much damage. The lightning damage increases by {@dice 1d6} each time your proficiency bonus increases.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

items: {@b Quick Draw.} Whenever you make an attack, you can draw a light melee weapon as part of taking the attack.

{@b Twin Strike.} When you make an attack while wielding more than one light melee weapon and make an attack with one of them, you can subtract the damage dice of another light melee weapon you are carrying from the attack roll to add twice its damage dice to the damage roll of that attack on hit.

name: Like a Boss
entries: You are accustomed to using others to avoid being attacked. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature you can see targets you with an attack and another creature is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. Once you use this ability, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Lilliputian
entries: You come from a unique population of halflings, as diminutive to regular halflings as their kin are to humans. You have the following benefits.

entries.name: Tiny
entries: Your size is Tiny.

entries.name: Miniature Weapons
entries: You can only wield weapons designed for creatures of your size. Generally, such weapons are identical to their standard versions but their damage dice decrease by one step ({@dice d12} or {@dice 2d6} → {@dice d10} → {@dice d8} → {@dice d6} → {@dice d4}, to a minimum of {@dice d4}).

entries.name: Nimble
entries: {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you.

name: Line Breaker
entries: You smash through your enemies, clearing the way for your allies.

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.

{@b Heavy Impacts.} When you push a creature, if the creature's movement is stopped early by another creature, object, or terrain, they take {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage for each 5 feet moved before the collision.
Gain the {@b Might Impact} special attack (below).

entries.name: Mighty Impact
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack)}

When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to slam an enemy backwards. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On failure, it takes {@damage 2d6} + your Strength modifier damage and is pushed 15 feet away from you. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you. The distance the target is pushed is reduced by 5 feet for every size larger than you it is. The number of d6 increases by one when your proficiency bonus increases (with the total number of d6 equaling your proficiency bonus).
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Linguist
entries: Your studies have required you to delve into ancient and foreign texts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn to read and write 3 languages of your choice, and if you spend 1 minute or more examining a mundane or magical script, you can determine the language in which it is written.

You learn to create written ciphers. Others can't decipher this code unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.
You can use your {@feat Repository of Lore|TalentTrees} feature twice between rests.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Linguist
entries: Your studies have required you to delve into ancient and foreign texts. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn to read and write 3 languages of your choice, and if you spend 1 minute or more examining a mundane or magical script, you can determine the language in which it is written.

You learn to create written ciphers. Others can't decipher this code unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.
You can use your {@feat Repository of Lore|TalentTreesMod} feature twice between rests.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Linguist
entries: You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits:

items: You learn three languages of your choice.

You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.

name: Living off the Land
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Herbalist
entries: When you take a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in a natural area (natural caves, forest, tundra, etc.), you can locate materials to create a {@item Healer's Kit|XPHB}, and enough mushrooms, berries, or root vegetables to feed one Medium creature for one day.

entries.name: Survival Shelter
entries: You can spend 30 minutes to create a lean-to, bivouac, tree well, igloo, or other temporary shelter out of snow, tree boughs, rocks, and sticks, suitable for 4-5 Medium humanoids. While inside your survival shelter, creatures automatically succeed on Constitution saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} and {@hazard Extreme Heat|XDMG}.

name: Loather of the City
entries: A number of times equal to the character's proficiency bonus, when dealing damage to a humanoid with a weapon attack, the character can roll damage twice and take the highest result. The character regains all uses of this feat after a long rest.

name: Locathah Hunter
entries: You have become accustomed to hunting on land, even with weapons others consider crude, and you've learned to survive far from your aquatic home. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@item spear|PHB} and {@item trident|PHB}, if you don't already have it.

While you are wielding a {@item spear|PHB} or {@item trident|PHB}, its damage increases to {@dice 1d8} (or {@dice 1d10}, if you wield it in two hands), and if you score a critical hit with either weapon, you can roll the damage die an additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.
You ignore the requirement to be submerged in water from your Limited Amphibiousness trait. Instead, you count as one size larger when determining how much water you must consume in a day.

name: Lodge Berserker
entries: You met the strict requirements of one of Rashemen's Berserker Lodges. The intense training has improved your abilities in combat.

items: Select one of the Berserker Lodges below and gain that lodge's benefit.
{@i {@b Ettercap Lodge.}} You have advantage on all climbing ability checks. When raging, you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.
{@i {@b Goblin Lodge.}} When raging, if you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.
{@i {@b Great Stag Lodge.}} When raging, if you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before making a melee attack, you have advantage on the attack.
{@i {@b Ice Troll Lodge.}} When raging, your AC increases by 1
{@i {@b Owlbear Lodge.}} When raging and grappling a creature, you automatically deal bludgeoning damage equal to your proficiency bonus at the start of your turn to the grappled creature.

{@i {@b Snow Tiger Lodge.}} When raging, if you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting a target with a melee attack, you deal extra damage equal to three times your proficiency bonus. You must finish a short or long rest before using this feature again. The berserkers of this lodge are known for using claw bracers (page 122) in combat.

{@i {@b White Dragon Lodge.}} You have advantage on all ability checks to move across snow and icy surfaces. When raging, you have advantage on saving throws against cold, and you have resistance against cold damage.

{@i {@b Wolf Lodge.}} When raging, if you hit a target with a melee attack, the target must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. The DC of your saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. You may use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all uses of this feature after finishing a short or long rest
When you level up, you may join a new Berserker Lodge. If you do, replace the feature granted by your old lodge with one from the new lodge.

name: Lolth's Meat
entries: Like all drow cultured in cities that are ruled by Lolth's priestesses, you know that you exist only to provide your goddess with food and pleasure. This knowledge lends you a certain bloodthirsty readiness. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on initiative rolls.
When you hit a creature that has not yet acted in combat, you deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Long Haft Strike
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Shield
entries: When you make an attack with a weapon with the Reach property against a creature wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, that creature doesn't benefit from the {@item Shield|XPHB}'s {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} bonus.

entries.name: Reaching Defense
entries: While wielding a weapon with reach, you have a +1 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

name: Long Reach
entries: You know how to extend your reach to target opponents with spear-like weapons. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your weapon attacks with a javelin, pike, spear, or trident score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
On your turn, when you attack with a javelin, pike, spear, or trident, your reach increases by 5 feet. The reach for your opportunity attacks with these weapons remains unchanged

name: Looping Cantrips
entries: You've learned to increase the potency of your cantrips, you gain the following benefits.

items: When you cast a cantrip, instead of increasing that damage when you reach certain levels, you can cast the cantrip additional times as part of the same action. The cantrip must deal damage, and it must make a spell attack or require a saving throw. You can cast it two times at 5th level, three times at 11th levefand fourtimes at 17th level When you do, the cantrip can deal its damage more than once, but its other effects aren't applied to the same target again.

name: Lord of the Herd
entries: You've discovered how to perfectly manage your relationship with a network of companions, and are even able to take on another.

items: Your Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can have up to four companions, and your Bond Strength with each of them is instead limited to 14.

name: Lord of the Herd
entries: You've discovered how to perfectly manage your relationship with a network of companions, and are even able to take on another.

items: Your Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can have up to four companions, and your Bond Strength with each of them is instead limited to 14.

name: Lotus States - Heart Lotus
entries: A warm and inviting Green, the Heart Lotus is a state of compassion and connection to others. Chakara in this state value the friendships and connections they make, and are eager to help share the burdens of others.

entries.name: Kindred Heart
entries: While in this state, You can sense the emotions of those around you. As an action on your turn, you may touch a creature and gain insight into their emotional state. You learn your choice of one of the following:

items: Something that Troubles or worries the Creature
Something that makes the Creature Happy or Excited
How the creature perceives yourself or another creature you are aware of.
If the creature has recently told a lie or been dishonest

entries: You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, after which you must complete a long rest before using it again.

name: Lotus States - Naval Lotus
entries: Resonating in a golden Yellow, the Core Lotus reflects a state of wilful determination and agency. Chakara in this state are driven and self-assured, rarely allowing others to hinder their progress.

entries.name: Forceful Will
entries: While in this state, you have advantage on saving throws against charm and fear effects. In addition, you gain access to the True Strike cantrip and may and may cast it as a bonus action a number of times between long rests equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Lotus States - Root Lotus
entries: Associated with the color Red, the Root Lotus represents a grounded state of stability and rational thinking. Chakara in this state are often focussed on the basics of survival, and find peace within the natural world.

entries.name: Grounded Form
entries: While in this state, you are considered proficient in survival checks if you do not already have proficiency. In addition, when you regain hit points through the use of a spell, class feature or other effect such as spending a hit dice, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Lotus States - Sacral Lotus
entries: Glowing with a fiery Orange, the Sacral Lotus is a state of emotional passion and creativity. Chakara in this state are innovative and clever, often finding themselves caught daydream or flights of fancy.

entries.name: Creative Passion
entries: While in this state you have advantage on checks made using artisan's tools in which you are proficient. In addition, You may use the energy within your body to create small palm-sized illusions of things you have seen or imagined. These illusions can include motion or sound, but are lightly transparent, and easily recognizable as illusions. You may have a number of these illusions active at one time equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Lotus States - Third-Eye Lotus
entries: Visible as a deep Purple, the Third Eye Lotus is a state centered around intuition and perception. Chakara in this state enjoy being passive observers, content to watch the world around them and appreciate it's beauty.

entries.name: Grounded
entries: While in this state, you are considered proficient in insight and perception checks if you do not already have proficiency. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against illusions or illusion spells, and on checks made to recognize illusions.

name: Lotus States - Throat Lotus
entries: A deep to brilliant Blue in color, the Voice Lotus represents a state of openness and expression. Chakara in this state are talkative, and often far more persuasive than usual, able to present themselves with a confident energy almost magical in nature.

entries.name: Infectious Personality
entries: While in this state, you are considered proficient in persuasion checks if you do not already have proficiency. In addition, you gain access to the friends cantrip and may use it to affect a number of creatures at one time equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Low-Light Vision
entries: Dim light doesnt impose disadvantage on your Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks relying on sight and you gain {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 5 feet.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Low-Light Vision
entries: Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks relying on sight and you gain {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 5 feet.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Lower Limb Disability

otherSummary.entry: You can only take this feat during character creation

entries: Due to injury, illness, or incident of birth, you are unable to walk as others do and must rely on some sort of aid for mobility. The cause might include paralysis, amputation of the leg or foot (congenital or acquired), chronic pain, muscular dystrophy, conditions which affect your respiration or balance, or a host of other factors. Because of this, you possess the following traits:

items: You rely on some sort of aid to stand and move. This can include, but is not limited to, crutches, a wheelchair or similar wheeled contraption, or a mechanical or magical apparatus that helps support your weight. Work with the GM to decide which sort of aid works best in the campaign world.
You can't take the {@action Dash} action on {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to knock you {@condition prone} or move you against your will.

entries: If your mobility disability is ever remedied, such as through the use of a {@spell regenerate} spell, you lose the benefits of this feat. The GM should discuss with you whether or not removing your impairment is appropriate for your character—it is always a possibility, but never a requirement.

name: Loxodon Stampede
entries: You've learned to use your sizable body to ignore enemies that block your path. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you take the {@action Dash} action, you can choose to pass through the space of one or more Large or smaller creatures. Each creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength bonus + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked {@condition prone} and take bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 1d10} + your Strength modifier. Whether a creature succeeds or fails its saving throw, it cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn. Once you use this ability, you can't ust it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Loyal Bodyguard
entries: You are renowned for protecting your comrades from danger however you can and they feel reassured by your presence. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You also become the new target of the attack.

When an allied creature you can see within 5 feet of you fails a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw against an effect that deals damage, you can use your reaction to make them take only half of the damage. However you take the other half of the damage from the effect.
If you are providing cover to an allied creature, that creature is considered to be in three-quarters cover if they are within 5 feet of you.

name: Loyal Minion
entries: You gain the services of a loyal minion, which takes the form of a Small humanoid or monstrosity of your choice. The minion has the statistics detailed below.

Your minion acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it rolls its own initiative and acts on its own turn. A minion can't attack, but it can take other actions as normal.
Additionally, you learn one new language or gain a skill or tool proficiency of your choice.
If you lose your minion, you can revive the minion or recruit a new minion at the end of a long rest.
If you select this feat multiple times, the number of loyal minions you have increases by 1 for each, and you can select an additional language, skill proficiency, or tool proficiency.

name: Loyal Servant
entries: You have a loyal companion who has gained power from your blood. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Companion
entries: A loyal Beast or Humanoid is Blood Bound to you. {@filter Choose a Beast or Humanoid stat block|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&3]|type=beast;humanoid} that has a maximum {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} of up to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. When choosing a companion, you may look in the monster section of source books or elsewhere for an eligible Beast or Humanoid if the Game Master permits you to do so.

entries.name: Power in the Blood
entries: Your Loyal Servant has one {@filter Kindred feat|feats|category=kf|level=level 1;level 2} of your choice, and it counts as a level 2 Kindred for the purpose of selecting a Kindred feat. In addition, your Loyal Servant can spend 1 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Point Die} in place of 1 Blood Point for the purpose of its feat.

entries.name: Replacing a Servant
entries: If your servant is killed or otherwise leaves, you can choose a new Loyal Servant after 30 days. The GM can lengthen or shorten this time based on in-game circumstances.

entries.name: The Blood Bond
entries: While Blood Bound to a Kindred, a creature is considered {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by that Kindred and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by other creatures. This is in addition to the effects from the {@item Kindred Vitae|BoundByBlood} consumable.

A Blood Bond can be suppressed for 1 minute if the creature succeeds on a DC 25 Charisma saving throw. The bond is only permanently removed if the creature doesn't drink from that Kindred again for a year, or if the Kindred in question is killed.

name: Loyal Servant
entries: When you take this talent, the next time an opportunity arises, if you don't currently have a retainer, you gain the loyal friendship and service of one, such as an attendant or messenger who willingly serves you. This retainer can perform mundane tasks, but will not fight for you, nor follow you into obviously dangerous areas (such as dungeons), and will leave you if frequently endangered or abused. While in your service, they are completely forthright with you and loyal only to you and your causes. After this retainer leaves your service, you must wait {@dice 1d4} weeks before finding another one, hopefully reflecting on your mistakes and bettering yourself (but you know, to each their own).
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Loyal Servant
entries: When you take this talent, the next time an opportunity arises, if you don't currently have a retainer, you gain the loyal friendship and service of one, such as an attendant or messenger who willingly serves you. This retainer can perform mundane tasks, but will not fight for you, nor follow you into obviously dangerous areas (such as dungeons), and will leave you if frequently endangered or abused. While in your service, they are completely forthright with you and loyal only to you and your causes. After this retainer leaves your service, you must wait {@dice 1d4} weeks before finding another one, hopefully reflecting on your mistakes and bettering yourself (but you know, to each their own).
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Loyalty to the Last
entries: If a friendly creature within 15 feet of you is reduced to 0 hit points, you may use your reaction to use your Lay on Hands ability. You must then take a long rest to regain this ability.

name: Lucid Meditation

prerequisite.other: The ability to manifest at least one psionic augment

entries: Your concentration is nigh unbreakable, even in the midst of combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your concentration cannot be broken by environmental phenomena.
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain concentration on a power when you take damage.
If your concentration breaks on a power because you were dealt damage by an enemy, you may use your reaction to regain half the psi points you spent to manifest that power.

name: Lucky (Revised)
entries: You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional d20. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the d20s is used for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. If you have disadvantage on the roll, you instead must choose between the result of the disadvantage roll, or the extra d20

You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a d20, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled.
You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.

name: Lucky
entries: You gain 2 additional Luck Points.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Lucky
entries: You gain 2 additional Luck Points.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Lucky
entries: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment.

You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional {@dice d20}. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You must use the {@dice d20} rolled for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.
You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a {@dice d20}, and must take the second roll.
If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out. No additional dice are rolled.
You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.

name: Luminescence
entries: Your gelatinous body developes an innate bioluminecance as well as the ability to control it.

items: As an action you can glow and emit 20 feet of bright light and additional 20 feet of dim light. As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can regulate how much light you give off, reducing the bright light and dim light to up to a minimum of 5 ft. each. You can end emitting light altogether as a bonus action.

As an action you can emit a powerful flash of light. Each creature within 20 feet of you must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn. The DC is equal to 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. Once you use this feature, you can't use an action to emit bright light or use this feature again until you have finished a short or long rest.
You gain resistance to radiant damage.

name: Luminescence
entries: Your gelatinous body developes an innate bioluminescence as well as the ability to control it.

items: As an action you can glow and emit 20 ft. of bright light and additional 20 ft. of dim light. As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can regulate how much light you give off, reducing the bright light and dim light to up to a minimum of 5 ft. each. You can end emitting light altogether as a bonus action.

As an action you can emit a powerful flash of light. Each creature within 20 ft. of you must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn. The DC is equal to 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. Once you use this feature, you can't use an action to emit bright light or use this feature again until you have finished a short or long rest.
You gain resistance to radiant damage.

name: Lurker
entries: Your natural stealthiness and affinity for ambush become even more apparent. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}.
When you apply poison to a weapon, you may add your proficiency bonus to the poison damage you deal on a hit.
You have advantage on {@skill Stealth} checks while you are in swampy, forested, or underwater environments.

name: Lutar às Cegas
entries: O personagem foi treinado em combate corporal, mesmo sem enxergar seus oponentes.

{@b Beneficio:} Um atacante invisível não recebe nenhum bônus para atingir seu personagem em um combate corporal, Ataques Surpresa não afetados pelo talento, entretanto. No entanto, os bônus da criatura invisível ainda se aplicam para ataques à distância. Quando o personagem não conseguir enxergar, não sofrerá imposição de Desvantagem.

name: Machine Slayer
entries: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against machines fashioned by the Ancients (and against most other constructs), gaining the following benefits:

items: When a construct within 5 feet of you takes its action, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

When you damage a construct with a weapon, you deal one additional die of damage of the same type that the weapon or attack normally deals—a longsword adds another {@dice 1d8}, a fireball adds another {@dice 1d6}, and so on.

name: Mad Mage
entries: You gain the following benefits

items.name: Spread Madness
items.entry: Whenever you fail a saving throw to maintain concentration, enemies within 5 ft of your must succeed on a constitution saving throw or take psychic damage equal to the level of the spell you're concentrating on plus your proficiency bonus.

items.name: Mad Magecraft
items.entry: Choose a number of spells you know equal to your proficiency bonus. For each of those spells, choose a damage type. Whenever you cast one of those spells, you can change its damage type to the chosen damage type. You can change one of the spells you chose (and its corresponding damage type) whenever you gain a level in the class that granted you this feat.

name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
entries: When you cast {@spell mage hand}, you can make the spectral hand {@condition invisible}, and you can perform the following additional tasks with it:

items: You can stow one object the hand is holding in a container worn or carried by another creature.
You can retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature.
You can use thieves' tools to pick lock and disarm traps at range.

entries: You can perform one of these tasks without being noticed by a creature if you succeed on a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature's Wisdom (Perception) check. If you have the {@feat Quickened Action|Adventurer} feat (Use an Object), you can use a bonus action to control the hand.
Additionally, your mage hand can carry a number of pounds equal to 10 times your spellcasting modifier.

name: Mage Slayer (Alternate)
entries: You have trained extensively to counter sinister spellcasters and foil their arcane abilities. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Disrupt Spell
entries: When you see or hear a creature within your reach cast a spell, you can use your reaction to make an {@action opportunity attack} against it. On hit, it makes a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration. On a failure, its spell fails to take effect, and its slot or use of that ability is wasted.

entries.name: Disrupt Concentration
entries: When you damage a creature that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, it has disadvantage on its saving throw to maintain its concentration on that spell.

entries.name: Spellguard
entries: You have advantage on saving throws to resist spells cast by creatures you can see or hear within 5 feet.

name: Mage Slayer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

items.name: Break Concentration
items.entry: Once per turn before a creature would succeed or fail on a saving throw to maintain concentration that you caused them to make, you can subtract your proficiency bonus from their saving throw.

items.name: Spellguard
items.entry: If someone you can touch would fail a saving throw against a spell, you can add twice your proficiency bonus potentially changing it into a success. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long or Short Rest.

name: Mage Slayer (Revised)
entries: You have practiced techniques in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
You have advantage on melee attacks against creatures that are concentrating on a spell.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you, or who started their turn within 5 feet of you.

name: Mage Slayer (Revised)
entries: You have practiced techniques in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
You have advantage on melee attacks against creatures that are concentrating on a spell.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you, or who started their turn within 5 feet of you.

name: Mage Slayer
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.
In addition, when a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Mage Slayer
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.
In addition, when a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Mage Slayer
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Mage Slayer Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Mage Slayer Feat:}

name: Mage Slayer
entries: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
When you damage a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its concentration.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.

name: Magesight

prerequisite.other: {@feat Ritual Collector|TalentTrees} or {@feat Mage Slayer|TalentTrees} or {@feat Planar Disruptor|TalentTrees}

entries: You can spend 1 minute opening your senses to the magic around you. When this minute ends, your senses are enhanced as if you had cast the {@spell detect magic} spell, except that your vision can penetrate twice the thickness of material as normal and if you spend the full 10-minute duration of the spell examining the aura of a magical item, you also learn its properties as if you had cast an {@spell identify} spell on it.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Magesight

prerequisite.other: {@feat Ritual Collector|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Mage Slayer|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Planar Disruptor|TalentTreesMod}

entries: You can spend 1 minute opening your senses to the magic around you. When this minute ends, your senses are enhanced as if you had cast the {@spell detect magic} spell, except that your vision can penetrate twice the thickness of material as normal and if you spend the full 10-minute duration of the spell examining the aura of a magical item, you also learn its properties as if you had cast an {@spell identify} spell on it.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Magic Adept
entries: You learn one {@filter 2nd-level spell|spells|level=2} from the same list as the one from Magic Initiate. You can cast the spell once at its lowest level, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as that for the class you chose for {@feat Apprentice|TalentTreesMod}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Magic Initiate (Expanded)
entries: Choose a class: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Witcher, or Wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class spell list.
In addition, choose one 1st-level spell from that same list. Using this feat, you can cast the spell once at its lowest level, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it again.
Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for Bard, Sorcerer, or Warlock; Wisdom for Cleric or Druid; or Intelligence for Witcher or Wizard.

name: Magic Initiate
entries: You learn one more cantrip of your choice from the class you chose for {@feat Apprentice|TalentTrees}. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell from that same list. You learn that spell and can cast it at its lowest level. Once you cast it, you must finish a long rest before you can cast it again. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the same as that for the class you chose for {@feat Apprentice|TalentTrees}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Magic Initiate
entries: You learn one more cantrip of your choice from the class you chose for {@feat Apprentice|TalentTreesMod}, or you choose the class now if you opted to skip {@feat Apprentice|TalentTreesMod}. In addition, choose one {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1} from that same list. You can cast the spell once at its lowest level, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spells is the same as that for the class you chose for {@feat Apprentice|TalentTreesMod}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Magic Initiate (Wychlaran)
entries: You've learned some of a wychlaran's magic; this magic is heightened while in Rashemen.

items: You learn one cantrip and one 1st-level spell of your choice from the wychlaran spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
You can cast this feat's 1st-level spell without aspell slot. You must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

Once per long rest, while in Rashemen, you can cast any 1st-level spell from the wychlaran spelllist. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell. If you are part of a wychlaran's communal binding when you cast this spell, the spell can be cast at 2nd level instead.

name: Magic Initiate
entries: Choose a class: {@filter bard|spells|level=0;1|class=bard|source=yastah}, {@filter cleric|spells|level=0;1|class=cleric|source=yastah}, {@filter druid|spells|level=0;1|class=druid|source=yastah}, {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=0;1|class=sorcerer|source=yastah}, {@filter warlock|spells|level=0;1|class=warlock|source=yastah}, or {@filter wizard|spells|level=0;1|class=wizard|source=yastah}. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list.
In addition, choose one 1st-level spell from that same list. You learn that spell and can cast it at its lowest level. Once you cast it, you must finish a long rest before you can cast it again.

Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for {@filter bard|spells|level=0;1|class=bard|source=yastah}, {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=0;1|class=sorcerer|source=yastah}, or {@filter warlock|spells|level=0;1|class=warlock|source=yastah}; Wisdom for {@filter cleric|spells|level=0;1|class=cleric|source=yastah} or {@filter druid|spells|level=0;1|class=druid|source=yastah}; or Intelligence for {@filter wizard|spells|level=0;1|class=wizard|source=yastah}.

name: Magic of the Blade
entries: You have the power to synchronise magic and swordplay, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn two cantrips that require you to make an unarmed strike or melee attack with a weapon you're holding as part of casting the spell. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

name: Magic of the Dryads
entries: You learn the ancient magic of the dryads, for which your people have a natural talent. You learn the {@spell thorn whip} spell and can cast it at-will, without expending a spell slot. You also learn {@spell barkskin} and {@spell pass without trace}, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast those two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

otherSummary.entry: Access to spell slots of 3rd level or higher

items: When you cast a spell and you are adjacent to another spellcaster with this feat, you can use spell slots of the adjacent spell caster to fuel your spell (provided they are willing). If you do so, choose one of the following:
One of the two spellcasters, spends the appropriate level of spell slot for the spell. If it is a concentration spell, you must maintain it, and your spellcasting DC is taken into account.
Both spellcasters spend the appropriate (same) level of the spell. The spell then is upcasted 1 level higher. You choose which spellcasting DC is taken into account and who is concentrating on it.

name: Magic-Empowered Strikes

prerequisite.other: {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} or {@feat Improved Beast Shape|Adventurer}, 5th level

entries: Your unarmed strikes and attacks in beast form count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

If you have the {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} feat, you also gain the ability to interfere with the ki in an opponent's body. When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Ki Save DC or be {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn.

name: Magical Bond
entries: The bond between you and your companion transcends material limits, and takes on a magical strength.

items: You learn the find familiar spell if you don't already know it.

Instead of choosing a creature from the find familiar spell's list, you can instead choose a willing companion whose Bond Strength with you is 12 or higher. The creature retains the statistics, type, and appearance it had before the spell was cast. If you cast the spell on another creature, or change its form, the companion instead loses the benefits from the spell. If it is in a demiplane when you do this, it appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.
Your familiar's maximum hit points are increased by a number equal to your caster level.

name: Magical Bond
entries: The bond between you and your companion transcends material limits, and takes on a magical strength.

items: You learn the find familiar spell if you don't already know it.

Instead of choosing a creature from the find familiar spell's list, you can instead choose a willing companion whose Bond Strength with you is 12 or higher. The creature retains the statistics, type, and appearance it had before the spell was cast. If you cast the spell on another creature, or change its form, the companion instead loses the benefits from the spell. If it is in a demiplane when you do this, it appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.
Your familiar's maximum hit points are increased by a number equal to your caster level.

name: Magical Intuition
entries: Whenever you see a creature cast a spell, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. You can tell if the creature's spellcasting abilities are superior, inferior, or equal in power to your own. Additionally, you can spend 1 minute examining a {@item spell scroll} to determine the level of the spell it contains and its school of magic, regardless of if you could cast the spell from the scroll.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Magical Intuition
entries: Whenever you see a creature cast a spell, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. You can tell if the creature's spellcasting abilities are superior, inferior, or equal in power to your own. Additionally, you can spend 1 minute examining a {@item spell scroll} to determine the level of the spell it contains and its school of magic, regardless of if you could cast the spell from the scroll.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Magically Gifted
entries: A quirk of ancestry or a touch of extraplanar power has gifted you with the ability to manipulate the weave in ways your peers cannot. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain one metamagic option of your choice from among those available to the {@class Sorcerer}.

If you have sorcery points, you add one more to your existing pool (regardless of when you gain them); otherwise, you have one sorcery point. This sorcery point is used to fuel your metamagic. A sorcery point is expended when you use it. You regain your expended sorcery point when you finish a long rest.

name: Magically Mischievous
entries: You've picked up a few magical tricks that assist your nefarious skills. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Sleight of Hand} skill. If you already have proficiency, you gain expertise instead, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it.

When you succeed on a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check to steal something, you can magically turn the object you stole {@condition invisible} as part of the same action, as if you had cast the {@spell Obscure Object|ObojimaTallGrass} spell. The object must be small enough to fit in the palm of your hand, and this effect lasts for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Magitechnician
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magic Item Expert
entries: If one of your magic items calls for a saving throw, it uses the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Magic Item Recharge
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can cause a magic item that regains charges or properties to recharge as if it were the next dawn. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Magitechnician
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magic Item Expert
entries: If one of your magic items calls for a saving throw, it uses the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Magic Item Recharge
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can cause a magic item that regains charges or properties to recharge as if it were the next dawn. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Magic Item Expert
entries: If one of your magic items calls for a saving throw, it uses the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Magic Item Recharge
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can cause a magic item that regains charges or properties to recharge as if it were the next dawn. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Major Invention
entries: You further hone your skill in constructing magic items. You can spend an amount of gold equivalent to half the cost of the item and 24 hours of total time, not necessarily continuous, working to create an item from the following list: {@item boots of striding and springing}, {@item bracers of archery}, {@item brooch of shielding}, {@item broom of flying}, {@item hat of disguise}, {@item slippers of spider climbing}.
Additionally, the cost of crafting a magic item using the Moderate Invention feat is halved, and you can ignore the cost of crafting a magic item using the Minor Invention feat.
Your DM may allow you to craft different magic items, but may specify required skill checks in order craft them.

name: Malware Master
entries: You have spent hours studying and creating malware, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@item hacking tools|MH}.
You can add half your proficiency bonus to the malware DC. In addition, you count as two characters for purposes of reducing the time it takes to create malware.

name: Mana Imbuement
entries: You can use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of weapons. When you use Intelligence in this way, add your Proficiency Bonus to the weapon's base damage.

name: Mantle of the Sun
entries: You are a paragon of the Avia-Ra, and your faith in the sun never wavers. You can't gain this feat if you have the Nonbeliever feat. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use a bonus action to undergo a divine transformation, which lasts for 1 minute. Once you use this transformation, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest. You can invest this divine power in one of the following abilities:

items.name: Aura
entries: You manifest a radiant aura, which sheds bright light in a radius of 10 feet, and dim light for an additional 10 feet. Additionally, each creature you choose which comes within 5 feet of you or begins its turn in that area takes {@damage 1d8} radiant damage.

items.name: Shield
entries: You manifest a glorious shield of crimson energy and your Armor Class increases by 2 if you aren't wielding a shield. You have resistance to fire, necrotic, and radiant damage.

items.name: Wings
entries: You manifest luminous, incorporeal wings and a sunlike disk appears behind your head. These wings grant you a flight speed of 30 feet.

name: Mãos Leves
entries: O personagem tem uma destreza manual excepcional.
{@b Beneficio:} Seu personagem tem Vantagem em todos os testes de {@skill Sleight of Hand}.

name: Map Master
entries: You have studied the art of cartography and are an expert in its practice. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item cartographer's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
Copying an existing map takes you half as much time.
While drawing a map, you can simultaneously draw a second copy of it without spending any extra time.

name: Marauder
entries: You are adept at skirting the edge of the front lines of the battlefield, mixing close-quarters combat and flanking tactics.

items: When you use the Attack action and make an attack with a melee weapon that you're holding in one hand, you can use a bonus action to make an attack with a one-handed ranged weapon in your other hand. Alternatively, when you use the Attack action and make an attack with a ranged weapon you're holding in one hand, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with a one-handed weapon in your other hand.
When a creature within 10 feet of you that you can see makes an opportunity attack, you can use your reaction to make the attack automatically miss.
You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

name: Marid Heritage
entries: You manifest more of the magical power of your marid heritage. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell detect magic} spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot.
You have resistance to cold damage.

name: Mariner
entries: You have spent time at sea and learned to use the tools of a mariner in combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have a swimming speed equal to your base walking speed.
When a creature provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against that creature with a net.
When you make a ranged attack with a net, you do not have disadvantage for being within 5 feet of a hostile creature or creatures.
When you wield a trident with one hand, its damage die changes to 1d8 from 1d6. When you wield a trident with two hands, its damage die changes to 1d10 from 1d8.
Tridents count as having the reach property for you.

name: Mariner
entries: You have spent time at sea and learned to use the tools of a mariner in combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have a swimming speed equal to your base walking speed.
When a creature provokes an {@action opportunity attack} from you, you can use your reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against that creature with a net.
When you make a ranged attack with a net, you do not have disadvantage due to being within 5 feet of hostile creatures.
When you wield a trident with one hand, its damage die changes to 1d8 from 1d6. When you wield a trident with two hands, its damage die changes to 1d10 from 1d8.
Tridents count as having the reach property for you.

name: Mark of Handling
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Wild Intuition
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) or Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Primal Connection
entries: You always have the {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} and {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).
When you reach character level 3, you can target a Beast when you cast {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB}.

entries.name: Monstrous Connections
entries: When you reach character level 3, you can target a Monstrosity when you cast {@spell Animal Friendship|XPHB} or {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} if the creature's Intelligence score is 3 or lower.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Handling Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

name: Mark of Healing
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Medical Intuition
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check or an ability check using a {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Healing Touch
entries: You always have the {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).
When you reach character level 3, you also always have the {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it the same way.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Healing Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

entries.caption: Mark of Healing Spells
rows: {@spell Aura of Vitality|XPHB}, {@spell Mass Healing Word|XPHB}
{@spell Aura of Life|XPHB}, {@spell Aura of Purity|XPHB}

name: Mark of Hospitality
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ever Hospitable
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check or an ability check using {@item Brewer's Supplies|XPHB} or {@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB}, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Innkeeper's Magic
entries: You always have the {@spell Purify Food and Drink|XPHB} and {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB} spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).
When you reach character level 3, you also always have the {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it the same way

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Hospitality Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

entries.caption: Mark of Hospitality Spells
rows: {@spell Prayer of Healing|XPHB} ({@spell Fortifying Feast|BakerKanon}*), {@spell Rope Trick|XPHB}*
{@spell Create Food and Water|XPHB}*, {@spell Leomund's Tiny Hut|XPHB}
{@spell Aura of Purity|XPHB}, {@spell Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound|XPHB}*

name: Mark of Making
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Artisan's Intuition
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check or an ability check using {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB}, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Spellsmith
entries: You know the {@spell Mending|XPHB} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Magic Weapon|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Making Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

name: Mark of Passage
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Courier's Speed
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Intuitive Motion
entries: When you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Magical Passage
entries: You always have the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Passage Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

name: Mark of Scribing
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Gifted Scribe
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill History|XPHB}) check or an ability check using {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Cartographer's Tools|XPHB}, or a {@item Forgery Kit|XPHB}, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Scribe's Insight
entries: You know the {@spell Sivis Sigil|BakerKanon} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Comprehend Languages|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. When you reach character level 3, you also always have the {@spell Whispering Wind|BakerKanon} spell prepared and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Tool Proficiency
entries: Choose one of the following tools: {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Cartographer's Tools|XPHB}, or {@item Forgery Kit|XPHB}. If you lack proficiency with the chosen tool, you gain proficiency with it. If you already have proficiency with the chosen tool or gain it from another source in the future, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} with it.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Scribing Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

name: Mark of Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Sentinel's Intuition
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB} or {@skill Perception|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Guardian's Shield
entries: You always have the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Vigilant Guardian
entries: When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to swap places with that creature, and you are hit by the attack instead. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Sentinel Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

name: Mark of Shadow
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cunning Intuition
entries: When you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) or Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Shape Shadows
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Shadow Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

name: Mark of the Accursed Archive
entries: You have been touched by the ruinous power of the Accursed
Archive, and its secrets have granted you power. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to unleash a bloodcurdling scream. Choose a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you that can hear you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. If they fail, they are {@condition frightened} until the start of your next turn.
You can cast {@spell dark secret|COFSA} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries: You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Ashen Wolf
entries: You have been scarred by the power of the Ashen Wolf, and its fiery might burns within your soul. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage, you can choose to have it deal fire damage instead of the normal type.

You can cast {@spell hunter's pace|COFSA} once as a 2nd-level spell without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Blackthorn Grove
entries: You have been blessed by the Blackthorn, and it grants you strength and cunning. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you are adjacent to a corpse, you can touch it as an action to remove its heart. While you are holding the heart of a creature, you can crush it as a bonus action to gain advantage on your next attack roll or ability check.
You can cast {@spell heartripper|COFSA} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Currency Conspiracy
entries: You've been marked as a person of interest by the Conspiracy, though you may not know it. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are holding an item, you can mark it with an {@condition invisible} rune as a bonus action. While the item is marked and on the same plane as you, you always know the direction and distance to it. The rune can be removed as an action by any creature that can see it.
You can cast {@spell sinister threat|COFSA} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Eternal Citadel
entries: You've stood within the radiant light of the Eternal Citadel, and it has granted you power. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you are within 10 feet of a friendly creature and it takes damage, you can use your reaction take the {@action Search} action and then move up to 30 feet towards the source of the damage if you can perceive it.
You can cast {@spell lesser restoration} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Fallen Exile
entries: You've been marked by the Exile, causing the stars themselves to regard you with interest. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you can see the sky, you can use your bonus action to emit bright magical light in a radius of 60 feet, and dim light in a radius of 60 feet beyond that. The light continues to emit from you until you dismiss it as a bonus action or you go to a location where you can't see the sky.
You can cast {@spell augury} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Forbidden Graveyard
entries: You've stood on the border between life and death, and the experience has marked you. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you are reduced to 0 hit points, spectral apparitions surround you and strike out at your foes. Each hostile creature within 20 feet of you takes necrotic damage equal to your character level.
You can cast {@spell suffer|COFSA} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Gelatinous Ones
entries: You've been touched by the wiggly ooze of the Convocation, and it has marked you. You gain the following benefits:

items: As an action, you can touch an object and coat it in thick adhesive slime. The next time that object touches another object, it becomes bound to it as though by strong glue. The glue can be broken if a creature uses its action to make a Strength check with a DC equal to your Charisma score. Once broken, the glue vanishes.
You can cast {@spell enlarge/reduce} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Gray Portrait
entries: You've created an artwork of incredible skill, marking yourself among the great artists. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you create an artwork, you can choose to imbue it with a figment of motion. The art will move realistically as though alive, following a pattern that you have predetermined upon its creation.
You can cast {@spell mirror image} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Keeper of the Depths
entries: Your flesh has been marked by the eldritch tentacles of the Keeper of the Depths. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can breathe normally in water, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. If you already have either of these benefits, your swimming speed is doubled.
You can cast {@spell devilish hunt|COFSA} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Perfect Chord
entries: You are blessed by the eternal song of the Perfect Chord, for it has marked your soul. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you cast a spell, you can choose a 5-foot cube within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, the area within that cube is magically silenced.
You can cast {@spell shatter} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Serpent Empress
entries: You bear the imperial mark of the Empress, either willingly or as a curse. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you take damage from a spell, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to {@dice 1d6} + your character level.
You can cast {@spell command} once without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Shadowcat
entries: Your nightmares now bow to you, for the Shadowcat's mark is upon your soul. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you take the {@action Hide} action and successfully become undetected, you can move normally up to 30 feet before losing the benefits of being hidden.
You can cast {@spell duskwalk|COFSA} once without using a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Storm Lord
entries: Your flesh has been scarred by the thunderous power of the Storm Lord. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you cast a spell as an action, you gain the benefits of the {@action Dash} action, and your jumping height and distance are doubled until the start of your next turn.
You can cast {@spell feather fall} once without using a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. You can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mark of the Warrior-Saint
entries: You have been blessed by the Warrior-Saint, as it has noted your devotion to balance. You gain the following benefits:
