items: You suffer the effects of {@condition exhaustion} as if you had one level less than you do. If you have 6 levels of {@condition exhaustion} and you would gain an additional level, you die.

When you finish a {@quickref resting|phb|2|0|short rest}{@sup {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|'24}}, you can choose to remove a level of {@condition exhaustion}. Once you do, you can't use this ability again until you finish a {@quickref resting||2|0|long rest}{@sup {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB|'24}}.
You learn the mold earth XGE cantrip. Your choice of one of the ability scores associated with your mote or anima subrace is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

name: Minor Alchemy

prerequisite.other: {@feat Spellbook|Adventurer} (School of Transmutation) or {@feat Acolyte: Forge|Adventurer}, 2nd Level

entries: You can temporarily alter the physical properties of one nonmagical object, changing it from one substance into another. You perform a special alchemical procedure on one object composed entirely of wood, stone (but not a gemstone), iron, copper, or silver, transforming it into a different one of those materials. For each 10 minutes you spend performing the procedure, you can transform up to 1 cubic foot of material. After 1 hour, or until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell), the material reverts to its original substance.

name: Minor Beast Shape
entries: You gain the ability to transform into beasts of CR 0 without expending a use of your Beast Shape. If you select the {@feat Improved Beast Shape|Adventurer} feat multiple times, the CR of beasts you can freely transform into increases to CR 1/8 after the second time, CR 1/4 after the third time, CR 1/2 the fourth time, CR 1 the fifth time, and CR 2 the sixth time.
If you have the Greater Favored Enemy feat, you can transform into creatures of your favored enemy type as well as beasts.

name: Minor Conjuration
entries: You can use your action to conjure up an inanimate object in your hand or on the ground in an unoccupied space that you can see within 10 feet of you. This object can be no larger than 3 feet on a side and weigh no more than 10 pounds, and its form must be that of a nonmagical object that you have seen. The object is visibly magical, radiating dim light out to 5 feet.
The object disappears after 1 hour, when you use this feature again, if it takes any damage, or if it deals any damage.

name: Minor Corruption
entries: You were exposed to the Corruption, a dark magic that's poisoning the island. It's now begun to alter you as well. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you have less than half of your hit points remaining.

You can draw upon the Corruption within you to channel your magical power. You don't need to use a spellcasting focus for your spells, allowing you to ignore the material components specified for the spell, unless the component indicates a cost or is consumed by the spell.

As a reaction, when you take damage, you can temporarily negate an amount of the damage equal to three times your level; you take any excess damage as normal. At the end of your next turn, you must make a Constitution saving throw, the DC of which is equal to 10 or one-third the damage you would have taken, whichever number is higher. On a failed save, you immediately take the negated damage. You must continue to make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of your turns for 1 minute or until you fail the save, at which point you take the negated damage. Once you take this reaction, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Minor Invention
entries: You learn the secrets of the constructing magic items. You can spend an amount of gold equivalent to half the cost of the item and 24 hours of total time, not necessarily continuous, working to create an item from the following list: {@item bag of holding}, {@item cap of water breathing}, {@item driftglobe}, {@item goggles of night}, {@item sending stones}, {@item alchemy jug}, {@item helm of comprehending languages}, {@item lantern of revealing}, {@item ring of swimming}, {@item obe of useful items}, {@item rope of climbing}, {@item wand of magic detection}, {@item wand of secrets}.
Your DM may allow you to craft different magic items, but may specify required skill checks in order craft them.

name: Minor Ki Control
entries: You managed to tap on the surface of the power that is ki by connecting with your inner self and the flow of energy in your surroundings.

You gain two ki features of your choice from the monk class, which follow the restrictions described in the Ki Rules and Restrictions section of the feature. Your Martial Arts die for these features is a d6. If a ki feature you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist its effects, the save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier. If the ki feature has a prerequisite of any kind, you can choose it only if you're a monk that meets them.
Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these feat's ki features with another one from the monk class.

You gain 2 ki points to spend on ki features (these points are added to any ki points you have from another source, but can be used only on ki features). You regain all expended ki points when you finish a short or long rest that you spent meditating uninterrupted for at least half of its duration.

name: Minor Pact
entries: You gain the first two available Tiers of the Minor Pact Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Minor Pact Feat:}
{@b Choose Between:}

name: Miracle Worker
entries: You have trained to disguise your spell casting and make others believe that the things happening around you have nothing to do with you.
You gain a proficiency in both {@skill Sleight of hand} and {@i Ventriloquism} that can be used when casting as an {@i opposed roll} against another's {@skill perception}.

entries.name: Cantrip Cover
entries: You can cast a {@i cantrip} at the same time as your spell to disguise what you are doing. You must be able to cast a {@i cantrip} and choose what you are doing to cover the act of casting. {@i Exact results are up to your DM}

entries.name: Sourceless effects
entries: You can make any ranged spell you cast originate from the point of impact.

entries.name: Snapshot cantrip
entries: As a bonus action before your main action you can choose to cast a cantrip that shows a static illusion of the target of your spell and their surroundings.
This illusion can be no greater than a 10 ft. cube and will last 30 seconds or until another snapshot or illusion cantrip is cast.

name: Mirror Magic
entries: Whenever you see a creature cast a spell, as a reaction you may attempt to cast the same spell. Make an Intelligence (arcana) check, the DC is equal to 12 + the spell's level. If the creature that cast the spell is friendly to you, the DC is 10 + the spell's level instead. On a success you know what spell they cast. If it had a casting time of 1 action, 1 bonus action or 1 reaction, you may expend a spell slot of the same level as that spell and cast it as if you knew the spell or had it prepared. You cast this spell immediately after the spell you are copying is cast. You must provide any components required for the casting.
Once you've cast a spell this way, you may not do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Misfit's Adaptation
entries: Your body continues to change in unexpected ways. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Constitution or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Choose one individual feature from a {@filter morph category|optionalfeatures|source=TheDemiDragon|feature type=morph} available to the {@class demi-dragon|TheDemiDragon|Embodiment of the Metamorph|Metamorph|TheDemiDragon|2-0}. You gain the chosen effect, which is permanent. If you already had access to morphs and have learned the associated morph category, you can choose whether to change this or your other Waning morph whenever you change morphs.

name: Mixed Emotions
entries: Pick a Fallen subrace you didn't choose at character creation. You gain the traits from the subrace chosen with this feat.
Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace this feat's subrace with another one from the Fallen race that you don't have.

name: Mobile
entries: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your speed increases by 10 feet.
When you use the {@action Dash} action, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.
When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

name: Mobile Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Slippery
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet and {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you until the end of your turn.

name: Moderate Invention
entries: You hone your skill in constructing magic items. You can spend an amount of gold equivalent to half the cost of the item and 24 hours of total time, not necessarily continuous, working to create an item from the following list: {@item bag of beans}, {@item chime of opening}, {@item decanter of endless water}, {@item eyes of minute seeing}, {@item folding boat}, {@item Heward's handy haversack}.
Additionally, the cost of crafting a magic item using the Minor Invention feat is halved.
Your DM may allow you to craft different magic items, but may specify required skill checks in order craft them.

name: Moderately Armored
entries: You have trained to master the use of medium armor and shields, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Modified Servant
entries: Choose one of the following modifications for your {@feat clockwork servant|Adventurer}. You can make one modification over a long rest, costing 50 gp worth of metal scraps. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, must choose a different modifications.

entries.name: Swarm Servant
entries: You craft a swarm of miniature clockwork servants. Your servant can take the form of any swarm of beasts under the CR restrictions from the {@feat Clockwork Servant|Adventurer} feat. As a swarm, your servant cannot benefit from any other modifications.

entries.name: Artificial Wings
entries: You attach a set of mechanical wings to your clockwork servant. Your clockwork servant gains a flying speed of 30 feet. If it already has a flying speed, its flying speed is increased by 10 feet.

entries.name: Seaworthy
entries: You attach aquatic propulsion to your clockwork servant. Your clockwork servant gains a swimming speed equal to its walking speed. If it already has a swimming speed, its swimming speed is increased by 10 feet. If you have the Cockpit modification, the cockpit becomes hermetically sealed, creating a pocket of air inside.

entries.name: Cockpit
entries: You create a compartment in your clockwork servant, allowing creatures to ride inside it. The cockpit space your servant provides is tied to its size. It can fit one creature of a size category smaller than it inside, or four creatures of two size categories smaller. While you are inside your servant, you have 3/4ths cover against attacks and other effects outside of your servant, and your movement speed is reduced to 0. You can get in and out of the cockpit just as you would mount or dismount a steed.

entries.name: Reinforced
entries: You attach armor plating to your clockwork servant, increasing its armor class by 2.

entries.name: Language Module
entries: Your clockwork servant gains the ability to speak any languages it understands.

entries.name: Integrated Weapon
entries: You attach a weapon to your clockwork servant, allowing it to use it in combat. Your servant is proficient with the attached weapon if you are proficient with it.

name: Monastic Weapon Training
entries: Choose one melee and one ranged weapon that lacks the heavy and special properties. The longbow is also a valid choice. You gain proficiency with these weapons if you don't already have it. You gain the following benefits while wielding one of those weapons:

items: When you use the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls for these weapons.
You can use abilities granted to you by the {@feat Martial Arts|Adventurer} feat as if you were unarmed.

entries: If you have the {@feat Magic-Empowered Strikes|Adventurer} feat, its benefits also extend to your chosen weapons.

name: Monster Hunter
entries: When attacking a non-humanoid creature, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls against that creature.

name: Monsterbane
entries: Choose one type of creature: beasts, dragons, or monstrosities. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature of the chosen type, you can add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1) to the damage.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Monsterbane
entries: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a beast, dragon, or monstrosity, you can add {@damage 1d6} to the damage with a minimum equal to your Intelligence modifier.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You count as being permanently affected by the magic fang cantrip (page 144).

Once per turn, if you move at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked prone.

name: Moon-Touched
entries: Your connection to the moon and its otherworldly radiance grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Moon Magic
entries: You know your choice of the {@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB} or {@spell Light|XPHB} cantrip. Choose one level 1 spell that creates or emits light, such as {@spell Color Spray|XPHB} or {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, from the Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard spell lists. You always have that spell and the {@spell Moonbeam} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Moonspeaker
entries: You call to the moon to entice your lycanthropic ancestors to further enhance your shifting abilities. You gain the following benefits:

items: Choose a shifter subrace other than your own. When you shift, you also gain the benefits of its Shifting Feature, in addition to your own.
If you are conscious when your shifting trait ends, you regain a number of hit points equal to your Constitution score, up to your hit point maximum, instead of your Constitution modifier.

name: Moonspeaker
entries: Your connection to the sacred moon has blessed you with great power. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a climbing speed or a swimming speed equal to your walking speed (your choice).
Choose one other subrace of shifter besides your own. While you are shifted, you gain the benefits of that subrace's Shifting Feature trait in addition to your own.

name: Morning Star Expert
entries: You have mastered the use of a morning star, and are able to leverage greater effectiveness from it. You gain the following features:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Strength or Constitution ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Improved Critical.} Your attacks with morning stars score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

{@b Rend.} Your critical strikes wound the target. The target loses 1d10 hit points at the end of each of their turns until the wound is healed. The target or any creature within 5 feet of it can make a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check as an action to heal the wound.

name: Motes of Mischief
entries: Taking a leaf from your pixie cousins, you have concocted fresh fun and mischief to be spread by the magic of your fairy dust. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can cast the {@spell sleep|PHB} spell at 2nd-level, targeting only those creatures within 5 feet of a light created by your {@spell dancing lights|PHB} cantrip that can see it. Once you cast the spell in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

When you cast {@spell levitate|PHB} using your Fairy Dust feature, you can turn one creature affected by the spell {@spell invisible|PHB} for the duration. The invisibility ends if the target attacks, casts a spell, or touches the ground. Any equipment the creature wears or carries is invisible with it.

name: Mountain Mover
entries: Your strength and resilience rivals the giants that roam your homeland. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

As an action, you can pick up a large boulder or rip a chunk of natural stone out of the ground and make the attack with it. The boulder is a simple melee weapon with the thrown property. It has a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, and on a hit, it deals bludgeoning damage equal to 2d6 + your Strength modifier. A creature struck by this boulder must make a Strength saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Mountain Mover
entries: Your strength and reslience rivals the giants that roam your homeland. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

As an action, you can pick up a large boulder or rip a chunk of natural stone out of the ground and make the attack with it. The boulder is a simple melee weapon with the thrown property. It has a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, and on a hit, it deals bludgeoning damage equal to {@dice 2d6} + your Strength modifier. A creature struck by this boulder must make a Strength saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked {@condition prone}. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Mountain's Endurance
entries: Your ability to shrug off some injuries is legendary, even for your race. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use your Stone's Endurance trait as a reaction to reduce damage, instead of rolling a d12 and adding your Constitution modifier, you can choose to gain resistance to the triggering attack's damage type until the start of your next turn. If the triggering attack deals more than one type of damage, choose one. As normal, after you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mountain's Endurance
entries: Your ability to shrug off some injuries is legendary, even for your race. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use your Stone's Endurance trait as a reaction to reduce damage, instead of rolling a {@dice d12} and adding your Constitution modifier, you can choose to gain resistance to the triggering attack's damage type until the start of your next turn. If the triggering attack deals more than one type of damage, choose one. As normal, after you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mountaineer
entries: You have mastered the art of mountaineering and climbing.

items: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws to avoid falling or being knocked {@condition prone}.
You ignore the first 30 feet of a fall when determining falling damage.

name: Mounted Adept
entries: You are a creative, learning a variety of artistic crafts. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with two artisan's tools of your choice. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

name: Mounted Combat
entries: While mounted, you have advantage on melee weapon attack and melee spell attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Mounted Combat
entries: While mounted, you have advantage on melee weapon attack and melee spell attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Mounted Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Mounted Combatant Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Mounted Combatant Feat:}

name: Mounted Combatant
entries: You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted. While you are mounted and aren't {@condition incapacitated}, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.
You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

name: Mounted Leap
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Equestrian Prowess
entries: While you're riding a mount, that mount's jump distance is doubled.

entries.name: Leaping Charge Attack
entries: While jumping from a moving mount, your jump distance is calculated using the mount's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} in place of yours (if its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is better than yours). If you make a successful melee attack roll against a creature after jumping, choose one of the following effects: gain a {@dice 1d8} bonus to the attack's damage roll, or make the target have the {@condition Prone} condition if the target is one size category larger than you or smaller. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

name: Mounted Mage
entries: You are trained in the use of magic from horseback. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in Animal Handling.
When you cast a spell targeting yourself while mounted, you can also affect your mount with the spell.
While mounted, you have advantage on melee spell attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.

While mounted, if your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

name: Mugger
entries: Your deft hands allow you to steal from and plant objects on a target whenever you attack. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with the {@skill Sleight of Hand} skill.

Whenever you hit with a melee attack while you are within 5 feet of the target the attack, you can make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check against the target's Passive {@skill Perception} as a part of the attack to attempt to steal something from or plant something on the target. On a success, you steal an item from, or plant an object on the target. The object must be small enough to be carried in one hand and cannot be something the target is wearing or wielding. If the attack is a critical hit, you make the {@skill Sleight of Hand} check with advantage.

name: Mul
entries: One of your parents was a human and the other was a dwarf. Such a pairing is unlikely to have produced offspring, but you have defied the odds to join the ranks of the sturdy and resilient muls. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Armor Acclimation
entries: Your speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor and you never have disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks as a result of wearing heavy armor.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

name: Multiattack Defense
entries: When an enemy hits you with an attack, you gain a +2 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.
If you have the {@feat Favored Enemy|Adventurer} feat and the creature is the type of your favored enemy, you gain a +4 bonus to AC instead.

name: Multidisciplinary
entries: You are adept at pulling from different disciplines to employ a variety of tactics both in battle and outside it. When you take this feat, and each time you gain your 1st level in a new class, choose one of the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in one skill and one type of artisan's tools of your choice.
Choose one saving throw proficiency that the class you have multiclassed into normally provides at 1st level. You become proficient in that saving throw.

name: Multiscale
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dual Ancestry
entries: Choose a second Draconic Ancestry option. The color of your scales reflect both of your dragon ancestors. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the damage type associated with both ancestries, and can use either damage type for your Breath Weapon.

entries.name: Improved Breath Weapon
entries: Your Breath Weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d10} damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry.

name: Multitasking
entries: You have trained to compartmentalise your mind and concentrate on multiple things at once.
You can use your bonus action to concentrate on a second task while maintaining background concentration on a first task.
While holding a second concentration, your movement is halved and you have {@i disadvantage} on any physical actions {@i (Any roll that involves using your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution.)}
Anything that automatically breaks concentration will disrupt both tasks. Anything you roll to maintain concentration has to be rolled for each task separately.

You may take this feat a second time to enable three concentration tasks at once, however you must use your {@i action} to maintain the third task and your {@i movement} is reduced to 5 ft. while holding all three at once.

name: Musical Caster
entries: Gain the first two available Tiers of the Musical Caster feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Musical Caster Feat:}

items: You gain proficiency with one {@item musical instrument|phb} of your choice, or you choose a {@item musical instrument|phb} with which you already have proficiency and double your proficiency bonus for each ability check you make with it.

You may spend 10 minutes playing a song with a musical instrument. When you do so, choose up to four friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who hear you. Each creature gains a {@dice d4} Inspiration die. Once within the next hour, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the {@dice d20} before deciding to use the Inspiration die, but must decide before the DM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the Inspiration die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can't gain an Inspiration die from this feat again until it has finished a short or long rest. You may choose to do this as part of a short rest.

name: Musician
entries: You grant the following benefits

items.name: Instrument Training
items.entry: You gain proficiency in a Musical Instrument of your choice.

items.name: Inspiring Song
items.entry: As you finish a Long Rest or short rest, you can play a song on a Musical Instrument with which you have Tool Proficiency and give Inspiration to allies who hear the song and do not have any inspiration. The number of allies you can affect in this way equals your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Musician
entries: You are an expert with a {@item Musical Instrument|phb}.
Your extensive knowledge of music allow you to recognize from which realm or culture a melody is from.

During a long rest, you can play with your instrument to make the rest more agreeable. Pick up to six friendly creatures which can hear you, they regains two additional Hit Dice at the end of the long rest.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Myrmidon
entries: Like the heroes of ages past, you learn to fight unencumbered by armor, instead relying on your innate speed and agility to grant you the following benefits:

items: While unarmored, your Armor Class equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.
While unarmored, damage you take from nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage is reduced by an amount equal to your Dexterity modifier.

name: Mystic Conflux
entries: Through your repeated exposure to the natural flow of arcane magic throughout Exandria, you've adapted to attune with additional enchantments, though the process can be physically taxing. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) checks when investigating the nature of a magical object or device.
You can now be attuned to a maximum of four magical items, rather than the normal limit of three. Other attunement limitations still apply.

name: Mystic Conflux
entries: You possess an intuitive understanding of the way magic ebbs and flows within enchanted items. Such items attune easily to you, and you are able to sound out their secrets. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
You can cast the {@spell identify} spell without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest} before you can do so again.

name: Mystic Evasion
entries: The glimmering veil of the Flittermarsh quickens your flight and misdirects attackers. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, up to a maximum of 20
You gain advantage on saving throws against falling {@condition prone} while flying.

When a creature you can see hits you with a ranged attack while flying, you can use your reaction to gain a bonus to AC against that attack, potentially it to miss you. The bonus is equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Mystic Warrior
entries: You have mastered Mystical Techniques which allow you to perform supernatural feats. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Mystic Ki
entries: You gain a pool of 2 Ki, which you can spend to use the Mystic Techniques you know. You regain all expended Ki when you finish a short or long rest. If you already have Ki from another source, this Ki is added to that pool of Ki.

entries.name: Techniques Known
entries: You learn two {@filter Techniques|optionalfeatures|feature type=llam:t} from the {@loader Alternate Monk|class/LaserLlama; Alternate Monk.json} class. You must meet any prerequisites they have, including Monk level. If a Technique uses a Martial Arts Die, you use a {@dice d4}, unless you have a higher Martial Arts Die.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: If a Technique requires a saving throw, its DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Wisdom modifeir.

name: Nakudama's Electric Bloodline
entries: Although it's uncommon in today's day and age, some Nakudama are able to awaken the now dormant skills held by their warring ancestors. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to lightning damage.

You have an electrified tongue that you can use to make unarmed strikes. It has the finesse and reach properties, and when you hit with it, the strike deals lightning damage equal to {@dice 1d6} + your Strength or Dexterity modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. The damage from your tongue increases when you reach 5th level ({@dice 1d8}), 11th level ({@dice 1d10}), and 17th level ({@dice 1d12}).

When you become {@condition grappled} by a creature, you can use your reaction to force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d10} lightning damage and the grapple ends.

name: Nakudama's Toxin Bloodline
entries: Although it's uncommon in today's day and age, some Nakudama are able to awaken the now dormant skills held by their warring ancestors. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to poison damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

You can cause your cheeks to swell and bubble out as your mouth fills with liquid poison. As an action, you can spit several globs of poison in quick succession, targeting a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus. Each target must be within 30 feet of you and must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). A target takes poison damage equal to {@dice 1d8} + your proficiency bonus on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Natural Defiance
entries: You know how to avoid natural ambushers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You cant be surprised by plants or oozes and you have advantage on saving throws against them.
If a plant or ooze would score a critical hit against you, it instead becomes a regular hit.
Once per turn, when you deal damage to a plant or ooze, you can add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1) to the damage.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Natural Defiance
entries: You know how to avoid natural ambushers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You cant be surprised by plants or oozes and you have advantage on saving throws against them.
If a plant or ooze would score a critical hit against you, it instead becomes a regular hit.
Once per turn, when you deal damage to a plant or ooze, you can add {@damage 1d6} to the damage with a minimum equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Natural Explorer
entries: You become skilled at navigating the wilderness, and gain the following benefits:

items: You ignore difficult terrain.
If you are leading your group, difficult terrain doesn't slow your group's travel out of combat.
Your group can't become lost except by magical means.
Even when you are engaged in another activity while traveling (such as foraging, navigating, or tracking), you remain alert to danger.
If you are traveling alone, you can move stealthily at a normal pace.
When you forage, you find twice as much food as you normally would.
While tracking other creatures, you also learn their exact number, their sizes, and how long ago they passed through the area.

name: Natural Ferocity
entries: You've grown used to using your body as the weapon it was meant to be. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two {@filter maneuvers|optionalfeatures|source=TheDemiDragon|feature type=MV:J} of your choice from among those available to the {@class demi-dragon|TheDemiDragon|Embodiment of the Juggernaut|Juggernaut|TheDemiDragon|2-0} archetype. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. If the maneuver makes use of a {@item horns|TheDemiDragon} or {@item wings|TheDemiDragon} natural weapon, you add it to your list of natural weapons.

You gain 3 points of fury, as described under the Embodiment of the Juggernaut. You can spend them on any Juggernaut maneuver you know and which you can pay the fury cost for. If you already had fury, your total increases by 3. You regain your expended fury when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Natural Magnetism
entries: Something about your personality and bearing makes others want to be near you. You gain the benefits on the table below that correspond to your Charisma modifier and lower.
If your Charisma modifier increases, the benefits you gain from this Feat also increase with your Charisma modifier:

rows: You gain proficiency with one {@item gaming set|PHB} of your choice.
The first time you meet a Humanoid, they treat you as Friendly instead of Indifferent.
You gain proficiency in your choice of {@skill Performance}, {@skill Persuasion}, or {@skill Intimidation}.
Whenever you make a Persuasion check, you treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.
When you make a Wisdom saving throw, you can make a Charisma saving throw instead.

name: Natural Weapon Expert

otherSummary.entrySummary: Have one or more natural weapons

entries: You master the use of your natural weapons, granting you the following benefits:

items: {@b Ferocity.} As a bonus action, you can make a single weapon attack with your natural weapon.
{@b Natural Perfection.} Your natural weapon damage die increases to 1d6. If it is already 1d6 or greater, it increases by d2 (or one step higher), up to a maximum of 1d12.

prerequisite.other: Permanent Claws or Bite Natural Weapon

items: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you take the Attack action to attack with your claws, provided both your hands are free, you can make one attack with your claws as a bonus action that turn.

If you hit a target with your bite, you can use your bonus action to make a grapple check against it. While grappling a target with your bite this way, your bite has advantage on attack rolls against it.
Your natural weapons deal additional damage of the same type dealt by them equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Naturalist
entries: {@i 1st-Level Feat. Repeatable: No.}

entries.name: Taxonomist
entries: When rolling a Survival check to identify the remains of any beast, plant, or humanoid, any roll of a 1–9 is treated as a 10.

entries.name: Fieldwork
entries: You have expertise in Survival checks when tracking a beast.

entries.name: Functional Morphology
entries: The first time you encounter a beast that you have not seen before, you are able to discern either its AC, maximum hit points, or one resistance it has (your choice).

name: Naturalist
entries: Your extensive study of nature rewards you with the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You learn the {@spell druidcraft} and {@spell detect poison and disease} spells. You can cast {@spell detect poison and disease} once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.
You gain expertise in Riding, {@skill Nature} or {@skill Animal Handling}.
You can cast {@spell commune with nature}, {@spell beast sense} and {@spell locate animals or plants} once per long rest.
You gain proficiency with {@skill Nature} and {@skill Animal Handling}.
You can cast {@spell speak with animals} or {@spell speak with plants} a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Docile beasts consider you a friend.

name: Nature Sense
entries: Using just a branch, dowsing rod, magnetic needle, or other instruments and your knowledge of nature, you can divine details of your surroundings. By spending 10 minutes examining the signs and the environment around you, you can select one of the following options:

items.name: Local Weather and Time
entries: You predict the weather for the next 24 hours at your location, and learn whether it is in a season of drought, famine, feast, or flood. You must be able to see the sky.

items.name: Closest Water Source
entries: You learn the location of the closest source of clean freshwater within a mile of your location. This might be a stream, spring, water-collecting plant, or something else.

items.name: Residents
entries: You discern if the local plantlife or animals were tended by a {@class ranger}, {@class druid}, or a creature such as a {@creature dryad} within the last week.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Nature Sense
entries: Using just a branch, dowsing rod, magnetic needle, or other instruments and your knowledge of nature, you can divine details of your surroundings. By spending 10 minutes examining the signs and the environment around you, you can select one of the following options:

items.name: Local Weather and Time
entries: You predict the weather for the next 24 hours at your location, and learn whether it is in a season of drought, famine, feast, or flood. You must be able to see the sky.

items.name: Closest Water Source
entries: You learn the location of the closest source of clean freshwater within a mile of your location. This might be a stream, spring, water-collecting plant, or something else.

items.name: Residents
entries: You discern if the local plant life or animals were tended by a {@class ranger}, {@class druid}, or a creature such as a {@creature dryad} within the last week.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Nature's Bounty
entries: Your attunement to nature causes you to find more herbs wherever you go, almost as if nature itself is attempting to aid you. Whenever you gather a herb, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 20, you gain an extra copy of the herb you just gathered.

name: Naturecraft

prerequisite.other: {@feat Monsterbane|TalentTrees} or {@feat Natural Defiance|TalentTrees} or {@feat Metalurgist|TalentTrees}

entries: You can use the tools of an herbalist for a variety of purposes. By using 5 gps worth of common herbalist's supplies and spending at least 8 hours aquiring, preparing, and packing them into a kit, you can create an {@item herbalism kit|PHB} from scratch.
In addition to the other benefits an {@item herbalism kit|PHB} provides, you can spend 10 minutes to produce one of the following effects:

items: You can purify a portion of food or drink, rendering it free of poison and disease.
You can increase the potency of a {@item healing potion} for 1 hour. When you do so, the potion restores the maximum number of hit points instead of rolling.
You can create up to 1 vials worth of {@item acid}, sealing wax, or perfume.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Naturecraft

prerequisite.other: {@feat Monsterbane|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Natural Defiance|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Metallurgist|TalentTreesMod}

entries: You can use the tools of an herbalist for a variety of purposes. By using 5 gps worth of common herbalist's supplies and spending at least 8 hours acquiring, preparing, and packing them into a kit, you can create an {@item herbalism kit|PHB} from scratch.
In addition to the other benefits an {@item herbalism kit|PHB} provides, you can spend 10 minutes to produce one of the following effects:

items: You can purify a portion of food or drink, rendering it free of poison and disease.
You can increase the potency of a {@item healing potion} for 1 hour. When you do so, the potion restores the maximum number of hit points instead of rolling.
You can create up to 1 vials worth of {@item acid}, sealing wax, or perfume.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Navigation Expert
entries: You are an expert at navigating, both at sea and on land. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item navigator's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient with them, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with them.
You can use navigator's tools to plot a course or to determine your location on land just as well as you can at sea.
The amount of time it takes you to use navigator's tools to perform any function is halved.

As part of a short rest, you can use scavenged or acquired materials to build a temporary set of {@item navigator's tools|phb} for when you lack access to a permanent one. This temporary set ceases to function after 1 hour.

name: Navigator
entries: You have developed the skills necessary to assist navigation at land and sea. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have proficiency in {@item navigator's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient in {@item navigator's tools|phb}, you can add a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier to any checks made while using them.
If you can see the stars or sun, you know which way is north.
You can tell which way the weather, including wind and temperature, is going to turn in the next 24 hours.

name: Navigator
entries: You have developed the skills necessary to assist navigation at land and sea. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have proficiency in {@item navigator's tools|phb}. If you are already proficient in {@item navigator's tools|phb}, you can add a bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier to any checks made while using them.
If you can see the stars or sun, you know which way is north.
You can tell which way the weather, including wind and temperature, is going to turn in the next 24 hours.

name: Navigator
entries: You are an expert with {@item Navigator's Tools|phb}.
You can use navigator's tools to plot a course or to determine your location on land just as well as you can at sea.
The amount of time it takes you to use navigator's tools to perform any function is halved.

As part of a short rest, you can use scavenged or acquired materials to build a temporary set of navigator's tools for when you lack access to a permanent one. This temporary set ceases to function after 1 hour.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Necropolitan High Magic
entries: You have mastered your animating force, and can use it to cast spells of dark necromantic power. You learn the {@spell toll the dead|xge} cantrip. You also learn the {@spell blindness/deafness} and {@spell animate dead} spells, each of which you can cast once at its lowest possible spell level without expending a spell slot. If you are using {@spell animate dead} from this source to reassert control over a creature, it can only ever assert control over one creature. You regain the ability to cast those two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Negotiator
entries: You have honed the knack of the deal and counter offer, perhaps by crossing words with creatures used to getting the upper hand in negotiations. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature two or more size categories larger than you targets you with a melee weapon attack, you can use your reaction to make yourself seem pathetic and unthreatening. The creature must redirect its attack against a different target; if no alternative target is within the attacker's reach or range, it can still attack you. Until the end of your next turn, your next melee or ranged attack against that creature is made with advantage. You must complete a short or long rest before using this ability again.

When you purchase a good or service, you can attempt an opposed Charisma (Persuasion) check versus the seller's Wisdom (Insight). If you win the contest, you secure a 10 percent discount on the transaction. Once you use this feature on a given individual, you can't use it on them again for one week.
When you pay for lifestyle expenses during downtime, they are halved.

name: Nerves of Steel
entries: You are difficult to startle and stay calm under pressure. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
When you take psychic damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to psychic damage (including from the triggering attack) until the start of your next turn.

name: Nerves of Steel
entries: You are difficult to startle and stay calm under pressure. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have resistance to psychic damage.
When you make a saving throw against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on that roll.

name: Net Master
entries: Extensive training with {@item net|phb|nets} has earned you the following benefits:

items: You don't suffer disadvantage when attack a creature within 5 feet of you with a net, or when throwing a net up to its long range.
You can add your proficiency bonus to the DC, AC, and damage requirement for escaping or destroying your nets.
When you use the {@action Attack} action and attack with a net, you can use a bonus action to attack with a {@filter one-handed weapon|items|type=Melee Weapon|property=!Two-handed} you are holding.

name: Net Master
entries: Extensive training with {@item net|phb|nets} has earned you the following benefits:

items: You don't suffer disadvantage when attack a creature within 5 feet of you with a net, or when throwing a net up to its long range.
You can add your proficiency bonus to the DC, AC, and damage requirement for escaping or destroying your nets.
When you use the {@action Attack} action and attack with a net, you can use a bonus action to attack with a {@filter one-handed weapon|items|type=Melee Weapon|property=!Two-handed} you are holding.

name: Net Master
entries: When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make the same number of attacks you can normally make with any weapon, instead of just one. Also, being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on attack rolls you make with a net.
Finally, you can spend 10 minute to repair a broken net, no material cost required.

name: Netherhound Companion
entries: You can call upon the Hunting Packs of your Patron. You may use {@spell Find Familiar} once per long rest without requiring material components. Regardless of the creature type you summon, its appearance is a smaller version of your own canine appearance, although it retains the abilities of the creature type you call upon.

name: Next Move

prerequisite.other: {@feat Connoisseur of Lies|TalentTrees} or {@feat Deprogramming|TalentTrees} or {@feat Sentinel|TalentTrees}

entries: Once per round, you can make an attack of opportunity without using your reaction.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Next Move

prerequisite.other: {@feat Connoisseur of Lies|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Deprogramming|TalentTreesMod} or {@feat Sentinel|TalentTreesMod}

entries: Once per round, you can make an attack of opportunity without using your reaction.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Night Blessed
entries: You were born aligned with shadows, instead of the sun, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Covert
entries: When you are hidden and a creature discovers you with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a Reaction to quickly conceal yourself. If your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) roll beats the creature's Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you silently reposition yourself and the creature doesn't notice you. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Craven
entries: When an enemy you can see misses you with a Melee attack, you can take a Reaction to move 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entries.name: Stealthy
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Stealth} skill.

name: Night Glider
entries: Your people are quite familiar with mounts, mainly dinosaurs. You gain the following benefits:

items: The range of your Silent Speech trait increases to 90 feet.

You can cast the {@spell animal friendship} spell at a range of 90 feet. You can cast this spell once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can do so again. Additionally, you can cast this spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

You can use your Silent Speech to speak telepathically with a beast {@condition charmed} by you, or your mount if you have one. The beast or mount will understand you even if you don't share a language, but you have no special ability to understand it in return.

name: Nilbog Trickery
entries: You learn the mischievous ways of your spirit-possessed kin, able to taunt and fool your enemies with ease. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell vicious mockery} cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

When a creature you can see targets you with an attack or a harmful spell, you can use your reaction to force the creature to first make a Wisdom saving throw. The DC for this saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This ability doesn't protect you from area effects, such as the explosion of a {@spell fireball}. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Nimble
entries: You can leap from place to place, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
You can use Dexterity instead of Strength to calculate jumping distances and if you use Strength, your jumping distance is doubled.
You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks to escape non-magical effects that {@condition grappled|PHB|grapple} or {@condition restrained|PHB|restrain}.
You can add your Dexterity modifier when determining your jump distance for your high and long jumps.

name: Nimble Combatant
entries: You are uncannily nimble and agile even for a member of your diminutive race, with matching tenacity and grit. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can take the {@action Dodge} action as a bonus action on your turn. You can only do this up to a number of times equal to 1 + half your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
You have advantage on Dexterity checks made to avoid becoming {@condition grappled} by a creature of a size larger than you.

name: Nimble Kobold
entries: Your nimble nature allows you to take advantage of openings in enemies defenses made by an allies attack.

items: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than you.
You can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Dash} action as a bonus action on each of your turns.
When an ally makes a melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

name: Nimble Kobold
entries: Your nimble nature allows you to take advantage of openings in enemies defenses made by an allies attack.

items: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than you.
You can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Dash} action as a bonus action on each of your turns.
When an ally makes a melee attack against a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature.

name: Nimble Physique
entries: You are small and thin for your race. You have a mysterious and consistent ability to avoid danger. This feat grants the following benefits:

items: As long as you are not wearing armour, you may take the dodge action as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once) per long rest.
You can fit and squeeze through spaces as though you were one size smaller than you are.
Moving through spaces occupied by allies does not impose movement penalties.

name: Nimble Physique
entries: You are small and thin for your species. You have a mysterious and consistent ability to avoid danger. You gain the following benefits:

items.name: Dodgy
entries: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|XPHB}, you can take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Slippery
entries: While you are {@condition Grappled|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, your attacks don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} and attacks against you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

name: Nimble Tumbler
entries: You have trained your body to be more nimble and spry, granting you the following benefits:

items: While you are {@condition prone}, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.
You are resistant to fall damage while you aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

You may attempt to tumble through the space of a hostile creature without using extra movement or incurring opportunity attakcs. To do so, you must make a Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. The DC is equal to 10 or 5 + the hostile creature's Challenge Rating, whichever is higher. If you fail, you must stop moving before entering the creature's space, and your speed becomes 0 until the end of your turn. You cannot end your turn in a hostile creature's space.

name: Nimbleness
entries: Your skill (or fortune?) in battle has increased with your growth in experience.

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC. You lose this bonus if you are {@condition incapacitated} or wielding a shield.

name: Nine Lives
entries: The tenacious luck of cats is the stuff of legend. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you would die as the result of failing your third death saving throw, or by taking excessive damage, mark a life on your character sheet. If you have not marked your 9th life, you miraculously survive the trauma and stabilize at 0 hit points.

Once you have marked your 9th life, your choice of Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you lose this feat's ability to miraculously stabilize you at 0 points instead of dying.

name: Nine-tails
entries: You've learnt to tap into the greater magic power within yourself. You gain an additional tail for every two character levels you posses up to a maximum of 9. For each tail you have you gain a use of the following feature:

entries.name: Well of Arcana
entries: During a short rest you can expend one use of this feature to regain a 1st level spell slot. You may expend multiple uses of this feature to regain spell slots of higher levels with the uses expended being equal to the spell slot's level (maximum of 3rd level).
You regain one use of this feature after finishing a long rest.

name: Nocturnal
entries: You have spent many formative years in the darkness of night. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@spell Darkvision|XPHB}, its range increases by 30 feet.

entries.name: Slink in Shadows
entries: Whenever you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) check while in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the {@dice d20} as a 10.

name: Nocturnal
entries: Due to extensive exposure to the dark, and possible supernatural abilities, you have an unmatched ability to fight adversaries in the dark. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain Darkvision with a radius of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, then the radius of your darkvision increases by 30 feet, to a maximum of 120 feet.
You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in dim light or nonmagical darkness.

name: Node Spellcasting

prerequisite.other: The ability to cast at least one spell

entries: You have discovered the secret of node magic. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell node door|JBoE} and {@spell node lock|JBoE} spells. You can cast each of these spells once without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
You are aware of the presence of any earth node within 30 feet of you.

When you come across a naturally occurring earth node, you can use an action to store one spell that you can cast of 1st level or higher in the node. As part of casting the spell, you can set a condition that will trigger the spell. If the spell has an area of effect, it is centered on the node. If the condition is not met within 24 hours, the spell within the node is lost.

name: Nonbeliever
entries: You are a heretic of the avia-ra, and have turned your back on the Sun Above. You can't gain this feat if you have the Mantle of the Sun feat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, and that creature begins to make death saving throws, it automatically gains one failure.
You can cast the spell {@spell darkness} once without using a spell slot or spell components. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

When a creature you can see regains hit points due to magic, you can use your reaction to cause that creature to lose that many hit points instead. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Nopperabō
entries: You have mastered shapechanging, to the point where you have some control over the form you assume.

items: You learn the {@spell disguise self} spell and can cast it a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

While in your humanoid form, you can use an action to temporarily take the appearance of a {@i nopperabō}, a humanoid with no facial features. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A target automatically succeeds on the save if it can't see you. On a failed save, a target becomes {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute, or until you dispel your {@i nopperabō} appearance with a bonus action (whichever occurs first). If the frightened target takes any damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once you have used this ability, you are unable to use it again until you have finished a short or long rest.

name: Norn-Touched
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fates' Favor
entries: Once per day, when you make a {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to the result. You can see the result of the roll before you use this feature.

entries.name: Fates' Scorn
entries: Once per day, when another creature rolls a {@dice d20} for an attack roll or ability check, you can subtract your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} from the result. You can see the result of the roll before you use this feature.

name: Northern Raider
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Born on the Water
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item navigator's tools|XPHB}.

entries.name: Blood in the Water
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks that you make the turn that you exit the water or exit a ship.

name: Northlands Hardiness
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Weather Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG}. If you already have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage, you also gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against Cold damage.

entries.name: Inexhaustible
entries: The first time in a day that you receive a level of {@condition Exhaustion}, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is not reduced. In addition, you may ignore the effects of {@condition Exhaustion} on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}.

name: Not Of This World
entries: Your connection to the Ethereal Plane is even stronger than most lemurians. You gain the following benefits:

items: You regain the use of your Vision Beyond Sight racial trait when you finish a short or long rest.
While you are partially ethereal as a result of using your Ethereal Step racial trait, you have resistance to all damage except force and psychic.

As an action, you can detect the distance and direction to all portals that connect the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal within 1 mile. After you use this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

name: Novice Occultist
entries: You have learned the hidden ways of pactmaking, and can summon a few minor spirits to your aid.

items: You gain the {@class binder|MFoVBinder|Soul Binding|binder|null|soul binding 1} feature.

You bind one {@filter Minor Spirit|optionalfeatures|source=null|feature type=ms} to your service, and can use its abilities. No matter how many minor spirits you have bound to you, you can only have one active at a time.

entries: You learn to summon a {@filter first level vestige|optionalfeatures|source=null|feature type=vs1}, with difficulty. As an action, you can bind this vestige and use its powers and abilities, while you maintain concentration on the binding as you would a spell. If you lose concentration, or after 1 minute, the vestige is expelled. You always make a poor pact with this vestige, unless you have levels in a class that grants you vestige binding.
After summoning this vestige, you must take a long rest before you can summon it again.

name: Novice Occultist
entries: You have learned the hidden ways of pactmaking, and can summon a few minor spirits to your aid.

items: You gain the {@class binder|MFoVBinderFoundry|Soul Binding|binder|null|soul binding 1} feature.

You bind one {@filter Minor Spirit|optionalfeatures|source=null|feature type=ms} to your service, and can use its abilities. No matter how many minor spirits you have bound to you, you can only have one active at a time.

entries: You learn to summon a {@filter first level vestige|optionalfeatures|source=null|feature type=vs1}, with difficulty. As an action, you can bind this vestige and use its powers and abilities, while you maintain concentration on the binding as you would a spell. If you lose concentration, or after 1 minute, the vestige is expelled. You always make a poor pact with this vestige, unless you have levels in a class that grants you vestige binding.
After summoning this vestige, you must take a long rest before you can summon it again.

name: Numb*
entries: The ice in your blood grows ever colder as you grow in power. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your Cold damage bonus on melee weapons becomes a 1d6.
Once per day as an action, you can surround yourself with ice. For one minute, everything within 10ft of you becomes difficult terrain.

name: Numenera Adept
entries: You learn a method whereby you can cause any numenera device that you carry or that is within 5 feet of you to create either of the following two specific effects as your action. Your Intelligence score is your associated ability. You either Force Onslaught or Mindslice by doing one of the following: burning out a cypher; rolling for depletion with a relic; using a charge with iron flesh. In all cases, the device's normal function is suppressed and one of the two effects described hereafter occurs instead. Some devices—especially those not under their control—might require that the character first succeed on a DC 15 (or higher) Intelligence check as a bonus action. In addition, some devices (particularly pills and injections) cannot be altered in this way.

items: {@b Force Onslaught:} As if making a simple weapon ranged attack, you project a beam of force at a target within 60 feet that you can see. It deals 10 ({@damage 3d6}) force damage.

{@b Mindslice:} You focus your mental energy to blast the thought processes of another creature within 60 feet that you can sense. It deals 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage if the target fails a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, or half that if they succeed.

name: Object Lesson
entries: When a creature that believes you are a normal object, rather than a mimic, touches or physically interacts with you, you can use your

{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} using your pseudopod against that creature. You have advantage on the attack roll, and on a hit you deal an extra ({@dice 2d6}) damage. This extra damage increases by {@dice 2d6} at 8th ({@dice 4d6}), 12th ({@dice 6d6}), and 16th ({@dice 8d6}) level

name: Object Reader
entries: Your time spent studying and transforming into objects has granted you a mystical ability to understand them and experience the emotional auras dyed into the object's history. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can place a hand on an object as an action in order to learn a piece of information about an emotional event that occurred involving the object some time within the past week. When you first use {@variantrule Object|XPHB} Reader on an object, you don't choose the topic of information you receive, and you can't choose the event in question if there were multiple emotional events in the last week. However, if you use your {@variantrule Object|XPHB} Reader feat on the the same item multiple times, you can either choose to focus on an event further to gain additional pieces of information about that same event, or to move on to gain a piece of information about a different emotional event within the applicable time frame. If you choose to move on to another event, you still can't choose the new event

name: Objects of Legend
entries: When you notice a magical item, you recognize the item's rarity, and if it is of legendary rarity, its name or the name of its previous owner. You also have advantage on appropriate checks to gain any further information about the object.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Objects of Legend
entries: When you notice a magical item, you recognize the item's rarity, and if it is of legendary rarity, its name or the name of its previous owner. You also have advantage on appropriate checks to gain any further information about the object.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Observant
entries: You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score. If you can see a creatures mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what its saying by reading its lips.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Observant
entries: You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score. If you can see a creatures mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what its saying by reading its lips.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Observant
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first two available Tiers of the Observant Feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Observant Feat:}

name: Observant
entries: Quick to notice details of your environment, you gain the following benefits:

items: If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips.
You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score.

name: Occult Investigator
entries: You have mired yourself in the study of byzantine beings, and developed a nose for tracking the magic they employ. You gain the following benefits:

items: Choose three schools of magic. You can always sense the presence of magic from the chosen schools as if by the detect magic spell, and you have a +5 to any Intelligence check you make regarding magic from those schools.

When a creature casts a spell that causes it to vanish from your sight, you can use your reaction to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against the creature's spell save DC. On a success, you track the creature's path through the Weave and determine its location if it is within 300 feet of you, or the direction of its travel if it is not.

name: Occult Specialist
entries: You delve deeper into your tradition perfecting a new rite. You can select an {@filter Occult Rite|optionalfeatures|source=BelzorMM|feature type=ktor} from the Occultist class Occult Rite list. You cannot select a rite you already know, or one that requires a level restriction, even if you are already of that level. You can only select one from a subclass list if you are have at least one level in that subclass.

name: Occult Specialist
entries: You delve deeper into your tradition perfecting a new rite. You can select an Occult Rite from the Occultist class {@filter Occult Rite|optionalfeatures|source=KT-CLL|feature type=KT:OR} list. You cannot select a rite you already know, or one that requires a level restriction, even if you are already of that level. You can only select one from a subclass list if you have at least one level in that subclass.

name: Occult Specialist
entries: You delve deeper into your tradition perfecting a new rite. You can select an {@filter Occult Rite|optionalfeatures|source=KT:O|feature type=ktor} from the Occultist class Occult Rite list. You cannot select a rite you already know, or one that requires a level restriction, even if you are already of that level. You can only select one from a subclass list if you are have at least one level in that subclass.

name: Occultist
entries: Your knowledge of the goals and behaviors of cults gives you deeper insight into dealing with them and what they worship. You can choose to use your bonus to {@skill Religion} in place of your bonus to {@skill Deception}, {@skill Investigation}, or {@skill History} for checks you make with those skills when dealing with fey, fiends, celestials, aberrations, or their cults.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Occultist
entries: Your knowledge of the goals and behaviors of cults gives you deeper insight into dealing with them and what they worship. You can choose to use your bonus to {@skill Religion} in place of your bonus to {@skill Deception}, {@skill Investigation}, or {@skill History} for checks you make with those skills when dealing with undead, fiends, celestials, aberrations, or their cults.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Offhand Steel
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Offhand Steel
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Ogre-Blooded
entries: Your coarse features and monstrous build betray that one of your parents is an ogre. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, and in darkness as if it were {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Monstrous Strength
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} skill. Additionally, when you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, you can treat the result as a 10, or your level plus your Strength modifier, whichever is higher.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

name: Old Dog, New Tricks
entries: Choose two skills and gain proficiency in both.

name: One Last Favor*
entries: Though Beyt is no more, he hasn't left his greatest creations without a final blessing, to aid them in their new world. You gain the Following Benefits:

items: As a Goliath, your Stone Endurance roll increases to a 1d20, and as a Jezeval you gain the Stone Endurance trait of the Goliaths with a 1d8 die.
Once per day you can cast {@spell Tongues|yastah} on yourself without expending a spell slot.

name: One with the Rider
entries: If a creature would target your mount with an attack or spell, you can choose to have the attack or spell target you instead.
When you or an allied creature casts a spell of 2nd level or lower targeting just you while you are mounted, you can choose to have the spell also affect your mount.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: One with the Rider
entries: If a creature would target your mount with an attack or spell, you can choose to have the attack or spell target you instead.
When you or an allied creature casts a spell of 2nd level or lower targeting just you while you are mounted, you can choose to have the spell also affect your mount.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: One with Wind
entries: You have mastered the supernatural ability striking like the wind, gaining the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Bonus.} Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Wind Walker.} You are not affected by difficult terrain or additional movement costs when the difficult terrain or movement cost comes from strong winds (such as the gust of wind spell).
You gain the {@b Wind Strike} special attack (below).

entries.name: Wind Strike
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack, Supernatural)}
