When you summon your familiar in the chosen form, it gains temporary hit points equal to your level, and the 1st-level improvement on its improvement tree. When you reach 5th level, these temporary hit points are doubled, and you can also grant it one of the 3rd-level improvements on its improvement tree.

name: Spirit Fox
entries: As kitsune age and garner experience, they can ascend up the ranks of the kitsune, becoming a spiritual being. You have lived many years and have been granted a rank on the first rung of the spiritual ladder, known as {@i kiko}.

items: Your creature type is celestial.
You grow an additional tail, up ot a maximum of nine tails.

name: Spirit Rider
entries: You learn an ancient ritual that creates a spiritual totem from a bracelet, figurine, tribal mask, or other item, that unites rider and mount in a sacred bond. While you possess your totem, you gain the following benefits:

items: You can communicate telepathically with your mount.
You have advantage on {@skill Animal Handling} checks made to control your mount, and your mount has advantage on {@skill Acrobatics} and {@skill Athletics} checks.
You can communicate simple ideas through sounds and gestures with other creatures of the same type as your mount.

name: Spiritual Awakening
entries: You have spent many quiet hours learning to commune with the invisible world of Spirits. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell mage hand} and {@spell seance|llspell} Cantrips, but they do not count against your number of Cantrips Known.

You learn the {@spell unseen servant} spell, and you can cast it at-will without expending a spell slot. When you do so, Wisdom is your spellcasting modifier, and the servant takes the shape of a local Spirit. you can only have one unseen servant conjured at a time. Should you conjure another, the first servant is instantly dispelled.

name: Spiritual Boon
entries: Gain the first two available Tiers of the Spiritual Boon feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Sorcerous Blood Feat:}
{@b Choose Between:}

name: Spray 'n' Pray

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency with a magitech firearm or {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting}

entries: You've learned to unleash the full potential of mechanised ranged weapons, leaving aiming down to lady luck. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can reload firearms and {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting|tommybows} as a bonus action or an action.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a one-handed firearm or {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} you are holding.

After you take the Attack action with a {@item tommybow|HelianasGuidetoMonsterHunting} or magitech firearm, you can use a bonus action to quickly make one or two additional ranged weapon attacks using the same weapon. If you choose to make two attacks, you take a -5 penalty to both attack rolls. You don't add your ability modifier to the damage of the bonus attack(s), unless that modifier is negative.

name: Spray and Pray
entries: When it comes to firing a blaster, quantity often beats quality. By holding down the trigger and firing nonstop, you gain the following benefits:

items: As an action, while wielding a weapon that has the Automatic property, you can target a 10-foot cube area with a hail of bullets. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) or take the weapon's normal damage.
You can use your Strength modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier when making attack rolls with a weapon that has the Mounted property.

name: Springtail Agility
entries: You are uncommonly agile and dexterous, even relative to your springtail kin, granting you the following benefits:

items: As a bonus action, you can leap a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus. This leap doesn't cost you any movement but your speed must be greater than 0 feet, and it does not provoke opportunity attacks. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Sprinter
entries: You are built for bursts of impressive speed. Increase your base movement by 10 feet.When you use the {@action Dash} action, you can ignore the first opportunity attack you would provoke.

name: Sprite Physical Gifts
entries: You have honed your tiny body past its physical peaks, making use of your fey nature to strengthen yourself beyond the normal limits of your size. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your base flying speed increases by 10 feet.
You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift, including for your grapples.
You ignore the effects of your Puny Body racial trait.

name: Spry Movement
entries: You manifest some of you lagomorph heritage. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell jump} spell, and can cast it as a bonus action without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your proficiency modifier, casting the spell this way you can only target yourself.
You regain all uses of this ability when you finish a long rest.

name: Stabilize Animal
entries: You can use Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) instead of Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) to stabilize a beast that has been reduced to 0 hp, calming and soothing the animal under your care, If you succeed on the check, the beast then regains 1 hit point.
Additionally, you have advantage on {@skill Animal Handling} checks related to approaching or pacifying frightened or injuried beasts.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Stabilize Animal
entries: You can use Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) instead of Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) to stabilize a beast that has been reduced to 0 hp, calming and soothing the animal under your care, If you succeed on the check, the beast then regains 1 hit point.
Additionally, you have advantage on {@skill Animal Handling} checks related to approaching or pacifying frightened or injured beasts.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Staff Expert
entries: You've unlocked the deadly ranged potential of the {@item Staff|XPHB}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Arcane Artillery
entries: When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater using a {@item Staff|XPHB} as your {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to double the range of the spell.

entries.name: Powerful Focus
entries: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a cantrip you cast using a {@item Staff|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB}, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

entries.name: Explosive Casting
entries: If all targets of a spell you cast using a {@item Staff|XPHB} as your {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} are more than half the spell's range from you, one creature of your choice that you hit with a spell attack or that fails a saving throw against the spell has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

name: Staff Master
entries: While you are wielding a bo staff, club, greatclub, or quarterstaff and no other weapons, you gain the following benefits:

items: As a bonus action on your turn, you can take a defensive stance, gaining a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can make a melee attack against a creature one size larger than you or smaller. On a hit, you deal no damage but instead push the creature 5 feet or knock it prone.
The first time you score a critical hit on a creature on a turn, it is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

name: Staff Master
entries: While you are wielding a bo staff, club, greatclub, or quarterstaff and no other weapons, you gain the following benefits:

items: As a bonus action on your turn, you can take a defensive stance, gaining a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can make a melee weapon attack against a creature no more than one size larger than you. On a hit, you deal no damage but instead push the creature 5 feet or knock it {@condition prone}.
The first time each turn you score a critical hit on a creature, it is {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn.

name: Stage-Fighting
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item rapier|PHB|rapiers}, {@item sickle|PHB|sickles}, {@item scimitar|PHB|scimitars}, {@item trident|PHB|tridents}, {@item dagger|PHB|daggers}, and {@item dart|PHB|darts}. You can use your Charisma modifier in place of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack rolls with these weapons, but not the damage rolls.
In addition, when you score a critical hit with one of these weapons, you can use your reaction to take the {@action Help} action if there is an ally within 30 feet of you.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Stage-Fighting
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item rapier|PHB|rapiers}, {@item sickle|PHB|sickles}, {@item scimitar|PHB|scimitars}, {@item trident|PHB|tridents}, {@item dagger|PHB|daggers}, and {@item dart|PHB|darts}. You can use your Charisma modifier in place of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for attack rolls with these weapons, but not the damage rolls.
In addition, when you score a critical hit with one of these weapons, you can use your reaction to take the {@action Help} action if there is an ally within 30 feet of you.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Staggering Critical
entries: Your piercing critical hits leave your opponents reeling. You gain the following benefits:

items: When wielding a one-handed melee weapon that deals piercing damage, you score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.
When you score a critical hit with a onehanded melee weapon that deals piercing damage, the target falls {@condition prone} if it is no more than one size larger than you.

When you score a critical hit with a onehanded melee weapon that deals piercing damage against a {@condition prone} creature, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failure, the creature is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.
When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack using Strength, the target's speed is reduced to 0 and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

name: Stalker
entries: You are an expert at hunting prey. You are never more at home than when on a hunt, and your quarry rarely escapes you. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Stealth} and {@skill Survival} skills.
You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to track a creature you have seen in the past 24 hours.

name: Stalwart Guardian
entries: You put yourself into harm's way to protect your allies. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use the {@action Help} action on a friendly creature within 5 feet of you, you can cause all attacks against that creature to be made with disadvantage until the start of your next turn. You must be wielding a melee weapon or a shield and remain within 5 feet of the friendly creature to be able to defend them in this way.
If a creature you are defending in this way takes damage, you can use your reaction to take half of the damage the creature would take yourself.

name: Star and Shadow Reader
entries: Illuminators mine the movements of the heavens to extract valuable insights. Heavenly bodies neither predict nor control the future, but all things are interconnected by patterns of light and darkness. A person who understands the patterns can discern information about one thing by studying another.
By tracking the movements of the heavens, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you gain this feat, choose either radiant or necrotic damage. Spells you cast ignore resistance (but not vulnerability) to the type of damage you chose.
You can cast {@spell augury} once between each of your long rests without expending a spell slot.
You gain {@sense darkvision} to a distance of 15 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision}, increase its range by 15 feet.

name: Star of Ice and Hate

prerequisite.other: Requires a fragment of Delban's soul

entries: The fragment Delban's divine soul that resides within has awaken. Because of that, your affinity with cold becomes clear. When you gain this feat, you gain the following benefits:

items: Spells you cast ignore resistance to the cold damage.
When you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals cold damage, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
When you cast a spell that deals acid, fire, lightning or thunder damage, you can spend 1 sorcery point to change that damage type to cold.

entries: This feat can stack with the {@feat Elemental Adept|phb} feat. If you take that feat choosing the cold element, treat immunity to cold as resistance to cold instead and you can also treat any 1 or 2 rolled on a damage die of a cold damage spell as a 3.

name: Star of Ice and Hate

prerequisite.other: Requires a fragment of Delban's soul

entries: The fragment Delban's divine soul that resides within has awaken. Because of that, your affinity with cold becomes clear. When you gain this feat, you gain the following benefits:

items: Spells you cast ignore resistance to the cold damage.
When you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals cold damage, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
When you cast a spell that deals acid, fire, lightning or thunder damage, you can spend 1 sorcery point to change that damage type to cold.

entries: This feat can stack with the {@feat Elemental Adept|phb|Elemental Adept} feat. If you take that feat choosing the cold element, treat immunity to cold as resistance to cold instead and you can also treat any 1 or 2 rolled on a damage die of a cold damage spell as a 3.

name: Starguide
entries: As a starguide, you are uniquely qualified for the task of charting unknown systems and braving the Galactic Frontier. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in {@skill Investigation}.
You have advantage on saving throws you make against natural hazards, such as radiation and high gravity, that you encounter in space and in harsh planetary environments.
You can add 5 whenever you roll on the Blind Jump table for an unassisted jump. If your result is greater than 100, you treat the roll as a 100.
You are immune to the effects of Roach addiction.

name: Starter Package
entries: You gain the following benefit and the first available Tiers of the Starter Package Feat:
The Options of the Starter Package:

name: Steady Marksman
entries: You've learned to steady your aim, granting you unerring accuracy. You gain the following benefits:

items: Being prone doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks. Additionally, the short and long range of your ranged attacks are doubled while you are prone.
As an action, you can steady your aim and grant yourself a +10 bonus on the next ranged attack roll you make before the end of your next turn.

name: Stealth Grapple*
entries: When hidden from your target and an others that might have seen you approach (Allies excluded) you have advantage on your grapple check. If you succeed, you may use your reaction to follow it with one of the following moves. If you fail, you provoke an attack of opportunity or grapple of opportunity from your target. The move effect applies as long as the stealth grapple is maintained. While maintaining it, creatures other than your target have advantage on attack rolls against you, and you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

items: Gag: You attempt to gag the target's mouth to prevent it from making any sound. Make another opposed Grapple check with your target. On a success, the target is gagged until the grapple ends. A gagged creature cannot cast spells with verbal components and its speech is muffled and difficult to understand.

Choke Hold: You try to grab the creature by the throat and prevent it from breathing. Make another opposed Grapple check with your target with a disadvantage. On a success, the target is also gagged and suffocating until the grapple ends.

entries: Once you have them grappled and gaged you can do a Silent Take-down as one of your attack actions. (For reference an grapple attempt is an attack action. So if you only have one attack this will have to wait until your next turn if you have more then one then you may do this.)

items: Silent take-down: If your target is already grappled and gagged, you may attempt to strike it with a weapon with Silent property. Make an opposed Grapple check to maintain the hold on your target. If you succeed, you can make a single special melee attack at advantage. The damage from this attack is doubled.

name: Stealthy
entries: You know how best to hide. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Stealth} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.
If you are hidden, you can move up to 10 feet in the open without revealing yourself if you end the move in a position where you're not clearly visible.

You gain proficiency in stealth. If you already have proficiency in stealth, you add double your proficiency bonus when you make Stealth checks. If you already had double proficiency in Stealth, you gain advantage.
While hidden you add +2 damage rolls.

name: Steam Hydromancer
entries: You have learned techniques to direct your hydromancy spells through water vapor, and to direct fire spells through bodies of water, gaining the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell fog cloud|PHB} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast this spell in this way when you finish a long rest.
You can treat an area of fog, mist, or steam as a body of water when casting spells with the hydromancy tag.
When you cast a spell that deals fire damage, it gains the hydromancy tag with a hydromancy radius of 30 feet.
Fire damage dealt by spells you cast using hydromancy ignores resistance granted from being underwater.

name: Steam Hydromancer
entries: You have learned techniques to direct your hydromancy spells through water vapor, and to direct fire spells through bodies of water, gaining the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell fog cloud|PHB} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast this spell in this way when you finish a long rest.
You can treat an area of fog, mist, or steam as a body of water when casting spells with the hydromancy tag.
When you cast a spell that deals fire damage, it gains the hydromancy tag with a hydromancy radius of 30 feet.
Fire damage dealt by spells you cast using hydromancy ignores resistance granted from being underwater.

name: Steel Soul
entries: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You can perceive through the Shade's senses and control its actions, but you cannot willingly move it more than 30 feet from your body. When you are stabilized or have any hit points restored, the Shade disappears.

name: Steel Soul
entries: You gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, your Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When a Weaver feature (such as {@classFeature Bind|Weaver|Weaver|1|Weaver}, {@optfeature Pin Badge|Weaver|Needle Strike}, or the Hunter's {@subclassFeature Focus|Weaver|Weaver|Hunter|Weaver|3}) is interrupted as a result of taking damage, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, the damage you took does not interrupt any Weaver features.
Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.

name: Steel Wings*
entries: Through determination and your birthright to the sky, you have become a feat of aerial excellence. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can now dash as a Bonus Action while you are flying, doubling your basic flying speed
Hostiles cannot be granted an attack of opportunity on you while you are flying past them

name: Stheno
entries: The offspring of medusas—named sthenos—are usually conceived before the mother begins their transformation. With sharp features and a nest of snakes for hair, sthenos can be easily mistaken for their monstrous parent, but possess a gaze that falls short of turning people into stone.

entries.name: Immobilizing Gaze
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an immobilizing gaze. Choose a creature you can see within 60 feet of you that can see you to make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus). A creature that is immune to being {@condition restrained} automatically succeeds this saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition incapacitated} and its speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
You can use your Immobilizing Gaze a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Stinger
entries: You specialize in the quiet and agonizing kill with subtle weapons. You gain the following benefits related to blowguns and darts:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Constitution ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Efficient Poisons.} When you apply a poison blowgun needle or dart, you can apply it to twice as many pieces of ammunition.

{@b Hidden Death.} If you attack while hidden from a target with a blowgun or dart, you can make a Dexterity (Stealth) check with a −5 penalty for each time you've hit the target this turn against their passive Wisdom (Perception) score (no action required). On a success, you remain hidden from that target, though the target will know which general direction you are in.

name: Stoic
entries: You are resilient to fear-incuding effects, and are stoic in the face of horror. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws to resist being {@condition frightened} or gaining madness effects.

name: Stoic
entries: You are resilient to fear-incuding effects, and are stoic in the face of horror. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on saving throws to resist being {@condition frightened} or gaining madness effects.

name: Stone Affinity
entries: You are granted a special affinity with stone, allowing you to borrow and harness its power.

You learn the {@spell impact|KT-CLL} and {@spell manipulate earth|SpellsThatDontSuck} cantrip, and learn the become stone spell. You can cast it innately without expending a spell slot once, regaining the ability to so when you complete a short or long rest. When you cast it this way, you cast it a level equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Stone Eyes
entries: Your Petrifying Gaze has come into its own. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Powerful Petrification
entries: If a creature that has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition as a result of one of your spells or your Medusa's Gift trait fails a saving throw to end the effect by 5 or more, you can choose to turn that creature to stone. Any magical effects causing the creature to have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition end, and the creature has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. You must concentrate to maintain the effect. If you lose your {@status Concentration|XPHB}, the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition ends. If you maintain your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on the effect for the entire possible duration, the target is {@condition Petrified|XPHB} until the condition is ended by {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic.

name: Stone Soul
entries: You were born with a dwarflike, innate sense about rock, stone, and construction. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks that involve stone or stony surfaces.
If you spend at least 1 minute analyzing a structure, you can find crucial load-bearing points in the structure, informing you of the best way to demolish it.
When in a cave or cavern, you can read the strata. You always know which direction will take you to the entrance of a cavern.

name: Stone-Hard
entries: The Dwarves were made to be strong to endure, for they came unto the world when a great evil ruled Middle-earth. As long as your spirit supports your strength you can resist any hurt of body more hardily than most.

items: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Stone-whisperer
entries: {@i 4th-Level Feat. Repeatable: No.}

entries.name: Stone Whisper
entries: You can cast the {@spell stone shape} spell once per day without requiring material components and without using a spell slot. This is increased to three times per day at level 10, five times per day at level 15, and an unlimited number of times per day at level 20.

entries.name: Whisper Back
entries: You have a {@sense tremorsense} of 10 ft.

name: Stoneborn
entries: With cracked and abrasive skin, stoneborn appear as if they were roughly hewn from granite and have similarly rigid personalities. These near-humans are proud of their connection to Elemental Earth and believe themselves conquerors, fated to rule over every stone. You have the following racial traits:

entries.name: Stony Skin
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Armor Class.

entries.name: Sure-Footed
entries: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws you make to resist being knocked {@condition prone} or moved against your will.

entries.name: Oresight
entries: By placing your hand on natural stone and using your action to focus, you can feel the presence of any natural gems or metals within 100 feet of you.

items.name: 1st-level feat
items.entry: Gain a first level feat.

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20.

{@b Raining Death.} If you kill a creature within a single ranged weapon attack (reducing it from maximum hit points to 0 hit points) using the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one additional ranged weapon attack as a bonus action that turn.
Gain the {@b Arrow Storm} special attack (below)

entries.name: Arrow Storm
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack)}

When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks by firing innumerable pieces of ammunition into the sky which rain down around a point within 60 feet of you. All creatures within 10 feet of the point must make a Dexterity saving throw. On failure, they take {@damage 2d6} + your Dexterity modifier damage, or half as much on success. The number of d6 increases by one when your proficiency bonus increases (with the total number of d6 equaling your proficiency bonus).
A number of pieces of ammunition are consumed equal to the number of targets that make the save against the ability times two.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Stout-Hearted
entries: Living for many a year under the ever-present menace of Smaug the Dreadful has made the Bardings a courageous race. After all, there are not many creatures more fearsome than a great Dragon...

items: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws, and you cannot be {@condition frightened} by non-undead creatures.

name: Strange as News from Bree
entries: It is indeed true that the affairs of the four villages are the chief concern of the Bree-folk, but the most inquisitive among the inhabitants are always ready to gather what tidings come from distant lands. You have learnt that listening to the strange tales that travellers often talk about can prove to be very precious.

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Investigation} skill. If you are already proficient, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.
During each Fellowship Phase, you can receive a rumour from the Loremaster.

name: Strapping
entries: You're an exemplary athlete. You gain the following benefits:

items: A swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
A climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
Advantage on Constitution saving throws against exhaustion due to forced marches while traveling.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Strapping
entries: You're an exemplary athlete. You gain the following benefits:

items: A swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
A climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
Advantage on Constitution saving throws against exhaustion due to forced marches while traveling.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Strategic Insight
entries: You have a gift for identifying weaknesses. When you take the {@action Search} action, you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet (DC = 8 + its Challenge Rating). If you can observe it for at least 1 minute, add your level to the roll.
On a success, you learn one characteristic of your choice from the table below. Once you use this feature on a creature you cannot target it again until you finish a long rest.

rows: One Trait or Action from its stat block

name: Strategic Leader
entries: Each unit you control has +2 to Command.

name: Strategist
entries: The application of your studies in the field has given you the opportunity to improve them:

items: At the beginning of the first turn, if there are surprised enemies, you take your first turn before them and can affect allies playing after you for {@feat Tactician|TalentTreesMod} regardless of initiative. You take your second turn at your rolled initiative.
If you use change tactic while there are surprised enemies it is not expended.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Street Samurai
entries: You have rigorously trained your body and mind in the ways of street bushido, allowing you to unsheathe your weapons at incredible speeds and deflect gunfire, gaining the following benefits:

items: While you are holding a melee weapon, you can use your reaction to deflect the missile when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by {@dice 1d8} + an ability modifier you could use to modify an attack roll with the melee weapon (your choice) + your proficiency bonus.

The first time you draw a melee weapon in each combat, you gain advantage on your first attack with the weapon, and if the attack hits, it deals extra damage equal to {@dice 1d6} + your proficiency bonus.

You are familiar with the street bushido code. You know the names of other street samurai, you have advantage on Intelligence checks related to the origin and nature of weapons, and you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks to persuade others who follow street bushido.

name: Streetwise
entries: The character is proficient at navigating the lower district and rougher parts of town. When wearing the appropriate style of dress (commoner) the character can gain advantage on an {@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Insight} roll (as street-level individuals are more likely to let their guard down around the character) when interacting with a street-level individual or thug a number of times equal to their proficiency modifier; all uses are regained at the end of a long rest. In addition, the character can blend into most street-level areas without drawing attention.

name: Strength of Will
entries: You have been raised in a land dotted with desolate ruins and burial mounds. You have heard the dead whisper with cold voices out of lonely barrows, while ghostly lights dance on haunted hills. When your will strengthens your heart, there is hardly anything in this world that can dismay you.

items: You have advantage on Charisma saving throws.
Whenever you must make a Charisma saving throw, you gain a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).

name: Strengthened Wings
entries: Your wings have grown in size and strength, allowing you short bursts of flight. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have a flying speed equal to your movement speed. If you end your movement in the air, you fall.
When you are falling, you can use your reaction to slow your descent, taking no damage from the fall.

name: Striker
entries: You move like the wind, striking faster than your foes can see. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

{@b Battlefield Dancer.} Each time you hit a creature, your movement speed increases by 5 feet until the end of your turn. If you attack and hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can pass through its space, treating it as difficult terrain.
Gain the {@b Slashing Dash} special attack (below)

entries.name: Slashing Dash
entries: {@italic Active Ability (Attack)}
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with a rapid burst of movement, moving up to 30 feet along any surface in a straight line.

You can move on vertical or horizontal surfaces with this movement, can pass through creatures, and do not provoke attacks of opportunity, but cannot pass through objects or terrain. If you are carrying a weapon you are proficient with when you take this action, each time you pass through a creature, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) damage of your weapon type on a failed save, or half as much on a successful save. The number of d6 increases by one when your proficiency bonus increases (with the total number of d6 equaling your proficiency bonus).
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Striker
entries: You master a never ending series of movements and attacks.

items: Immediately before or after making a weapon attack with a melee weapon, you can move 5 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity.

entries.name: Flowing Strikes
entries: As an action, you can move up to 15 feet. Each time you move into range of a new creature, you can make one melee weapon attack against the creature. This can only hit a creature once per turn, and each time you move you can only attack once (even if moving into reach of multiple new creatures). You can make a maximum number of attacks this way equal to your proficiency bonus.

If you are wielding two weapons with the Light property, you can use your bonus action to make one additional attack in this way.Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

name: Striker
entries: In siegeball, strikers are players who play offensively, pursuing the ball and making shots at the opposing tower, while others on the team hang back and defend. Such players need high stamina and a thunderous strike, and gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with all siegeball weapons.
Whenever you hit a siegeball, it gains a +2 bonus to its momentum points.
When you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can choose one of the attack's damage dice and maximize it. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Strong Draw
entries: You can use Strength instead of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with {@item shortbows|PHB}, {@item longbows|PHB}, and {@item slings|PHB}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Strong Draw
entries: You can use Strength instead of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with {@item shortbows|PHB}, {@item longbows|PHB}, and {@item slings|PHB}.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Strong Jaw
entries: You have trained extensively with the earth pony knight weapons normally too large for a fingerless creature like you to wield. Gain the following benefits:

items: You may use the versatile property of a melee weapon without disadvantage.
You may wield two-handed weapons without disadvantage.
Any attempt to disarm you is made at disadvantage.

name: Strong Mind
entries: You are unusually difficult to affect with psionic powers and mind attacks. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to psychic damage.

At the end of each of your turns, if you are under the effects of a spell or ability that applies the {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} condition to you, the creature from which that effect originated takes psychic damage equal to your intelligence modifier + your proficiency bonus.

name: Strong-Arm

prerequisite.other: Replaces the {@feat Grappler|PHB} feat found in the Player's Handbook

entries: You've developed an iron grip for grappling in close quarters. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on attack rolls and Charisma (Intimidation) checks against a creature you are grappling.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with an attempt to restrain a creature {@condition grappled|PHB} by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, the creature is {@condition restrained|PHB} until the start of your next turn so long as it remains {@condition grappled|PHB} by you.

name: Strongdraw
entries: You can use strength instead of dexterity for weapons that don't have the loading property. If you do, masteries still treat your attack rolls as dexterity attack rolls. Add 1 to your weapon's base damage when you make an attack in this way.

items: As long as you are conscious, you cannot be shoved or knocked prone by creatures no more than one size larger than you.
You have advantages on Strength checks and saving throws against being shoved or knocked prone.

As a bonus action, you can take a defensive stance until the start of your next turn. While you are in the defensive stance, the area within 5 feet of you are considered as difficult terrain for your enemies, and other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter the area within 5 feet of you. The defensive stance ends early if you move or are incapacitated.

name: Student of Nature
entries: You also gain proficiency in the {@skill Nature} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it instead.
Furthermore, if you spend an hour studying a Plant, Beast or Monstrosity, either in its natural habitat or as a corpse, you learn the following characteristics about it:

items: Its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities
Its hitpoint maximum and CR.

name: Stunning Sniper
entries: You have mastered the use of ranged weapons to cripple your target from a distance. When you score a critical hit on a ranged attack roll, you can {@condition stunned|PHB|stun} the target until the start of your next turn instead of doubling the damage.

name: Styled Fighter
entries: You learn a fighting style:

items.name: Fighting Style
items.entry: You gain a fighting style feat

items.name: Repeatable
items.entry: You can take this feat more than once.

items: You learn one fighting style of your choice from the list available to the fighter class. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

name: Stylized Fighter
entries: You have learned to specialize in a particular method of combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You choose and learn one Fighting Style option of your choice among those available to the fighter class.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a Charisma ability check or Charisma saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new result, even if it is a 1.
Whenever you roll a 20 on an ability check or attack roll, you gain advantage on the first Charisma ability check you make within the next hour.

name: Suble Interaction
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks to move or conceal an object that you are holding that is small enough to fit in the palm of your hand.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Submariner
entries: Your time spent training beneath the waves has earned you the following benefits:

items: You gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
You add your proficiency bonus to the number of minutes for which you can hold your breath.
You add a your proficiency bonus to the number of rounds you can survive after running out of breath.

name: Submariner
entries: Your time spent training beneath the waves has earned you the following benefits:

items: You gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
You add your proficiency bonus to the number of minutes for which you can hold your breath.
You add a your proficiency bonus to the number of rounds you can survive after running out of breath.

name: Subtle Interaction
entries: You have advantage on {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks to move or conceal an object that you are holding that is small enough to fit in the palm of your hand.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Sufficiently Advanced
entries: Although Lemuria is no more, you have acquired some of its lost secrets. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill if you are not proficient in it already. If you are, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Intelligence (Arcana) check you make.
You learn any two cantrips of your choice. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these cantrips.

name: Summoner
entries: You specialize in the magic of summoning powerful creatures to aid you in combat. Any creature summoned or created by a spell that you cast appears with 1 extra hit point per Hit Die it has. While you are within 30 feet of it and you can see it and control it, it gains a bonus to its AC and saving throws equal to half your proficiency bonus, and any ability checks to dispel it are made with disadvantage. This feat does not affect creatures you summon that have class levels.

entries.name: Hit Dice for Summoned Creature
entries: Some summoning spells, such as {@spell summon beast|TCE} or {@spell summon shadowspawn|TCE}, use statistics for creatures that do not have any hit dice. When an effect such as that of the Summoner feat grants a creature extra hit points based on the number of Hit Dice it has, you can treat those creatures as if they had 1 Hit Die for every 8 maximum hit points, before any increases to hit points are applied.

name: Sundering Strikes

otherSummary.entry: Proficiency with Smith's Tools

entries: Years of experience in the forge have given you great knowledge of armament construction, letting you identify and target the weak spots in your foes' armor. Whenever you hit an armored enemy with a weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, the target's armor then takes a permanent and cumulative ?1 penalty to the AC it offers (applicable only to metallic, non-magical items). A piece of armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its total AC to 10. A creature can repair their broken armor over the course of a long rest.

name: Sunstaff Master
entries: You have mastered the sunstaff, the only true total weapon, capable of dispatching enemies in close quarters and at range. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use Dexterity modifier, instead of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls of quarterstaffs you wield.
Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action to make a ranged weapon attack with a sunstaff, you can make a melee weapon attack with it (as a quarterstaff) as a bonus action.
You don't suffer disadvantage from attacking with a blaster while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

name: Superhuman Ability
entries: Choose an ability score which is already at 20 and increase it to 24. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different ability score.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Charm Monster|XPHB} or {@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against the spell.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} but only as a ritual. You can cast {@spell Clairvoyance|XPHB} and {@spell Telepathy|XPHB}. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 Blood Point to gain an additional action. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Dodge|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Mass Suggestion|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the saving throw against the spell.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

When you take damage except Fire and Radiant, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage taken by your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} plus your Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1).

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can cast the {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. In addition, when you gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, you can expend up to 3 Blood Points to grant up to three other creatures that you can see within 30 feet of yourself the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The number of Blood Points expended in this way equals the number of creatures affected by this feat.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB|Black Tentacles} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, the {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB|Black Tentacles} deal {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 2d6} Cold damage (instead of {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage).

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend up to 6 Blood Points to increase your Strength score by an amount equal to the number of Blood Points expended in this way for 1 hour.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.
You can cast the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell without expending a spell slot.

name: Superior Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: The vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline is now second nature to you. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Meld into Stone|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, the object or surface must be dirt, sand, or clay, and the spell's duration becomes 24 hours for that casting.

name: Superior Marksman
entries: You have perfected the art of the slow, steady kill. You gain the following benefits when wielding a ranged weapon with the {@itemProperty H||heavy} property:

items: You gain a +1 to attack rolls with these weapons.
You can use a bonus action to steady your aim. You can make an attack roll that can neither have advantage nor disadvantage. On a hit, deal double the weapon's damage die.
If you make an attack roll with advantage, you can reroll one of the attack rolls once.

name: Superior Psionics
entries: Your psionic powers are superior to those of your brethren. You can cast {@spell jump} and {@spell invisibility} (targeting yourself only) once with this ability. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest.

name: Superior Shifting
entries: You have a strong connection to the beast within, strengthening your body and your ability to shift. You gain the following benefits:

items: Choose one of the ability scores affected by your subrace's Ability Score Increase. Increase this ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20
When you use your Shifting trait, the transformation lasts for ten minutes, until you die, or until you end it as a bonus action.
You can use your Shifting trait one additional time. You regain all uses when you complete a short or long rest.

name: Superior Shifting
entries: You have a potent connection to the beast within, strengthening your body and your ability to shift. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shifting Endurance
entries: At the start of your turn, you can use your Shifting trait (no action required). The transformation now lasts 10 minutes.

entries.name: Shifter Recovery
entries: You can use your Shifting trait one additional time. You regain 1 expended use when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Superior Technique
entries: You learn one maneuver of your choice from the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice.)

You gain two Stratagem dice, which are d6 (this die is added to any Stratagem dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A Superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended Superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

items: {@i Replaces {@feat Martial Adept}}

Choose a specialization - {@filter Cut-Throat|optionalfeatures|feature type=CM:C}, {@filter Mystic Knight|optionalfeatures|feature type=CM:M}, {@filter Savage|optionalfeatures|feature type=CM:S}, or {@filter Warlord|optionalfeatures|feature type=CM:W} - if you do not have one already. You learn two maneuvers from your chosen specialization or the {@filter Combat Maneuvers|optionalfeatures|feature type=CM} group, following the {@variantrule Maneuvers Expanded|marpro|rules above} except as modified below.
You gain two superiority dice, which is a {@dice d4}s (these dice are added to any superiority dice you have from another source) and does not change size as you gain levels.
If you gain this feat or feature again, you learn two additional maneuvers from your specialization or the Combat Maneuvers group, and gain two additional d4 maneuver dice.

Unless you also have {@subclassFeature Battle Master|Fighter||Battle Master||3||Combat Superiority}, you cannot replace maneuvers gained from this feature at the end of a long rest. Instead, when you gain a level, you can replace one maneuver you know with a different eligible maneuver from your specialization or the Combat Maneuvers group.

name: Supervisor
entries: When taking a short rest, the character can grant a number of willing creatures up to {@dice 1 + @abilities.int.mod|1 + their Intelligence modifier} temporary hit points equal to the character's {@dice @prof|proficiency bonus}.

name: Supportive Spell
entries: When you cast a spell which successfully affects an enemy creature, you may spend a sorcery point to give a friendly creature you choose within 15 feet of you advantage on their next roll against the target.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Animalism)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You cast the {@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB} spell as its level 7 version without expending a spell slot, and you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Once you cast the spell with this feat, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Auspex)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.
You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell True Seeing|XPHB} spell on yourself.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Celerity)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 2 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, when the spell ends, you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't reduced to 0.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Dominate)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You cast the {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB} spell as its level 7 version without expending a spell slot, and you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Once you cast the spell with this feat, you can't do so in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Fortitude)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

When you take damage except Fire and Radiant, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 2 Blood Points to reduce the damage you take by half (round down) or 4 Blood Points to reduce the damage to 0.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Obfuscate)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 1 Blood Point to cast the {@spell Greater Invisibility|XPHB} spell. When you cast the spell in this way, you can modify it so that it doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Oblivion)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

When a creature that you can see within 10 feet of you misses an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend 1 Blood Point to deal {@damage 2d8} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 2d8} Cold damage to that creature.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Potence)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 2 Blood Points to give yourself {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls using Strength for 1 minute. In addition, whenever you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll using Strength, you can reroll one of the dice once.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Presence)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast the {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB} spell on yourself. When you cast the spell in this way, the spell doesn't end if you make an attack roll, cast a spell, or deal damage.

name: Supreme Discipline Acquisition (Protean)
entries: You have learned all you can about a vampiric Discipline of another clan or bloodline. You gain the following benefits.

You can expend 3 Blood Points to cast {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} on yourself, shape-shifting into a {@creature Bat|XMM}, {@creature Cat|XMM}, {@creature Rat|XMM}, {@creature Raven|XMM}, or {@creature Wolf|XMM}. You can expend 1 additional Blood Point to shape-shift into a {@creature Dire Wolf|XMM}, {@creature Giant Bat|XMM}, {@creature Giant Rat|XMM}, or {@creature Panther|XMM}. While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

name: Sure at the Mark
entries: Hobbits are nimble and keen-eyed, qualities that make them good archers. You have honed this natural talent to perfection, so much so that you just need to stoop for a stone to find yourself armed with a deadly weapon.

items: You are proficient with improvised weapons.
When making a ranged attack with an improvised weapon, you can use your choice of your Strength or your Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls.

As a bonus action, you can give yourself advantage on your next ranged attack roll on the current turn. You can use this bonus action only if you haven't taken reactions during this turn, and after you use the bonus action, you cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

name: Sure-Footed
entries: Experienced with shifting terrain or the rocking and swaying of ships out at sea, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to resist being knocked {@condition prone}.

When a creature within 5 feet of you fails an ability check or saving throw against an effect that would knock it {@condition prone}, you can use your reaction to allow the creature to reroll the ability check or saving throw if you have at least one hand free.

name: Sure-Footed
entries: Experienced with shifting terrain or the rocking and swaying of ships out at sea, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to resist being knocked {@condition prone}.

When a creature within 5 feet of you fails an ability check or saving throw against an effect that would knock it {@condition prone}, you can use your reaction to allow the creature to reroll the ability check or saving throw if you have at least one hand free.

name: Surprising Riposte
entries: You are highly skilled in fighting with a onehanded finesse weapon. You gain the following benefits:

items: While wielding a finesse weapon in one hand and nothing in your other hand, you can use your reaction to make one melee attack against a creature within range that misses you with a melee attack.
While wielding a finesse weapon in one hand and nothing in your other hand, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

name: Surtr's Touch
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Touch of Flame
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can imbue your touch with the power of fire for 1 minute. During that time, when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal extra Fire damage equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can use this feat a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Survival of the Cunning*
entries: You gain the ability to always appear as your perfect person to those with True Sight or any ability to see through transformations. If you do change into something else they will still only see you as your perfect person instead of the new form or your true form. Those that suspect you can make an Investigation check vs 8+PB+CHA to determine you are not normal.

name: Survival Tactics
entries: You always have a trick up your sleeve to avoid a fatal blow, but a brush with death is still as scary as ever. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You become {@condition frightened} of whatever dealt the triggering damage to you for 24 hours. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

name: Survivalist
entries: You master wilderness lore, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival} skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist extreme weather phenomena (such as {@hazard extreme heat} and {@hazard extreme cold}) and wilderness hazards (such as {@hazard quicksand} and {@hazard slippery ice}).

name: Survivalist
entries: You can make fires, craft shelters, cook food, etc. even in difficult circumstances, without having to make a {@skill Survival} check.
In addition, select one terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or cavern. Difficult terrain doesn't slow down the group's travel.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Survivalist
entries: You can make fires, craft shelters, cook food, etc. even in difficult circumstances, without having to make a {@skill Survival} check.
In addition, select one terrain: arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or cavern. Difficult terrain doesn't slow down the group's travel.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Survivalist

items: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival} skill, and you gain the benefits of the {@classFeature Favored Terrain|Martial Ranger|TMR|1|TMR} feature from the {@homebrew martial} ranger class for one terrain type, choosing from arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or the Underdark.

entries: If you already have one or more favored terrains, you add an additional terrain type, but you cannot gain the {@classFeature Favored Terrain Master|Martial Ranger|TMR|9|TMR} benefit from the favored terrain granted by this feat, if you have that feature.

name: Survivalist
entries: Gain the first two available Tiers of the Survivalist feat:
{@b The Tiers of the Survivalist Feat:}

name: Survivalist Training
entries: You have been trained to survive, track, and explore in the wild, much like a Ranger. You gain the benefits listed below:

entries.name: Expert Marksman
entries: You learn a {@filter Knack|optionalfeatures|feature type=ll:sk} of your choice from those available to the Alternate Ranger. To learn this Knack, you must meet all prerequisites that it has.
If the Knack requires a Quarry Die, roll a d4 unless yours is higher. If the Knack forces a saving throw, the DC is equal to 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Wisdom modifier.

name: Survivor
entries: You are well-versed in surviving in hostile environments, even thriving where others are sure to perish. You gain the following benefits:

items: You require only half of the food and water normally required for a creature of your size.

You can withstand extreme temperatures indefinitely, and you automatically pass saving throws made against extreme heat and cold for a number of days equal to your Constitution or Wisdom modifier, whichever is lower. After this time, you must make saving throws as normal until you spend 24 hours in a comfortable temperature.

name: Survivor
entries: Your ability to make the best out of a bad situation has served you well. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hardy
entries: You need half the amount of food per day based on your size.

entries.name: Intuitive
entries: When you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks made when taking the {@action Study|XPHB} action.

entries.name: Shake It Off
entries: Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level, if any, decreases by 1. Additionally, when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 2.

items: You gain proficiency in {@skill Survival}.
When facing a creature for the first time, you can make a {@skill Survival} check to find its mostly deadly, non-spell feature.
During the first round of combat, you have resistance to all damage.

name: Survivor
entries: You're masterful at surviving in harsh environments and gain the following benefits:

items: You can choose to add your Wisdom modifier to one of your death saving throws. Once you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
When you're dying, you don't fall unconscious until you've failed at least one death saving throw.
If you succeed on 3 death saving throws, you regain 1 hit point.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Survivor
entries: You're masterful at surviving in harsh environments and gain the following benefits:

items: You can choose to add your Wisdom modifier to one of your death saving throws. Once you do so, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
When you're dying, you don't fall unconscious until you've failed at least one death saving throw.
If you succeed on 3 death saving throws, you regain 1 hit point.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Suspicious
entries: Whenever you make an {@skill Insight} check to determine if a creature is lying, after your roll but before the DM determines the result, if that check was not made at disadvantage, you can attempt to do so again at disadvantage and must take the new result.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Suspicious
entries: Whenever you make an {@skill Insight} check to determine if a creature is lying, after your roll but before the DM determines the result, if that check was not made at disadvantage, you can attempt to do so again at disadvantage and must take the new result.
{@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Swarmfighter
entries: There is nothing quite so satisfying as two swarm pistols releasing a hail of fire upon your enemies. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can draw or stow up to two weapons when you roll initiative and whenever you take an action on your turn.
Whenever you wield a weapon with the Foregrip property in one hand, you can double its range.
Blasters you wield in one hand which have the Light property deal an additional {@damage 1d4} damage on a hit.

name: Swift Artes

prerequisite.other: The ability to use at least one arte

entries: You gain the following benefits:

items: When a hostile creature provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to to use an {@filter arte|spells|school=AR|subschool=!Grand} rather than making an opportunity attack.

name: Swift Witchcraft
entries: You have honed your skills in the rituals of witchcraft and can quickly weave your magic in times of need. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Swift Invocation
entries: You can use an action to cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 minute. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Swimmer
entries: You have undergone extensive aquatic training to gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed.
You can hold your breath a number of minutes equal to 2 + twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 minute).
When you fall into water, you take no bludgeoning damage from the fall if you are not {@condition incapacitated}.
You can't be knocked {@condition prone} while you are underwater.

name: Swimmer
entries: You have undergone extensive aquatic training to gain the following benefits:

items: When you fall into water, you take no falling damage.
You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed.
You can hold your breath a number of minutes equal to 2 + twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 minute).
You can make unarmed strikes while underwater without disadvantage.

name: Swimmer
entries: You have undergone extensive aquatic training to gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed.
You can hold your breath a number of minutes equal to 2 + twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 minute).
When you fall into water, you take no bludgeoning damage from the fall if you are not {@condition incapacitated}.
You can't be knocked {@condition prone} while you are underwater.

name: Switchaxe Mastery
entries: You master fighting with the {@item switch axe|AGMH|switchaxe}, gaining the following benefits:

items: When you use a phial and critically hit with this weapon, you regain a number of expended {@optfeature phials|AGMH} equal to half the cost of the one you used (rounded up).
Your phials save DC is increased by 1.
You can use a free action on your turn to {@optfeature switch mode (sa)|AGMH|switch weapon modes}. This replaces your free action to draw or stow a weapon.

name: Swordmaster
entries: Your swordplay leverages every advantage to build momentum, allowing you to strike or defend in new ways. When wielding a sword, you gain a special Swordplay d6 die each time you successfully attack a creature with it. You can have a maximum number of Swordplay dice equal to your proficiency bonus. You lose all accumulated dice if you stop wielding a sword or end your turn without making an attack with a sword.
You can spend your Swordplay dice on the following abilities:

entries.name: Sword Parry
entries: As a reaction to being hit by a melee weapon attack, you can expend your Swordplay dice, rolling them and reducing the damage taken by the amount rolled. If the amount rolled exceeds the damage taken, the attacker takes damage equal to the difference.

entries.name: Sword Finisher
entries: As a bonus action when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend your Swordplay dice, rolling them and dealing additional damage equal to the roll.

name: Sylph Grand Magic
entries: Sylph Grand Magic

items: Your travels riding the wind have given you an instinctive control over it.
You can cast each of the following spells once with this ability: {@spell dust devil|XGE} (XGtE page 154, EEPC page 17), fog cloud, and warding wind (XGtE page 170, EEPC page 23).
Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and they are each cast at their lowest possible spell levels.
You regain the ability to cast any spells provided by this feat when you finish a long rest.
At 8th level, {@spell dust devil|XGE} is cast as a 3rd level spell, becoming cast as a 4th level spell at 12th level, a 5th level spell at 16th level, and a 6th level spell at 20th level

name: Synaptic Bind
entries: In your time, you were an exceptional Taker, and never let a quarry escape your grasp, a skill which confers the following benefits:

items: When you use your Neural Lock feature, the target is {@condition stunned}, instead of {@condition incapacitated}. Additionally, you regain the use of this ability when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Synchronized Combatant
entries: You have an intuitive understanding of your allies movement, allowing to coordinate perfectly with their actions. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1.

{@b Synchronized Movement.} Your space is not difficult terrain for your allies, and allies can move into your space to make an attack, but still cannot end their turn your space (and cannot move into your space if they don't have the movement to move out of it).

name: Syndicate Spy
entries: Rising in the ranks of the Ebon Syndicate has taught you the clandestine skills of spycraft, valuable in your trade as a racketeer. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Locksmith
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}. While holding {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, you can craft a key to a lock by spending 10 minutes with that lock.

entries.name: Master of Disguise
entries: You have proficiency with a {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB}. If you spend 10 minutes donning a {@item Costume|XPHB},  you decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and other distinguishing characteristics. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this benefit to become quadrupedal, for instance.

entries.name: Master Calligrapher
entries: You have proficiency with a {@item Forgery Kit|XPHB}. You aren't limited to 10 or fewer words when mimicking someone else's handwriting.

entries.name: Blending In
entries: When using the {@action Hide|XPHB} action to conceal yourself from creatures that aren't {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} to you, you need only be {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} and you may use Charisma instead of Dexterity for the check.

name: Tabaxi Curiosity
entries: Your desire for knowledge often lands you in dire situations, though you gain statisfaction from even near-death experiences. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Arcana}, {@skill History}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Investigation}, {@skill Nature}, or {@skill Religion}.

You have advantage on death saving throws, and whenever you make a death saving throw, your mind enters a tranquil space between life and death. There, you find yourself alone with a deity appropriate to your people, and you may ask it a single question that can be answered with "yes", "no", or "unknown". The deity answers to the best of its knowledge.

name: Tactical Combatant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Buffering Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total number rolled on the weapon's damage dice. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Honed Instincts
entries: When you fail an ability check, you can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

name: Tactical Combatant
entries: You excel at creating opportunities for other. You gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Ability Score Increase.} Increase one ability score of your choice by 1.
{@b Combat Help.} Once per turn when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can replace one attack with the {@action Help} action.
{@b Varied Tactics.} When you take the Help action to aid a friendly creature in attacking a target, the range becomes 10 feet and you can Help an additional creature as part of the same action.

name: Tactical Leader
entries: Each unit you control has +2 to Attack.

name: Tactical Training
entries: You have studied greater combat strategies that allow you to perform Tactical Exploits. You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Tactical Exploits Known
entries: You learn one of the following {@filter Tactical Exploits|optionalfeatures|feature type=ll:tte} of your choice from the {@loader Warlord|class/LaserLlama; Warlord.json} Class:

entries.name: Issuing an Order
entries: Once per turn, when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can use the Tactical Exploit in place of one attack. You can't use this Exploit more than once per turn unless you learn Tactical Exploits from a source other than this Feat.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can choose this Feat multiple times. Each time you do, raise one of the ability scores above by one, and learn one new Tactical Exploit from the table above.

items: A number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus of your choice, have advantage on initiative rolls.

When another creature that you can see within 30 feet makes an opportunity attack, you can use your reaction to give them advantage and +5 on the damage. If the attack misses, you regain your reaction.

name: Tactician
entries: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier when rolling initiative.

Once per short rest, during your turn you can use a bonus action to issue a command to change tactics. Two friendly creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you that can see or hear you exchange their initiative scores. Their scores must be lower than yours for the feature to apply.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTrees}.}

name: Tactician
entries: Your studies on military campaigns have taught you new ways to approach battles. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier when rolling initiative.

Once per short rest, during your turn you can use a bonus action to issue a command to change tactics. Two friendly creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you that can see or hear you exchange their initiative scores. Their scores must be lower than yours for the feature to apply.

entries: {@note This feat is meant to be used with the variant rule {@variantrule Talent Trees|TalentTreesMod}.}

name: Tactician
entries: You have studied history and learned to apply its lessons to battle. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
